chapters.title: Chapter 4051: Battle God Palace
paragraphs: Chapter 4051: Battle God Palace
Planets flashed before his eyes, ten thousand miles in an instant.
Peng!
Ling Han fell heavily, and crashed onto solid rock. Instantly, he felt a strong urge to vomit. However, his physique was too shocking, and this feeling immediately disappeared.
“Yi, this newcomer actually didn’t throw up!” A voice rang out.
“Stunned silly?” someone asked with a laugh.
“I don’t think so.”
Ling Han crawled to his feet, and saw that he should be in a cave. Torches were lit all around him, illuminating the space.

Aside from him, there were also 34 young people here. There were men and women, and they were either standing or sitting. Every single one of them was exuding an extraordinary aura. They were definitely giants among men.
That was definite.
How had he come here?

Naturally, it was that “stamp” on his hand that had acted as a lighthouse, stimulating the Transfer Formation that spanned across galaxies, and where had that “stamp” been placed? The Young Dragon Trial!
Was there no memory of it?
The Three Styles of the God of War… the Battle God Palace!
This was too ironic. He had just been targeted by the Battle God Palace, and in the end, he had actually been teleported to the Battle God Palace. This was practically walking into a tiger’s den.
Why had he changed his appearance and soul at the first instant?
The reason was very simple. He did not want to be recognized by the Battle God Palace.
“Hey, brat, have you gone stupid?” A young man shouted at Ling Han with a hint of disdain, “We are talking to you!”
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them. Everyone here was at the level of the Core Formation Tier. At this level, did he need to fear anyone?
“Do you know what’s going on?” Ling Han asked.
“Brat, I’m the one asking you!” The young man stood up, raised his voice, and shouted at Ling Han.
Peng!
Right at this moment, another person was teleported over, and fell from midair, landing solidly on the ground.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Peng, peng, peng!
One after another, in these few short minutes, twelve people were actually teleported over, one after another.

“Newcomers, all of you listen up!” The young man who had previously shouted at Ling Han cleared his throat, “My name is Li Lei, and this is Han Yue, our Boss Han. From now onwards, everyone has to listen to Boss Han.”
“What Boss Han? Why do we have to obey his commands?” Immediately, someone was defiant.
Li Lei humphed coldly, and said, “Because Boss Han is ranked 2537th in the Galaxy Network. Which one of you can catch up to him?”
When these words fell, everyone was instantly speechless.
Ranked in the 2000s in the Galaxy Network. That was too awesome. In any galaxy, this could be considered a top prodigy.
Meanwhile, Han Yue finally spoke up, saying, “You’ve all been teleported here, so do you have any clues?”
Quite a number of people shook their heads, but there were also some that nodded.
Han Yue smiled, “I believe that you have all participated in the Young Dragon Trial before, right?”

“Oh!” Instantly, realization dawned on those who had been shaking their heads just now. After all, those who could pass the Young Dragon Trial could at least be called a prodigy. Of course, top-tier prodigies were rarer, and Han Yue could be counted as one of them, but there was really no one else as freakish as Ling Han.
Peng, peng, peng! Just as they were speaking, another person was teleported over.
Ling Han was astounded. Just how many places had this Battle God Palace set up the Young Dragon Trial?

It could be imagined that the reason why they had gone to so much effort was definitely not because they had teleported them over to kill them. After all, it was all too coincidental for Ling Han to be in such a situation.
So, was this the Battle God Palace’s method of recruiting disciples?

-The Young Dragon Trial was set up all over the galaxy, attracting people to enter. Then, the well-known among them would be chosen, and they would be left to grow for a few more years. Those who were still alive would be transmitted here to be taken in as disciples, directly saving them the hardship and resources of nurturing.
F***, how astute.
Ling Han didn’t step out, mainly because of his special identity. Who knew if elites from the Battle God Palace had arrived at the scene and would be able to see through his disguise?
Thus, he had to keep a low profile.
Every time a batch of people was transferred over, Li Lei would step out as a lackey, and establish Han Yue’s leadership position.
But very soon, this situation was resolved.
A new arrival had arrived. His name was Sima Dong, and his Galaxy Network ranking was also in the 2000s. This was slightly higher than even Han Yue.
Sima Dong was naturally defiant, and the two of them immediately began an intense battle.
Their rankings on the Galaxy Network were close, and the Galaxy Network battle couldn’t take into account factors such as the Spirit Tool. Thus, the two of them fought for a while, yet it
was a tie.
Sima Dong took advantage of the opening to call out loudly, and established his own faction.

Previously, some people had only submitted to Han Yue because they had been threatened and bribed. Now that they had other options, they naturally “betrayed”, and switched to becoming subordinates of Sima Dong.

As more and more people were teleported over, the camps on both sides also became stronger and stronger. However, there were still no prodigies that could match Sima Dong and Han Yue. Thus, it did not become three camps, or four camps.
After this day ended, no one else was teleported over. It was as if everyone had already been brought over.
However, the strange thing was that the people who were teleported here were all in the Core
Formation Tier.
So coincidental?

Ling Han didn’t believe it. He thought that when these people were teleported here, they had already been “categorized”. Whether it was the Foundation Building Tier, the Cauldron Forging Tier, the Core Formation Tier, or the True Self Tier, they were all placed in the areas according to their cultivation levels.
Thus, everyone’s cultivation level was the same here.
After a day, everyone’s initial fear had also calmed down. They were all prodigies, at least, so they naturally knew that the Battle God Palace hadn’t spent so much effort to get them here to
kill them.

However, everyone couldn’t help but feel anxious. This was the Battle God Palace, the most mysterious and powerful assassin organization in the universe. After entering here, would they still be able to retreat unscathed?

Of course, there were also some people who came from lowly backgrounds and had absolutely no understanding of the Divine Palace. At first, they were very expectant. After all, the Three Styles of the God of War was a Saint-level technique, which represented the strength of the Battle God Palace. If they could be taken in as disciples by this force, then wouldn’t they be able to get their big break?
Weng, a powerful aura assaulted them, filled with pressure, causing everyone to fall silent.
A middle-aged man walked out from who knows where, looking down on everyone with a
lofty attitude.
This was a Spirit Transformation True Lord. In fact, this might not even be his original body, but rather a manifestation of his spirit.

“My name is Wanhe. You have all passed the Young Dragon Trial, and that is why you have appeared here,” the middle-aged man said. He briefly explained why they had come here. Then, he continued, “After passing the Young Dragon Trial, you all can also be considered external disciples of our War God Palace.”
“And now, the further selections will begin. Those who perform better will be able to successfully advance, and become official disciples of our Battle God Palace.”
When his words fell, a commotion arose in the crowd.
Some people were indeed very interested in joining the Battle God Palace, viewing it as a
stepping stone, but even more people knew what kind of organization the Battle God Palace was. They had no wish to become assassins.
“Dare I ask, Lord, what if we fail?” someone asked.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶

chapters.title: Chapter 4052: Four Hundred
paragraphs: Chapter 4052: Four Hundred
The victor could become an official disciple of the Battle God Palace, then what about the loser?
Wanhe didn’t answer immediately. Instead, he swept his gaze across everyone’s faces before saying, “The Battle God Palace doesn’t need weaklings. Losers are naturally disposed of.”
Disposed of?
Everyone’s hearts clenched. How should they deal with this?

There was no need to say anything else. They all understood, because the Battle God Palace would definitely not allow outsiders to leave alive, and reveal the secret of where the Battle God Palace was located.
-There was no Galaxy Network signal here. Even if everyone’s reaction was slightly slower, after they had calmed down, they would immediately connect to Galaxy Network.
All of a sudden, a strong fighting spirit rose up in everyone, and they felt that everyone around them was filled with malice.
These were all competitors!

“There are a total of… 739 of you now.” Wanhe’s expression was cold, without a trace of emotion, “I’ll give you three days’ time. No matter what method you use, there can only be 400 people alive. If this number is exceeded, I will move, and randomly choose a few people to kill, right until the number is reduced to 400.”
Hearing these words, everyone’s hearts constricted violently.
This kind of elimination battle was a little too cruel, wasn’t it? It actually had to be decided with life and death.

“Now, you guys can leave here.” Wan He said, “In these three days, you guys can hide, or join forces with others. You can do anything. However, let me make things clear first. If there are more than four hundred people alive in three days, I’ll start killing those who haven’t killed anyone.”
He turned around and left. In front of him, a stone door silently opened, and instantly, light was transmitted in. It was brightly lit.
Everyone hurriedly exited the stone chamber, only to see that this was a forest covered with greenery and red pines. It was like a utopia.
Unfortunately, the beautiful scenery couldn’t change the fact that this was the Battle God Palace, an organization of assassins.
“Now… the countdown begins!” Wanhe stated calmly. His figure floated in midair, exuding a faint brilliance, as if he was a god.

Instantly, the crowd was divided into two groups. One group was led by Sima Dong, and the other group was led by Han Yue. Of course, there were also lone warriors like Ling Han, but there were only three of them.
At this time, it was clearly an advantage of greater numbers.
“Retreat first!” Han Yue said. If an intense battle broke out with Sima Dong’s camp at this time, who knew what kind of massive losses would be caused. In fact, even he could possibly die here.
Since he only needed to get rid of over three hundred people, there seemed to be no need for such a fierce battle, right?
Sima Dong looked meaningfully at Han Yue, a smile appearing at the corners of his lips, and said, “Let’s retreat too.”

“Wait!” A person suddenly said. It was one of the three lone warriors, but it was not Ling Han. Ling Han was surprised, and looked towards that person. He saw that this was a young man that looked weathered and cold. Though he was only standing very casually, he exuded an incredibly fierce feeling, like a sharp sword that had been unsheathed.
“Who do you think you are? Just because you say to wait, we wait?” Someone jumped out, pointing at the young man.
That young man bared his teeth in a grin. It was clearly a grin, but it caused a chill to rise up from the bottom of one’s heart.
Shua, everyone felt their vision blur, and then saw that the person who had jumped out to rebuke him had already been split into two.
The aloof young man raised his hand, and with a light blow, a drop of blood fell.

He revealed a smile like a god of death, placed his sword on his shoulder, and said, “There is no need to go to so much trouble. I will begin to kill people now. Once I have killed enough, this boring game would naturally end.”

Pa, he had just finished saying these words, when the person that he had killed fell onto the ground, one half on the left and one half on the right, blood gushing all over the ground. “Hahaha, what a joke!” Another person jumped out, “You are only one person, so how could it be that you want to kill a hundred people?”
Sima Dong looked towards Han Yue, and Han Yue just happened to look over. The two of them nodded in an indiscernible manner.
“Let’s attack together and kill this person!”
“This person is far too vicious. He kills people at every turn, so let’s kill him together!”
The two of them spoke at the same time, instantly forming an alliance.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢

-This young man was clearly a troublemaker, and was not easily controlled at all. Furthermore, his abilities were incredibly powerful. Thus, it was best not to have any plans of forming an alliance with him, and just kill him first.
Instantly, several hundred people rushed out at the same time, charging towards that cold young man.
Hundreds of people against one, and everyone’s cultivation level was similar, so what did they have to fear?
Not only was the aloof young man unafraid, he even revealed a smile, as if he was anticipating
a feast of blood.
‘Die!’
His figure flashed, and took the initiative to greet the crowd.
Shua, shua, shua! Sword light flashed, and one after another, they were cut into two halves. Furthermore, they were all halved vertically, and not severed at the middle.
In just a few breaths’ time, thirteen people were killed by this cold-looking young man, and he himself was completely unharmed.
This did not seem like a battle of equal cultivation levels at all, but rather a one-sided slaughter like a tiger charging into a flock of sheep.
In the sky, Wanhe was indeed just watching coldly from the sidelines. He had no intention of interfering at all. Furthermore, he even revealed a cruel smile, as if he was enjoying this scene
of slaughter.

In the first place, they were a motley crowd, a team that had been temporarily put together. With such a massacre, their morale instantly dropped drastically. The majority of them did not have the heart to continue fighting. Faced with such a sharp sword, they did not want to die under the sword.
Sima Dong and Han Yue exchanged a glance, and the two of them nodded again. At this time, if the two of them did not step forward to stabilize the morale of the army, it would be easy to
lead the team.
Thus, in the next instant, the two of them rushed up at the same time, and joined forces to battle the cold young man.
Ding, ding, ding! This time, the cold young man’s sword was finally blocked.
“Long live!”
“Boss is mighty!”
When everyone saw this, their confidence instantly soared. As long as someone could block

the cold young man head-on, the advantage of having more people would be displayed. If they attacked together, it would somehow eventually kill the cold young man. “Haha, you think you can stand against so many people on your own? How naive!” Han Yue
said with a cold chuckle.
“How preposterous!” Sima Dong also said.
The aloof young man revealed a cold smile, “A few clowns dare to boast shamelessly!”
He slanted the blade of his sword slightly, and then delivered another slash. Instantly, the
sword light was as bright as thirty thousand meters.
Inconceivable, his battle prowess had actually increased greatly again.
Han Yue and Sima Dong did not dare to face this head-on, and hurriedly retreated. Otherwise,
it was possible that they would be severely injured.
The two of them had already retreated, so how could the others withstand it?

The cold-looking young man took advantage of the opening to commit a massacre. Blood splattered madly, and one after another, they were cut into two halves. There were also some traces of blood on his face, which made him look even more hideous and terrifying.
However, he did not stretch out his hand to wipe away the traces of blood. Instead, he licked them with his tongue, and even showed an expression of enjoyment.
What a freakish guy.

The aloof young man revealed a cold smile, “A few clowns dare to boast shamelessly!”
He slanted the blade of his sword slightly, and then delivered another slash.
Instantly, the
sword light was as bright as thirty thousand meters.
Inconceivable, his battle prowess had actually increased greatly again.
Han Yue and Sima Dong did not dare to face this head-on, and hurriedly retreated.
Otherwise,
it was possible that they would be severely injured.
The two of them had already retreated, so how could the others withstand it?
The cold-looking young man took advantage of the opening to commit a massacre.
Blood splattered madly, and one after another, they were cut into two halves.
There were also some traces of blood on his face, which made him look even more hideous and terrifying.
However, he did not stretch out his hand to wipe away the traces of blood.
Instead, he licked them with his tongue, and even showed an expression of enjoyment.
What a freakish guy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4053: Second Selection
paragraphs: Chapter 4053: Second Selection
The aloof young man went on a killing spree. His battle prowess was incredibly powerful, and even the combined forces of Sima Dong and Han Yue, who were ranked in the 2000s in the
Galaxy Network, were no match for him.
Shua, shua, shua! Blood rained down, and one after another, human bodies were cut in half. The scene could be said to be extremely shocking and cruel.
In the sky, a smile appeared on Wanhe’s face, and his eyes were filled with admiration as he looked at the aloof young man.
This kind of extravagant killing intent seemed to have been born for the Battle God Palace.
Everyone finally couldn’t hold on any longer, and dispersed quickly.
They were completely outmatched. This was simply courting death.
Meanwhile, the aloof young man mercilessly began his pursuit, killing until blood flowed all over the ground, and corpses lay all over the ground.
In the end, he was stopped by Wanhe, preventing him from continuing his attack.
-There were only 400 people left now, and he had already achieved his goal.
Wanhe looked at the cold young man, and asked, “What is your name?”
“Mo Yun,” the cold-looking young man said calmly. He didn’t even take even a Spirit Transformation True Lord seriously.

Wanhe, on the other hand, did not take offense. He looked at them, and said, “Aside from Mo Yun, the performance of all of you have disappointed me greatly. The core disciples of the Battle God Palace need to be strong, courageous, and view life and death as a kind of game.” Everyone was silent. F***, this Mo Yun was freakishly strong. Whoever dared to attack him would die. Why don’t you try lowering your cultivation level to the Core Formation Tier?
Wanhe waved his hand, “I’ll give you guys a night to rest. The second round of selections will begin tomorrow morning.”
After saying this, he stepped into the air and left.
Many people began to walk around, wanting to see if they could find an exit to leave this godforsaken place.
However, after a while, everyone returned, shaking their heads and sighing.
How could the Battle God Palace possibly leave behind such an obvious flaw?

Mo Yun had become famous with a single battle, and his limelight had completely surpassed Han Yue and Sima Dong. Thus, people approached, wanting to form a good relationship with him. If they could be on the same side as him in tomorrow’s selection, that naturally would greatly increase their hopes.

However, he directly drew his sword and killed the four people who had walked over first, not giving them the chance to speak at all, causing the faces of those behind them to turn green in fear, and they hurriedly stepped back.
Thankfully, Mo Yun did not start another massacre, which made everyone breathe a sigh of relief.
The night passed, and Wanhe came again.
Everyone was very afraid of meeting this person, because the moment he came, it meant that some of them were going to die, and it was not a small number either.

“Yi, another four have died?” Wan He swept an eye over them, and discovered the corpses that had been cut into eight halves. His eyes immediately fell on Mo Yun, but he had no intention of reprimanding him, which disappointed a great many people.
How they wished that Wanhe could move, and kill Mo Yun. This guy’s existence was practically destroying the balance, and the others had no way out.

“Next, the second round of selections will begin,” Wan He said. “In this wilderness, there are a total of a hundred targets that can be assassinated. Some targets are very simple. Their abilities are very weak, but though some targets are also very weak, they have the protection of elites.”
“You only need to kill one target, and you will have passed the test. And three days later, those who have not completed a single kill… will all be executed!”
When his words fell, everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
There were only 100 targets, but there were 400 of them. In other words, even if they could successfully assassinate these targets, at least 300 of them would die.
This was too cruel.
“The countdown begins now. Hurry up and hunt!” Wanhe waved his hand, and that cruel smile appeared on his face again.
Everyone hurriedly split up, and entered into the forest ahead of them.

They had to hurry up, because there were only a hundred targets. If they were all assassinated, the only fate for the remaining people would be death. Furthermore, mission targets were also divided into difficulty levels. If the simple targets were all killed, it would naturally increase the difficulty level endlessly.
Thus, they had to hurry.
Ling Han also strolled forward. He was naturally extremely displeased, but now that he was under someone else’s roof, he had no choice but to lower his head.

During this night, he had already studied the ley lines here. However, this planet had clearly been set up with a powerful formation long ago. He could sense the ley lines, but couldn’t mobilize the Earth Qi.𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮
It couldn’t be helped. His Spiritual Power wasn’t strong enough, and couldn’t compete with the formation. All the Earth Qi had been extracted by the formation, and it was circulating
according to some kind of trajectory.
This caused him to lose a trump card.
“Now, I have to hide my identity. Otherwise, if the Battle God Palace discovers that I am Ling Han, I would really be deader than dead.”
“However, as long as I leave alive, I’ll know where the Battle God Palace is. Then, I’ll publicize it on the Galaxy Network. I’m sure that countless forces that have been assassinated
by the Battle God Palace will charge over.”
“So, for now, live on!”
Ling Han firmed his resolve, and his figure immediately sped up. He soared through the forest, searching for a target that he could assassinate.
Not long after, he stopped.
There was a wooden figure standing upright, but beside the wooden figure, there were two fierce beasts with metal chains wrapped around their necks, exuding a powerful aura.
The word “target” was written on this wooden figure, and it was very eye-catching.
Yi, the Battle God Palace didn’t make it too bloody this time, using wooden puppets as assassination targets.

Ling Han used his eye technique to scan the surroundings. These two fierce beasts were both at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and judging by the wave of aura they exuded, they probably had battle prowess of around 15th Heaven.
For ordinary prodigies, the battle prowess of 15 Heavens was already terrifying enough. Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take it to heart. He casually walked over.
The two ferocious beasts immediately roared. They were trapped here, so they naturally became even more violent.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura. Pa, pa, pa! The minds of the two ferocious beasts instantly exploded. They wailed in agony as they collapsed to the ground,
dead.
He walked in front of the wooden figure, and was just about to deliver a palm strike, when he saw that the wooden figure actually moved. Xiu, it leaped up, its speed extremely fast.
Yi?
Ling Han faltered upon seeing this. However, how quick was his reaction? He immediately
launched a palm strike.
Peng!
The wooden block was instantly shattered, turning into pieces that filled the air.
“Pass.” A voice rang out in Ling Han’s mind, “You can rest here.”
This was Wanhe.
Ling Han looked up at the sky, but did not see any sign of Wanhe.
The Spirit Transformation Tier far surpassed his cultivation level.
Ling Han sat down cross-legged as he was told. Right now, he had to maintain a low profile.
“Humph, I was too late!” A voice rang out behind Ling Han, and Han Yue walked out. His eyes swept over them, revealing a baleful expression, “You actually dare to snatch my prey!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh, “There’s such a thing as that?”
“I remember you,” Han Yue said. “You’re that arrogant rookie!”
Ling Han sighed, “Since you have so much time, why don’t you go find your next target? What
are you squabbling about with me?”
“It’s fine!” Han Yue said calmly. “Killing you is only a matter of raising my hand. It won’t
waste too much time.”
‘F*ck! Do you think I’m an easy target to bully?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4054: Courting Death
paragraphs: Chapter 4054: Courting Death
Ling Han reflected on himself for a moment. Had he been too low-key?
Otherwise, how could someone like Han Yue dare to make threatening gestures at him? Whatever.
Ling Han ignored him, and merely closed his eyes to rest.
“Very good. Now that you know you can’t resist, you might as well give up resisting!” Han Yue said coldly.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. This guy had such a high opinion of himself that he was about to soar into the skies.
“Die!” Han Yue leaped over, and delivered a palm strike at the top of Ling Han’s head, intending to shatter his mind with a single strike.
Ling Han sat as still as a boulder, and it was only when Han Yue’s palm was about to strike him that he suddenly lashed out.
“There’s no need to resist,” Han Yue said coldly. However, a look of astonishment spread across his face as soon as he finished speaking.

Even though Ling Han’s attack had come later, and his speed looked pitifully slow, in truth, his palm had not even landed on Ling Han’s head, when the latter’s hand had already grabbed onto his throat.
How was this possible?
He had not even finished the thought, when he felt his whole body go soft. Instantly, he lost all his power.

Too terrifying, too terrifying. This guy’s strength was even stronger than Mo Yun. At least, he could still block a few moves from Mo Yun, but faced with Ling Han, he couldn’t even survive a single move.
He actually took the initiative to trifle with this kind of freak!
He was really courting death.

At this moment, Han Yue really wanted to cry. For better or worse, he was a prodigy ranked in the 2000s in the Galaxy Network. No matter which galaxy he was in, he could only be considered one of the top prodigies. Why did he keep encountering freaks that were innumerable times more freakish than him?
“S-spare me!” he forced out.
“If you were stronger just now, would you have spared me?” Ling Han countered calmly.
However, before Han Yue could even answer, Ling Han suddenly clenched his fist. Pa! Han Yue’s neck was snapped, and a burst of power surged into his mind, obliterating his spirit as well.

He already understood that those who entered the Battle God Palace would either die in the selection process, or become assassins of the Battle God Palace after passing. Thus, it was best for Han Yue to die, to avoid harming others.
Ling Han swung his arm and tossed Han Yue aside. He then sat down in a cross-legged position again. It was as if he were disconnected from the rest of the world.
“Interesting.” In the sky, a faint smile appeared on Wanhe’s face. Nothing that happened in this area could escape his senses.

When Han Yue charged towards Ling Han, he had initially wanted to stop him, but he also wanted to see the strength of the two of them. Thus, he chose to sit by and watch. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so strong. With a single strike, he had insta-killed Han Yue. “I really didn’t expect that two promising saplings would actually be chosen this time.”
“Hehe, the seed of the king of assassins should be one of the two.”
The assassination was still continuing.
Some succeeded, while others failed. Instead, they were killed by the guards who protected the target. This was a life-or-death competition.
Three days later, the time expired.
Wanhe’s voice rang out, “A total of 71 people have completed the mission. As for the others, all of them will be executed!”
“No!”
“I don’t want to die!”
“Please, I’m willing to do anything. Don’t let me die!”
Instantly, a chorus of pleading voices rang out.
But very quickly, these voices stopped abruptly. Clearly, it was Wanhe who had moved, and executed these people.
“Rest for a night, and the final round of selections will begin tomorrow,” Wanhe said again, then disappeared.
Only 71 people remained.
These people did not return to the cave to reunite. Tomorrow, they would all become competitors, and they could no longer trust anyone else.
The night passed in silence.

In the early morning, Ling Han decided to cultivate for a while first. Although the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier was mainly dependent on natural treasures to strengthen the Celestial Core, absorbing the power of heaven and earth was also effective, though the effefct
was negligible.
However, no matter how small it was, it was still improvement, and could not be wasted.
Wanhe appeared, telling everyone to gather.
“This is the final selection,” Wan He said. “Next, I will choose seven people as my target, and then assign nine people each to assassinate them.”
“In that case, there would be a total of seven groups… and one group would have eleven
people.”

“For assassins, success in the assassination would mean rising above the rest, and for the assassination targets, they would need to eliminate all the assassins before they could pass the test. As for the others… they would all be executed!”
“Understood?”
Hearing such rules, everyone frowned. If they were assigned as assassination targets, they would have to kill nine or ten to be able pass, so the pressure was naturally great.
But if he became an assassin, the pressure was actually not small either. He had to be the one to kill the target first to survive.
To put it bluntly, only one person in a group could survive.

In the first round, there were only 400 people left out of the 700 plus people, and the survival rate was 50%. In the first round, there were only 100 people left out of the 400 people, and the survival rate was only 20%. Now, only one person in very ten would remain, and the survival
rate was only 10%.
This was too cruel, wasn’t it?
However, Wan He didn’t give them any time to discuss at all, and he immediately started to
group them into groups.
“Now, I will first select the seven assassination targets.”
“You, you, you, you… and you!”
Wanhe used his hand to point at them one by one, and finally stopped in front of Ling Han.

The seven targets of assassination were chosen, and those who had not been chosen breathed a sigh of relief. As assassins, no matter what, the pressure on them would be slightly lighter. “Now, it’s the first set of assassins.” Wanhe began to assign them again, assigning nine people to the first set, then the second set, and the third set.
Because Ling Han was in the seventh group, the assassins in his group weren’t nine people,
but rather ten.
Most importantly, one of the assassins in this group was… Mo Yun!
When they discovered that Mo Yun had not been divided up for a long time, all the way until
the seventh group, the nine assassins of the seventh group all had pale faces, including Sima
Dong.
What was the point of continuing the game?
Who was Mo Yun’s match?
No, there was still a chance, and that was to kill Ling Han first. In that way, no matter how strong Mo Yun was, he would only be killed according to the rules.
“Alright, let’s begin!” Wanhe smiled. He loved to say the word “begin”, making him feel like he was an omnipotent and in control of everything.
Instantly, the assassins from the seven groups all charged towards their respective targets
like wolves and tigers. Whoever could be the first to kill their target would be able to survive.
Living was the most primitive, most ordinary, most basic desire, but at the same time, it was also the strongest desire.
Everyone exploded with a fighting spirit and battle prowess that was far stronger than usual. Their eyes were bloodshot. At this time, no matter who stood in their way, they would
mercilessly eliminate them.
‘I want to live!’ Shua, shua, shua! Sword light flashed, incomparably fierce.
Mo Yun was already on a killing spree, but his target was not Ling Han, but rather the
members of the seventh group.
Tragic wails rang out. After nine strikes, eight had fallen, and only one person was still alive.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Sima Dong.

However, he was also having a hard time. He had been stabbed in the back, and the wound had penetrated deep into his internal organs. He could clearly see that there was still Sword Qi tyrannizing his body. If he could not expel the Sword Qi, he would still be unable to avoid
death.
Hiss, Mo Yun was actually extremely powerful!
When the others saw this scene, they all broke out in a cold sweat. Thankfully, they were not
in the same group as Mo Yun.
Mo Yun did not pursue any further. Instead, he looked towards Ling Han, and showed a cruel
smile.

In the first round, there were only 100 people left out of the 400 people, and the survival rate was only 20%.
Now, only one person in very ten would remain, and the survival
rate was only 10%.
This was too cruel, wasn’t it?
However, Wan He didn’t give them any time to discuss at all, and he immediately started to
group them into groups.
“Now, I will first select the seven assassination targets.”
“You, you, you, you… and you!”
Wanhe used his hand to point at them one by one, and finally stopped in front of Ling Han.
The seven targets of assassination were chosen, and those who had not been chosen breathed a sigh of relief.
As assassins, no matter what, the pressure on them would be slightly lighter.
“Now, it’s the first set of assassins.” Wanhe began to assign them again, assigning nine people to the first set, then the second set, and the third set.
Because Ling Han was in the seventh group, the assassins in his group weren’t nine people,
but rather ten.
Most importantly, one of the assassins in this group was…
Mo Yun!
When they discovered that Mo Yun had not been divided up for a long time, all the way until
the seventh group, the nine assassins of the seventh group all had pale faces, including Sima
Dong.
What was the point of continuing the game?
Who was Mo Yun’s match?
No, there was still a chance, and that was to kill Ling Han first.
In that way, no matter how strong Mo Yun was, he would only be killed according to the rules.
“Alright, let’s begin!” Wanhe smiled.
He loved to say the word “begin”, making him feel like he was an omnipotent and in control of everything.
Instantly, the assassins from the seven groups all charged towards their respective targets
like wolves and tigers.
Whoever could be the first to kill their target would be able to survive.
Living was the most primitive, most ordinary, most basic desire, but at the same time, it was also the strongest desire.
Everyone exploded with a fighting spirit and battle prowess that was far stronger than usual.
Their eyes were bloodshot.
At this time, no matter who stood in their way, they would
mercilessly eliminate them.
‘I want to live!’ Shua, shua, shua!
Sword light flashed, incomparably fierce.
Mo Yun was already on a killing spree, but his target was not Ling Han, but rather the
members of the seventh group.
Tragic wails rang out.
After nine strikes, eight had fallen, and only one person was still alive.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Sima Dong.
However, he was also having a hard time.
He had been stabbed in the back, and the wound had penetrated deep into his internal organs.
He could clearly see that there was still Sword Qi tyrannizing his body.
If he could not expel the Sword Qi, he would still be unable to avoid
death.
Hiss, Mo Yun was actually extremely powerful!
When the others saw this scene, they all broke out in a cold sweat.
Thankfully, they were not
in the same group as Mo Yun.
Mo Yun did not pursue any further.
Instead, he looked towards Ling Han, and showed a cruel
smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 4055: Victory
paragraphs: Chapter 4055: Victory
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, as if he had not seen anything.
He had his own worries. The Battle God Palace should have a considerable understanding of him, so he could only use the methods of “Ding Yi”.

The God Slaying Technique could be cast. This was a celestial technique that practically no one knew about. The Heavenly Brilliance Technique could be cast. Previously, he had learnt it under the name of Ding Yi. However, the Demonic Monkey Fists could not cast, and the formation technique was also not usable. This was already deeply marked as Ling Han’s unique traits.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core couldn’t be used, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower couldn’t be used either. Sigh, there were so many restrictions.
Just as Ling Han was vexed, Mo Yun also strode over, his sword lowered, blood dripping.
He did not like to speak. If it was anyone else, they would definitely say a few words at this time, and furiously show their feeling of superiority.
But Mo Yun’s eyes were only bloodshot, his killing intent blazing, as if it had solidified.
Shua, he moved. His sword slashed out, like a blood-coloured ribbon.

Ling Han snapped his fingers, and with a ‘ding’, this ribbon was instantly severed from the middle, and separated into two halves that swept past either side of Ling Han. Naturally, not even a single hair on Ling Han’s head was severed.
Seeing this scene, Sima Dong instantly gaped, then sank into deep despair.
Originally, he had wanted to muster up the last bit of his power, and kill Ling Han before Mo Yun did. Then, no matter how strong Mo Yun was, he could only wait helplessly for death.
However, he had never imagined that Ling Han would actually be so strong.
This time, he was done for. Whether it was Ling Han or Mo Yun that would emerge victorious, he would not be able to escape death.

And the battles of the other six groups had already begun. Everyone was fighting for their lives, so they naturally had no time to watch the battle between Ling Han and Mo Yun. Thus, no one got a scare.
Mo Yun showed a hint of surprise, as if he was wondering how Ling Han had managed to block his attack.
However, this was only an instant, and he immediately delivered another strike with his sword.
Ling Han casually snapped his fingers, and once again dispersed Mo Yun’s attack.
“You are very strong.” It was rare for Mo Yun to speak up.
Ling Han merely smiled faintly. Mo Yun’s killing nature was extremely cruel, and he could not appreciate it at all.
Thus, it would be better for him to die.

“I want to kill you even more!” Mo Yun continued. He raised his sword, and lightly licked the blade of the sword. Instantly, a bloody mark appeared on his lips. It was unknown whether it was the original blood on the sword, or the blood from a cut on his lip.
“If you have the ability, then bring it on,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Die!”𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

Mo Yun rushed over. Boom, an intense blood colour overflowed from his body. It was as if his whole person had turned into a blood demon. Even his hair had turned completely red, exuding a terrifying demonic aura.
Ling Han used the God Slaying Technique to exchange blows with Mo Yun.

Mo Yun was really very strong. His battle prowess was probably twenty Heavens, which was enough to advance into the top hundred of the Galaxy Network. It was no wonder that even when Han Yue and Sima Dong joined forces, they were still no match for him.
However, Ling Han’s raw power was already at the Eighteenth Heaven. After activating the God Slaying Technique, Ling Han’s battle prowess had even advanced to the 21st Heaven.
Even though it was only the suppression of a single Heaven, when elites exchanged blows, could they afford to have a disadvantage of even one Heaven?
Mo Yun had already fallen into a disadvantage. Being suppressed by Ling Han, his disadvantage was also continuously magnified.

This was naturally because Ling Han had held back. He hadn’t used the murderous aura attack, nor had he used the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. Otherwise, he would have killed Mo Yun several hundred times over.

Wanhe couldn’t help but look impressed. In truth, he was more optimistic about Mo Yun, because this kind of extravagant, murderous personality of Mo Yun was more suited to become an assassin, and Ling Han was the ultimate test that he had set for Mo Yun.
Unfortunately, Mo Yun had not passed the test.
Mo Yun roared loudly, his voice rolling out, solidifying.
However, this did not have the slightest effect on the battle situation.

However, Mo Yun turned his hand and grabbed onto his own spine. Then, with a powerful pull, pu, blood sprayed out violently. He had pulled out the whole spine, and holding it in his hand, it was like a bone whip, covered with blood.
Strangely, from the gaping wound, it could be seen that he actually still had a spine.
“Bone Nurturing Technique!” Wanhe couldn’t help but light up, revealing a hint of excitement.

The Bone Nurturing Technique was actually very simple. That was, an elite would forcibly pull out his own bones, and insert them into the body of another. In this way, his own martial arts experience could also be passed on.
Usually, this was only done by elites before they died, and it had to be someone close to them. Otherwise, the bloodline would reject them, and the bones implanted would only rot of
necrosis.
Moreover, the skull and spine were the best. They could most likely inherit one’s martial arts memories.

At crucial moments, this elite’s bone could still be used as a tool to wield like a Spirit Tool. After all, the Spirit Tool came from an elite, and their bloodlines were connected. After nurturing it for many years, it could naturally unleash astonishing power.
Was the tables about to turn?
Wanhe was filled with anticipation.
“Die!” Mo Yun brandished the bone whip and attacked. Hu, his blood was burning, causing the bone whip to turn into a fiery whip. When the attack was delivered, it was incredibly
terrifying.
His battle prowess had increased by at least three Heavens.

This was a little troublesome. Ling Han used his movement technique, focusing on dodging and evasion. He frowned slightly. If he could unleash his full battle prowess, he would naturally be unafraid. He would be able to suppress his opponent with a flip of his hand.
But now, he had too many abilities that he could not use. How was he supposed to defeat his opponent in this kind of situation?
Thus, he could only think as he dodged.

Mo Yun had suddenly regained the upper hand. Not only had his morale increased greatly, his killing intent had also soared explosively. His whole head of bloody hair was soaring into the skies. He really looked like he had completely become a god of death.
Ling Han used his eye technique, capturing the weaknesses in his attacks, and began to dodge.

However, Eye Techniques could not compensate for the difference of two Heavens in battle prowess. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han still had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, that could disperse the power that impacted on him, his present situation would definitely be very
terrible.
Ling Han was also a little anxious. If this continued, Wanhe might become suspicious. Under the crushing pressure of battle prowess of two Heavens, how had you been able to take it
head-on?
Thus, he had to end the battle as soon as possible!
Good.
Ling Han deliberately planted a weak point, causing Mo Yun to charge over. With a thought,
the murderous aura surged out.
This was divine sense-level, and without a trace, it directly blasted into Mo Yun’s mind.
Instantly, Mo Yun showed an expression of pain, but before he could even call out, Ling Han’s fist had already shot out, and landed on Mo Yun’s forehead.
Pu!
Mo Yun did not have the slightest ability to resist, and his head was blasted apart with a single
punch from Ling Han.
This!

Even Wanhe was dumbfounded for a moment. Hadn’t Mo Yun completely gained the upper hand? Just when it looked like he had grasped Ling Han’s weak point, and was about to kill him with a single strike, why had the situation suddenly turned around? The one who had been killed with a single strike was not Ling Han, but rather Mo Yun.
But Mo Yun’s headless corpse was lying there, fresh blood still gushing out. This was a fact
that could not be more real.
He looked at Ling Han, his eyes filled with confusion. Even he couldn’t tell what method Ling
Han had used to achieve a reversal.
His palm pressed down. Pa, pa, pa, pa! The minds of the people below all exploded completely, and they were all dead. Even Sima Dong did not manage to escape. Pa, his head
drooped onto the ground, his eyes still filled with shock.
Right now, only Ling Han was still alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 4056: Blood Tower
paragraphs: Chapter 4056: Blood Tower
“How did you kill Mo Yun?” Wanhe asked, filled with curiosity.
Ling Han swept an eye over the corpses all over the ground, and his heart clenched. However, his expression was calm, and he said, “I was stronger than him, so I naturally can kill him.”

Wanhe was naturally dissatisfied with this answer. He shook his head, “Mo Yun used the Celestial Bone of an elite at the end, and his battle prowess is at least two Heavens higher than yours. How could he possibly be killed by you?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Because I am Ding Yi.”
Ding Yi?
Wan He was stunned at first, and after searching for this name, he immediately revealed a shocked expression.
As it turned out, this brat was Ding Yi.
Who was Ding Yi?
He became famous in the Donglin Imperial Clan’s gathering of prodigies, and even Fu Huoyang, an Imperial Son, was defeated, becoming one of the most dazzling new stars in the West Heavenly Realm.
He had never thought that the Battle God Palace would cast a wide net and gather prodigies, and would actually be able to catch such a big fish.
This was really profitable. With such a good foundation, and with proper training, he may be able to become the king of assassins in future.
It was clear that Ling Han still did not answer, but Wanhe did not ask further about Mo Yun’s death.
Ding Yi-this name was enough.
“Very good. You have defeated everyone, and become the seed of the king of assassins,” Wan He said. “I hope you can continue to work hard and become the next king of assassins.”
Ling Han mocked internally. If you knew that I am Ling Han, then you wouldn’t be nurturing me to become the king of assassins at all. Instead, you would have the assassins come to kill
me.
“What is the king of assassins?” He took the chance to ask, wanting to know more about the Battle God Palace.
“The seed of the king of assassins is equivalent to the Dao Child of our Battle God Palace,” Wanhe said, “And in the case of the king of assassins, he is the master of our Battle God Palace!”

With these words, Ling Han finally understood. No wonder the competition was so cruel. Close to eight hundred people had entered, and it could be said that they were all prodigies. However, in the end, he was the only one who had survived.
This was because the Battle God Palace didn’t want to recruit ordinary disciples. Instead, they wanted to recruit the Dao Child!
Why didn’t they nurture those who were eliminated as ordinary disciples? Wasn’t it too wasteful to kill them directly?

Thinking about it, it was simple. That was because most of these people had their own masters, so it was inevitable that they would be disloyal. It was far inferior to raising them from an infant, and brainwashing them from a young age.
But why would they still choose the Dao Child like this?

That was because the Dao Child had to be outstanding enough, so they naturally had to choose from the wider universe, and if it was only one person, it would be considerably easier to brainwash him. Additionally, this was someone who would become the Dao Child of a Holy Land, which was enough to tempt a great many top-notch prodigies.
Thus, the Battle God Palace was still filled with confidence, thinking that even if they used this method, they would still be able to make others willingly join the Battle God Palace in the
end.
“Follow me,” Wanhe said, walking ahead with his hands clasped behind his back.
Ling Han followed behind him. He didn’t want to walk alongside him.
After walking for a while, a wall of air appeared ahead of them. There was clearly still a path ahead, but they could not walk through it.
Wanhe pressed down with his hand, and a seal instantly lit up in his palm. Then, he walked forward.
The wall of air disappeared.
Ling Han hurriedly followed, but he had already memorized the seal in Wanhe’s palm.
The other party would never have imagined that he was a Formations Grandmaster.
After walking for a while, structures appeared ahead of them. They were all very ordinary, as if they were the residences of ordinary people.
However, this was the territory of the Battle God Palace, an organization of assassins.
“What is it? You didn’t expect it, did you?” Wanhe asked with a smile.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “I really didn’t expect this. At first glance, it looks like an ordinary village.”
A smug expression appeared on Wanhe’s face, and he said, “As an outstanding assassin, before he makes a move, he should be like an ordinary person. He won’t attract anyone’s
attention.”
Ling Han didn’t agree with this at all. From the bottom of his heart, he hated assassination. In a battle, they should charge head-on and fight fiercely.
Of course, if one’s abilities were inferior, they definitely wouldn’t be able to charge. Delivering oneself to die and being brave were two completely different things.
“Old Wan, is this the seed of Core Formation Tier?” A person walked out of the village, glanced at Ling Han, and then asked Wan He.
Wan He nodded, then said mysteriously, “Guess who he is?”
“What nonsense; how am I supposed to guess!” That person immediately shook his head. With how big the universe was, how could he possibly know a junior in the Core Formation
Tier?
Wan He laughed loudly, “You must have heard of his name!”
That person was startled. Looking at Wan He, he seemed to be very confident. He thought for
a moment, then asked, “It can’t be Ling Han, right?”
Tsk, his guess was really accurate.
“How could that be!” Wan He shook his head, “How could there be such a coincidence!”
It was really so coincidental.
“Then who is it?” That person did not want to guess.
“Ding Yi,” Wan He replied.
Instantly, that person was shocked, and turned back to look at Ling Han, asking, “You are
Ding Yi?”
He still had to confirm.
Ling Han nodded, “I am Ding Yi.”
“Haha, we’ve really picked up a treasure this time!” That person laughed loudly, “Who knows, this may be the strongest seed, the future king of assassins.”
“M-hm.” Wan He nodded.

Ling Han finally understood why the Battle God Palace always had a Killing Saint on standby. That was because they had plundered prodigies from the universe for generation after generation. With the lifespan of a Saint as high as a million years, they would always be able to nurture out successor within the time limit of their lifespan.
“Have the other groups also chosen seeds?” Wan He asked.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
“Not yet. Your group is the fastest,” that person shook his head.
“Alright, I’ll arrange for this brat’s accommodations first,” Wan He said.
He led Ling Han into the village to settle down. He was allocated a very ordinary house, but it also had a small garden. After telling Ling Han to temporarily stay here for a few days, he left
swiftly.
Wasn’t he afraid that Ling Han would flee?
He really wasn’t afraid.
Core Formation Tiers couldn’t travel through the universe with their physical bodies, and it

would be difficult for them to reach the nearest planet even if they were given 1000 years. As for the Transfer Formation… with the tight security of the Battle God Palace, the Transfer Formation would definitely be extremely strictly guarded.
Most importantly, Ling Han still didn’t want to leave.
Since he had accidentally entered into the Battle God Palace, he wanted to find out more.
-Didn’t you guys want to kill me? Then I’ll reveal all your information to the public, and unite the power of the entire universe to destroy you guys.
In the past few days, Ling Han had been cultivating with no intention of fleeing at all.
Seven days later, Wan He finally came again.
“Follow me.” He didn’t speak any nonsense.
Ling Han left with him. This time, they arrived at the foot of a tall tower.
This tower was completely blood-red, and had a total of 33 levels.

Ling Han wasn’t the only one. There were also three young people here, two men and one woman. The two men were Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, while the woman was True Self Tier. She was extremely beautiful, and her figure was even more graceful, with astonishing curves.

“Congratulations on becoming seeds this time,” Wan He said. “Next, what you guys will be competing for is the title of king of assassins. There is only one king of assassins. Every generation can only have one king of assassins.”
“Before you, there were 27 seeds… Oh, there should be 26 now. One just died.”

Wan He paused, then pointed at the Blood Tower behind him, “This is the tower of inheritance of our Battle God Palace. Which one of you seeds can reach the thirty-third level? You will be the next king of assassins, and as for the others… they will all be executed!”

You have defeated everyone, and become the seed of the king of assassins,” Wan He said.
“I hope you can continue to work hard and become the next king of assassins.”
Ling Han mocked internally.
If you knew that I am Ling Han, then you wouldn’t be nurturing me to become the king of assassins at all.
Instead, you would have the assassins come to kill
me.
“What is the king of assassins?” He took the chance to ask, wanting to know more about the Battle God Palace.
“The seed of the king of assassins is equivalent to the Dao Child of our Battle God Palace,” Wanhe said, “And in the case of the king of assassins, he is the master of our Battle God Palace!”
With these words, Ling Han finally understood.
No wonder the competition was so cruel.
Close to eight hundred people had entered, and it could be said that they were all prodigies.
However, in the end, he was the only one who had survived.
This was because the Battle God Palace didn’t want to recruit ordinary disciples.
Instead, they wanted to recruit the Dao Child!
Why didn’t they nurture those who were eliminated as ordinary disciples?
Wasn’t it too wasteful to kill them directly?
Thinking about it, it was simple.
That was because most of these people had their own masters, so it was inevitable that they would be disloyal.
It was far inferior to raising them from an infant, and brainwashing them from a young age.
But why would they still choose the Dao Child like this?
That was because the Dao Child had to be outstanding enough, so they naturally had to choose from the wider universe, and if it was only one person, it would be considerably easier to brainwash him.
Additionally, this was someone who would become the Dao Child of a Holy Land, which was enough to tempt a great many top-notch prodigies.
Thus, the Battle God Palace was still filled with confidence, thinking that even if they used this method, they would still be able to make others willingly join the Battle God Palace in the
end.
“Follow me,” Wanhe said, walking ahead with his hands clasped behind his back.
Ling Han followed behind him.
He didn’t want to walk alongside him.
After walking for a while, a wall of air appeared ahead of them.
There was clearly still a path ahead, but they could not walk through it.
Wanhe pressed down with his hand, and a seal instantly lit up in his palm.
Then, he walked forward.
The wall of air disappeared.
Ling Han hurriedly followed, but he had already memorized the seal in Wanhe’s palm.
The other party would never have imagined that he was a Formations Grandmaster.
After walking for a while, structures appeared ahead of them.
They were all very ordinary, as if they were the residences of ordinary people.
However, this was the territory of the Battle God Palace, an organization of assassins.
“What is it?
You didn’t expect it, did you?” Wanhe asked with a smile.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “I really didn’t expect this.
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary village.”
A smug expression appeared on Wanhe’s face, and he said, “As an outstanding assassin, before he makes a move, he should be like an ordinary person.
He won’t attract anyone’s
attention.”
Ling Han didn’t agree with this at all.
From the bottom of his heart, he hated assassination.
In a battle, they should charge head-on and fight fiercely.
Of course, if one’s abilities were inferior, they definitely wouldn’t be able to charge.
Delivering oneself to die and being brave were two completely different things.
“Old Wan, is this the seed of Core Formation Tier?” A person walked out of the village, glanced at Ling Han, and then asked Wan He.
Wan He nodded, then said mysteriously, “Guess who he is?”
“What nonsense; how am I supposed to guess!” That person immediately shook his head.
With how big the universe was, how could he possibly know a junior in the Core Formation
Tier?
Wan He laughed loudly, “You must have heard of his name!”
That person was startled.
Looking at Wan He, he seemed to be very confident.
He thought for
a moment, then asked, “It can’t be Ling Han, right?”
Tsk, his guess was really accurate.
“How could that be!” Wan He shook his head, “How could there be such a coincidence!”
It was really so coincidental.
“Then who is it?” That person did not want to guess.
“Ding Yi,” Wan He replied.
Instantly, that person was shocked, and turned back to look at Ling Han, asking, “You are
Ding Yi?”
He still had to confirm.
Ling Han nodded, “I am Ding Yi.”
“Haha, we’ve really picked up a treasure this time!” That person laughed loudly, “Who knows, this may be the strongest seed, the future king of assassins.”
“M-hm.” Wan He nodded.
Ling Han finally understood why the Battle God Palace always had a Killing Saint on standby.
That was because they had plundered prodigies from the universe for generation after generation.
With the lifespan of a Saint as high as a million years, they would always be able to nurture out successor within the time limit of their lifespan.
“Have the other groups also chosen seeds?” Wan He asked.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
“Not yet.
Your group is the fastest,” that person shook his head.
“Alright, I’ll arrange for this brat’s accommodations first,” Wan He said.
He led Ling Han into the village to settle down.
He was allocated a very ordinary house, but it also had a small garden.
After telling Ling Han to temporarily stay here for a few days, he left
swiftly.
Wasn’t he afraid that Ling Han would flee?
He really wasn’t afraid.
Core Formation Tiers couldn’t travel through the universe with their physical bodies, and it
would be difficult for them to reach the nearest planet even if they were given 1000 years.
As for the Transfer Formation… with the tight security of the Battle God Palace, the Transfer Formation would definitely be extremely strictly guarded.
Most importantly, Ling Han still didn’t want to leave.
Since he had accidentally entered into the Battle God Palace, he wanted to find out more.
-Didn’t you guys want to kill me?
Then I’ll reveal all your information to the public, and unite the power of the entire universe to destroy you guys.
In the past few days, Ling Han had been cultivating with no intention of fleeing at all.
Seven days later, Wan He finally came again.
“Follow me.” He didn’t speak any nonsense.
Ling Han left with him.
This time, they arrived at the foot of a tall tower.
This tower was completely blood-red, and had a total of 33 levels.
Ling Han wasn’t the only one.
There were also three young people here, two men and one woman.
The two men were Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, while the woman was True Self Tier.
She was extremely beautiful, and her figure was even more graceful, with astonishing curves.
“Congratulations on becoming seeds this time,” Wan He said.
“Next, what you guys will be competing for is the title of king of assassins.
There is only one king of assassins.
Every generation can only have one king of assassins.”
“Before you, there were 27 seeds…
Oh, there should be 26 now.
One just died.”
Wan He paused, then pointed at the Blood Tower behind him, “This is the tower of inheritance of our Battle God Palace.
Which one of you seeds can reach the thirty-third level?
You will be the next king of assassins, and as for the others… they will all be executed!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4057: The True Three Styles of the God of War
paragraphs: Chapter 4057: The True Three Styles of the God of War
What great pressure, and what an intense competition.
One person became the Killing Saint, while the others were all executed.
The woman opened her mouth, and asked, “Senior, may I know which level the person with the fastest progress has reached?”
This was very crucial.
Including Ling Han, everyone looked towards Wan He.
Wan He paused, and said, “The fastest person has already reached the thirtieth level.”
Ling Han and the others all frowned. Then they would have lost out too, wouldn’t they? The gap was too wide.
“Senior, this is far too unfair,” the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator said.
Wan He sneered, “This world is unjust in the first place. It can only be changed with one’s own efforts.”
“Senior, can we enter the inheritance tower now?” the True Self Tier woman asked.
Wan He broke into a smile, “This is the correct attitude! Of course, you can come to the Blood Tower at any time to challenge and comprehend.”
“In this place, it is strictly forbidden for you to kill each other. Otherwise, you will all be executed!”
“En, you all introduce yourselves first. In the future, for a very long time, not only will you all be competitors, you will also be like-minded companions, and will be going on missions together.”

The four of them introduced themselves. The Foundation Building Tier cultivator was called Chen Bing, the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was called Zhao Biao, and the True Self Tier cultivator was called Zhu Yan.
Wan He soon left elegantly, leaving the four of them to do whatever they had to do.
From the looks of it, there didn’t seem to be any traps here. There was only cruel competition.
However, if it was just that, how could it make people completely devoted to the Battle God Palace?
Ling Han looked at the Blood Tower in front of him. Could it be that all its mysteries were here?
Zhu Yan was the first to move, and she had already walked into the Blood Tower.
After hesitating for a moment, Chen Bing and Zhao Biao hurriedly followed after her.

Ling Han, on the other hand, was not in a rush. He circled around the tower once. He discovered that this tower was not ordinary. Not only was it a powerful Spirit Tool, it was also the core of a great formation.
Without batting an eyelid, he walked towards the great doors at the foot of the tower.
In the end, he would still have to face this.
After entering the tower, Ling Han felt as if he had stepped into another world. There were powerful warriors, and there was endless slaughter.

Pu, pu, pu! Innumerable drops of blood bloomed in front of him, and heads fell one after another. Not only were there adults, there were also children. In fact, there were even infants. Their stomachs were cut open, and the scene was incredibly bloody.
This kind of massacre would drive normal people crazy.

Ling Han was extremely resolute. He had walked all the way from the Genesis World, and had even witnessed the destruction of a whole realm, so how could he be distracted by this kind of scene?𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
He watched calmly, capturing every single detail.
Soon, he discovered that there were multiple seals hidden in the blood that had splattered.
These seals were all dark red in colour, and was akin to blood. Thus, if one did not carefully observe them, it would be impossible to discover them.
Ling Han was grasping these seals, and at the same time, it was inevitable that he would also be absorbing the images of slaughter.
Realization dawned on him. So this was how the Battle God Palace brainwashed people.
If he wanted to grasp these seals, he had to carefully look at these images of slaughter. The longer it took, the more likely it was that it would affect his mind, or even influence his personality.
Of course, that would definitely need a very long time. However, this Blood Tower had 33 levels.
What else was there?
Seeds like them were all competitors, so everyone would definitely feel extremely pressured, because once someone reached the top, the others would all die.

This meant that everyone would spend a lot of their time here. Then, with this influence, it would not be strange for their temperament to slowly be influenced, and their personalities to gradually become distorted.

Moreover, the images in the first level might only be a piece of cake, and would be multiplied with every successive level afterwards. In short, it was certain to turn a normal person into a mass murderer.
Ling Han took a deep breath. If that was all, he believed that with his self-control, he would definitely remain unchanged.
“All right, then let’s have a competition!”
Ling Han extracted all the seals, then analyzed them in his mind.
After a while, he revealed an expression of surprise.
This was the first style of the Three Styles of the God of War. However, it was much more complicated than the first style that he had learnt.
The real Three Styles of the God of War.
Not bad, not bad. The Battle God Palace was really generous. From the very beginning, they were gifting the Saint Technique to him.

Ling Han quickly smiled. In any case, they could not leave the Battle God Palace. Furthermore, in the end, only one of them would be able to become the king of assassins. The others would all die, so what if the Battle God Palace passed this technique on to them?
He began to practice, over and over again. When he had completely mastered this style, a door silently opened, revealing a set of stairs that led to the second floor.
This first level, it would be considered as him having passed.
Ling Han smiled. He did not see Zhu Yan and the others who had entered before him. Thus,
they must have entered into separate spaces.
-Previously, he had already discovered that this Blood Tower itself was a precious tool.
Ling Han walked up the stairs, and soon arrived at the second floor.
Shua, a fierce Sword Qi slashed over, incredibly terrifying.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel shocked. He hurriedly dodged to the side. Then, he discovered that the person who had attacked was actually a child. He looked extremely innocent, but after his attack had missed, he immediately attacked again and again, every move fierce.
It was really hard to imagine that a child would actually have such a high cultivation level, that even Ling Han would feel some pressure. This had to be battle prowess above twenty
Heavens, at least.
But how could a mere five- or six-year-old child be so strong?
He immediately realized that this should not be a real person, but rather a manifestation created by the formation.
Ling Han activated his Eye Technique, and sure enough, he didn’t find any majestic life
essence. It was just a blur.
Since it wasn’t a real person, Ling Han naturally didn’t need to have any more reservations. He aggressively attacked and killed this child.
Strangely, though this child had died, it had not dispersed. Instead, he was lying there like a real person. There was blood flowing, and one could even smell the strong stench of blood.
This blood was real!
The Battle God Palace was truly a freak. For the sake of twisting one’s mind, they would do
anything.
Ling Han circled the surroundings, but did not find any doors that led to the third floor open.
What was going on? He had not passed the test?
That’s right. He had learnt the First Style of the God of War from the first level, so going by that trend, he should be able to learn the true Second Style of the God of War here.
He observed carefully, yet could not make heads or tails of the situation at all.
Could it be?

Ling Han’s eyes turned to the corpse on the ground. This was clearly an illusion, but it still hadn’t dissipated after being defeated. It should have been deliberately designed like this. ‘F*ck! It can’t be that freakish, right?’
Ling Han faltered for a moment. Forming the appearance of a child to attack him, and having him personally kill a “child” was already cruel enough, but now, the key to the Second Style of
the God of War was probably on this corpse.
He was required to dismember someone’s corpse?
Although this was fake, Ling Han still felt a strong feeling of nausea. It was too
uncomfortable.
However, Ling Han still guarded his heart. He began to dissect the corpse.
