chapters.title: Chapter 4058: Strange Shadow Steps
paragraphs: Chapter 4058: Strange Shadow Steps
Ling Han felt that this was cruel, but he had no choice but to do so.
If he couldn’t learn the Second Style of the God of War, it was clear that he couldn’t go to the third level.
Thus, he suppressed all his emotions, and told himself that this was not a real corpse, but rather a formation manifestation.
However, this corpse was too real, and there was no difference between it and a real person.
Ling Han silently recited the Six Characters Bright King Curse in his mind. His mind was clear, transcendent above all else.
After cutting open this corpse, Ling Han finally discovered seals again.
Some were on the bones, some were on the organs, and some were on the veins. In short, Ling Han definitely had to dissect this corpse carefully to obtain the complete seal.
It could be said that this stage was not difficult to pass. As long as one had the slightest bit of strength, and was ruthless enough, that was enough.
Thus, the first few stages were not used to impede seeds like them, but rather to “temper” their temperament, falling slowly in the direction of cold-bloodedness and cruelty.
Ling Han channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames, and boom, this corpse was instantly turned into ash.
He began to combine these seals. With his outstanding comprehension ability, in less than half a day, he had already grasped the profound mysteries.
Ling Han began to practice. This was indeed the Second Style of the God of War. It was similarly much more complicated, and could be considered “authentic”.
As he cultivated, a door silently opened. He could now go to the third floor.
Ling Han stepped out, but this time, no one attacked him. He saw that there were ten elders lying or sitting on the ground, and they were all skin and bones. Aside from them, there was no one else.
This!
To make a move on these defenseless old people that had no cultivation level at all?

The Battle God Palace, oh, the Battle God Palace. He already knew that this was a cruel organization of assassins, but he still hadn’t imagined that such a method with no bottom line at all would be used to train new disciples.
Obviously, the seal of the Third Style of the God of War was on these old people, but it was definitely not their skin, but rather the same as the second floor.
It was too cruel, and too freakish.
Ling Han frowned deeply. Even if he knew that this was a formation manifestation, he still felt extremely uncomfortable.
Furthermore, what if there was a real person for him to kill later?
“How exactly does the Battle God Palace judge whether seeds are affected or not?”
“If I forcefully suppress my negative emotions and maintain a clear mind, they might discover me. After all, they’ve been doing this all their lives. I’m the newbie here.”
“Thus, if I want to deceive everyone, I have to think of another way.”
“Yi, why don’t I create a second consciousness, and let this consciousness become a demon? After I pass the test, I will then sever this consciousness.”

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. In the Buddhist Race, this was actually a cultivation technique called Slaying Evil Thoughts or Slashing Heart Demons. However, they would only slay demons and evil thoughts after they had developed them in their hearts, and as for Ling Han, he originally didn’t have any internal demons, but rather wanted to create one first.
“This can also be seen as a tempering. After severing the internal demon in my heart, my willpower will definitely be able to become slightly stronger.”
“All right!”

Ling Han retracted his intent into the depths of his mind and adhered it to the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, using the power of this Celestial Core to cut off the connection with his physical body. At the same time, he left behind a sliver of divine sense, leaving behind all the images that he had seen on the first and second levels.
When this sliver of divine sense entered Ling Han’s mind, he suddenly opened his eyes, instantly exuding an incredibly terrifying aura.
He was a completely different person. There was no expression on his face, only coldness and slaughter.
Ling Han moved without hesitation. Pa, pa, pa! The ten old people were all killed. He skinned them, searched for the seals, and then began to cultivate.
He had obtained the Third Style of the God of War.
The fourth level opened.
Ling Han had lost all emotion. Like a demon, a god of death, he began a massacre, without the slightest hesitation.
The Fourth Style of the God of War, the Fifth Style… When Ling Han charged to the ninth level, he had also learnt the Nine Styles of the Saint Technique.

However, after entering into the tenth level, though slaughter was still inevitable, he had not learnt the Tenth Style of the God of War. Instead, he had learnt a secret technique that concealed his tracks.
This was called the Strange Shadow Step.

After channeling this secret technique, it was as if his whole person had entered into a shadow. Even if they were face to face, you would not be able to discover that there was another person in front of you. If you were suddenly attacked, your only fate would be death.
If it had been a seed-level assassin that had attempted to assassinate Ling Han, then merely this Strange Shadow Steps would be enough to cause Ling Han a lot of trouble.

However, the Strange Shadow Steps of the tenth level weren’t complete. After Ling Han ascended to the eleventh level, he learned another part, and another part on the twelfth level. It wasn’t until the sixteenth level that he finally mastered all of the Strange Shadow Steps.
Calculating the time, more than a month had already passed.

Though Ling Han felt a little hungry, as long as he had stepped into Celestial Path, he only had to absorb the energy of heaven and earth, and he would not die of hunger and thirst. In his present consciousness, he was not a glutton at all. Thus, he charged all the way to the
seventeenth level without the slightest hesitation.
A white-haired elder was presently sitting in a cross-legged position. He was like a stone statue, without the slightest sign of life.
Ling Han wasn’t reserved at all. He used the Strange Shadow Steps, and quietly arrived behind the old man. Then, he shot out the Nine Styles of God of War, striking out at the old man.
“Good one, brat!” The old man humphed lightly, and without even turning his head, delivered a palm strike.
Peng!
Ling Han instantly turned into a rolling gourd, crashing into the wall before finally stopping. However, he immediately used the Strange Shadow Steps and once again entered into the
shadows.

“Haha, showing off your Strange Shadow Steps in front of me, what a joke!” The white-haired old man laughed. He stood up. Boom, his whole person exuded a powerful life essence. It was too terrifying, as if a furnace was burning fiercely.
“However, to be able to reach this kind of level in a short month’s time, and furthermore, you are only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. It is really not easy.”
“I have a high opinion of you!”
Xiu, right at this moment, Ling Han had already escaped from the shadows, and shot out a punch at the white-haired elder.
The white-haired elder moved, and very easily grabbed onto Ling Han’s wrist, preventing him from advancing an inch further.
However, in his current state, Ling Han’s only thought was to kill. He swung his other fist at
the old man again.
The elder also reached over with his other hand and grabbed Ling Han’s wrist.
Ling Han straightened his back and launched a series of kicks.
“Hiss!” The old man was slightly shocked. This desire for battle was too strong.
However, he was really too strong. With a toss of his head, a few strands of grey hair flew out,
easily wrapping around Ling Han’s hands.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and the Heptagold Sword Qi slashed out.
“Yi?”
The old man hadn’t expected Ling Han to have such a move, but his strength was too extraordinary. With a thought, a mystical power barrier appeared in front of him, easily blocking Ling Han’s attack.

“What a good brat! You are practically a born assassin!” The old man was very impressed, “You should be Ding Yi, right? A cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier already has the power of 18 Heavens. Looking at the whole world, even an Imperial Son is no
match for you!”
“Good! Good! Good!”
Ling Han became slightly more alert, but his killing intent was still very strong. Now, under
the control of this consciousness, he was like an bloodthirsty demon god.
“Who are you?” he asked in a raspy voice.

sentences.text: Chapter 4058: Strange Shadow Steps
Ling Han felt that this was cruel, but he had no choice but to do so.
If he couldn’t learn the Second Style of the God of War, it was clear that he couldn’t go to the third level.
Thus, he suppressed all his emotions, and told himself that this was not a real corpse, but rather a formation manifestation.
However, this corpse was too real, and there was no difference between it and a real person.
Ling Han silently recited the Six Characters Bright King Curse in his mind.
His mind was clear, transcendent above all else.
After cutting open this corpse, Ling Han finally discovered seals again.
Some were on the bones, some were on the organs, and some were on the veins.
In short, Ling Han definitely had to dissect this corpse carefully to obtain the complete seal.
It could be said that this stage was not difficult to pass.
As long as one had the slightest bit of strength, and was ruthless enough, that was enough.
Thus, the first few stages were not used to impede seeds like them, but rather to “temper” their temperament, falling slowly in the direction of cold-bloodedness and cruelty.
Ling Han channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames, and boom, this corpse was instantly turned into ash.
He began to combine these seals.
With his outstanding comprehension ability, in less than half a day, he had already grasped the profound mysteries.
Ling Han began to practice.
This was indeed the Second Style of the God of War.
It was similarly much more complicated, and could be considered “authentic”.
As he cultivated, a door silently opened.
He could now go to the third floor.
Ling Han stepped out, but this time, no one attacked him.
He saw that there were ten elders lying or sitting on the ground, and they were all skin and bones.
Aside from them, there was no one else.
This!
To make a move on these defenseless old people that had no cultivation level at all?
The Battle God Palace, oh, the Battle God Palace.
He already knew that this was a cruel organization of assassins, but he still hadn’t imagined that such a method with no bottom line at all would be used to train new disciples.
Obviously, the seal of the Third Style of the God of War was on these old people, but it was definitely not their skin, but rather the same as the second floor.
It was too cruel, and too freakish.
Ling Han frowned deeply.
Even if he knew that this was a formation manifestation, he still felt extremely uncomfortable.
Furthermore, what if there was a real person for him to kill later?
“How exactly does the Battle God Palace judge whether seeds are affected or not?”
“If I forcefully suppress my negative emotions and maintain a clear mind, they might discover me.
After all, they’ve been doing this all their lives.
I’m the newbie here.”
“Thus, if I want to deceive everyone, I have to think of another way.”
“Yi, why don’t I create a second consciousness, and let this consciousness become a demon?
After I pass the test, I will then sever this consciousness.”
Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
In the Buddhist Race, this was actually a cultivation technique called Slaying Evil Thoughts or Slashing Heart Demons.

However, they would only slay demons and evil thoughts after they had developed them in their hearts, and as for Ling Han, he originally didn’t have any internal demons, but rather wanted to create one first.
“This can also be seen as a tempering.
After severing the internal demon in my heart, my willpower will definitely be able to become slightly stronger.”
“All right!”
Ling Han retracted his intent into the depths of his mind and adhered it to the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, using the power of this Celestial Core to cut off the connection with his physical body.
At the same time, he left behind a sliver of divine sense, leaving behind all the images that he had seen on the first and second levels.
When this sliver of divine sense entered Ling Han’s mind, he suddenly opened his eyes, instantly exuding an incredibly terrifying aura.
He was a completely different person.
There was no expression on his face, only coldness and slaughter.
Ling Han moved without hesitation.
Pa, pa, pa!
The ten old people were all killed.
He skinned them, searched for the seals, and then began to cultivate.
He had obtained the Third Style of the God of War.
The fourth level opened.
Ling Han had lost all emotion.
Like a demon, a god of death, he began a massacre, without the slightest hesitation.
The Fourth Style of the God of War, the Fifth Style…
When Ling Han charged to the ninth level, he had also learnt the Nine Styles of the Saint Technique.
However, after entering into the tenth level, though slaughter was still inevitable, he had not learnt the Tenth Style of the God of War.
Instead, he had learnt a secret technique that concealed his tracks.
This was called the Strange Shadow Step.
After channeling this secret technique, it was as if his whole person had entered into a shadow.
Even if they were face to face, you would not be able to discover that there was another person in front of you.
If you were suddenly attacked, your only fate would be death.
If it had been a seed-level assassin that had attempted to assassinate Ling Han, then merely this Strange Shadow Steps would be enough to cause Ling Han a lot of trouble.
However, the Strange Shadow Steps of the tenth level weren’t complete.
After Ling Han ascended to the eleventh level, he learned another part, and another part on the twelfth level.
It wasn’t until the sixteenth level that he finally mastered all of the Strange Shadow Steps.
Calculating the time, more than a month had already passed.
Though Ling Han felt a little hungry, as long as he had stepped into Celestial Path, he only had to absorb the energy of heaven and earth, and he would not die of hunger and thirst.
In his present consciousness, he was not a glutton at all.
Thus, he charged all the way to the
seventeenth level without the slightest hesitation.
A white-haired elder was presently sitting in a cross-legged position.
He was like a stone statue, without the slightest sign of life.
Ling Han wasn’t reserved at all.
He used the Strange Shadow Steps, and quietly arrived behind the old man.
Then, he shot out the Nine Styles of God of War, striking out at the old man.
“Good one, brat!” The old man humphed lightly, and without even turning his head, delivered a palm strike.
Peng!
Ling Han instantly turned into a rolling gourd, crashing into the wall before finally stopping.
However, he immediately used the Strange Shadow Steps and once again entered into the
shadows.
“Haha, showing off your Strange Shadow Steps in front of me, what a joke!” The white-haired old man laughed.
He stood up.
Boom, his whole person exuded a powerful life essence.
It was too terrifying, as if a furnace was burning fiercely.
“However, to be able to reach this kind of level in a short month’s time, and furthermore, you are only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
It is really not easy.”
“I have a high opinion of you!”
Xiu, right at this moment, Ling Han had already escaped from the shadows, and shot out a punch at the white-haired elder.
The white-haired elder moved, and very easily grabbed onto Ling Han’s wrist, preventing him from advancing an inch further.
However, in his current state, Ling Han’s only thought was to kill.
He swung his other fist at
the old man again.
The elder also reached over with his other hand and grabbed Ling Han’s wrist.
Ling Han straightened his back and launched a series of kicks.
“Hiss!” The old man was slightly shocked.
This desire for battle was too strong.
However, he was really too strong.
With a toss of his head, a few strands of grey hair flew out,
easily wrapping around Ling Han’s hands.
Ling Han opened his mouth, and the Heptagold Sword Qi slashed out.
“Yi?”
The old man hadn’t expected Ling Han to have such a move, but his strength was too extraordinary.
With a thought, a mystical power barrier appeared in front of him, easily blocking Ling Han’s attack.
“What a good brat!
You are practically a born assassin!” The old man was very impressed, “You should be Ding Yi, right?
A cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier already has the power of 18 Heavens.
Looking at the whole world, even an Imperial Son is no
match for you!”
“Good!
Good!
Good!”
Ling Han became slightly more alert, but his killing intent was still very strong.
Now, under
the control of this consciousness, he was like an bloodthirsty demon god.
“Who are you?” he asked in a raspy voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 4059: Breaking the rules
paragraphs: Chapter 4059: Breaking the rules
The white-haired elder smiled faintly, “I am Fu Tianyi, and I am your Teacher.”
After saying this, he released his hold on Ling Han.
Ling Han clasped his hands respectfully, “Lord Fu.”

Fu Tianyi nodded, “From this stage onwards, you would have to face me. On this level, I have the battle prowess of the early stage of the True Self Tier, which I will then increase with every consecutive level.”
Though Ling Han was freakish, it was obviously impossible for him to match a True Self Tier cultivator now.

“You are not too bad. Merely in terms of natural talent, you are not just the strongest among these seeds now, but also the strongest in all the generations of Battle God Palace!” Fu Tianyi was all smiles, “Though this is practically impossible, but if a Killing Emperor could emerge from our Battle God Palace… hahaha!”

He was filled with anticipation. Though the Battle God Palace had never lacked Saint-level elites, it had also never produced an Ancestral King. If a Assassin Emperor could emerge, then the Battle God Palace would be able to cast off their fate of being unable to see the light of day, and walk to the front lines in a dignified manner.
With their Imperial Might, who dared to oppose it?

In the future, even if they killed Emperors, the Battle God Palace would be the Imperial Clan. With the Imperial Weapon keeping watch, they would be able to stand on equal footing with any Imperial Clan.

That’s right. At present, they even dared to trifle with the Imperial Clan, but that couldn’t be seen in public at all. They were only at a mental disadvantage because no one knew where the Battle God Palace was.
Just ask the world, what force did not want to become an Imperial Clan?

Of course, becoming an Emperor was much, much too difficult. Not only was it a matter of natural talent, it also depended on luck. This thing could not be seen or touched, and completely depended on whether one had the favour of the heaven and earth.

“Very good. You have reached the seventeenth level so quickly, so you can be considered to have passed the test.” Fu Tianyi patted Ling Han’s shoulder, incredibly satisfied with him. Every level of the Blood Tower was tempering his heart. After passing through so many levels, his temperament must have been refined to an incredibly bloodthirsty state. Furthermore, he could also clearly see that Ling Han had indeed completely fallen into the path of death, and could no longer return.
“Go and rest for a while. It’s time to strike a balance between work and rest,” he said.
“Understood,” Ling Han replied with a nod. He then turned around and descended, level by level. He then exited the Blood Tower.

He had just stepped out, when he saw that there were a few people standing outside. Meanwhile, Chen Bing and Zhao Biao, who had entered earlier, were lying on the ground, moaning, but there was no sign of Zhu Yan.
“Finally, another one has come out.” Among the five people standing, one of them spotted Ling Han and said with a smile.
“Brat, come here and kneel!” another person said.
The current person in charge of Ling Han was a demon king of slaughter!
A baleful killing intent instantly appeared on Ling Han’s face, and he said, “If I don’t kneel? Would I lie on the ground like these two weaklings?”
“That’s right,” the first person said.
Xiu, Ling Han charged out, and shot out a punch.
“F***, this maniac!” That person had not thought that Ling Han would move so decisively, and hurriedly launched a counterattack.
He was a consummate level cultivator of the Core Formation Tier, and his raw power was as high as 22 Heavens, which was considerably stronger than Ling Han.
Peng!

The two of them exchanged a blow. Ling Han was outmatched, and was immediately sent flying. However, his figure had not even landed on the ground, when he had already used the Strange Shadow Steps. His figure instantly slipped into darkness, and could not be seen clearly at all.
“Heavens!” Those who were standing all exclaimed in shock, appearing to be incredibly stunned.

They naturally knew that Ling Han had used the Strange Shadow Steps. However, this guy had only entered the Blood Tower for over a month, and he had already reached above the tenth floor? Furthermore, not only had he mastered the Strange Shadow Steps, he could even -channel them nimbly.
What kind of prodigy was this?

It should be known that they were also seeds. Thus, even though they were now fellow disciples, in truth, they were competitors that would fight to the death. In the end, only one of them would be able to survive, and become the king of assassins.
Ling Han’s comprehension ability was too terrifying, causing them to feel a strong killing intent.
“Humph, don’t think that you’re the only one who has mastered the Strange Shadow Steps!” Ling Han’s opponent humphed coldly, and he too entered into the darkness.
The two of them disappeared without a trace. Now, it was up to who would be the first to find who, and take the initiative.

No matter how one looked at it, it was Ling Han’s opponent that had a greater advantage, because his cultivation level was higher, his battle prowess was stronger, and he had also cultivated the Strange Shadow Steps for a longer time.
Peng!
Right at this moment, a figure appeared. He had been beaten out, and his feet were stumbling. Immediately after, another figure also appeared, immediately beginning the
pursuit.
Seeing this scene, everyone was dumbfounded, because the person that had been blasted out was actually not Ling Han, but rather he had caught hold of his opponent, and succeeded with
a single strike.
Heavens!

“Huai Rong is a Core Formation Tier consummate level cultivator, and he climbed to the fifteenth floor. His grasp of the Strange Shadow Steps is already close to perfection, so how could he be inferior to this rookie?”
“Ding Yi! Ding Yi! How could it be that this guy is really so terrifying?”
“Not good, Huai Rong has completely fallen into a passive position!”

“Senior Brother Zhang and the others didn’t come. They’re all only at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and their battle prowess is not much different from Huai Rong. I’m afraid the result would be the same even if they came.”
These people exchanged looks, completely stupefied.

They were also seeds of the king of assassins, but had entered the Battle God Palace several hundred years earlier than Ling Han and the others. This time, when they heard that new disciples had come, they deliberately wanted to take the new disciples down a notch. Because they were competitors, there was naturally no need for them to be reserved.
And as long as no one was killed or crippled, the Battle God Palace would also turn a blind eye to this. After all, all the people who had risen above the masses were the true kings of
assassins.
They had never thought that Ling Han would be so awesome, being able to suppress Huai Rong with his cultivation level of the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier-completely unreasonable.

Ling Han’s figure appeared and disappeared. His grasp of the Strange Shadow Steps surpassed Huai Rong’s. Furthermore, he also had an eye technique that could see through falsehoods. With the two combined, Huai Rong’s Strange Shadow Steps was simply a joke in front of him. Huai Rong was completely thrashed. It was clear that he had the absolute upper hand in terms of battle prowess, yet he did not even have the chance to exchange a head-on blow with Ling Han. He only had power, yet was unable to use it, which made him extremely depressed.
At present, he could only tire himself out in parrying. If he was the slightest bit careless, he would be severely injured.

It should be known that he was a seed of the king of assassins. He was clearly one of the most skilled assassins in the world, yet now, Ling Han was ambushing him time and time again from the shadows. How could he endure this?
However, he was the one who had provoked him, so he couldn’t run. This was awkward, and
he could only be continuously attacked by Ling Han.
Everyone was speechless, and could only feel a deep sense of shock.
Peng!
Ling Han seized this opportunity to punch Huai Rong’s left leg, forcefully breaking it.
“Ah-” Huai Rong screamed, falling onto the ground, his expression extremely pained.
At present, Ling Han only had the thought of slaughter, and had absolutely no intention of stopping. He charged over again.
“You dare!” Immediately, someone was about to rush up, but was stopped by the others.
Why were they stopping him?
Just let Ling Han kill Huai Rong. Killing each other was strictly forbidden here, so if Ling Han
killed anyone, he would also be executed.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Under Ling Han’s close pursuit, Huai Rong was forced to stand on one foot, continuing to
fight fiercely with Ling Han.
However, Ling Han had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, which could disperse power attacks,
and and he wanted to fight him head-on?
After several hundred moves, Huai Rong was killed by Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4060: Easily Resolved
paragraphs: Chapter 4060: Easily Resolved
Good!

Seeing this scene, the remaining four all cheered in their hearts. In any case, they were all competitors among themselves, and now, there were two of them that would be eliminated all at once. Furthermore, one of them was a freak like Ling Han. This was really too good.
Ling Han’s killing intent was completely ignited. He looked at the four people again, his eyes cold.
“Haha, don’t look at others with such a fierce gaze.”
“Killing each other is strictly forbidden here. You have already broken the rules, and the result is… death!”
“What a pity, such a prodigy!”
The four of them shook their heads, pretending to feel pity.
Xiu, a figure flew over. It was Wan He.
“What’s going on?” His eyes swept over Huai Rong, who was lying on the ground, and he frowned.

The four of them hurriedly began to talk at once. They did not distort the truth. There was absolutely no need for that. There was only one thing that was important, and that was Ling Han had killed Huai Rong.
“Ding Yi, were you the one who killed Huai Rong?” Wan He looked at Ling Han with a baleful expression.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded, “I will kill whoever wants to kill me.”
That was the only explanation.

“Humph, have you forgotten that I told you that it is strictly forbidden to kill each other here?” Wan He said in disappointment, “Since you have broken the rules, don’t blame me!” He raised his hand, about to execute the rules, and kill Ling Han.
“Little Yi, what are you doing?” Fu Tianyi’s voice rang out, and a figure appeared, his white hair fluttering.
When Wan He saw this, he hurriedly bowed and said, “Greetings, Lord Fu!”
Fu Tianyi was a Sect Master, and was a major tier higher than him. In the cultivation world, if there was a gap of a level between cultivation levels, that was an insurmountable gulf.
Even if this was only a manifestation of Fu Tianyi’s spirit.
“Hoho, I am here, so what need is there for you to enforce the rules?” Fu Tianyi stated calmly, “I am completely capable of moving, and stopping their battle. Why would I not?”
‘F*ck! He’s blatantly shielding him!’
When the four seeds saw this, they all had sense of foreboding.
“But-“Wan He wanted to argue.

“There are no buts.” Fu Tianyi immediately stopped him, “Inside the Divine Palace, it is indeed forbidden to kill each other, but that is to protect those with lower cultivation level. If that was not the case, what would be called a contest?”
“However, if someone with a higher cultivation level can’t defeat someone with a lower cultivation level, what right does he have to live?”
“So, this Huai Rong sought his own death.”
Yi, there was such an explanation?
Wan He’s mouth gaped open. He wanted to say something, but in the end, he did not say anything.
You’re awesome, so whatever you say.
“Go on, rest well.” Meanwhile, Fu Tianyi waved a hand at Ling Han.
Ling Han bowed respectfully to Fu Tianyi, then left.
Looking at Ling Han’s disappearing back, everyone was extremely speechless.
After killing a seed, he could still leave without a second thought. This was the first time.
Meanwhile, Fu Tianyi was stroking his white beard, his face full of smiles.

This seed was really too much to his liking. He was resolute and decisive, and was also inconceivably strong. The chances of him becoming a Saint was as high as 99%. In fact, he even had a chance of breaking through to Emperor Tier!
-If he knew that this seed was Ling Han, whom the Battle God Palace was determined to get rid of, how would he feel?
He had barged into the Battle God Palace and killed a seed?
Haha, they would definitely be laughed to death.
Ling Han returned to his residence. His main consciousness immediately began to fully take over. However, that sliver of divine sense was naturally unwilling to die, and began a counterattack.
As expected, the gap was too wide.
This was only a sliver of divine sense, so how could it possibly rival the main consciousness?
The battle only continued for a few seconds, and Ling Han’s main consciousness returned to him.

“Now, I can be considered to have gotten over the issue of identity,” Ling Han mumbled to himself. “The inheritance of the Blood Tower is too strange, and seriously affects one’s temperament. Even if it is only a month, this sliver of divine sense that I have split out has become incredibly bloodthirsty. If it was a little longer, it is really possible that it would grow to the extent that it can contend with the main consciousness.”
“This is playing with fire and self-immolating. It’s too dangerous.”
“Now all I have to do is wait for a chance so I can leave.”
“Previously, I heard from Wan He that the seeds still have to go out on missions, which gives me a chance to escape.”

Ling Han focused his attention on his own wrist. There had once been a mark on it, and it was like a lighthouse in the darkness, guiding the Transfer Formation of the Battle God Palace. Thus, he had to erase this mark. Otherwise, no matter how far he ran, he would still be easily
captured and brought back.
“Yi, this is a one-use item!”
After Ling Han examined it for a while, he came to a conclusion.
“That’s true. After coming here, if you don’t die, you’ll become a seed. And if the seed hadn’t been successfully brainwashed, why would he be sent out on a mission? Thus, there’s no need
for this mark.”
“Of course, it’s also possible that he will be stamped with another mark when they leave.”
“I can only take things one step at a time.”
Ling Han cultivated diligently. He was a seed, which was equivalent to having status as a Dao Child. Thus, he did not lack cultivation resources at all.
Though the Battle God Palace was a force that hid in the shadows and could not see the light
of day at all, in terms of wealth, this force was really extremely wealthy. After all, killing people was a very profitable job.
Ling Han was also the most favoured seed, so an endless stream of natural treasures was sent
to Ling Han for him to cultivate.
This was really not too bad.
Even Ling Han felt an urge to stay here forever and cultivate until he became a Saint before leaving. The Battle God Palace was indeed rich and imposing.
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
“Come with me,” Fu Tianyi appeared, and said to Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t ask any questions, and simply followed after him.
They arrived at an empty space, and saw that there was actually another Fu Tianyi seated
there.
Ling Han didn’t find this strange. He knew that the seated Fu Tianyi was the real one, and the one who had come to call him should only be a spiritual body.
One after another, more and more Fu Tianyi appeared. They all had a seed with them, including Zhu Yan and Chen Bing.
“Today, I will bring everyone to carry out a mission,” Fu Tianyi said, “Hehe, don’t think that
this is a game. Everyone will be assigned a target according to their abilities, and it is guaranteed that the difficulty level would be about the same.”
“Those who fail the mission will be executed! The last person to complete the mission will be
executed!”
“Understood?”
This was brutal!
Everyone was expressionless, and merely nodded solemnly.
After such a long time, the seeds of slaughter had been planted in everyone’s hearts, and their personalities had long since been twisted.
Ling Han naturally remained calm and collected. His heart was filled with anticipation. He
could finally leave.
Fu Tianyi tore a rip into space. He was a Sect Master elite, and had already gained preliminary
grasp of the ability to tear a rip into space and teleport.
“Let’s go!” Everyone walked in, one after another. Fu Tianyi was the last to walk in. With a curl of his
large hand, he brought everyone through the Void.
He was much weaker than the Nine Mountains Venerate. He would often be affected by the chaotic flow of space, but in the end, they would still arrive safely.
Fu Tianyi tore open space again, and everyone had already appeared on a different planet.

sentences.text: Chapter 4060: Easily Resolved
Good!
Seeing this scene, the remaining four all cheered in their hearts.
In any case, they were all competitors among themselves, and now, there were two of them that would be eliminated all at once.
Furthermore, one of them was a freak like Ling Han.
This was really too good.
Ling Han’s killing intent was completely ignited.
He looked at the four people again, his eyes cold.
“Haha, don’t look at others with such a fierce gaze.”
“Killing each other is strictly forbidden here.
You have already broken the rules, and the result is… death!”
“What a pity, such a prodigy!”
The four of them shook their heads, pretending to feel pity.
Xiu, a figure flew over.
It was Wan He.
“What’s going on?” His eyes swept over Huai Rong, who was lying on the ground, and he frowned.
The four of them hurriedly began to talk at once.
They did not distort the truth.
There was absolutely no need for that.
There was only one thing that was important, and that was Ling Han had killed Huai Rong.
“Ding Yi, were you the one who killed Huai Rong?” Wan He looked at Ling Han with a baleful expression.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded, “I will kill whoever wants to kill me.”
That was the only explanation.

“Humph, have you forgotten that I told you that it is strictly forbidden to kill each other here?” Wan He said in disappointment, “Since you have broken the rules, don’t blame me!” He raised his hand, about to execute the rules, and kill Ling Han.
“Little Yi, what are you doing?” Fu Tianyi’s voice rang out, and a figure appeared, his white hair fluttering.
When Wan He saw this, he hurriedly bowed and said, “Greetings, Lord Fu!”
Fu Tianyi was a Sect Master, and was a major tier higher than him.
In the cultivation world, if there was a gap of a level between cultivation levels, that was an insurmountable gulf.
Even if this was only a manifestation of Fu Tianyi’s spirit.
“Hoho, I am here, so what need is there for you to enforce the rules?” Fu Tianyi stated calmly, “I am completely capable of moving, and stopping their battle.
Why would I not?”
‘F*ck!
He’s blatantly shielding him!’
When the four seeds saw this, they all had sense of foreboding.
“But-“Wan He wanted to argue.
“There are no buts.” Fu Tianyi immediately stopped him, “Inside the Divine Palace, it is indeed forbidden to kill each other, but that is to protect those with lower cultivation level.
If that was not the case, what would be called a contest?”
“However, if someone with a higher cultivation level can’t defeat someone with a lower cultivation level, what right does he have to live?”
“So, this Huai Rong sought his own death.”
Yi, there was such an explanation?
Wan He’s mouth gaped open.
He wanted to say something, but in the end, he did not say anything.
You’re awesome, so whatever you say.
“Go on, rest well.” Meanwhile, Fu Tianyi waved a hand at Ling Han.
Ling Han bowed respectfully to Fu Tianyi, then left.
Looking at Ling Han’s disappearing back, everyone was extremely speechless.
After killing a seed, he could still leave without a second thought.
This was the first time.
Meanwhile, Fu Tianyi was stroking his white beard, his face full of smiles.
This seed was really too much to his liking.
He was resolute and decisive, and was also inconceivably strong.
The chances of him becoming a Saint was as high as 99%.
In fact, he even had a chance of breaking through to Emperor Tier!
-If he knew that this seed was Ling Han, whom the Battle God Palace was determined to get rid of, how would he feel?
He had barged into the Battle God Palace and killed a seed?
Haha, they would definitely be laughed to death.
Ling Han returned to his residence.
His main consciousness immediately began to fully take over.
However, that sliver of divine sense was naturally unwilling to die, and began a counterattack.
As expected, the gap was too wide.
This was only a sliver of divine sense, so how could it possibly rival the main consciousness?
The battle only continued for a few seconds, and Ling Han’s main consciousness returned to him.
“Now, I can be considered to have gotten over the issue of identity,” Ling Han mumbled to himself.
“The inheritance of the Blood Tower is too strange, and seriously affects one’s temperament.
Even if it is only a month, this sliver of divine sense that I have split out has become incredibly bloodthirsty.
If it was a little longer, it is really possible that it would grow to the extent that it can contend with the main consciousness.”
“This is playing with fire and self-immolating.
It’s too dangerous.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4061: Escape
paragraphs: Chapter 4061: Escape

“We’ll now assign the targets of assassination,” Fu Tianyi said. With a flick of his index finger, he sent the target information into everyone’s minds, including age, cultivation level, abilities, and clan background.
Of course, appearance was important. It would appear in the form of a three-dimensional image.
“All right, let’s set out!”
One after another, spiritual bodies walked out from the main body. This was firstly, for protection, and secondly, for surveillance, to ensure that there would be no accidents.

Ling Han looked at the target of his mission. This was the Young Master of a clan. The employer was probably one of his clansmen, and one who was able to compete for the position of heir to the clan leader’s position. As long as he killed this Young Master who was first in line, those who were ranked later would naturally be able to replace him.
There was no animosity between them, so it was naturally impossible for Ling Han to kill innocent people.
But Fu Tianyi’s spiritual body was watching from the sidelines. How could it be that he could cheat?
Furthermore, the last person to complete the mission would be executed.
There was no time to waste, so he would stop here.

Though Ling Han still did not know exactly where the Battle God Palace was, and was also slightly reluctant to part with the cultivation resources inside the Battle God Palace, since he was unwilling to go against his principles and kill someone who had no animosity with him, there was only one option left for him.
Xiu, he suddenly disappeared.
Fu Tianyi was a little dumbfounded. What was going on here? In front of him, a mighty Sect Master, there was actually someone that could kidnap Ling Han?
That’s not right!

Realization immediately dawned on him. It was definitely not some inconceivably powerful person that had kidnapped Ling Han, but rather Ling Han had channeled some kind of movement technique and suddenly teleported away.
However, how could a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator teleport?
Moreover, even Venerate Tier elites needed to tear open space before they could teleport. So, what was Ling Han relying on?
Had he been teleported away by some kind of formation?
No, there was no sign that a formation had activated.
Just as Fu Tianyi was feeling puzzled, another Fu Tianyi appeared. This was his true self.
The spirit body immediately fused into the main body. In terms of ability of deduction and thought, the spirit body was naturally inferior to the main body. This was definite.
Fu Tianyi thought about this process again, and couldn’t help but raise a brow. Star Steps!
Only Formations Grandmasters could make use of ley lines and instantly flee.
This seed was actually a Formations Grandmaster?
At first, Fu Tianyi was pleasantly surprised, but immediately, he frowned again.
He clearly possessed this kind of ability, so why did he not say it out loud? Then, the level of notice that he would receive would definitely rise to another level.
Unless!
This seed had never thought of submitting to the Battle God Palace in the first place, and that was why he had concealed this ability – not good!
He immediately tore a rip into space and arrived at the Transfer Formation of this planet. Ling Han definitely wanted to flee!
However, even if he was a Formations Grandmaster, Ling Han’s cultivation level was only at the Core Formation Tier. Thus, if he wanted to leave this planet, he would need the Transfer Formation.
Thus, if he waited here, he would definitely be able to catch Ling Han.
Hehe, after capturing him, this time, he would personally brainwash Ling Han.
Strange, he had already climbed to the seventeenth floor of the Blood Tower, so why would he still think of fleeing?
He smirked coldly. With his Sect Master-level strength, Ling Han would never be able to escape.
Right at this moment, a young man walked past him.
Fu Tianyi swept his divine sense over him, and immediately withdrew it.
Ling Han broke into a smile. He had changed his appearance and soul fluctuation, and even Fu Tianyi was unable to recognize him.
He was leaving.
He entered the Transfer Formation and activated it. Weng! A white light flashed, and he instantly disappeared without a trace.
When Ling Han reappeared, he had already arrived at another planet.
He changed his appearance again, and returned to his original appearance.
Ling Han connected to the Galaxy Network and contacted the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others.
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu and the empress both exclaimed in shock, their voices filled with extreme
concern.

“F***, you’ve finally made contact. Grandpa Dog thought you were dead.” The large black dog didn’t say anything nice, “Brat, why did you disappear as you walked? Could it be that you were seduced by some vixen?”
This was very much like the large black dog, extremely despicable.
Ling Han shook his head, saying, “I was captured by the Battle God Palace.”
Instantly, the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog all fell silent. Then, they became anxious, and rushed to ask Ling Han about his present situation.
Ling Han recounted his recent experiences, and only then did the empress and the others
relax.

“No wonder you immediately transformed into Ding Yi. As it turned out, you’ve already guessed it.” The large black dog breathed a sigh of relief, and said, “Brat, you suddenly disappeared, and you didn’t appear even after so long. Now, everyone’s saying that you were killed by the Battle God Palace, and they’re trying to erase you from the prodigy list.”

Ling Han laughed loudly, “All right. When I return, I will slap their faces.” “Alright, hurry up. It’s been a long time since I’ve gone with you to swindle people. Grandpa Dog is a little unused to it,” the large black dog said.
“Ling Han, Niu misses you!” Hu Niu also said.
Meanwhile, the empress was still as domineering as before. She simply said, “Hurry up and
come home!”
Ling Han nodded. He boarded the Transfer Formation and headed home.
However, he wasn’t in the North Heavenly Realm right now. Instead, he was in the West Heavenly Realm!
Was the Battle God Palace in the West Heavenly Realm?

Ling Han nodded. Though he did not know the exact location of the Battle God Palace, Fu Tianyi was only Sect Master Tier-level. After tearing a rip into space, they had not travelled for too long either. Thus, the Battle God Palace should be in the West Heavenly Realm. Putting aside the Battle God Palace for now, when his abilities improved, he would naturally be able to sweep aside all opposition in this organization.
Moreover, he had also learnt the true Nine Styles of the God of War, as well as the Strange Shadow Steps, which increased his strength slightly.
This trip was not a loss.
After travelling for a few days, Ling Han finally stopped.
Transfer Formations couldn’t be used continuously, because every time it was used, it would cause a huge burden on the body. If it was used too many times, one would die.
He found an inn to stay in. He had not had a good meal for so many days, and now that he had returned to being Ling Han, he naturally had to eat without restraint.
After eating and drinking to his heart’s content, Ling Han stayed here for a few more days, planning to set out again. However, when he was eating this last meal at the inn, he heard
some customers discussing.
They mentioned a term-Soul Nurturing Stone.

This was a type of Divine Stone that could strengthen one’s divine sense. It was greatly beneficial even for Spirit Transformation True Lords, and for the Core Formation Tier, it was also an excellent ingredient for nourishing the Celestial Core.

At present, a massive Soul Nurturing Stone had been discovered, but there were really too many forces participating in the competition. Thus, an elite had spoken, and that was for the youngsters to compete. Thus, a great number of young prodigies were presently rushing over.
Ling Han was instantly moved. Now that he had temporarily gotten rid of the Battle God Palace, he no longer had a sharp sword hanging by his neck.
He would first go and take this Soul Nurturing Stone, then return to Nine Suns Holy Land.
Ling Han listened for a while longer, and already knew clearly where this Soul Nurturing
Stone was.
Black Rock Mountain.
Let’s go.
Ling Han set out, heading towards the Black Rock Mountain. After travelling for a few hours,
he arrived at his destination.
The Black Rock Mountain was pitch-black and towered into the clouds like a sharp sword that
pierced into the clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 4062: Mocking Frankly
paragraphs: Chapter 4062: Mocking Frankly
Editor: Henyee Translations
The Black Rock Mountain belonged to the Black Rock Sect.

However, the Black Rock Sect was not very powerful, and even the strongest among them was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier. Thus, when a Soul Nurturing Stone was discovered here, the Sect Master made a prompt decision. He did not think of hiding this treasure, or selling it for a high price. Instead, he contacted a great force, wanting to offer it up as a gift.
This was a wise move. Otherwise, this kind of precious treasure would definitely cause a great massacre, causing the Black Rock Sect to disappear overnight.

However, for some reason, the information about the Soul Nurturing Stone leaked out, attracting the attention of a great many powerful forces. Just when they were about to engage in a great battle for it, a super elite passed by and stopped this battle.
Thus, under the guidance of this elite, the Black Rock Sect took out the Soul Nurturing Stone and had the young prodigies contend for it.
Promoting martial arts was the true way to go.

Thus, countless young prodigies rushed over from all corners of the West Heavenly Realm. As for the other Heavenly Realms, because they were too far away, they probably wouldn’t make it in time. Of course, if Venerate Tier elites were willing to make a move, they would still make it in time.

Now, the Black Rock Sect had opened their doors widely, and anyone could ascend the mountain. Of course, those whose abilities were too weak would not need to ascend, as they were completely unqualified to participate.
“Sir, please identify yourself.” Just as Ling Han was about to ascend the mountain, he was stopped by the two disciples on duty from the Black Rock Sect.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “My name is Ling Han.”
“Ling Han?” The two of them looked at each other, both wearing blank expressions.

Ling Han’s name was already renowned throughout the entire North Heavenly Realm. However, in the West Heavenly Realm, his name was limited to the knowledge of those supreme prodigies. Ordinary people didn’t know who he was.
“What cultivation level do you have?” a disciple asked.
This question was still the most practical.
Ling Han smiled and replied, “Core Formation Tier.”
“This way please, sir.” The two disciples immediately looked reverent. Their Sect Master was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, and this was a supreme elite in their eyes.
Ling Han nodded, and walked up the mountain.
The Black Rock Mountain was extraordinarily tall, but for Ling Han, it would only need about ten minutes, and he would be able to reach the summit.
There were quite a lot of people.

Ling Han saw a few familiar faces, such as Yi Yuanrong, the number one Core Formation Tier of the West Heavenly Realm, such as Shi Yongming, the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm, as well as some other prodigies that he had seen at the Donglin Imperial Clan.

In terms of specifications, the lineup of competitors this time was really strong. Those who came were all the top prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm, and even a Buddha Son like Shi Yongming had come.
However, the competition had not begun yet. Thus, since they had nothing else to do, everyone began to discuss cultivation here.
Ling Han remained calm and collected. He simply watched and listened from the sidelines, treating himself as a spectator.
“I heard that the North Heavenly Realm has produced a so-called prodigy called Ling Han or something.” Someone suddenly changed the topic to Ling Han.
Yi?
Was he getting shot while lying down?
Ling Han reflected on himself. He seemed to have been keeping a very low profile recently.
“Haha, don’t mention this person anymore.” Someone continued, “That Ling Han has already been assassinated by the Battle God Palace.”
“Really?”
“That’s for sure. Who can survive being targeted by the Battle God Palace?”

“That may not be the case. In history, there have also been people who have been placed on the must-kill list by the Battle God Palace. chapters.title: Chapter 4063: Duel with the West Heavenly Realm
paragraphs: Chapter 4063: Duel with the West Heavenly Realm
Xiu, Ma Wanlong was sent flying with a single punch.

A great many people showed expressions of shock. As expected, no one’s fame was in vain. This number one prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm was really awesome. No wonder he could defeat even an Imperial Son. However, prodigies like Yi Yuanrong and Shi Yongming showed no expression of shock at all. That was because they could do the same thing, and could do so easier.
No matter what, a few years ago, Ling Han was only in the Cauldron Forging Tier. How far could he reach now?
Early stage of Core Formation Tier? Middle stage?
“Hmph, no matter how strong he is, he’s only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier!” Yi Yuanrong walked out with a murderous expression.
For some reason, she felt an indescribable resentment when she looked at Ling Han.
It had to be said that women’s instincts were quite sharp. Even if she didn’t know that Ling Han and Ding Yi were the same person, she still subconsciously felt that Ling Han was detestable.
“Yi Yuanrong is about to make a move.”𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
“It can’t be, right? He just defeated Ma Wanlong, and the number one person of our West Heavenly Realm is making a move?”
“This is called a lion would fight a rabbit with its full strength. How could it be that Ling Han would have to defeat a few more of our people before we defeat him?”
“That’s true. In any case, he’s going to be defeated, so there’s no need for him to be arrogant a few times.”
Everyone nodded, thinking that Yi Yuanrong was very decisive. Otherwise, if Ling Han defeated a few more prodigies of the West Heavenly Realm, Ling Han would really have something to boast about.

Ling Han’s fighting spirit soared. In the Battle God Palace, he had obtained innumerable cultivation resources. Though only half a year had passed, with how freakish he was, he had already cultivated more than half of the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and now his power had reached the 19 Heavens.

This was definitely still inferior to those top-notch prodigies, especially for someone like Yi Yuanrong, the top Core Formation Tier of the West Heavenly Realm. Her power was probably at 22 Heavens, but in terms of power, there were definitely not many in the world that could suppress him in terms of power.
“Make your move,” Ling Han said calmly.
“How arrogant!” Yi Yuanrong humphed, and charged towards Ling Han.

As expected of the top Core Formation Tier of the West Heavenly Realm. She only casually sent out a palm strike, but a brilliance that filled the skies blazed, and even the sun in the skies paled in comparison.
Boom, a palm struck out, its might soaring to the heavens.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and greeted the incoming attack with a raised fist.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han was instantly sent flying.

This was within Ling Han’s expectations. After all, there was a gap of three Heavens in power between them, so it was normal for him to be outmatched. However, he had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, so it was completely a piece of cake for him to disperse the attack power.
In an instant, Ling Han charged back.
This caused everyone to be dumbfounded. It was clear that there was such a wide gap in power, but why was Ling Han completely unscathed after a head-on clash?
He was really a monster!
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them continued to exchange blows. At this time, it was naturally the elite in power that had the absolute upper hand, and Ling Han was continuously sent flying. However, every time he was sent flying, Ling Han would immediately charge back, as if he had an undying and indestructible body.
Even if Ling Han didn’t have the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, he would still be able to withstand this kind of bombardment.

Ling Han didn’t use the Primal Chaos Celestial Core to suppress Yi Yuanrong’s battle prowess, nor did he use the murderous aura to attack Yi Yuanrong. Nor did he summon the Earth Dragon, and merely attacked her with the traditional celestial techniques.
This was enough to make Yi Yuanrong suffer.

Her battle prowess was indeed stronger, but she was unable to take down her opponent even after a long time. Her mystical power had been expended too much, and in such a high- intensity battle, how long could she last?
Those with discerning eyes could all see clearly, and they all frowned.
If the battle continued like this, Yi Yuanrong would flourish first and rapidly decline.
Others could see clearly, and Yi Yuanrong was naturally aware as well. She gave a soft exclamation, and her attack became even fiercer.

Unfortunately, unless her battle prowess surpassed Ling Han by six Heavens, no matter what she did, she would not be able to cause the slightest bit of effect on Ling Han. It would only speed up the expenditure of her mystical power.
On the surface, Yi Yuanrong’s advantage was further increased, but in truth, she was speeding up the scales of victory to tilt towards Ling Han’s side.
After battling for over an hour, Yi Yuanrong had no choice but to withdraw from the battle.
She did not say anything, but everyone knew that she had already lost.
This dealt a serious blow to the morale of the people from the West Heavenly Realm. Even the strongest elite of the Core Formation Tier couldn’t take down Ling Han, so who else could do
anything to this guy?

“Humph, a piece of trash from the North Heavenly Realm came to our West Heavenly Realm and still dares to strut around like this?” A man whose whole body was enshrouded in black mist walked out, and his face could not be seen at all.
“Yi, who is this guy?”
Not only did Ling Han not recognize this person, but even the people from the West Heavenly Realm didn’t recognize him. They all looked at each other in confusion.
“That’s Cold Mist Holy Land’s Zhong Tian.”
“Hiss, the Cold Mist Holy Land!”

When it came to Zhong Tian, no one knew who he was, but it was a different story for the Cold Mist Holy Land. The words ‘Holy Land’ were enough to explain everything. There had once been a Saint, and he was practically standing at the pinnacle of martial arts.

Those from the Holy Lands could not be underestimated, because the Imperial Clans had not managed to produce another Ancestral King. However, the Holy Lands were different. A great many Holy Lands had produced a second Saint, or even a third. The best example was the Battle God Palace. They had never lost their inheritance from a lack of Killing Saints. However, even Yi Yuanrong was unable to defeat Ling Han, so what right did Zhong Tian have
to step out?

“Don’t blindly believe in the Galaxy Network’s ranking!” someone said. “Look at those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters. Which one of them appeared on the Galaxy Network’s ranking? However, what about their strength?”
“However, those are Imperial Daughters and Imperial Sons!” Immediately, someone
retorted.
“Hehe, then you should also know that some Holy Lands have Saints keeping watch. In terms
of nurturing disciples, they may not be much inferior to the Imperial Clans.”
“True.”
Everyone nodded one after another, then focused their gazes on Zhong Tian. Could this guy really be even more powerful than Yi Yuanrong?
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, “Come.”
Zhong Tian sneered, “You are really arrogant!”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Wrong, this is not called arrogance, but strength!”
“Zhong Tian, teach him a lesson!” someone shouted coldly. This was a white-haired man, but
his face was very young, forming a strong contrast.
“All right.” Zhong Tian nodded.
“Yi, who is this white-haired man?” someone beside him asked.
“Shh! This is the Great Mountain Holy Land’s Luo Mingdong, the current Dao Child!” Immediately, someone reprimanded, telling him to watch his words.
“I don’t think I’ve seen him on the Galaxy Network either?”
“Indeed.”
“From this, it can be seen that the whole world is really filled with crouching tigers and
hidden dragons. There are a great many supreme prodigies that keep too low a profile.”
Just as everyone was conversing, Zhong Tian had already risen into the skies, looking down on
Ling Han.
Boom!
When Ling Han also rose into the air, Zhong Tian suddenly delivered a palm strike.
This was not considered a sneak attack on Ling Han, because this palm strike was very casual,
and definitely would not be able to wound Ling Han.
However, there was a strong sense of disdain in this.
I, look, down, on, you!

paragraphs: Chapter 4064: All Trash
Ling Han was instantly angered.
‘You want to humiliate me?’
He immediately shot out a murderous aura attack. This could ignore distance, and instantly blasted into Zhong Tian’s mind.

“Wu!” Even if Zhong Tian’s willpower was as strong as iron, he still revealed a pained expression after being struck by the murderous aura. However, he did not grab his head and moan. Merely this fact was enough to prove that he was extraordinary.
However, affected by this, the palm strike he delivered naturally slanted, and who knew where it had hit.
Seeing this scene, everyone shook their heads, feeling that Zhong Tian was too weak.

They didn’t know how terrifying the murderous aura was. They only saw that Ling Han hadn’t even launched a single attack, and Zhong Tian was already thrown into disarray. His palm strike had completely missed its target, and he even showed a pained expression. With such measly abilities, why did he still have to come out and embarrass himself?
“Damn it!” Zhong Tian had already gotten his breath back. He roared loudly, and launched a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

He was truly powerful. With a single strike, fog swirled back, like the air of Primal Chaos from when the universe was first created. It was incredibly ancient and powerful, and anyone who saw it would feel a chill in their hearts.
As it turned out, this guy’s strength was so terrifying!
“I’ve misjudged him. He’s actually this powerful!”
“Not inferior to Yi Yuanrong!”
“No, he should be stronger than Yi Yuanrong.”
“That’s right. If he was only as strong as Yi Yuanrong, then why did he step out?”
Everyone nodded one after another. Then, they all looked shocked, because this proved that Ling Han was even more terrifying.
-Just now, Zhong Tian’s palm strike had missed for no reason. It must be Ling Han’s doing. In truth, Zhong Tian’s battle prowess was indeed superior to Yi Yuanrong.

Ling Han exchanged blows with Zhong Tian. Naturally, he was the clearest about Zhong Tian’s strength. This guy’s raw power was as high as 23 Heavens, and added with the Saint Technique, his battle prowess had reached 25 Heavens!
It should be known that even the strongest cultivator of the Core Formation Tier in the entire Galaxy Network had not broken through to battle prowess of 24 Heavens!
Sure enough, the ranking of the Galaxy Network didn’t represent everything.
Zhong Tian was very aggressive, and every move was bold and powerful, wanting to crush Ling Han into dust in the most violent state.
But he also had the same problem as Yi Yuanrong, and that was his battle prowess was unable to surpass Ling Han by six Heavens.
If he didn’t break through this barrier, how could he hurt Ling Han?
However, this time, Ling Han wasn’t as patient as before. He wanted to end the battle as quickly as possible.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core was activated. A supreme aura spread out, causing Zhong Tian’s battle prowess to drop drastically by three Heavens.

“What!” Even with Zhong Tian’s strong willpower, he couldn’t help but exclaim in shock. All of a sudden, his battle prowess was weakened by three Heavens. To him, this was an inconceivable matter, and he could not accept it at all.
Ling Han activated the God Slaying Technique and launched an attack at Zhong Tian.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and this time, Ling Han did not retreat in the slightest.
They had come to a tie.
Everyone was dumbfounded. What was going on?
“I don’t believe it!” Zhong Tian roared. He continued to launch attacks at Ling Han.
However, this did not change the reality at all.
Ling Han responded with a tit for tat exchange. Every move was a head-on clash, and he was not the slightest bit inferior.

Furthermore, Zhong Tian did not have the Primal Chaos Celestial Core that could disperse the rebound force that he had sustained. In this kind of high-intensity exchange of blows, all the blood and Qi in his body was churning, his bones were groaning, and the mist on his body had dispersed, revealing a flushed face.
This!

Everyone was speechless. Previously, it was clearly Zhong Tian that was stronger, and the previous battle had also proven that Ling Han’s battle prowess was inferior to Yi Yuanrong. It was just that his physique was too tough, and he could take all attacks head-on. Now, it was clearly Zhong Tian that was stronger, so why did it seem like he had suffered a loss instead? Peng, peng, peng! In a single breath, after several dozen moves, Zhong Tian finally could no longer bear it, and spat out a mouthful of blood.
His battle prowess was not inferior to Ling Han’s, but his physique was unable to withstand such a high-intensity clash.
Zhong Tian, defeated!
This time, everyone in the West Heavenly Realm had no choice but to accept it.

If it had to be said that Yi Yuanrong had lost, that was because Ling Han was a freak. Not only did he have endless mystical power, his physique was also unbelievably tough. It was not that Ling Han was really capable of suppressing Yi Yuanrong in terms of battle prowess. However, Zhong Tian’s loss rendered everyone speechless.
Defeated head-on, fair and square.

Seeing Ling Han’s nonchalant expression, these prodigies from the West Heavenly Realm were truly enraged. They wanted nothing more than to charge over and gang up on him. Right now, Ling Han had already defeated the prodigies from the West Heavenly Realm. Ling Han was the number one prodigy of the two generations of the Cauldron Forging Tier and the Core Formation Tier. He had practically become a nightmare to the West Heavenly Realm!
This guy couldn’t possibly continue to suppress West Heavenly Realm in the True Self Tier
and Spirit Transformation Tier, right?
He alone had suppressed a whole Heavenly Realm.
Hiss, would this guy become an Ancestral King, and suppress an era?
“Ling Han, you’ve forgotten yourself in your conceit!” His monk robes fluttered in the wind,
without the slightest bit of dust.
Buddha Son, Shi Yongming!
Seeing Shi Yongming speak up, everyone erupted in excitement.
An Imperial Son was finally going to make his move!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I’ve always been a modest person. I’m humble and generous, and I accept…” He was simply blowing his own trumpet.

This caused everyone to grit their teeth. They really wanted to rush up and beat him up. “You’re all alone, and you actually dare to come to the West Heavenly Realm and issue a challenge. Isn’t this called forgetting one’s own worth in his arrogance?” Shi Yongming said balefully. “Although I don’t want to pick on the weak, I can’t allow you to do as you please. Do you really think that there’s no one in the West Heavenly Realm that can stop you!” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “You’re clearly using your superior strength to bully the weak. Where do you get all these excuses from? However, it’s true that your cultivation level
is higher, but who can defeat whom? Heh, that is not certain.”
Hiss, this guy really dared to say it.
Everyone shook their heads. Ling Han was indeed extraordinary, but Shi Yongming was an
Imperial Son.
What was an Imperial Son?
Only those who were invincible among their peers would be qualified to be called Imperial
Son. Furthermore, Shi Yongming was superior to Ling Han by two minor levels of cultivation level. This was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
What chance did Ling Han have of winning?
Meanwhile, Shi Yongming raised a brow. Even if he cultivated the dharma of Buddha, which meant that he would not be moved by wordly temptations, there was still a nameless anger
surging.
“Buddha Son, don’t waste your breath on this kind of person. Just suppress him.”
“That’s right. This kind of madman has completely no idea of the immensity of heaven and
earth, and doesn’t know his own worth.”
“Beat him into submission!”
“You’re wrong, you’re wrong. Buddha Son cultivates dharma, so of course he’s using virtue to
convince others and reform them with virtue.”
“Haha, yes, yes, yes. Please expiate this freakish being, Buddha Son!”
Everyone said one after another. Though the Imperial Clan was transcendent, and did not

belong to any Heavenly Realm, the Buddhist Race was special. There were Buddha Sons and Holy Daughters in the four Heavenly Realms, and they were all competing among themselves. Thus, it was logical that Shi Yongming would be considered a part of the West Heavenly
Realm.
Shi Yongming smiled faintly, and with a step, he had already risen into the air.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid. He also rose into the air step by step, standing at the same
height as Shi Yongming.
“If you adjust your attitude now, I can also let you go,” Shi Yongming said calmly.
“All right!” Ling Han nodded.
Yi?
The people below were all stunned. Ling Han actually admitted defeat? True, Shi Yongming
had already made his move. This was a Buddha Son, invincible among his peers. How could Ling Han, who was two minor levels below him, block him?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “It is not that I look down on all of you, but everyone here is trash!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4065: Fighting Buddha Son
paragraphs: Chapter 4065: Fighting Buddha Son
The moment these words left his mouth, everyone’s mouths were twisted in anger.
Just now, who had said that this guy was a coward?
To hell with cowering!
Hehe, let him make some adjustments to his attitude. He had indeed made some adjustments, but it was not cowardice. Instead, he had become even more arrogant.
Damn it, he was really too detestable.
Even Shi Yongming’s expression darkened, “Ling Han, you are really stubborn.”

Ling Han chuckled, and said, “You people are all targeting me. One moment, you say you want to suppress me, and the next, you want to expiate me. Do I still have to be polite to you? Am I stupid, or are you people despicable?”
This enraged everyone again, and the people below all glared at him in disdain.
“Since that is the case, you should bear the consequences for what you have said!” Shi Yongming Yongming humphed coldly, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
The Buddha Son’s attack was completely different!
Boom!
This palm strike enlarged endlessly, and had even turned bronze in colour, as it descended down on Ling Han like a great mountain.
Ling Han could see very clearly. This palm was not formed by mystical power, but rather Shi Yongming’s own hand. Who knew what tricks he had used to actually be able to enlarge it to this extent.
Direct attacks were naturally far more powerful than long-distance attacks.
Ling Han didn’t back down. He clenched his fist and punched at the large hand.
Peng!

But this was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot. The giant bronze hand descended, and was completely unaffected. It directly swatted Ling Han down from the skies, as if it was swatting at a mosquito.
Boom, the earth shook and the mountains swayed. The whole Black Rock Mountain was trembling, as if it was about to shatter under the force of this palm strike.
“Done!”
“It’s Buddha Son that’s more awesome!”
It was only one move.
“Haha, just now, you were just blowing your own trumpet, and saying that we were all trash, but what happened?”
“Thus, one must be more modest.”
Everyone was laughing and joking, making cynical remarks. Previously, they had been mocked by Ling Han, and now, they naturally had to hit him when he was down.
Shi Yongming retracted his palm and stood up. However, he saw a figure soar into the sky, and only stopped when he reached the same height as Shi Yongming.
It was Ling Han.

There was a trace of blood at the corner of his lips. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core had not been able to completely disperse this attack from Shi Yongming. Thankfully, his physique was strong enough, so he had only bled a little, and it had not caused any internal injuries.
This Shi Yongming was really very strong. His raw power was as high as 28 Heavens, and with a casual attack, his battle prowess was as high as 29 Heavens, completely crushing Ling Han.
As expected of the Buddha Son.

Ling Han knew that he had underestimated his opponent. This was because Shi Yongming had only reached a level close to six stars in the test for the Donglin Imperial Clan. As a result, Ling Han had underestimated him. However, the Buddha Son was still the Buddha Son, after all. If he didn’t have absolute strength, how could he be qualified to sit in this position?
He needed to be more serious.

“I have to admit, the strength of your physique is truly amazing.” Shi Yongming nodded, “However, the gap in battle prowess between you and me is too wide. No matter what, you would not be able to withstand a single blow from me!”
“Haha, don’t be so sure. Otherwise, if you slap yourself in the face later, it will be very painful!” Ling Han said with a smile, and immediately charged towards Shi Yongming.
“You don’t know what’s good for you!” Shi Yongming humphed, and sent out another palm strike, which similarly turned into an azure mountain.
The barrage of murderous aura, and the Primal Chaos Celestial Core!

Ling Han used two powerful moves at the same time. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core directly decreased Shi Yongming’s battle prowess by three Heavens, and under the barrage of the murderous aura, Shi Yongming gave a muffled groan, a pained expression appearing on his face.
Boom, the palm strike that he had struck out was sent flying somewhere.
“Here it is again!”
“It was the same for Zhong Tian just now. All of a sudden, he missed.”
“That guy must have used some rare treasure. Otherwise, how could he possibly have such might?”

Everyone was in an uproar. Previously, Zhong Tian’s attack had inexplicably missed, and they already felt that something was off. However, at the time, they did not know how strong Zhong Tian was, so they did not take it to heart too much. However, the same thing had happened to even Shi Yongming, so this was not right.
Yet Ling Han took advantage of the opening to charge over. The God Slaying Technique was used, and blasted madly at Shi Yongming.
“An, Ma, Ne!” Shi Yongming shouted three consecutive words of the Six Characters Bright King Curse, and finally managed to expel the murderous aura barrage.

The Buddhist Race had always been skilled in mental control, and the Six Characters Bright King Curse was more so capable of expiating the dead and purifying the mind. Thus, this murderous aura was quickly dispersed by Shi Yongming.
“Detestable guy, you actually dare to sneak attack me!” Shi Yongming was furious. The Buddhist Race being was the true master of divine sense attacks!
He charged towards Ling Han, but even if he dispersed the barrage of murderous aura, he was still affected. On top of weakening his battle prowess by three Heavens, it was weakened
further by another three Heavens.
Boom!

In this exchange of blows, Ling Han was still slightly inferior, and was sent flying. However, the gap in battle prowess between the two sides was already within six Heavens. Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core shook lightly, and dispersed the force that was attacking him
completely.
“Again!” Ling Han activated his Eye Technique, capturing the weak point in Shi Yongming’s attack, and then targeting it.
Peng, peng, peng! The two of them battled fiercely.
Below them, everyone was watching dumbfounded.
Ling Han was actually exchanging blows with Shi Yongming!
This was too terrifying.

It should be known that Shi Yongming was a Buddha Son, and furthermore, he had the advantage of two minor levels of cultivation. Yet, he was actually unable to suppress Ling Han. In fact, he only had a slight advantage in the situation.
This… how could they accept this?
“In comparison, we are indeed trash,” someone muttered softly.
No one refuted, and there was complete silence.
They didn’t have any confidence at all. Compared to Ling Han and his freakishness, what else
could they be but trash?
Shi Yongming instantly felt a mountain of pressure.

Although he had the upper hand, he also knew that he had the advantage in terms of cultivation level. With his status as Buddha Son, he should have been able to defeat Ling Han easily. Now, the situation was in a stalemate. With every second that passed, his face would
become hotter.
How embarrassing!
He roared furiously. Boom! A Buddha Halo formed behind his head, and his entire body also emitted endless light. It was as if he had transformed into an enlightened monk.
“The sea of suffering is boundless, turn back to shore!” he shouted. Weng, Buddhist chants reverberated, as if the heaven and earth itself was also chanting.
Ling Han instantly felt his spirit being affected. It was as if he wanted to let go of everything
in search of release.
However, his willpower was extremely firm in the first place, especially after severing the consciousness that desired slaughter once, it had increased to another level.
He immediately focused, and charged back with the murderous aura. “Wu!” Even if Shi Yongming was already on guard, he still released a muffled humph, and his
battle prowess uncontrollably dropped drastically.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to attack aggressively, and looked like he was about
to turn around to suppress Shi Yongming.
“Golden Arhat!” Shi Yongming clasped his hands together. The Buddha Halo behind his head
released streaks of golden light, and his skin also became golden, exuding a metallic luster, as
if it had been forged from Buddha Metal.
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with him, and instantly felt a frightening destructive power
spread out from his fist.
This was not just domineering in terms of power, but was also like a supreme Divine Sword,
indestructible.
