Previously, Zhong Tian’s attack had inexplicably missed, and they already felt that something was off.
However, at the time, they did not know how strong Zhong Tian was, so they did not take it to heart too much.
However, the same thing had happened to even Shi Yongming, so this was not right.
Yet Ling Han took advantage of the opening to charge over.
The God Slaying Technique was used, and blasted madly at Shi Yongming.
“An, Ma, Ne!” Shi Yongming shouted three consecutive words of the Six Characters Bright King Curse, and finally managed to expel the murderous aura barrage.
The Buddhist Race had always been skilled in mental control, and the Six Characters Bright King Curse was more so capable of expiating the dead and purifying the mind.
Thus, this murderous aura was quickly dispersed by Shi Yongming.
“Detestable guy, you actually dare to sneak attack me!” Shi Yongming was furious.
The Buddhist Race being was the true master of divine sense attacks!
He charged towards Ling Han, but even if he dispersed the barrage of murderous aura, he was still affected.
On top of weakening his battle prowess by three Heavens, it was weakened
further by another three Heavens.
Boom!
In this exchange of blows, Ling Han was still slightly inferior, and was sent flying.
However, the gap in battle prowess between the two sides was already within six Heavens.
Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core shook lightly, and dispersed the force that was attacking him
completely.
“Again!” Ling Han activated his Eye Technique, capturing the weak point in Shi Yongming’s attack, and then targeting it.
Peng, peng, peng!
The two of them battled fiercely.
Below them, everyone was watching dumbfounded.
Ling Han was actually exchanging blows with Shi Yongming!
This was too terrifying.
It should be known that Shi Yongming was a Buddha Son, and furthermore, he had the advantage of two minor levels of cultivation.
Yet, he was actually unable to suppress Ling Han.
In fact, he only had a slight advantage in the situation.
This… how could they accept this?
“In comparison, we are indeed trash,” someone muttered softly.
No one refuted, and there was complete silence.
They didn’t have any confidence at all.
Compared to Ling Han and his freakishness, what else
could they be but trash?
Shi Yongming instantly felt a mountain of pressure.
Although he had the upper hand, he also knew that he had the advantage in terms of cultivation level.
With his status as Buddha Son, he should have been able to defeat Ling Han easily.
Now, the situation was in a stalemate.
With every second that passed, his face would
become hotter.
How embarrassing!
He roared furiously.
Boom!
A Buddha Halo formed behind his head, and his entire body also emitted endless light.
It was as if he had transformed into an enlightened monk.
“The sea of suffering is boundless, turn back to shore!” he shouted.
Weng, Buddhist chants reverberated, as if the heaven and earth itself was also chanting.
Ling Han instantly felt his spirit being affected.
It was as if he wanted to let go of everything
in search of release.
However, his willpower was extremely firm in the first place, especially after severing the consciousness that desired slaughter once, it had increased to another level.
He immediately focused, and charged back with the murderous aura.
“Wu!” Even if Shi Yongming was already on guard, he still released a muffled humph, and his
battle prowess uncontrollably dropped drastically.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to attack aggressively, and looked like he was about
to turn around to suppress Shi Yongming.
“Golden Arhat!” Shi Yongming clasped his hands together.
The Buddha Halo behind his head
released streaks of golden light, and his skin also became golden, exuding a metallic luster, as
if it had been forged from Buddha Metal.
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with him, and instantly felt a frightening destructive power
spread out from his fist.
This was not just domineering in terms of power, but was also like a supreme Divine Sword,
indestructible.

chapters.title: Chapter 4066: Golden Arhat
paragraphs: Chapter 4066: Golden Arhat
This was high-level energy!

Only high-level energy would have an extremely strong restraining effect on mystical power. Even in a situation when power was inferior, it could still have the effect of defeating the strong even with weakness.

The Primal Chaos Celestial Core shook slightly, dispersing more than half of the force that was attacking. However, it seemed to be a little rushed in dispersing high-level energy, and a certain amount of impact was still inflicted on Ling Han.

Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. A bloody wound had appeared on his fist, and the high- level energy was spreading all the way to his shoulder, causing the meridians in his entire arm to be damaged.

He waved his hand. This should be a high-level energy of Metal Element. Furthermore, it could be ranked very high among high-level energy, so its destructive power was extremely shocking. Otherwise, it would not be enough to pierce through his physique, and cause damage to even his meridians.
“Hahaha!” Shi Yongming laughed loudly, “A mere cultivator from the North Heavenly Realm, how would know what true strength is!”
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He struck continuously, and golden energy surged, as if an enraged Arhat was presently subduing demons.

Ling Han shot out a murderous aura attack. However, in the state of the Golden Arhat, Shi Yongming’s mind was also incredibly sturdy. Though the small black figure was just barely able to penetrate into the mind, its own energy had already been expended, and instantly disappeared completely.
“Humph, don’t you know that Buddhist Race elites like us are most skilled in exorcism?” Shi Yongming sneered. He delivered palm strikes, heavy, vicious, fast, and incredibly fierce.
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, extracting high-level energy. However, this was Wood Element, and was filled with exuberant vitality. Instantly, Ling Han’s right arm recovered.
Sure enough, even though Shi Yongming, a Buddha Son, couldn’t compare to a real Imperial Son, a Buddha Son was still a Buddha Son, after all. He was far, far superior to a prodigy like Yi Yuanrong.
It seemed like he couldn’t deal with him with ordinary means. After all, the gap in battle prowess was too wide.

Ling Han had no intention of admitting defeat. To say nothing of the fact that this was a battle of honour between two Heavenly Realms, merely for the sake of the Soul Nurturing Stone, there was no reason for him to back down.
He raised his hand, and the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was shot out.
“Wu!” Shi Yongming gave a muffled humph, and he immediately fell into an illusion.

However, he was a Buddha Son, and was most skilled in spiritual attacks. In only an instant, he let out a loud roar and recovered. At this moment, a bolt of lightning had already arrived in front of him.
He hurriedly stretched out a hand to parry, and with a zi, lightning blazed.
This attack didn’t hurt him, but it still gave him a scare, because Ling Han’s battle prowess had inconceivably increased by another two Heavens.
What kind of monster was this?

He was clearly only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, but his battle prowess already surpassed the number one on the Galaxy Network. If this guy cultivated to the consummate stage of Core Formation Tier, just how powerful would he be?
A blazing killing intent rose up in his heart. This guy could not be left alive. Otherwise, he would become the greatest opponent on his own Imperial Path.
“Die!”
Boom, boom, boom! His strikes became even more rapid.
Ling Han activated Starlight Screen, and with a shake of his fists, he wrapped Destructive Energy around them.
Competing in high level energy? Who was afraid of whom?
He roared loudly and charged towards Shi Yongming.
Seeing that indescribably dark energy, an indescribable chill suddenly rose up in Shi Yongming’s heart, and he instinctively wanted to dodge. However, reason told him not to!
The mighty Buddha Son actually didn’t dare to face his opponent head-on when his cultivation level was at an advantage?
Hehe, would he still have the face to travel the world in future?
‘Fine, if you want to face me head-on, I’ll obliterate you!’
Shi Yongming was cold, and he raised the high-level energy of the Metal Element to the maximum before launching an attack at Ling Han.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and endless energy surged. Some energy soared into the sky, while energy slid towards the ground like meteors, causing the people below to panic and hurriedly dodge.
Even though this was only a shockwave, for most people, this was equivalent to a calamity, and they had to dodge it.

Prodigies like Zhong Tian and Yi Yuanrong naturally didn’t need to dodge. With a wave of their hand, they could extinguish the aftermath. They all focused their gazes on the sky; how was the battle progressing?

Ling Han only felt that terrifying Metal Element energy had come again, bringing with it an indestructible murderous aura. It easily tore through the Starlight Screen, shattering his physique, and continuing onwards, destroying his meridians.
Thankfully, it still stopped at the shoulder.

On the other side, Shi Yongming wasn’t much better off either. Under the barrage of Destructive Energy, his protective shield was like ice and snow that had encountered boiling water, immediately melting completely.
Then, the Destructive Energy invaded, and his golden body immediately dimmed.

Shi Yongming was astounded. The golden body was a kind of use of energy, allowing him to transform into the Subduing Demon Arhat. His body was as tough as Buddha Metal, and indestructible. But now? Under this mysterious energy, the golden body’s energy was devoured madly, making him actually unable to maintain the body of the Arhat.
F***, what kind of high-level energy was this?
Peng!
After a short contact, Ling Han was immediately sent flying. In terms of power, he was still far inferior to Shi Yongming.

The brilliance that filled the skies completely dispersed, and everyone could see that Ling Han and Shi Yongming were standing about three hundred meters away from each other. Ling Han’s right arm was drooping, while Shi Yongming had returned to his original appearance,
no longer the Golden Arhat.
“Shi Yongming won!”
“En, there is already no need to use his golden body. It is clear that he has won.”
“Haha, he’s a Buddha Son, after all!”
“It’s still our West Heavenly Realm that’s awesome, finally suppressing this demon!”
“Er, could it be that you guys have never thought that Ling Han is only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier at present?”
The people below were discussing spiritedly, but one word silenced all of them.
That’s right, Ling Han was only at the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier! F***, how could there be such a freakish Core Formation Tier middle stage martial artist?
Ling Han shook his right arm, and channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique. His right arm immediately recovered, but he discovered that this process was slightly longer than the first
time.

Obviously, the recovery ability of the Ten Cultivation Technique was not omnipotent. For a short period of time, continuously healing the same body part would cause the effects to continuously decline.
Since that was the case, Ling Han once again charged towards Shi Yongming, throwing a left
punch.
Shi Yongming gritted his teeth, but still sent out his right palm to parry Ling Han’s attack. This time, only his palm was wrapped in a golden light, because he was unable to use the
Golden Arhat.
“Haha, this is the final resistance. You see, the Buddha Son is already disdainful of using the Golden Arhat. He only needs a casual palm strike to suppress him,” someone commented with
a smile. This drew the agreement of a great many people.
Boom!

Ling Han exchanged another blow with Shi Yongming. Without the support of the Golden Arhat, Shi Yongming’s battle prowess instantly dropped by a notch. Though Ling Han was once again sent flying, under the protection of the Starlight Screen, his extremely strong physique, and the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, Ling Han’s internal organs only suffered some
shocks.

On the other hand, the metallic energy on Shi Yongming’s palm was completely engulfed by the Destructive Energy, and was still spreading towards Shi Yongming’s palm, scaring him so much that he hurriedly used several secret techniques. He was flustered, and finally blasted
the Destructive Energy into oblivion. Ling Han laughed loudly, and began a powerful counterattack.

chapters.title: Chapter 4067: Ancient Well
paragraphs: Chapter 4067: Ancient Well

Ling Han launched a powerful counterattack, while Shi Yongming was extremely wary of Destructive Energy. He didn’t dare to face it head-on anymore, and had no choice but to avoid a confrontation and adopt a roaming battle strategy. He endlessly launched counterattacks from the side.
This?
Why had the tables suddenly turned?
“Er… Buddha Son disdains to fight head-on with this brat from the North Heavenly Realm.” The person who had previously been flattering Shi Yongming said.
This was really forced flattery.
Only a few people nodded reluctantly, while the others remained silent.
How were they supposed to respond?
Wasn’t it clear that Shi Yongming had been beaten to the point that he was running around in circles?
Hong! Hong! Hong!

After attacking a few more times, Shi Yongming finally launched a fierce counterattack. Boom, his whole body was once again covered in a layer of gold. The Buddha Halo was flickering, as if an Arhat had descended into the world.
“Monster, take this!” Shi Yongming approached with this attack. He knew that this attack could cause serious injury to Ling Han.
-After such a long time of recovery, he had accumulated a certain amount of Metal Element energy, which could allow him a burst of power.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?!” Ling Han threw a punch with his left hand.
Peng!

The two of them exchanged blows again. A terrifying power surged over, and Ling Han was instantly sent flying. His left arm was completely drooping. From his meridians to his bones, he had suffered a serious blow.
However, Shi Yongming wasn’t much better. His golden body flickered, and he was about to exit this state again.
“Er… the Buddha Son used his golden body again. What’s going on?” someone asked.

The person who had previously boasted stuttered, as if he was searching for words. Then, he said, “That demon stubbornly resisted, causing the Buddha Son to become impatient. That’s why he wants to settle it once and for all.”
Alright, that was fine too.

Ling Han channelled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and his left arm immediately returned to normal. He charged towards Shi Yongming and kicked out with his right leg, which was similarly entwined with Destructive Energy.
‘Come, take this!’
Shi Yongming was enraged. So be it if Ling Han attacked him left and right with his fists, but what was the meaning of kicking out with a foot?
Just how much are you looking down on me?
He forcibly extracted the Metal Element energy, stabilized his golden body, and returned Ling Han’s attack.
Peng!
After this blow, Ling Han was indeed sent flying, but Shi Yongming also exited the Golden Arhat state once more.
Ling Han laughed loudly. The Ten Cultivation Technique instantly healed his right leg, and he shot out a kick. This time, it was his left leg.
Shi Yongming shouted in anger. In his eyes, this was a great humiliation.

However, without the support of his golden body, he would be affected by the barrage of murderous aura. His battle prowess would not be able to surpass Ling Han by six Heavens, and he did not have the sharpness of Metal Element energy either, so how could he pose a threat to Ling Han?

After exchanging a few blows, Ling Han was unscathed, while Shi Yongming felt extremely troubled. The Destructive Energy posed too much of a threat to him, and he didn’t dare to face it head-on at all. He could only avoid facing it head-on, which made him both anxious and angry.
The mighty Buddha Son was actually in such a passive position when he had the advantage in cultivation level?
How could he accept this!

However, there was nothing he could do. Not only did Ling Han possess astonishing defenses, but his recovery ability was also freakish. More importantly, this guy’s attack power was incredibly terrifying. How could there be such a freak in this world?
He was still fighting now, and had not retreated because he could not bring himself to do so. How could the Buddha Son cower from battle?
“Hey, can you explain the situation now?” someone asked the person who had previously praised Shi Yongming.
“Uh!” That person opened his mouth wide, wanting to say something nice about Shi Yongming, but didn’t know where to start. In the end, he still shut his mouth.

“Hehe, the two young prodigies, please stop for a moment.” A voice rang out from below. Everyone looked over, and saw that this was an old man whose hair was slightly grey. However, his cultivation level was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier.
“I am the Sect Leader of the Black Rock Sect,” the old man introduced himself.
‘Oh!’
Hearing his words, everyone came to a sudden realization. No wonder this old geezer would appear here. As it turned out, he was the owner of this place.

“It’s about time. According to Ancient Prosperity Saint’s instructions, this old man plans to start this battle of prodigies.” The old man didn’t even announce his name. In truth, no one would care even if he did. A weakling that could only be a Cauldron Forging Tier till death, how could he possibly gain the attention of these prodigies?

However, the competition for the Soul Nurturing Stone was about to begin, and this made everyone excited. However, there was still Ling Han and Shi Yongming, two indescribably powerful guys here, which made everyone extremely discouraged.
“I have tossed the Soul Nurturing Stone into an ancient well,” the old man said, “Whoever is the first to obtain the Soul Nurturing Stone will possess the Soul Nurturing Stone.”

He paused for a moment, then continued, “However, this ancient well is very strange. None of the people who went down have come out alive, and occasionally, there would be wails of grief, which is very terrifying.”
“Thus, without enough strength, please do not risk your life.”
Hearing his words, everyone was unconcerned.
-You are only a mere Cauldron Forging Tier, so how many elites could there be in the sect?
“Where’s the ancient well?” someone asked.
“Please follow me.” The old man turned around, and began to lead the way.
Shi Yongming humphed and said, “I’ll spare you this time!” After saying this, he turned
around and left.
He knew that he couldn’t defeat Ling Han, so this was naturally the best excuse for him to
stop the battle.
Ling Han smiled faintly, but did not pursue any further. Instead, he crossed his arms behind his back, and followed the old man.

As long as he obtained the Soul Nurturing Stone, he would definitely be able to cultivate the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier to the end, and enter the third stage of the Core Formation Tier. Furthermore, his battle prowess would definitely increase greatly as well. At that time, if he battled Shi Yongming again, he would not need to exert so much effort to be able to maintain a tie. Shi Yongming would be completely thrashed.
The old man led the way ahead, and soon stopped. It was seen that there was a house not far ahead of them, but where was the ancient well?
“The ancient well is in the house ahead,” the old man said. “Because that wail was too shrill,
a house was built to prevent the sound from spreading out.”
“Everyone, let me give you a warning again. The ancient well is extremely strange and
dangerous.”
After saying this, the old man turned around and left.
No one noticed that there was a sliver of anticipation in the old man’s eyes.
This ancient well had existed for who knew how many years, and had caused a great problem
for the Black Rock Sect. Thus, an idea came to him, and he threw the Soul Nurturing Stone into the ancient well. He was going to use these prodigies to solve this problem for the Black Rock
Sect.
-What if all these prodigies failed and died?
Then there would definitely be elites that would come. Furthermore, he was only acting under the command of the Saint. Who would dare to blame him? Wasn’t that a slap to that Saint’s
face?
“Haha, everyone, I’ll take my leave first!” Someone immediately rushed out, throwing a punch. Peng, the building in front of them was blasted into pieces, and as expected, there was
an ancient well inside.
“Move aside, I’ll go first!” Immediately, someone rushed out to intercept him.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The two of them immediately began an intense battle. The matter was very simple. Whoever
entered the ancient well first would be able to obtain the Soul Nurturing Stone first.
All of a sudden, everyone scrambled over one another.

After this blow, Ling Han was indeed sent flying, but Shi Yongming also exited the Golden Arhat state once more.
Ling Han laughed loudly.
The Ten Cultivation Technique instantly healed his right leg, and he shot out a kick.
This time, it was his left leg.
Shi Yongming shouted in anger.
In his eyes, this was a great humiliation.
However, without the support of his golden body, he would be affected by the barrage of murderous aura.
His battle prowess would not be able to surpass Ling Han by six Heavens, and he did not have the sharpness of Metal Element energy either, so how could he pose a threat to Ling Han?
After exchanging a few blows, Ling Han was unscathed, while Shi Yongming felt extremely troubled.
The Destructive Energy posed too much of a threat to him, and he didn’t dare to face it head-on at all.
He could only avoid facing it head-on, which made him both anxious and angry.
The mighty Buddha Son was actually in such a passive position when he had the advantage in cultivation level?
How could he accept this!
However, there was nothing he could do.
Not only did Ling Han possess astonishing defenses, but his recovery ability was also freakish.
More importantly, this guy’s attack power was incredibly terrifying.
How could there be such a freak in this world?
He was still fighting now, and had not retreated because he could not bring himself to do so.
How could the Buddha Son cower from battle?
“Hey, can you explain the situation now?” someone asked the person who had previously praised Shi Yongming.
“Uh!” That person opened his mouth wide, wanting to say something nice about Shi Yongming, but didn’t know where to start.
In the end, he still shut his mouth.
“Hehe, the two young prodigies, please stop for a moment.” A voice rang out from below.
Everyone looked over, and saw that this was an old man whose hair was slightly grey.
However, his cultivation level was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier.
“I am the Sect Leader of the Black Rock Sect,” the old man introduced himself.
‘Oh!’
Hearing his words, everyone came to a sudden realization.
No wonder this old geezer would appear here.
As it turned out, he was the owner of this place.
“It’s about time.
According to Ancient Prosperity Saint’s instructions, this old man plans to start this battle of prodigies.” The old man didn’t even announce his name.
In truth, no one would care even if he did.
A weakling that could only be a Cauldron Forging Tier till death, how could he possibly gain the attention of these prodigies?
However, the competition for the Soul Nurturing Stone was about to begin, and this made everyone excited.
However, there was still Ling Han and Shi Yongming, two indescribably powerful guys here, which made everyone extremely discouraged.
“I have tossed the Soul Nurturing Stone into an ancient well,” the old man said, “Whoever is the first to obtain the Soul Nurturing Stone will possess the Soul Nurturing Stone.”
He paused for a moment, then continued, “However, this ancient well is very strange.
None of the people who went down have come out alive, and occasionally, there would be wails of grief, which is very terrifying.”
“Thus, without enough strength, please do not risk your life.”
Hearing his words, everyone was unconcerned.
-You are only a mere Cauldron Forging Tier, so how many elites could there be in the sect?
“Where’s the ancient well?” someone asked.
“Please follow me.” The old man turned around, and began to lead the way.
Shi Yongming humphed and said, “I’ll spare you this time!” After saying this, he turned
around and left.
He knew that he couldn’t defeat Ling Han, so this was naturally the best excuse for him to
stop the battle.
Ling Han smiled faintly, but did not pursue any further.
Instead, he crossed his arms behind his back, and followed the old man.
As long as he obtained the Soul Nurturing Stone, he would definitely be able to cultivate the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier to the end, and enter the third stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Furthermore, his battle prowess would definitely increase greatly as well.
At that time, if he battled Shi Yongming again, he would not need to exert so much effort to be able to maintain a tie.
Shi Yongming would be completely thrashed.
The old man led the way ahead, and soon stopped.
It was seen that there was a house not far ahead of them, but where was the ancient well?
“The ancient well is in the house ahead,” the old man said.
“Because that wail was too shrill,
a house was built to prevent the sound from spreading out.”
“Everyone, let me give you a warning again.
The ancient well is extremely strange and
dangerous.”
After saying this, the old man turned around and left.
No one noticed that there was a sliver of anticipation in the old man’s eyes.
This ancient well had existed for who knew how many years, and had caused a great problem
for the Black Rock Sect.
Thus, an idea came to him, and he threw the Soul Nurturing Stone into the ancient well.
He was going to use these prodigies to solve this problem for the Black Rock
Sect.
-What if all these prodigies failed and died?
Then there would definitely be elites that would come.
Furthermore, he was only acting under the command of the Saint.
Who would dare to blame him?
Wasn’t that a slap to that Saint’s
face?
“Haha, everyone, I’ll take my leave first!” Someone immediately rushed out, throwing a punch.
Peng, the building in front of them was blasted into pieces, and as expected, there was
an ancient well inside.
“Move aside, I’ll go first!” Immediately, someone rushed out to intercept him.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The two of them immediately began an intense battle.
The matter was very simple.
Whoever
entered the ancient well first would be able to obtain the Soul Nurturing Stone first.
All of a sudden, everyone scrambled over one another.

chapters.title: Chapter 4068: Armored Man
paragraphs: Chapter 4068: Armored Man

The Soul Nurturing Stone could not only help the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier to nurture the Celestial Core, it also had the effect of nurturing the soul for every cultivator at the cultivation level of the Core Formation Tier. If it was not for the fact that a Saint had spoken up and said that this great opportunity would be passed on to the youngsters, there would definitely be old monsters of the True Self Tier and Spirit Transformation Tier running
over.
Now, everyone had a chance to search for the treasure in the ancient well, so the competition was naturally intense.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, everyone leaped into the ancient well.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was not in a rush. This ancient well should be a one-way entrance. Thus, no matter who managed to snatch the Soul Nurturing Stone, he would be able to snatch it from him.
Even if Shi Yongming obtained it, Ling Han was still unafraid.
That was because when he had been fighting with Shi Yongming, he had not revealed all his trump cards.

-The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and Earth Dragon were his two biggest cards. Ling Han also leaped into the ancient well. He had only descended a few meters, when he discovered that the temperature had suddenly dropped, causing him to get goosebumps. This was not just the coldness of the body, but also a kind of terrible chill that assaulted the soul.
It was extremely strange. No wonder that old geezer from the Black Rock Sect had warned them repeatedly. It was not because the overall strength of the Black Rock Sect was too weak.
Ling Han controlled his speed, not falling too fast. On the other side, his divine sense spread out, communicating with the ley lines.
There were ley lines here, but he shockingly discovered that this ley line was actually independent, and was not connected to any other ley lines.
This was very strange.
The ley lines were equivalent to the veins of a plain. Every vein was connected, so how could there be a solitary vein?
Hence, this must be man-made.
However, who could be strong enough to change the ley lines like this?
It was either a supreme elite, at least Saint-level, or… a Saint-level Formation Master!

Ling Han could use ley lines, and this could only be considered Grandmaster-level, and in the case of Formation Saints, they could change the ley lines. In fact, they could even use the planets in the universe as their formation foundations, and lay out a supreme great formation, capable of killing Saints!
Hiss!
He inhaled sharply. Whether it was a Saint Tier elite or a Formation Saint that had participated, this was proof of the extraordinary nature of this ancient well.
Retreat now?
Ling Han quickly shook his head. This could be incredibly dangerous, but it could also be an opportunity.
Let’s take a look first.

Although there was only one ley line, Ling Han could still make use of it. At the very least, it was completely no problem for him to teleport to the ground. However, he could only appear near the Black Rock Mountain.

This well was extraordinarily deep. Ling Han had already fallen for at least five minutes, but there was no sign that he could see the bottom at all. He was still falling endlessly. Furthermore, there was a powerful gravity field in the well that was making him accelerate.

Ling Han hurriedly exerted force to resist, maintaining his original speed. Otherwise, if there was a Celestial Weapon stabbed upside down, and he crashed into it at an extremely fast speed… he might die.
After a few more minutes, Ling Han finally sensed that the ground was rapidly approaching. He hurriedly stopped in his tracks.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

However, he wasn’t the only one who landed. Many people couldn’t stop in time, and there were even some people who didn’t know that they were about to touch the ground. They instantly crashed into each other.
Blood sprayed, and it was a tragic sight.

Some people’s feet landed on the ground, and with the massive impact, the bones in their legs were all broken. This was still considered good. Some people’s heads instantly exploded, and they directly died.
If word of this got out, it would even be a little funny. A dignified elite of the Core Formation Tier actually fell to his death?
But in truth, this had happened, and it was still continuing to happen.
-This ground was really too hard.
Of course, elites like Shi Yongming and Yi Yuanrong could naturally control their bodies very well, and there was no “crash”.
It was no wonder that the members of the Black Rock Sect could only enter and not exit. Indeed, Cauldron Forging Tiers that came here would be seeking death.
But the problem was… where was the Soul Nurturing Stone?
The Black Rock Sect tossed the precious stone down. The stone didn’t have legs, so how could
it have run off on its own?
Everyone searched for a while, but did not find the Soul Nurturing Stone. Instead, they discovered a hole that led to who knew where.
This?
Could it be that there was some creature in this cave that had taken away the Soul Nurturing Stone?
“What do we do?” someone asked, appearing to have no idea what to do.
“We haven’t lost contact with the Galaxy Network yet. Contact the clan first and report the
situation!”
“That’s right!”
Everyone first connected with their clans or sects. The present situation was a little unexpected. It was very possible that there was an even greater secret hidden in the ancient
well.
Meanwhile, Ling Han strode into the cave. He was a Formations Grandmaster, and could make use of ley lines. He could fight or retreat, so he was unafraid.
Seeing that Ling Han had already set out first, the others hurriedly followed. With how tough Ling Han’s defenses were, if the Soul Nurturing Stone fell into his pocket, who would be able
to snatch it from him?
Furthermore, it was also good for this brat to walk in front, so that he could scout out the way. If there was any danger, Ling Han would naturally bear it first.
Ling Han naturally discovered the people following behind him, and guessed their thoughts. He smiled faintly. They wanted to make use of him?
As he walked, he observed everything through the ley lines.

However, the situation here was very special, as if there was an invisible force suppressing the ley lines. Thus, even if Ling Han was a Formations Grandmaster, the range of his observation was still considerably limited.
All of a sudden, he heard an ear-piercing sound. It was very much like a sharp object dragging𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
on the ground.
It was transmitted from ahead!
Ling Han shuddered, and immediately stopped.
Not only him, but the others also heard it. They all stopped in their tracks.
Everyone was waiting, waiting for the person or whatever it was that had made the sound to
appear.
However, that existence was advancing too slowly. Everyone waited for a long while, but they still did not see that existence appear. There was still only that sound echoing.
Ling Han took another step forwards.
Everyone exchanged looks, and hurriedly followed.
After walking for a short while, Ling Han stopped again. That was because that sound was
already very close, but because it was too dark ahead of them, only the sound could be heard, and their face could not be seen.
Xiu, someone shot out a fist of fire ahead of them. Flames burned fiercely, illuminating the
surroundings.
Yi!

At this moment, everyone could clearly see that the person who was approaching them was a man in iron armor. He held an iron spear in his right hand, and it was precisely because the tip of the spear was dragging on the ground that it released that sharp and ear-piercing sound.
There was indeed someone here!

“Hurry up and hand over the Soul Nurturing Stone!” someone shouted. He was an impatient person, and he immediately dashed forward with a saber in his hand. A brilliant light burst from his saber as he slashed at the armored person.
If the Sect Master of the Black Rock Sect had not lied, then the Soul Nurturing Stone must have
been picked up by him.
Just think, a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator wouldn’t dare to disobey the Saint’s will,
right?

Now, the saber light was blazing, and everyone could naturally see clearly. When that person neared the armored man, the armored man that had been maintaining a slow pace suddenly launched a counterattack. With a wave of his right hand, the battle spear stabbed towards that
person.
Pu!

The battle spear was indestructible, easily piercing through the saber light. Then, the tip of the spear pierced into that person’s chest, nailing that person to the cave wall. That person struggled repeatedly, but the extent of his movements became smaller and smaller, and very soon, he was completely drooping, his life force completely gone. Strangely, that person’s corpse appeared to have been dead for several hundred years, and had completely turned into a dried corpse.

chapters.title: Chapter 4069: Yin Soul Again
paragraphs: Chapter 4069: Yin Soul Again
Killing an enemy with a single spear strike was not an amazing feat, but with a single strike, one would be turned into a dried corpse. This was extremely bizarre.
“How dare you!” Everyone shouted loudly.
The armored man held a spear in hand, and looked coldly at everyone.
His entire body was covered in armor, and not even his eyes or hair could be seen. His figure was extremely tall, and wherever he stood, there would be an extremely strong pressure.

Just when everyone thought that he didn’t dare to take the initiative to attack, the armored man unexpectedly took a step with his right leg, and rushed towards them. His speed was astonishingly fast, and the tip of the spear stabbed towards Ling Han.
It could not be helped. He was standing at the very front.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid. As he threw a punch, the Starlight Screen wrapped around his fist and faced the battle spear head-on.
Peng!
In the exchange of blows, astonishing sparks instantly exploded from the tip of the spear, as well as high-level energy boiling.
Ling Han stumbled slightly, and couldn’t help but take a few steps back. This armored person’s power was superior to his.

“He’s nothing more than this!” Shi Yongming, Zhong Tian, and the others all thought to themselves. With this test, their wariness was halved. The strength of this armored figure lay in the battle spear in his hand. This was a strange Spirit Tool, capable of instantly absorbing all the blood essence of others.
“Hand over the Soul Nurturing Stone!” Several people rushed forwards, launching attacks at the armored man.
The armored man did not speak, and merely brandished his battle spear in a counterattack.

However, his strength was only around 24 Heavens, so he was indeed very strong. However, there were more than one or two such powerful prodigies, so how could he withstand their combined attacks? He took a few heavy blows consecutively, and even his armor caved in a few places.
Weng!

But just when everyone thought that they were going to defeat this armored man, a great many veined patterns appeared on his Battle Armor, and they were all exuding blazing light. In an instant, the battle prowess of the armored man increased greatly.
He brandished his spear, and no one dared to face it head-on. They all stepped back.
This might was too strong. Probably, only Shi Yongming’s power could suppress him. Otherwise, even Zhong Tian was no match.

Everyone was stunned. At the bottom of an ancient well, an armored figure that had randomly popped out would have battle prowess that surpassed the number one person on the Galaxy Network. This was too inconceivable.
It should be known that the Black Rock Sect was merely a small Cauldron Forging Tier force. Could it be that this was a trap that was deliberately laid out?
No, no, Ancient Prosperity Saint’s interference in this matter was known to the whole world. Who would dare make a move right in front of the eyes of a Saint?
In other words, this armored person had been hiding at the bottom of the ancient well all this while. It was only because of the Soul Nurturing Stone that he had been discovered by everyone.
Strange, why would someone with such powerful battle prowess like him hide in such a place?
Really, no matter which Holy Land he entered, this kind of battle prowess would be worthy of being taken in as a disciple, or even nurtured as a Dao Child.
“Who exactly are you?” Zhong Tian shouted loudly.
The armored man had no intention of replying, but he had indeed heard him, because the next spear strike was aimed at Zhong Tian.
Boom! The might of this strike was at least at 28 Heavens. Zhong Tian didn’t dare to face it head-on, and he could only dodge to the side.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked over, his expression becoming extremely solemn.
No way!
He unleashed a barrage of murderous aura attacks, but this was completely useless. The armored person was still killing in all directions, completely unaffected.
As expected.
Ling Han activated the Primal Chaos Celestial Core again, targeting the armored figure. However, this was still ineffective. The armored figure’s battle prowess wasn’t weakened in the slightest.
“I will do it!” Shi Yongming walked out. Weng, a Buddha Halo formed behind his head, his whole body exuding golden light. Then, he delivered a palm strike at the armored man.

At first, the armored man was chasing after them, but when Shi Yongming raised the golden light, he immediately turned around and stared at Shi Yongming. Although his face couldn’t be seen, everyone could feel a powerful hatred.
Xiu, the armored figure immediately moved as well, blasting towards Shi Yongming.
Peng!

In the exchange of blows, the armored man was instantly sent flying, and crashed heavily into the cave wall. However, this cave wall was really sturdy. With such a collision, there was actually no hole created. Instead, the armored man was bounced back.
Strangely, the armored man immediately stepped out again, launching a counterattack at Shi Yongming.
Ten thousand curse words instantly streaked through Shi Yongming’s mind.
Why was there another one?

First, it was Ling Han. It was clear that Ling Han’s battle prowess was weaker than him by about ten Heavens, yet he could not be killed. Even if he was injured, he could immediately recover. Now, it was the same for this armored person. It was clear that his battle prowess was far inferior to him, and he had sent him flying with a single strike, but he was actually completely unscathed.
‘Holy f*ck! Are you two family?’
Shi Yongming let out a loud roar. He naturally wouldn’t back down. He delivered palm strikes,
and golden light shot in all directions, making everyone feel refreshed.

He was indeed powerful, and the armored man was no match for him at all. However, this person seemed to be a simple-minded person. He was clearly no match for Shi Yongming, yet continued to oppose him head-on.
The armored person wasn’t Ling Han. He didn’t have the Primal Chaos Celestial Core to dissipate the power that was inflicted on him. After being struck several hundred times, peng,
his helmet was finally sent flying.
“What!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. It was not that they had seen an incredibly ugly face, but rather that there was actually nothing behind the helmet!
That’s right, it was just a lump of empty air.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
What was going on here?
Could it be that this armored person was actually extraordinarily small, and he was only as tall
as the chest-level? Was that why he couldn’t be seen?
Yet Shi Yongming’s expression changed drastically, and he exclaimed, “Yin soul!”

He originated from the Buddhist Race, so he naturally had extraordinary senses towards Yin souls. Thus, he immediately saw that this was not an encounter with a dwarf, but rather a Yin soul that was controlling this Battle Armor.
No wonder no matter how many times he attacked previously, it was useless. As it turned out, it was a Yin soul controlling it, so it naturally did not have any so-called vital points, and was
not afraid of heavy blows either.
“Yin soul!” Everyone called out as well, all extremely solemn.
They had heard a lot about Yin souls. Years ago, a connection point with the Netherworld had appeared on a certain planet, and a large number of Yin souls had appeared. As a result, even a
Saint had died.
This was too terrifying.
Thus, what if this was also a connecting point?

Only Ling Han was very calm. He had observed this place through the ley lines. Though they were not detailed enough, there was one thing that he was sure of. This was definitely not a connecting point to the Netherworld.
Shi Yongming humphed, and attacked again. This time, he used the Six Characters Bright King Curse. This had an incredibly strong restraining effect on Yin souls.
As expected, the Six Characters Bright King Curse combined with Shi Yongming’s Buddhist
Race Mystical Power finally caused the armored figure to collapse. A wisp of almost transparent black Qi floated out of the Battle Armor, then turned into nothing.
Pa, that Battle Armor immediately fell onto the ground like scrap metal.
However, no matter how hard they searched, there was no Soul Nurturing Stone.
“Is the Soul Nurturing Stone hidden even deeper by this Yin soul?”
“Or… is there more than one Yin soul here?”
Everyone frowned. If there were more yin souls here, then it really could be a connecting point
to the Netherworld.

sentences.text: Chapter 4069: Yin Soul Again
Killing an enemy with a single spear strike was not an amazing feat, but with a single strike, one would be turned into a dried corpse.
This was extremely bizarre.
“How dare you!” Everyone shouted loudly.
The armored man held a spear in hand, and looked coldly at everyone.
His entire body was covered in armor, and not even his eyes or hair could be seen.
His figure was extremely tall, and wherever he stood, there would be an extremely strong pressure.
Just when everyone thought that he didn’t dare to take the initiative to attack, the armored man unexpectedly took a step with his right leg, and rushed towards them.
His speed was astonishingly fast, and the tip of the spear stabbed towards Ling Han.
It could not be helped.
He was standing at the very front.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid.
As he threw a punch, the Starlight Screen wrapped around his fist and faced the battle spear head-on.
Peng!
In the exchange of blows, astonishing sparks instantly exploded from the tip of the spear, as well as high-level energy boiling.
Ling Han stumbled slightly, and couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
This armored person’s power was superior to his.
“He’s nothing more than this!” Shi Yongming, Zhong Tian, and the others all thought to themselves.
With this test, their wariness was halved.
The strength of this armored figure lay in the battle spear in his hand.
This was a strange Spirit Tool, capable of instantly absorbing all the blood essence of others.
“Hand over the Soul Nurturing Stone!” Several people rushed forwards, launching attacks at the armored man.
The armored man did not speak, and merely brandished his battle spear in a counterattack.
However, his strength was only around 24 Heavens, so he was indeed very strong.
However, there were more than one or two such powerful prodigies, so how could he withstand their combined attacks?
He took a few heavy blows consecutively, and even his armor caved in a few places.
Weng!
But just when everyone thought that they were going to defeat this armored man, a great many veined patterns appeared on his Battle Armor, and they were all exuding blazing light.
In an instant, the battle prowess of the armored man increased greatly.
He brandished his spear, and no one dared to face it head-on.
They all stepped back.
This might was too strong.
Probably, only Shi Yongming’s power could suppress him.
Otherwise, even Zhong Tian was no match.
Everyone was stunned.
At the bottom of an ancient well, an armored figure that had randomly popped out would have battle prowess that surpassed the number one person on the Galaxy Network.
This was too inconceivable.
It should be known that the Black Rock Sect was merely a small Cauldron Forging Tier force.
Could it be that this was a trap that was deliberately laid out?
No, no, Ancient Prosperity Saint’s interference in this matter was known to the whole world.
Who would dare make a move right in front of the eyes of a Saint?
In other words, this armored person had been hiding at the bottom of the ancient well all this while.
It was only because of the Soul Nurturing Stone that he had been discovered by everyone.
Strange, why would someone with such powerful battle prowess like him hide in such a place?
Really, no matter which Holy Land he entered, this kind of battle prowess would be worthy of being taken in as a disciple, or even nurtured as a Dao Child.
“Who exactly are you?” Zhong Tian shouted loudly.
The armored man had no intention of replying, but he had indeed heard him, because the next spear strike was aimed at Zhong Tian.
Boom!
The might of this strike was at least at 28 Heavens.
Zhong Tian didn’t dare to face it head-on, and he could only dodge to the side.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked over, his expression becoming extremely solemn.
No way!
He unleashed a barrage of murderous aura attacks, but this was completely useless.
The armored person was still killing in all directions, completely unaffected.
As expected.
Ling Han activated the Primal Chaos Celestial Core again, targeting the armored figure.
However, this was still ineffective.
The armored figure’s battle prowess wasn’t weakened in the slightest.
“I will do it!” Shi Yongming walked out.
Weng, a Buddha Halo formed behind his head, his whole body exuding golden light.
Then, he delivered a palm strike at the armored man.
At first, the armored man was chasing after them, but when Shi Yongming raised the golden light, he immediately turned around and stared at Shi Yongming.
Although his face couldn’t be seen, everyone could feel a powerful hatred.
Xiu, the armored figure immediately moved as well, blasting towards Shi Yongming.
Peng!
In the exchange of blows, the armored man was instantly sent flying, and crashed heavily into the cave wall.
However, this cave wall was really sturdy.
With such a collision, there was actually no hole created.
Instead, the armored man was bounced back.
Strangely, the armored man immediately stepped out again, launching a counterattack at Shi Yongming.
Ten thousand curse words instantly streaked through Shi Yongming’s mind.
Why was there another one?
First, it was Ling Han.
It was clear that Ling Han’s battle prowess was weaker than him by about ten Heavens, yet he could not be killed.
Even if he was injured, he could immediately recover.
Now, it was the same for this armored person.
It was clear that his battle prowess was far inferior to him, and he had sent him flying with a single strike, but he was actually completely unscathed.
‘Holy f*ck!
Are you two family?’
Shi Yongming let out a loud roar.
He naturally wouldn’t back down.
He delivered palm strikes,
and golden light shot in all directions, making everyone feel refreshed.
He was indeed powerful, and the armored man was no match for him at all.
However, this person seemed to be a simple-minded person.
He was clearly no match for Shi Yongming, yet continued to oppose him head-on.
The armored person wasn’t Ling Han.
He didn’t have the Primal Chaos Celestial Core to dissipate the power that was inflicted on him.
After being struck several hundred times, peng,
his helmet was finally sent flying.
“What!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
It was not that they had seen an incredibly ugly face, but rather that there was actually nothing behind the helmet!
That’s right, it was just a lump of empty air.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
What was going on here?
Could it be that this armored person was actually extraordinarily small, and he was only as tall
as the chest-level?
Was that why he couldn’t be seen?
Yet Shi Yongming’s expression changed drastically, and he exclaimed, “Yin soul!”
He originated from the Buddhist Race, so he naturally had extraordinary senses towards Yin souls.
Thus, he immediately saw that this was not an encounter with a dwarf, but rather a Yin soul that was controlling this Battle Armor.
No wonder no matter how many times he attacked previously, it was useless.
As it turned out, it was a Yin soul controlling it, so it naturally did not have any so-called vital points, and was
not afraid of heavy blows either.
“Yin soul!” Everyone called out as well, all extremely solemn.
They had heard a lot about Yin souls.
Years ago, a connection point with the Netherworld had appeared on a certain planet, and a large number of Yin souls had appeared.
As a result, even a
Saint had died.
This was too terrifying.
Thus, what if this was also a connecting point?
Only Ling Han was very calm.
He had observed this place through the ley lines.
Though they were not detailed enough, there was one thing that he was sure of.
This was definitely not a connecting point to the Netherworld.
Shi Yongming humphed, and attacked again.
This time, he used the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
This had an incredibly strong restraining effect on Yin souls.
As expected, the Six Characters Bright King Curse combined with Shi Yongming’s Buddhist
Race Mystical Power finally caused the armored figure to collapse.
A wisp of almost transparent black Qi floated out of the Battle Armor, then turned into nothing.
Pa, that Battle Armor immediately fell onto the ground like scrap metal.
However, no matter how hard they searched, there was no Soul Nurturing Stone.
“Is the Soul Nurturing Stone hidden even deeper by this Yin soul?”
“Or… is there more than one Yin soul here?”
Everyone frowned.
If there were more yin souls here, then it really could be a connecting point
to the Netherworld.

chapters.title: Chapter 4070: Giant Doors
paragraphs: Chapter 4070: Giant Doors
A great many people began to hesitate, wondering if they should continue onwards.
However, people like Shi Yongming and Zhong Tian wouldn’t give them time to think. They already started to advance.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t retreat either. Instead, he was slightly expectant. If he could enter the Netherworld again, he would have a chance to continue increasing the strength of his spirit.
They had not walked too far, when they heard the same sound again.
Sure enough, it wasn’t long before an armored figure appeared before them. This was identical to the one before.

Shi Yongming didn’t shirk his responsibilities and immediately delivered a palm strike. However, this armored person was overwhelmingly weak. With a single palm strike, it was directly destroyed. The Yin soul turned into nothing, and the Battle Armor fell onto the ground.
“It’s only at the level of the Cauldron Forging Tier,” everyone said.
As it turned out, the Yin souls here weren’t all of the Core Formation Tier.
This did not reassure them. On the contrary, they became even more worried.
The more varied the Yin soul’s abilities were, the more likely it was that this was a connecting point to the Netherworld. Otherwise, how could there be such a clear hierarchy?
“Let’s go!”
There would always be those who were courageous and strong. They were completely unafraid, and continued onwards.

As they walked, there were a great many Yin souls that were attached to the Battle Armor, and the gap in strength was very wide. The weakest was only Foundation Building Tier, while the highest could reach Core Formation Tier. So far, they had not seen a Yin soul of True Self Tier or above.

This path was really long. They had already walked for more than an hour. Even if they were on guard and did not dare to walk too fast, after such a long time, the distance they had walked should not be less than 500km.
Where did this lead to?
However, Ling Han knew that they were almost at the end. He could communicate with the ley lines, and the range of his senses far surpassed the others.

As expected, after walking for a while, they finally reached the end ahead of them. Originally, this was a tunnel. Though it was still quite spacious, it only looked like it could accommodate a single carriage, but now that they were here, it suddenly widened, and was incredibly shocking.

A massive space appeared in front of them. It was as tall as three thousand meters, and its width was also several hundred meters, and what was even more astonishing was that there were actually two tightly shut stone doors in front of them, which were the same height and width as this space.
Hiss, so grand, so majestic.
At this moment, everyone was transfixed with shock. They were so stunned that they couldn’t speak.
Ling Han was also slightly surprised, because he only knew that they had reached the end, but did not know that there was another door at the end.
What lay behind this door? Was it connected to the Netherworld?
This time, even he was completely unsure.
“Look!” Someone pointed ahead.
At the foot of the great doors, there was presently a rock that was faintly exuding light. Even if it was still very far away, everyone still felt at ease.
Soul Nurturing Stone!
Everyone could confirm that it was the Soul Nurturing Stone.
As expected, this gem had been moved here by the yin souls.
“Haha, I’m coming!” Someone immediately flew out, rushing towards the Soul Nurturing
Stone.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! With his movement, it instantly caused a considerable number of people to fly as well, rushing towards the Soul Nurturing Stone.
Meanwhile, Ling Han didn’t move. This was because he could sense danger. This caused his hair to stand on end.
Shua, a cold light flashed past, and then those who had rushed out were all cut in half, blood and internal organs flying in unison.
What!

A great many people had not managed to catch sight of that ray of light, and could only see that those people had suddenly been sliced into two. However, Ling Han could see very clearly. That was a stone statue at the foot of the giant doors had suddenly moved.
It was clearly just a stone statue, yet it was able to shoot out a fierce saber light, slicing at least ten prodigies of the Core Formation Tier into two.
What kind of abilities was this?
This shocked everyone. Those who had not reached there yet all stepped back.
Thankfully, the stone statue didn’t charge out again after completing its attack. Instead, it retreated to its original position, motionless.
“What’s going on?” Many people exclaimed in shock.
After a while, Shi Yongming said in a deep voice, “The stone statues at the entrance are guards, and it was one of them that attacked just now.”
“What?”
“We didn’t even see what kind of attack it was, and those people were already dead. How wide
is the gap in strength?”
“Hiss, even True Self Tier elites aren’t this strong, right?”
“Spiritual Transformation Tier!”

Everyone was speechless. If it was only the True Self Tier, then if they used their trump card, it was indeed impossible for them to defeat the stone statue. However, it was still possible that they could steal the Soul Nurturing Stone.

However, in the case of Spiritual Transformation Tier elites… there was absolutely no chance. No matter what trump card they used, charging forward would only result in death. Treasures were indeed good, but if one lost his life, how was he supposed to use them? “Contact the clan again. The situation here is far more important than we can imagine.” “Perhaps, there is a world-shaking treasure hidden behind these stone doors!” Many people’s hearts were stirred, and they became excited. They all opened their connection devices, wanting to communicate with their clans or sects. However, they soon discovered that this place was actually unable to connect to the Galaxy Network.
“We have to go back.”
There was nothing to hesitate about. With the Spirit Transformation Tier-level stone statues standing guard, who would be able to obtain the Soul Nurturing Stone?
Moreover, there wasn’t just one stone statue. Instead, there was a whole row of them.
Everyone turned around and walked back. Ling Han also followed the main troops, but while
he was walking, his divine sense communicated with the ley lines, channeling Earth Qi into tentacles that grabbed out at the Soul Nurturing Stone.
No one saw that the Earth Qi had already grabbed the Soul Nurturing Stone and entered into
the ley lines. Then, it instantly arrived at Ling Han’s feet.
He lowered his body slightly, and with a stretch of his hand, the Soul Nurturing Stone appeared, which he stowed into his Spatial Spirit Tool.
Success!
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. No one knew about this.

He followed the masses, and without leaving the passage and about one third of the way, the connection to the Galaxy Network was recovered. Everyone hurriedly reported the situation. Ling Han also managed to contact the Nine Mountains Venerate, relating that there may be
something incredible hidden here.
When the Nine Mountains Venerate heard this, he told Ling Han not to move for the moment. He would immediately rush over with the Saint Tool.
He would rush over with a Saint Tool. Tsk, these words sounded very domineering.
After making the contact, everyone returned one after another.
However, when they arrived in front of those massive stone doors, they were all
dumbfounded.
Yi, where was the Soul Nurturing Stone?
It was clearly there just now. Could a dog have eaten it or something?
Everyone was about to go crazy. How could the Soul Nurturing Stone possibly disappear?
There should be no one here that could snatch it.
“Could it be that there is a True Self Tier cultivator here?” someone asked.
Unless a True Self Tier cultivator came, only then would he be qualified to obtain the Soul
Nurturing Stone and escape alive. Of course, he would definitely have to use his trump card, or he would still be insta-killed by a Spirit Transformation Tier.

Everyone looked at each other, searching through the crowd. However, there would always be people who knew each other. After eliminating them one by one, it could be confirmed that there was no one in the True Self Tier here, nor was there anyone in the Spiritual
Transformation Tier.
Then what was going on?
Ling Han merely smiled, secretly pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 4071: Arrival of the Saint
paragraphs: Chapter 4071: Arrival of the Saint
Unfortunately, there was no place for Ling Han to refine the Soul Nurturing Stone.
Sigh.
Ling Han didn’t take it to heart. Since he had already obtained it, it was equivalent to him already advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
A few days would make no difference.
Ling Han waited quietly. Two days later, the first batch of people arrived.
This was a Sect Master elite. It wasn’t that he was more impressive than the Venerate Tiers or Saints, but rather that he was the closest, and that was why he was the first to arrive.
The moment he arrived, he immediately walked to the main doors. His eyes swept over the surroundings, and an expression of shock appeared on his face.
Ling Han knew that his shock was due to the great doors themselves.

He had not been idle these few days, and had been observing these great doors. Though they were simple, and there were no designs or patterns on them, the stone doors themselves were not ordinary. They had an indescribably ancient air to them.
However, the Sect Master glanced at them for a moment before immediately charging toward the main doors.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂

A stone statue revived, and moved to block the Sect Master. However, Spirit Transformation Tier-level battle prowess was completely insufficient in front of the Sect Master. That elite very easily shattered the row of stone statues.
He tried to push the stone doors open, yet no matter how red his face became, the stone doors still wouldn’t budge.
F***, this was too shocking, wasn’t it?
The Sect Master was a supreme elite, yet he was actually unable to open the doors?
That elite refused to give up, and used great power to bombard the stone doors repeatedly,

but no matter what kind of attack he launched, it was useless. These stone doors were incredibly plain, without a sliver of light flickering, yet could not be broken through no matter how hard he tried.
This was very strange, because these stone doors were clearly made of very ordinary stone, so how could they possess such a terrifying defense?
“Regulations!” that elite exclaimed in excitement. He stroked the great doors, as if he was treating a gentle lover.

Ling Han nodded internally. Only with the blessing of the Regulations of heaven and earth, could ordinary stone possess heaven-defying defense. Even a Sect Master elite would not be able to penetrate through them.
Hearing the words of this Sect Master elite, everyone rushed over. They all rubbed the stone doors, hoping to catch a sliver of Regulations.

It could be imagined that the elite that had set up these stone doors must have surpassed the level of Sect Master. Thus, if one could grasp a sliver of the Regulations of heaven and earth, they would be able to greatly increase their own strength.
Unfortunately, without reaching the True Self Tier, one would not be able to touch Regulations. No matter how talented and intelligent you were, it was useless.
After a while, more and more elites arrived.
This time, there was a Venerate Tier elite.
The Venerate Tier elite moved, but it was useless. The stone doors were still completely unharmed, and did not open a single crack.
This caused everyone to be both stunned and excited. Could it be that there was a Saint-level treasure trove sealed inside?
“It’s definitely not connected to the Netherworld. There are no records of it in history,” someone said resolutely.

This won the agreement of a great many people. They had all investigated, and there had never been any legend of a battle with yin souls on this planet. Thus, what was sealed behind these great doors was definitely not the connecting point with the Yin souls.

Originally, it would have been impossible for Saints to appear. However, this could possibly involve a Saint-level secret trove. Thus, the news spread wider and wider, and finally, a Saint replied, saying that he wanted to come and take a look.
Before the Saint arrived, the Nine Mountains Venerate arrived first.

“You’re really lucky, brat!” the Nine Mountains Venerate exclaimed ruefully. He had already contacted Ling Han on the Galaxy Network previously, and found out the reason for his “disappearance”. Ling Han was probably the only person who had managed to come back out alive after entering the Battle God Palace.
Ling Han merely chuckled, then asked, “Senior, do you know what this place is?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate stepped forwards to observe for a while, then walked back, and said, “Extraordinary, truly extraordinary!”
Why are you still keeping me in suspense at this time!
The Nine Mountains Venerate sighed with emotion before explaining, “I estimate that these stone doors were at least forged by a Saint, or even forged by an Ancestral King.”
This was actually… nonsense.
Even Venerate Tier elites like you couldn’t do anything about it. That was either the doing of a Saint or an Ancestral King. It was obvious.
Ling Han mocked internally, but also became even more expectant. What exactly was hidden behind these stone doors?
“Why don’t we use the Saint Tool to blast it?” he suggested.

The Nine Mountains Venerate rolled his eyes at him. At present, all the Venerable Tier elites had gathered here, and in fact, not long after, even the Saints would arrive. He, a Venerate Tier from the Nine Mountains Venerate, would be beaten to death if he was too high-profile. “Yi!” Ling Han looked behind him. He sensed an incredibly powerful aura.
“The Saint is here!” the Nine Mountains Venerate said softly. There was an indescribable glow on his face.

Becoming an Emperor was too difficult. Furthermore, only one would appear in each era. Thus, this was an unrealistic fantasy. Those who were knowledgeable would set their eyes on the position of Saint. Only after becoming a Saint would they think about becoming an
Emperor.
And in the whole world, just how many Saints were there?
To the Nine Mountains Venerate, becoming a Saint was now his greatest extravagant hope. He
had thought about this for too many years.
And now, seeing Saints standing in front of him, he was naturally excited.
There were a total of three people who had entered in this group.

One person was completely enshrouded in Regulations, and they could not see clearly whether they were tall or short, fat or thin, or even male or female. However, wherever he stood, it was as if he was the centre of heaven and earth, attracting everyone’s attention. Furthermore, their hearts and spirits trembled, and they wanted to kneel down in worship.
Needless to say, this was definitely a Saint.

A man and woman followed behind him. The man was very young, but also very strong, exuding a sharp aura. The woman was dressed in a white dress, and a white veil covered her face, concealing her beauty.
However, her slightly loose dress couldn’t hide her exquisite figure, instantly attracting the gazes of many young men.
“Wu!” It was only an instant, and these people were all covering their eyes and screaming in
pain.
Without a doubt, it was definitely that Saint that had moved.
No, no, no. This wasn’t called making a move. It was just a thought, and a light punishment. Otherwise, if the Saint really made a move, at least 90% of the people here would be instantly
killed.
Ling Han was also looking at the veiled woman, but he didn’t have any strange thoughts. He only felt that she looked a little familiar.
Oh, that’s right. Chi Menghan, Imperial Daughter!
That’s right. The Imperial Clan basically wouldn’t have a lapse in generations for Saints. Thus, it was reasonable that the Donglin Imperial Clan had sent a Saint.
However, this actually alerted the Imperial Clan… hiss!
“Greetings, Saint!” At this moment, everyone bowed in respect, including Venerate Tier.
The Saint from the Donglin Imperial Clan raised his hand, signaling for everyone to stand up.

He walked forwards, and began to study the two stone doors.
Chi Menghan’s eyes swept over them, and actually stopped on Ling Han.
‘F*ck! This woman didn’t recognize me, did she?’
Scary things came true. Chi Menghan actually walked over gracefully towards him.

thing, but he didn’t stop her. Instead, a smile tugged at the corners of his lips, and he crossed his arms over his chest as he watched.

sentences.text: Chapter 4071: Arrival of the Saint
Unfortunately, there was no place for Ling Han to refine the Soul Nurturing Stone.
Sigh.
Ling Han didn’t take it to heart.
Since he had already obtained it, it was equivalent to him already advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
A few days would make no difference.
Ling Han waited quietly.
Two days later, the first batch of people arrived.
This was a Sect Master elite.
It wasn’t that he was more impressive than the Venerate Tiers or Saints, but rather that he was the closest, and that was why he was the first to arrive.
The moment he arrived, he immediately walked to the main doors.
His eyes swept over the surroundings, and an expression of shock appeared on his face.
Ling Han knew that his shock was due to the great doors themselves.
He had not been idle these few days, and had been observing these great doors.
Though they were simple, and there were no designs or patterns on them, the stone doors themselves were not ordinary.
They had an indescribably ancient air to them.
However, the Sect Master glanced at them for a moment before immediately charging toward the main doors.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂
A stone statue revived, and moved to block the Sect Master.
However, Spirit Transformation Tier-level battle prowess was completely insufficient in front of the Sect Master.
That elite very easily shattered the row of stone statues.
He tried to push the stone doors open, yet no matter how red his face became, the stone doors still wouldn’t budge.
F***, this was too shocking, wasn’t it?
The Sect Master was a supreme elite, yet he was actually unable to open the doors?
That elite refused to give up, and used great power to bombard the stone doors repeatedly,
but no matter what kind of attack he launched, it was useless.
These stone doors were incredibly plain, without a sliver of light flickering, yet could not be broken through no matter how hard he tried.
This was very strange, because these stone doors were clearly made of very ordinary stone, so how could they possess such a terrifying defense?
“Regulations!” that elite exclaimed in excitement.
He stroked the great doors, as if he was treating a gentle lover.
Ling Han nodded internally.
Only with the blessing of the Regulations of heaven and earth, could ordinary stone possess heaven-defying defense.
Even a Sect Master elite would not be able to penetrate through them.
Hearing the words of this Sect Master elite, everyone rushed over.
They all rubbed the stone doors, hoping to catch a sliver of Regulations.
It could be imagined that the elite that had set up these stone doors must have surpassed the level of Sect Master.
Thus, if one could grasp a sliver of the Regulations of heaven and earth, they would be able to greatly increase their own strength.
Unfortunately, without reaching the True Self Tier, one would not be able to touch Regulations.
No matter how talented and intelligent you were, it was useless.
After a while, more and more elites arrived.
This time, there was a Venerate Tier elite.
The Venerate Tier elite moved, but it was useless.
The stone doors were still completely unharmed, and did not open a single crack.
This caused everyone to be both stunned and excited.
Could it be that there was a Saint-level treasure trove sealed inside?
“It’s definitely not connected to the Netherworld.
There are no records of it in history,” someone said resolutely.
This won the agreement of a great many people.
They had all investigated, and there had never been any legend of a battle with yin souls on this planet.
Thus, what was sealed behind these great doors was definitely not the connecting point with the Yin souls.
Originally, it would have been impossible for Saints to appear.
However, this could possibly involve a Saint-level secret trove.
Thus, the news spread wider and wider, and finally, a Saint replied, saying that he wanted to come and take a look.
Before the Saint arrived, the Nine Mountains Venerate arrived first.
“You’re really lucky, brat!” the Nine Mountains Venerate exclaimed ruefully.
He had already contacted Ling Han on the Galaxy Network previously, and found out the reason for his “disappearance”.
Ling Han was probably the only person who had managed to come back out alive after entering the Battle God Palace.
Ling Han merely chuckled, then asked, “Senior, do you know what this place is?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate stepped forwards to observe for a while, then walked back, and said, “Extraordinary, truly extraordinary!”
Why are you still keeping me in suspense at this time!
The Nine Mountains Venerate sighed with emotion before explaining, “I estimate that these stone doors were at least forged by a Saint, or even forged by an Ancestral King.”
This was actually… nonsense.
Even Venerate Tier elites like you couldn’t do anything about it.
That was either the doing of a Saint or an Ancestral King.
It was obvious.
Ling Han mocked internally, but also became even more expectant.
What exactly was hidden behind these stone doors?
“Why don’t we use the Saint Tool to blast it?” he suggested.
The Nine Mountains Venerate rolled his eyes at him.
At present, all the Venerable Tier elites had gathered here, and in fact, not long after, even the Saints would arrive.
He, a Venerate Tier from the Nine Mountains Venerate, would be beaten to death if he was too high-profile.
“Yi!” Ling Han looked behind him.
He sensed an incredibly powerful aura.
“The Saint is here!” the Nine Mountains Venerate said softly.
There was an indescribable glow on his face.
Becoming an Emperor was too difficult.
Furthermore, only one would appear in each era.
Thus, this was an unrealistic fantasy.
Those who were knowledgeable would set their eyes on the position of Saint.
Only after becoming a Saint would they think about becoming an
Emperor.
And in the whole world, just how many Saints were there?
To the Nine Mountains Venerate, becoming a Saint was now his greatest extravagant hope.
He
had thought about this for too many years.
And now, seeing Saints standing in front of him, he was naturally excited.

However, wherever he stood, it was as if he was the centre of heaven and earth, attracting everyone’s attention.
Furthermore, their hearts and spirits trembled, and they wanted to kneel down in worship.
Needless to say, this was definitely a Saint.
