chapters.title: Chapter 4072: Might of the Imperial Weapon
paragraphs: Chapter 4072: Might of the Imperial Weapon
Ling Han remained calm and collected. Right now, he was Ling Han, not Ding Yi. Thus, he naturally wouldn’t recognize this Imperial Daughter.
Chi Menghan didn’t speak either. She simply continued to stare at Ling Han.
Ling Han sighed, “I have sinned!”
What crime have you committed?

The Nine Mountains Venerate glanced over in surprise. How could it be that Ling Han had come into contact with this woman from the Donglin Imperial Clan? He naturally knew that Ling Han had gone to the Donglin Imperial Clan under an alias, but how could he have left behind evidence that would lead back to him?
Ling Han continued, “It’s all my fault. I’m too handsome, and everyone loves me!”
The Nine Mountains Venerate almost spluttered in shock. This brat was truly outrageously bold. He even dared to tease a member of the Imperial Clan.

Chi Menghan was also astonished. She hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would actually say something so narcissistic. She simply nodded slightly before turning around to leave. She didn’t say a single word throughout the entire process.
Had this woman really seen through to his true identity?
Ling Han thought internally. If she didn’t, then it would be too baffling for her to walk straight over like this, but if she had seen through him, why didn’t she say anything?
“Hiss, could it be that this is really the doing of the Ancestral King?” The Nine Mountains Venerate inhaled sharply, and looked ahead.
After such a long time, the Saint from the Donglin Imperial Clan was still rubbing the main doors. He actually hadn’t opened the doors yet.
That was a Saint!
To be able to stop a Saint in their tracks, what else could it be but the means of a Great Emperor?
“Haha, Old Geezer Chi, you’re here so early!” Amidst a loud laugh, a figure suddenly appeared.

This was a white-haired old man, but his spirit was hale and hearty. Regulations would appear and disappear on his body, and there was also the phenomenon of stars shattering in his eyes, which was boundlessly terrifying.
“Greetings, Saint!” At this moment, the Venerate Tier elites led the others again, paying their respects to the white-haired elder.
This was another Saint!
This was extremely astounding. Originally, it would have been extremely difficult to even meet one Saint. Now, however, two Saints had suddenly popped up.
The first Saint turned around, glanced at the white-haired Saint, and said, “Liu Fang, hurry up and come over to help!”

“Yi, there’s something that you, Old Geezer Chi, can’t settle?” The white-haired Saint exclaimed in surprise. However, he did not hesitate, and immediately walked forwards. The conversation between the two of them instantly caused the others to explode.
“Liu Fang… That’s the Shattering Stars Saint!”
“Old Geezer Chi, Old Geezer Chi, hiss, Dong Lin Imperial Clan’s Crystal Saint, Chi Feihong!” “Heavens!”
Everyone had pieced together the identities of these two Saints, and they all exclaimed in shock. These were mighty figures that could not possibly be seen under normal circumstances.

The two Saints were studying the stone doors, while the others didn’t even dare to breathe too loudly. In front of a Saint, even Venerate Tier elites were ants. The gap between them was like a gulf between heaven and earth.
However, what was even more astonishing was the fact that even though the two Saints had joined forces, they were still unable to open the stone doors for a long time.
This caused more and more people to believe that this was definitely the doing of the Ancestral King.
The moment they thought that the inheritance of an Ancestral King might be hidden here, everyone’s blood boiled, and they were incredibly excited.

This was a Great Emperor Tier-level treasure. As long as one could obtain even one, they would be able to stand firmly in the universe, and if one could obtain the Imperial Weapon, that would directly become the strongest force in the universe, and join the ranks of the Imperial Clans.
Not long after, a third Saint arrived.

Ancient Prosperity Saint, who was also the elite that had started the prodigy battle this time round, had never imagined that he would actually discover the tomb of what he suspected to be a Great Emperor because of a mere thought.
The three Saints joined forces, and finally opened the stone doors.
They had not deciphered it, but rather the three Saints had all returned to the Imperial Clans respectively, and used the Imperial Weapons to work together to blast open the stone doors.

Ling Han finally witnessed the might of the Imperial Weapon. That scene of its might was really too terrifying. With a light strike, even planets would not be able to withstand it, and would directly shatter.

The Chi Clan’s Imperial Weapon was a flag, and with a wave, it shot out endless swords of ice that could easily kill even Saints. The Shattering Stars Saint came from the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan, and the Imperial Weapon he summoned was a golden bell. With a shake, a golden dragon appeared, as if it was a True Dragon!
Meanwhile, Ancient Prosperity Saint had come from the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan. The Imperial Weapon in his hand was a saber, and as it slashed out, lightning flashed.

The three Imperial Weapons didn’t need to be activated by the Saints at all. When they were close enough to each other, they would automatically awaken and float above the heads of the three Saints. An aura of eternal destruction circulated around them, and it was as if three
living Great Emperors had walked out.
Instantly, everyone knelt down, incredibly respectful.

Previously, even if a Saint had arrived, everyone could still suppress the reverence in their hearts, and would not bow down at all. But now, with the might of the Imperial Weapon, even Venerate Tier elites could not help but bow down, completely unable to resist this kind of
intimidating pressure.
The Imperial Weapon awakened, and it was as if the Great Emperor himself had arrived!
There was only one exception, and that was Ling Han.
The Celestial Foundation he cultivated was a replica of the Primitive Celestial Gate, which allowed him to be unafraid of any kind of intimidation. He was unafraid of even Great
Emperors.
Everyone bowed. Ling Han was an exception and this made him the focus of everyone’s
attention.
This young man was far too astonishing. He had actually withstood Imperial Might!

In truth, Ling Han had initially wanted to keep a low profile. After all, only if he kept a low profile would he be able to screw others over and trick them. Everyone knew that he was very awesome, so he wouldn’t be able to do things like lying and making bets.

The problem was that the moment the three Imperial Weapons appeared, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in his mind seemed to be affected as well. It was moving around, as if it was about to jump out and compete with the other three Imperial Weapons.

In terms of quality, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was not the slightest bit inferior to the Imperial Weapon. In fact, because it was formed from two types of utmost grade materials, it was even slightly superior. However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was not the real Imperial Weapon, after all, and had not been refined by an Ancestral King. If it really clashed with the Imperial Weapon, it would definitely lose. Thus, Ling Han forcefully controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, not allowing it to come out and compete with the other Imperial Weapons. Otherwise, it would be exposed that he possessed the embryonic form of an Imperial Weapon. In fact, it would even draw the attention of the Imperial Clans to attack him.

Even the three Saints glanced at Ling Han in surprise. However, they didn’t want to waste their time on a measly Core Formation Tier cultivator at this moment. They immediately controlled their Imperial Weapon to attack the stone doors.
Peng, the ice swords, fire dragon, and sea of lightning blasted out, and the two stone doors immediately crumbled, completely incapable of standing against these attacks.
The great doors had finally opened.
However, the Imperial Weapons were still floating there, and there were still three Saints
standing. Who would dare to snatch the opportunity to enter now? Thus, everyone was watching from the surroundings, all of them stretching out their necks.
Ling Han was also watching, and saw that there was a blood-coloured world behind the great doors. The ground was blood-coloured, and even the skies were enshrouded by a blood-
coloured mist.
Could there be… a rare treasure of a Great Emperor hidden inside?

“Let’s go!” Ancient Prosperity Saint said. The Ten Thousand Thunder Saber hovered above his head, spitting out supreme lightning and intertwining with the Regulations of heaven and earth. It was untouchable, and even if a Great Emperor came, the Imperial Weapon would still be able to go a few rounds with him.
Moreover, in this era, there was no monarch tier in the world.
The Shattering Stars Saint and the Crystal Saint both nodded in agreement. The three Saints
then set off at the same time, stepping through the large doors and entering the blood-red
world.

chapters.title: Chapter 4073: Blood Palace
paragraphs: Chapter 4073: Blood Palace
With the three Saints leading the way, what did the others have to fear?
Everyone followed behind them.

A few youngsters caught up with them. They were the clansmen of the Donglin Imperial Clan, the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan and the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan respectively. Naturally, they followed closely behind their respective Saints.
Meanwhile, Ling Han stayed by the Nine Mountains Venerate’s side. This Venerate Tier elite also had a deadly weapon, and as long as it wasn’t Emperor-level power, he could withstand it.

Because they all came from the Imperial Clans, the few young people in front naturally came together, and as the only woman, Chi Menghan was naturally surrounded by men. Though her appearance was not obvious, her exquisite beauty had long since been circulated on the Galaxy Network. Being able to be called the third most exquisite beauty in the galaxy, what need was there for doubt?
The Imperial Daughter was both graceful and exquisite. This kind of identity naturally caused the males from the other Imperial Clans to scramble madly for her.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
However, Chi Menghan only responded calmly, neither too distant nor too cordial to everyone, appearing both polite and aloof.
Ling Han glanced at her for a moment before withdrawing his gaze. This had nothing to do with him, and he didn’t care about any Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter.
“What is it? Do you like her?” The Nine Mountains Venerate communicated through divine
sense.
‘Pfft, what’s wrong with your eyes?’
Ling Han laughed loudly, “A wise and mighty person like me can only be the target of crushes from others.”
This time, it was the Nine Mountains Venerate who couldn’t bear it any longer. He felt that this disciple of his was truly shameless.
“Yi, the fog here is really thick!” Ling Han said. His divine sense could not extend out at all in this place.
The Nine Mountains Venerate nodded, “Indeed.” To say nothing of Ling Han, even his divine sense could not extend very far.
Ling Han attempted to communicate with the ley lines, but he shockingly discovered that the ley lines here had been suppressed.
F***, even ley lines could be suppressed?
Ling Han did not doubt in the slightest that this must be a technique of the Ancestral King, because even a Saint Master could only change the ley lines, but could not suppress the ley lines.
Then was this the temporary residence of a Great Emperor, or… a tomb?
If it was the latter, hehe, they had barged into the tomb of the Great Emperor, so how could they leave alive?
Ling Han naturally thought of Buddha Doga. This was only a Pseudo-Emperor, and he had practically conquered all the Saints in the world. What if it was a real Great Emperor?
Fortunately, the Saints had brought three Imperial Weapons with them this time, so they should be able to block that.
As they walked, a palace appeared ahead of them. It matched this place very well. The walls were also blood red, exuding a harsh smell.
“Come, let’s go in and take a look.”
The three Saints were the first to enter. With the Imperial Weapon in hand, they were naturally unafraid.

After entering the palace, Ling Han saw that there were twelve massive pillars supporting this blood-red palace, and the pillars were engraved with incredibly complex veined patterns. Ling Han felt like he was about to pass out with a single glance.

This veined pattern was filled with attraction, yet it was also incredibly complex, and could not be analyzed. It was extremely exhausting, and could exhaust one’s spirit in an instant, which was why one would feel the discomfort of passing out.

Ling Han hurriedly composed himself, not daring to look any further. However, when he looked around, there were already people collapsed all over the ground, and elites such as the Nine Mountains Venerate, Ancient Prosperity Saint and other elites were all staring fixedly at those veined patterns.
“Senior, Senior!” Ling Han called out.

After calling out a few times, the Nine Mountains Venerate finally came back to his senses. He took a deep breath, and said, “These veined patterns represent supreme true meaning. They’re precious treasures among precious treasures. Unfortunately, you don’t cultivate the Regulations now, so this is detrimental to you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4074: An Imperial Dao Stone
paragraphs: Chapter 4074: An Imperial Dao Stone
True Self Tier!

Even if these people were all prodigies of the present generation, and even if there was no shortage of heirs of the Imperial Clans, there was still a gap of a major tier between their cultivation levels, so everyone frowned.
Even for them, against a Yin soul of this level, it was still possible that they would be killed.

The main reason was because Yin souls were too unique. They did not have a physical body, and were not injured by mystical power. They could only be attacked through high-level energy. This would undoubtedly erase a lot of their advantage, and make it so that they were not much stronger than ordinary prodigies.
The heirs of the Imperial Clans all carefully charged forwards to battle, but very soon, they all retreated, their expressions filled with fear.
The Yin soul was too terrifying, wanting to invade their minds and seize their bodies.
There was a gap between their cultivation levels, especially in terms of the strength of their souls. They indeed couldn’t withstand it.
What could they do? That was an Imperial Dao Stone!

“Blood-Patterned Dao Stone, this is a Blood-Patterned Dao Stone, one of the highest grade Dao Stones!” Someone’s eyes lit up, wanting nothing more than to rush forwards to snatch it, yet forcibly stopped himself.
Of course, the Dao Stone that the Great Emperor had refined was naturally top-notch.
Everyone knew how precious this stone was, but with three True Self Tier Yin souls keeping watch, how could they take it?
Could it be that they had to wait for those higher ups to come out of the blood-coloured palace?
However, in this way, this Blood-Patterned Dao Stone would be theirs. This was an Imperial Dao Stone, and even Saints would be tempted.
Everyone was scratching their heads. All of them were anxious, not wanting to give up, but also feeling helpless.
“Brother Ling, aren’t you going to give it a try?” Chi Menghan suddenly said to Ling Han. Yi, what do you mean?

“Haha!” Before Ling Han could even answer, someone laughed loudly, and said, “Him? He’s merely in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, so Fairy Chi’s expectations of him are a bit too high, aren’t they?”
Ling Han looked at that person and said, “What business is it of yours whether I can or not?” If you want to mock me, then why should I be reserved?
A furious expression instantly appeared on that person’s face, “What an arrogant lowly commoner, you actually dare to be rude to the Imperial Clan!”

His name was Liu Yiming, and he was a member of the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan. Although he wasn’t the Imperial Son, his status wasn’t low either. He could just barely be considered a reserve Imperial Son, or Pseudo-Imperial Son and so on. His natural talent and aptitude weren’t inferior either.

Just how high and noble was the Imperial Clan? To say nothing of the Imperial Son, even if it was only a Pseudo-Imperial Son, they would still be very arrogant as they travelled the world. Just from the fact that he directly called Ling Han a lowly commoner, it was clear how high an opinion of himself he had.

He was extremely interested in Chi Menghan, and he continued to curry Chi Menghan’s favor along the way, looking for all kinds of topics to talk about. However, Chi Menghan was cold and cheerless. He was clearly very polite, yet she still kept him at a distance.
So be it if this was all. Now that Chi Menghan had taken the initiative to speak to Ling Han, he couldn’t tolerate it any longer.
What right did he have?

‘I come from the Imperial Clan, yet I’m actually no match for a lowly commoner like you?’ -In the eyes of the Imperial Clans, even if they had come from a Holy Land, they were still lowly commoners. If they wanted to take them seriously, they would have to be at least Sect Master-level, and Venerate Tiers could be treated with respect, and in the case of Saints, even the Imperial Clans would view them as esteemed guests.
But Ling Han? He was nothing.
Ling Han ignored him completely. Instead, he looked at Chi Menghan, and asked, “Fairy Chi, why do you think I can do it?”
“How would you know if you don’t try?” Chi Menghan asked calmly.

Seeing that Ling Han was ignoring him completely, Liu Yiming was naturally even more furious. He glared fiercely at Ling Han, but when he thought that he couldn’t lose his demeanor in front of Chi Menghan, he forcefully suppressed his anger, and said in a disdainful tone, “I’ll make a bet with you. You definitely won’t succeed!”
Everyone was watching the excitement from the sidelines. They had nothing to do anyway, so they were not in a rush at all.
Bet?
Ling Han immediately came to his senses, and asked, “All right, what do we bet?”

Liu Yiming was startled. He said it was a bet, but in truth, he was only emphasizing it. He did not really want to make a bet with Ling Han. He scoffed, “A mere lowly commoner, you think you are worthy of making a bet with me?”
Ling Han was angered. This guy kept calling him a lowly commoner, which made him extremely displeased.
He took out ten Great Herbs and asked, “Can’t afford the stakes?”

Previously, he and the large black dog had worked together to trick people, and obtained a considerable number of Great Herbs. Naturally, they could not possibly consume all of them, and there were some left behind.
Ten Great Herbs were laid out, all of them exuding a soft lustre, causing one to feel intoxicated with a single sniff, which was incredibly comfortable.
Even Liu Yiming was startled. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so rich and
imposing.
However, wasn’t this just delivering money to him?
You, a cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, want to snatch the Blood- Patterned Dao Stone from the hands of three True Self Tier Yin souls? Hehe, isn’t that just a
fantasy?
He was definitely going to win.
“All right!” He also touched his Spatial Spirit Tool, but immediately looked awkward, because he only took out two Great Herbs, Great Herb.
As a dignified Pseudo-Imperial Son, his wealth was actually inferior to a lowly commoner. This made Liu Yiming feel incredibly awkward.
He immediately used his divine sense to transmit a message to the other Imperial Clan elites, asking them to lend him some treasures, and promised that he would repay them with double
the amount.
Those members of Imperial Clans were all tempted, because no matter how they looked at it, Ling Han was definitely going to lose, so they could take this chance to earn some profit.
Thus, Liu Yiming soon gathered ten Great Herbs.
“Fairy Chi, come and act as notary, and safeguard the stakes.” Ling Han turned around, and handed the ten Great Herbs over to Chi Menghan.
“All right.” Chi Menghan nodded.
Liu Yiming naturally believed Chi Menghan’s character as well. She was an Imperial Daughter,
so how could she possibly embezzle money in public?
Thus, the 20 Great Herbs all fell into Chi Menghan’s hands.
“Peasant, begin!” Liu Yiming said coldly, “I advise you to take a few more breaths, because it
is very possible that you will die immediately.”
Ling Han didn’t say anything. Later, he would let him know what it meant to be slapped in the
face.

Shi Yongming was also filled with anticipation. He couldn’t defeat Ling Han, yet he also hated Ling Han to the core. This was an extremely good opportunity. If Ling Han’s mind was invaded by the Yin soul, then this heaven-defying freak would disappear forever.
Die, die quickly.
“What is it, lowly commoner? Afraid now?” Seeing that Ling Han had not walked forwards for
a long time, Liu Yiming began to mock him.
Ling Han turned around and said, “Let’s make another bet. If I win, you’ll kneel on the ground and slap yourself three times, saying that your mouth stinks like a cesspit.”
Liu Yiming flew into a thunderous rage. How dare this lowly commoner! “Fine, I’ll oblige you!” he said balefully. “If you’re lucky enough not to die, I’ll personally
tear you into pieces!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and strode forwards, greeting those three Yin souls.
In this place, the yin souls’ behavior was very strange. The yin souls that he had previously
seen actually possessed Battle Armor, and these three yin souls seemed to be guarding the Blood Patterned Dao Stone. It could be said to be completely different from the yin souls that
he had learned about.
What was so strange about this?
As he thought, he was also getting very close to those three Yin souls. Instantly, the three yin souls all released sharp cries, which then blasted towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He had even killed Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin souls in the Netherworld, okay? In terms of soul strength, what did he need to be afraid of?
A divine sense-level screech assaulted him, yet Ling Han was completely unmoved. His divine
sense was as sturdy as metal.
Hehe, you guys are still a little lacking.
Ling Han’s fists shook, and the Destructive Energy wrapped around him.

paragraphs: Chapter 4075: Betrothal Gift
The moment the Destructive Energy appeared, the three Yin souls all looked like they were shrinking back.
They were clearly Yin souls, yet they actually had such a human-like expression. This was really enough to make people click their tongues in amazement.
Boom!

Ling Han brandished Destructive Energy, and as he shot out a punch, fist light was shot out, mixed with Destructive Energy. This was the strongest weapon against Yin souls, and could even allow him to battle surpassing his cultivation level.
Otherwise, how could he kill a Spirit Transformation Tier Yin soul?
Logically speaking, since the three Yin souls were so afraid of the Destructive Energy, why didn’t they run?
Indeed, they kept retreating, but it was only limited to the vicinity of the Blood-Patterned Dao Stone. There seemed to be some kind of power, or even Regulations, that restricted them from leaving.
Under such circumstances, how could they possibly escape from Ling Han’s attack?
In just a few hundred punches, the three Yin souls were all killed by Ling Han. Then, he easily picked up the Blood-Patterned Dao Stone.
This caused everyone to be dumbfounded with shock. Who would have thought that not only had Ling Han obtained the Blood Patterned Dao Stone, he had even killed the three Yin souls.
Shua, everyone’s eyes turned towards Shi Yongming.
‘Aren’t you the Buddha Son?’
Dealing with Yin souls isn’t your forte?
But why was it that you were sent flying with a single strike, yet Ling Han easily killed three True Self Tier Yin souls?
Shi Yongming was naturally speechless. F***, how did he know?
The Buddhist Race was indeed skilled in exorcising Yin souls, but that was only limited to those at the same cultivation level!
Ling Han strode over to Chi Menghan, stretched out his hand, and said, “I’ll have to trouble Fairy Chi.”
Chi Menghuan handed over16 Great Herbs to Ling Han.
‘Huh? What’s the meaning of this? Are you trying to pluck my profits?’
“Celestial maiden Chi, there are still four missing,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Chi Menghan sent a message through divine sense, saying, “I’ll only say one name. Ding Yi.”
F***, this woman had indeed guessed correctly.
Ling Han still wanted to struggle for a while. After all, those were four Great Herbs! “Fairy Chi, I don’t know what you’re talking about.”
“As long as you cultivate the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, I’ll be able to sense it,” Chi Menghan said calmly. “Now, do you understand?”

Ling Han was rendered speechless. At first, he had thought that Chi Menghan was only speaking out of a woman’s intuition. He could still spout some nonsense about this, but with the Heavenly Brilliance Technique, there was no way he could deny it.
Depressing, this was really depressing.
“All right. Since Fairy Chi is willing to marry to a lower station, then the four Great Herbs will be the betrothal gift,” Ling Han suddenly said loudly.
Yi?

As soon as these words fell, everyone in the area was stunned. Even Chi Menghan hadn’t expected this. She couldn’t help but blush, but her face was hidden by a white veil. This was a top-grade treasure, and even Saints might not be able to see through it.
This guy was really shooting his mouth off.
Yet Ling Han bore the philosophy of the large black dog, and that was he definitely could not lose out!
‘You scammed four of my Great Herbs, so I’ll scam even you. This way, you’ll be mine, and the Great Herbs will still be mine.’
“Ling Han!” Liu Yiming shouted furiously. This guy actually dared to tease his goddess? ‘You’re seeking death!’

Ling Han gave an ‘oh’, and turned around, “I almost forgot. You still owe me a wager.” Hearing the matter of the wager, not only did Liu Yiming’s expression change drastically, even the expressions of the others did not look too good. At first, they had thought that they could easily make a profit, but they had not thought that Ling Han would actually win. However, it was fine. They had only lent the Great Herbs to Liu Yiming. Whetherhe won or lost, they only had to ask Liu Yiming for repayment.
As a member of the Imperial Clan, how could he renege on his promise?
“Impudence! You actually dare to humiliate the Imperial Clan? You’re seeking death!” Liu Yiming said with a humph. He immediately charged toward Ling Han.
That’s right. Ling Han was very awesome against Yin souls. He could even kill a Yin soul that was superior to his cultivation level by a whole major tier. However, he was not a Yin soul!
Boom, he delivered a palm strike, and seven streaks of light bloomed behind him, boosting his power, becoming even more terrifying.
However, this attack hadn’t reached its target yet, when Chi Menghan stepped out bravely, raised a hand to block, and said, “Brother Liu, you have to accept your loss. Don’t lose your demeanor!”
Demeanor?
You want me to kneel on the ground, slap myself three times, and say that my mouth stinks like a cesspit?
‘Sorry, I don’t have that kind of demeanor.’
As Liu Yiming attacked, he said, “Fairy Chi, please move aside. Don’t protect this lowly commoner!”

Chi Menghan didn’t reply. Instead, she simply sent out a casual palm strike. Her slender hand flipped over slightly, and it was indescribably beautiful. However, its might was incredibly powerful, and it easily suppressed Liu Yiming.

This was the gulf between the Imperial Daughter and someone who was not an Imperial Son, what more when Chi Menghan had a seven-star aptitude, and her battle prowess at the same cultivation level surpassed even the majority of Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters.
In just a few moves, Liu Yiming was outmatched. With a furious roar, he directly turned around and left.
He had no face to stay any longer. How could it be that he really had to kneel down and complete the bet?
Liu Yiming left, and all the Imperial Clan elites had a whole new respect for Chi Menghan.

They all had extremely high opinions of themselves, and even Galaxy Network prodigies such as Yi Yuanrong weren’t worthy of their notice. However, Chi Menghan’s strength caused them to admit that they were inferior. Thus, their attitudes immediately changed.
-They had become even more eager.
Who didn’t want to marry such an exquisite prodigy?
Everyone continued onwards, walking along the coastline.
Not long after, they saw another four Yin Souls, similarly guarding a Blood-Patterned Dao
Stone.
However, though there were many more Yin souls, their abilities had decreased to the level of the Core Formation Tier. Everyone was unafraid, and charged forwards to fight, easily
destroying the Yin souls.
However, there was only one Blood-Patterned Dao Stone, so what could they do?
Everyone decided to hand it over to Chi Menghan first. When there were enough of them, they would discuss how to divide them among themselves.
Someone immediately pointed out that Ling Han should also hand over his Blood-Patterned
Dao Stone.
Ling Han naturally refused. Chi Menghan actually spoke up for him, saying that Ling Han had obtained it with his own abilities, so it naturally belonged to him alone. This silenced
everyone.
They continued to advance, and it wasn’t long before they discovered the third Blood-
Patterned Dao Stone.
This time, there were still only three Yin souls guarding the Dao Stone. However, after Ling Han glanced at them, he resolutely gave up the idea of going up to fight.
Because these three were all Spiritual Transformation Tier elites.
“Brother Ling, how about we team up?” Chi Menghan suggested.
Ling Han knew that she wanted to join forces with him to unleash the Heavenly Brilliance

Technique. At that time, the two of them had joined forces and indeed killed a Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin soul, which also allowed the strength of their souls to finally break through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier.

However, the soul state was different from the physical state. In the soul state, the strength of the soul was the only factor, but in the physical state, there were all kinds of reservations. It would be corroded by the Yin Qi, causing great effects or even great damage.
Thus, Ling Han was extremely confident that he could defeat a Yin soul at the True Self Tier,
but against a Spirit Transformation Tier?
Hehe, forget it.
Ling Han was confident, and dared to take risks, but the gap between them was obviously too
wide.

“Don’t worry. I have a rare treasure, which can block even Sect Master-level attacks,” Chi Menghan said confidently. “If it weren’t for the fact that I can’t unleash the might of the Heavenly Brilliance Technique by myself, I wouldn’t need to join forces with you.” “All right, then let’s give it a try.” Ling Han nodded. This Imperial Daughter probably wouldn’t seek her own death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4076: White Mountain
paragraphs: Chapter 4076: White Mountain
Ling Han and Chi Menghan walked out together.
Seeing the two of them walk side by side, everyone’s expressions did not look too good. They felt as if they were being cuckolded.
Chi Menghan drew out a mirror, which hovered above her head. Instantly, streaks of precious light shone down, encircling both herself and Ling Han.
“Quickly!” she said. “This treasured mirror has only been charged with energy three times. Once the energy is exhausted, I won’t be able to activate it with my current cultivation level.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. This was the only logical explanation. If a Core Formation Tier cultivator could control a Sect Master-level treasure, that would be far too abnormal.
He extended his divine sense and intertwined it with Chi Menghan’s.
Instantly, the two of them felt an indescribably wonderful feeling, as if they were part of each other.

Realization dawned on Ling Han. No wonder Chi Menghan was said to be looking for a husband. As it turned out, when they used the Heavenly Brilliance Technique in their physical state, it was actually like this!

Chi Menghan’s pretty face was also flushed red, and her beautiful body trembled slightly. In fact, even her skin was covered with an enchanting blush. Unfortunately, no one could see it. That precious light concealed everything.
At this moment, the two of them were slightly intoxicated, and even stopped in their tracks.
However, it was still Ling Han who was more resolute. With a light cough, he interrupted Chi Menghan’s wandering thoughts.
“Attack!”
Ling Han said solemnly, channelling the Heavenly Brilliance Technique.

Though he could already cast this Imperial Technique on his own, he definitely did not want Chi Menghan to find out. Otherwise, who knew what the Donglin Imperial Clan would do? Capture him and imprison him? It was also possible that they would force him to have children forever.
Moreover, if the two of them worked together to cast this technique, its might would definitely be even greater.

Chi Menghan didn’t have the time to be shy, and hurriedly channeled the Heavenly Brilliance Technique as well. Working together with Ling Han, they charged towards the three Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin souls.
Boom!

The three Yin souls also immediately charged over. Their attacks were even faster, and the sharp whistles of the souls reached them at the first instant. However, when they came into contact with the precious light, they all bounced back, unable to cause any effect.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan teamed up, unleashing the Heavenly Brilliance Technique together. In fact, it was even entwined with the Destructive Energy, which was a deadly weapon against Yin souls.

As expected, the moment Destructive Energy appeared, those Yin souls all felt an instinctive fear. However, they had too much of an advantage in cultivation level, after all. They overcame this kind of fear, and faced Ling Han and Chi Menghan head-on.

The two sides fought fiercely. In terms of true strength, even if Ling Han and Chi Menghan teamed up, they would still be outmatched. However, in terms of defense, they had the boost of a Sect Master-level treasure, while in terms of attack, they had the Imperial Technique, Destruction Energy, and so on. This made the three Yin souls feel very helpless.
They couldn’t attack, and they could only defend. Faced with the Destructive Energy, they were completely unable to oppose it.
Every time they were hit, their bodies would shrink a little, and when they had shrunk to a certain extent, their power would drop drastically.
After more than an hour of grinding, Ling Han and Chi Menghan finally disposed of all three Yin souls.

“Yi, why isn’t there any reward from the heaven and earth?” Ling Han found this strange. Killing Yin souls in the Living Realm couldn’t increase the strength of the soul, but the heaven and earth would reward one with the purest energy to temper the body, which also had endless benefits.
Chi Menghan also nodded, a puzzled expression on her face.
“Could it be that this place doesn’t belong to the Living Realm, nor does it belong to the Netherworld?” she said.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “I’ll leave this dilemma to the Saints.”
Chi Menghan removed the treasure mirror and returned to the crowd with Ling Han. Meanwhile, the newly obtained Blood Patterned Dao Stone was naturally shared equally between the two of them.
The group set out, and encountered a great many Yin souls. They were all guarding a Blood Patterned Dao Stone.
After a few times, everyone decided to go their separate ways.

Because there were obviously a great many Blood-Patterned Dao Stones in this place, and a great many of them were guarded by Cauldron Forging Origin Tier and Core Formation Tier Yin souls. Thus, this would have to depend on luck. Whoever encountered such Yin souls would be able to easily obtain the Blood-Patterned Dao Stones.
Previously, a large part of the reason why they had gathered together was because of Chi Menghan. However, how could their pursuit of a beautiful woman surpass their thirst for
strength?
Moreover, only when he became stronger would he be qualified to pursue an Imperial
Daughter.
All of a sudden, only Ling Han, Chi Menghan, and that young man from the Chi Clan remained
in the group.
“Hello, my name is Chi Dao,” the man said with a smile, introducing himself.
“Your name… is really unique,” Ling Han said.
“Because I stayed in my mother’s womb for a whole three years,” Chi Dao said. “So, that irresponsible father of mine gave me this name.”
Ling Han was surprised. Forget about ordinary people, but for cultivators like them, the longer their pregnancy period, the more nutrients the infant would be able to absorb. This
was true congenital energy!
This guy had been in the womb for three years, so his natural talent and aptitude was
definitely strong.
“I have a very high opinion of you. If Meng Han decides to marry you, I will definitely speak
up for you, and convince the clan,” Chi Dao continued.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
“Chi! Dao!” Chi Menghan spat out word by word, her killing intent blazing.
“I can’t say any more.” Chi Dao raised his hands, and winked at Ling Han.
Ling Han was extremely speechless. Previously, when he had seen that this guy was taciturn,
he had thought that he was a serious person. He had not thought that he was actually a secretly the opposite.
The three of them advanced, and after walking for a while, a stretch of white vaguely
appeared ahead of them.
Yi?

They were all very curious. This place was practically ruled by blood. The blood-coloured ground, the blood-coloured sky, the blood-coloured sea, the blood-coloured fog, but all of a sudden, a smear of white appeared. This was naturally inconceivable.
However, the fog was too heavy, and they could only vaguely see a sliver of white. As for what exactly it was, they were completely unclear.
“Let’s go.”
They quickened their pace, and after walking for a while, they could see that the white should
be a small hill.
What mountain was this? It was actually white?
The three of them exchanged looks. This place was too strange, and it would not be strange no
matter what appeared.
“Be careful.”
They all said this to each other, then quickly walked forwards.
It wasn’t long before the white hill revealed its true appearance.
“What!”
The three of them all exclaimed in shock, because this small mountain was actually built from
multiple skulls.

Not only were there humans, but there were also tigers, goats, and wolves. Basically, as long as they were a race that existed in the galaxy, their skulls would be left here. No wonder there were so many of them that they could build a mountain.
“How terrifying. Even from so far away, I can still sense a terrifying pressure,” Chi Dao said.

Ling Han nodded in understanding. He wouldn’t submit to pressure, but this didn’t mean that he could ignore pressure. After reaching a certain level, he would also be crushed by pressure. And now, he felt that if he took another hundred steps, he would be crushed by the terrifying
pressure.
“These people… just how powerful were they when they were alive?” Chi Menghan
murmured.
They had already been dead for who knew how many years, and still had such a terrifying
pressure. When they were alive, they must have been top tier elites.
Venerate Tier, or even Saint Tier?

up for you, and convince the clan,” Chi Dao continued.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
“Chi!
Dao!” Chi Menghan spat out word by word, her killing intent blazing.
“I can’t say any more.” Chi Dao raised his hands, and winked at Ling Han.
Ling Han was extremely speechless.
Previously, when he had seen that this guy was taciturn,
he had thought that he was a serious person.
He had not thought that he was actually a secretly the opposite.
The three of them advanced, and after walking for a while, a stretch of white vaguely
appeared ahead of them.
Yi?
They were all very curious.
This place was practically ruled by blood.
The blood-coloured ground, the blood-coloured sky, the blood-coloured sea, the blood-coloured fog, but all of a sudden, a smear of white appeared.
This was naturally inconceivable.
However, the fog was too heavy, and they could only vaguely see a sliver of white.
As for what exactly it was, they were completely unclear.
“Let’s go.”
They quickened their pace, and after walking for a while, they could see that the white should
be a small hill.
What mountain was this?
It was actually white?
The three of them exchanged looks.
This place was too strange, and it would not be strange no
matter what appeared.
“Be careful.”
They all said this to each other, then quickly walked forwards.
It wasn’t long before the white hill revealed its true appearance.
“What!”
The three of them all exclaimed in shock, because this small mountain was actually built from
multiple skulls.
Not only were there humans, but there were also tigers, goats, and wolves.
Basically, as long as they were a race that existed in the galaxy, their skulls would be left here.
No wonder there were so many of them that they could build a mountain.
“How terrifying.
Even from so far away, I can still sense a terrifying pressure,” Chi Dao said.
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
He wouldn’t submit to pressure, but this didn’t mean that he could ignore pressure.
After reaching a certain level, he would also be crushed by pressure.
And now, he felt that if he took another hundred steps, he would be crushed by the terrifying
pressure.
“These people… just how powerful were they when they were alive?” Chi Menghan
murmured.
They had already been dead for who knew how many years, and still had such a terrifying
pressure.
When they were alive, they must have been top tier elites.
Venerate Tier, or even Saint Tier?

chapters.title: Chapter 4077: Corrosive Sea
paragraphs: Chapter 4077: Corrosive Sea
Ling Han gritted his teeth. This couldn’t be another Black Heaven Temple, right?
He had a very deep impression of that hell for Saints, and also very much did not want to remember it.

“Which Great Emperor did this place belong to?” Chi Dao murmured. “Those who can become Emperors have all obtained the approval of the Dao of Heaven and Earth. Though the Imperial Might cannot be violated, I have never heard of an Ancestral King that has a fondness for bloodshed.”

To be able to obtain the Dao of Heaven and Earth, that did not only require a great talent and strategy, but also an open-minded person. He was definitely not the type to seek revenge for the smallest grievance.
Then, what had caused a Great Emperor to go on a killing spree, killing so many people that they had piled up into a mountain?
Was there any such record in history?
Ling Han activated his eye technique, penetrating through the blood mist and seeing even more details.
“These skulls have existed for hundreds of millions of years,” he said.
Several hundred million years!

Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “There will always be lapses in history from time to time. To say nothing of a few hundred million years, even events tens of millions of years ago might not be known to anyone.”
The three of them circled around the pile of bones a few times, continuously searching for clues, but found nothing.
“Let’s go and take a look elsewhere.”
They roamed around, mainly to find Blood-Patterned Dao Stones, and they did indeed find a few.
This area may be very large, but when they had reached a certain depth, the fog turned into a hard wall, stopping them from continuing forwards.
With their strength, there was no way for them to break through at all. They could only retreat.
Right now, the only area that they could explore was the sea.
The three of them arrived at the edge of the sea. Although Chi Dao was born slowly and unhurriedly, they were now anxious and ready to cross the sea.
“Don’t be rash,” Ling Han stopped him.
He channeled his mystical power, which transformed into a giant hand that grabbed out at the
sea.
A terrifying scene appeared. When this giant hand of mystical power reached into the sea, it was immediately corroded. In fact, it was still rapidly spreading towards Ling Han’s main body.
Ling Han hurriedly severed the mystical power. However, the corrosive power didn’t stop, and it continued to chase after him.
Yi?
Ling Han hurriedly retreated, but the corrosive power was still pursuing him. It was as if an invisible willpower was controlling it.
“Menghan, hurry up and help!” Chi Dao called out. Speaking of which, it was also because of him that Ling Han had moved to test the waters.
Chi Menghan nodded, and was just about to make a move, when Ling Han stopped her.

“Don’t make a move. This corrosive power should be the power of Regulations, and is not something that we can contend against now!” Ling Han said. He was a person who distinguished clearly between goodwill and animosity, so how could he possibly trick those who were friendly to him?
“Then what are you going to do?” Chi Menghan’s slender brows wrinkled into a frown.
“I have a way,” Ling Han said. Then, he broke into a run and fled.
Er, is this your solution?
Chi Menghan and Chi Dao exchanged looks, both feeling slightly speechless.
Ling Han continued to run, and the corrosive power continued to pursue him. It was as if it wouldn’t give up until it killed him.

The blood mist here was too thick, and Ling Han had not run too far, when he had already left Chi Menghan and Chi Dao behind. With a thought, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower immediately flew out of his mind, greeting the corrosive power.

Ling Han couldn’t withstand this kind of corrosive power. This involved Regulations. However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was forged from Origin Gold, a weapon to be used by a Great Emperor, so what need was there to be afraid of Regulations?
The corrosive power assailed, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower vibrated lightly. Lightning filled the air, and the power of Primal Chaos surged.
Origin Gold, a top grade material that would last for eternity.
The corrosive power was instantly blocked. Then, it was slowly destroyed by the power of lightning and Primal Chaos. Finally, it completely disintegrated.

Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. He had only touched a sliver of it, and the corrosive power was already so terrifying. Then what if he had to cross the sea with his own physical body? He would probably immediately be corroded to the point that not even scraps would be left,
right?𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
He turned around, only to see Chi Menghan and Chi Dao, who were both still waiting for him at the original location.

“Haha, it’s great that you’re fine.” Chi Dao laughed loudly, and patted Ling Han’s shoulder. Then, he turned to Chi Menghan and said, “This guy not only has freakish abilities, but also great luck. I suggest that you marry him.”

Chi Menghan rolled her eyes at him. This clan brother of hers was really too unreliable. “This is just touching a little bit of seawater, and the corrosive power is already so terrifying. Then, if we enter into the sea, what kind of damage would we suffer?” Chi Dao coughed, and forcefully changed the topic.
“I tried it just now. I threw a rock out, but it was directly corroded fully before it even touched the sea,” he added.
In other words, even if he didn’t go into the sea, crossing the sea directly was an extravagant
hope.
“Looks like we can only wait for those higher ups to come out of the Blood Palace.”
In less than two days, the people that had previously dispersed gradually returned, and the other youngsters that had fainted in the Blood Palace also woke up one after another, joining
their ranks.
However, it was a shame that there weren’t any Blood-Patterned Dao Stones now.
“Peasant, do you dare spar with me?” Liu Yiming naturally returned as well. He provoked
Ling Han again.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Sure. However, you’ll have to fulfill the bet that you owe me
first.”
These words caused Liu Yiming’s face to flush red, and he was rendered speechless.

“Hehe, a mere lowly commoner dares to be rude to the Imperial Clan. Where did you get such courage from?” Another member of the Liu Clan stepped out. His name was Liu Kaiji. Ling Han raised a brow, and said, “Don’t keep calling me lowly commoner. You people are merely relying on the lingering prestige of your ancestors. You’re not all that noble.” Liu Kaiji humphed, and said balefully, “Just for these words, you deserve to die ten thousand
times over!”
Chi Menghan wanted to mediate again, but the three clansmen of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan stopped her simultaneously.
Liu Kaiji glanced over, and revealed a sliver of a cold smile. Then, he waved his palm in a palm strike towards Ling Han.
He was also at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, but his raw power was as high as 28 Heavens, not inferior to the Buddha Son, Shi Yongming, at all.
This caused Shi Yongming to frown slightly. That was because Liu Kaiji was not the Imperial

Son of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan, but in terms of raw power, he was actually not inferior to him. Then, if the real Imperial Son appeared, would he be a match for him? He had great ambitions, and wanted to break through to the Imperial Path, but if he could not even be invincible among his peers, how could he possibly become a Great Emperor? There had never been such a weak Great Emperor in history.
Since Ling Han wasn’t afraid of Shi Yongming, he naturally wouldn’t be afraid of Liu Kaiji
either. He immediately charged forwards.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them began a fierce battle. Though Ling Han’s power and battle prowess were much weaker, he still had many trump cards. The murderous aura assault, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, Starlight Screen, when these techniques were used, though Liu Kaiji had the advantage, he was completely unable to turn it into a victory.
In fact, with Ling Han’s endless mystical power as support, as long as the battle lasted long
enough, he could even turn the situation around and obtain victory.
Thus, Liu Kaiji had no choice but to stop and retreat after battling for half a day.
If they continued fighting, it would be his turn to be on the back foot.
Liu Kaiji’s expression was very ugly. An Imperial Clan prodigy was actually still unable to win
when his cultivation level was superior?
How humiliating!

chapters.title: Chapter 4078: Hide and Seek
paragraphs: Chapter 4078: Hide and Seek
In truth, Ling Han was also extremely displeased.

First, it was Shi Yongming, followed by Liu Yiming and Liu Kaiji. All of them relied on their high cultivation level and battle prowess to attack whenever they wanted. Did they really think that he was made of clay and had no temper?
Towards this kind of provocation, Ling Han’s response was to slap him across the face, beating him until he submitted.
But now, though these three people could do nothing against him, which was extremely embarrassing to them, Ling Han was still unable to personally beat them up, and was extremely displeased.
Fine, while those Saints and Venerate Tier elites were still comprehending, he would refine the Soul Nurturing Stone, and break through to the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.

If he advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, according to his experience, his original power would definitely be able to reach 25 Heavens. Then, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core would pull down the battle prowess of Shi Yongming, Liu Yiming, and so on by three Heavens. The two sides would be equal in terms of original power.
With equal power, who could be a match for him?
Ling Han found an excuse to excuse himself from Chi Menghan and Chi Dao. He then left quietly by himself, keeping his distance from the others.
However, there were no hidden places here, but there was fog everywhere, blocking divine sense. It would be extremely difficult for others to find him.
Fine, he would cultivate in seclusion here.
Ling Han took out the Soul Nurturing Stone, and began to refine it.
He held the Soul Nurturing Stone in both hands and channeled the Nine Suns Divine Scroll, extracting its essence for his own use.
An indescribable power surged into his body, yet he couldn’t feel the impact of the power. This was extremely strange.
Was this Regulations?

Ling Han thought. The Core Formation Tier had actually already come into contact with Regulations, but the cultivators were in a hazy state. They had clearly come into contact with it, yet were completely unable to understand it.
Just like how everyone knew that eating meat was nutritious, but why was it nutritious? There were a great many people that did not understand the logic behind this.
Who cares? I’ll just raise my cultivation level first. When I reach the True Self Tier, I’ll naturally be able to understand.
With the nourishment of the Soul Nurturing Stone, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core’s growth rate immediately sped up.

Ling Han was already nearing the end of the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier in the first place, and with the help of the Soul Nurturing Stone, he quickly took this step, cultivating the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier to the Consummate level.
At this moment, he needed to take that most crucial step and break through to the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han placed the Soul Nurturing Stone down first. He wouldn’t be able to use this thing in his break through into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
He sat in a cross-legged position, like a boulder. He was in no rush to break through. Instead, he first reflected on himself, to see if he had cultivated his present cultivation level to perfection.
Fixing it now would be a hundred times easier than coming back later. In fact, there were some shortcomings that could not be compensated, or would need the Saintly medicine to be able to mend.
Time passed very quickly. In the blink of an eye, four days had passed.
Ling Han suddenly shuddered, and sense of danger rose up in his heart.
Strange Shadow Steps!
Realization suddenly dawned on him. Someone was approaching him with the Strange Shadow Steps.
An assassin from the Battle God Palace.

Humph, he had not thought that there would actually be someone from the Battle God Palace here. He should have coincidentally participated in this expedition, and then accidentally discovered that he was here as well.
Previously, Ling Han had been with Chi Menghan and the others, so the assassin didn’t have the chance to attack. However, now that Ling Han was moving alone, the assassin had sneaked over.
Why had he only come after so many days?
Simple. The blood mist here cut off divine sense and vision, so it would naturally take some time to find him.

A smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. ‘Then I’m really sorry. I also know the Strange Shadow Steps. In fact, it’s the complete version. When it suddenly unfolds, who knows who would be given a scare.’
He was really looking forward to it.
He remained calm and collected, not even raising a single finger.

The assassin was approaching, and had already reached Ling Han’s back. Then, he suddenly drew his sword. Weng, the Spirit Tool was activated, and a dazzling light burst forth from the sharp sword, a terrifying aura circulating around it.
This sword could be considered top grade among Three Star Spirit Tools. As an assassin, the requirement for “tools” was naturally high.
However, in the instant that he stabbed out with his sword, he suddenly discovered that Ling
Han had disappeared.
He was gone!
How was this possible?
How could a living person suddenly disappear? Was this a ghost?
“Looking for me?” Just as he was at a loss, a voice rang out from behind him.
Ling Han!
Hiss, it was really haunted here.
It could not be said that his reaction speed was not fast. Immediately, he stabbed his sword behind him, and then his figure rapidly turned around.
Where was he?
He suddenly discovered that it was completely empty ahead of him. There was not even a
single person.
This… A cold chill gripped at his heart. This was far too uncanny! His hair stood on end.

“Still looking for me?” At this moment, Ling Han’s voice was heard from behind him again. The assassin turned around again. Shua, he sent out a palm strike, but his long sword had stabbed out in a completely opposite direction.
But whether it was the palm strike or the sword, they both missed.
He forced himself to calm down. Using the Strange Shadow Steps, he immediately fled into the shadows. After quickly moving a few steps, he stopped.

His mastery of the Strange Shadow Steps had yet to reach the peak stage, so when he was moving, he would cause slight fluctuations in the air. As long as one was careful enough, they would discover it. However, once he stopped moving, there would really be no flaws.
He was waiting. He was waiting for Ling Han to appear first, and then he would seize the opportunity to deliver a fatal blow.

“Hehe, let’s play a game now. It’s called hide-and-seek.” Ling Han’s voice rang out. His figure appeared not too far away, but just as the assassin was about to make a move, Ling Han once again disappeared without a trace.
The assassin instantly broke out in a cold sweat, because this time, he could clearly see that Ling Han’s method of fleeing into the shadows was exactly the same as his. Furthermore, it
was even more covert and untraceable.
Strange Shadow Steps!
But how was this possible? This was a secret of the Battle God Palace that would not be taught
to outsiders, so why would it be used by an outsider? Furthermore, it was a target that the
Battle God Palace was determined to kill?
“I’ve caught you!” Right at this moment, Ling Han’s voice rang out behind him.
The assassin instantly felt his scalp go numb.
He had actually been caught by Ling Han while in the state of Strange Shadow Steps. What
kind of concept was that?
This meant that the other’s grasp of the Strange Shadow Steps was superior to his!
“You, how do you know the Strange Shadow Steps?” As he asked, he stabbed out like
lightning.

“You guess,” Ling Han said with a smile. His figure appeared, and he immediately grabbed onto his opponent’s sword. The Starlight Screen enveloped him, allowing him to catch the Spirit Tool with his bare hands.

In fact, when he tempered his physique to a slightly stronger level, even if he didn’t channel the Starlight Screen, he would still be able to take on a Spirit Tool of the same level head-on. The assassin’s eyes were about to pop out of his head. ‘F*cking caught a Spirit Tool with his bare hands? Are you a Body Arts cultivator? But there’s clearly no such data in the
information.’
This was too much of a failure. How had the intel been gathered?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Are you the only one this time, or is there someone else travelling
with you?”
“Humph, you want me to reveal the secret of the Battle God Palace? Impossible!” the assassin said resolutely.
Ling Han laughed, and said, “Actually, we’re on the same side.” As he said this, he released
his grip, then continued, “You see, if that wasn’t the case, why would I know the Strange
Shadow Steps?”
Yi, that made sense.
The assassin was slightly dazed.

Instead, he first reflected on himself, to see if he had cultivated his present cultivation level to perfection.
Fixing it now would be a hundred times easier than coming back later.
In fact, there were some shortcomings that could not be compensated, or would need the Saintly medicine to be able to mend.
Time passed very quickly.
In the blink of an eye, four days had passed.
Ling Han suddenly shuddered, and sense of danger rose up in his heart.
Strange Shadow Steps!
Realization suddenly dawned on him.
Someone was approaching him with the Strange Shadow Steps.
An assassin from the Battle God Palace.
Humph, he had not thought that there would actually be someone from the Battle God Palace here.
He should have coincidentally participated in this expedition, and then accidentally discovered that he was here as well.
Previously, Ling Han had been with Chi Menghan and the others, so the assassin didn’t have the chance to attack.
However, now that Ling Han was moving alone, the assassin had sneaked over.
Why had he only come after so many days?
Simple.
The blood mist here cut off divine sense and vision, so it would naturally take some time to find him.
A smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. ‘Then I’m really sorry.
I also know the Strange Shadow Steps.
In fact, it’s the complete version.
When it suddenly unfolds, who knows who would be given a scare.’
He was really looking forward to it.
He remained calm and collected, not even raising a single finger.
The assassin was approaching, and had already reached Ling Han’s back.
Then, he suddenly drew his sword.
Weng, the Spirit Tool was activated, and a dazzling light burst forth from the sharp sword, a terrifying aura circulating around it.
This sword could be considered top grade among Three Star Spirit Tools.
As an assassin, the requirement for “tools” was naturally high.
However, in the instant that he stabbed out with his sword, he suddenly discovered that Ling
Han had disappeared.
He was gone!
How was this possible?
How could a living person suddenly disappear?
Was this a ghost?
“Looking for me?” Just as he was at a loss, a voice rang out from behind him.
Ling Han!
Hiss, it was really haunted here.
It could not be said that his reaction speed was not fast.
Immediately, he stabbed his sword behind him, and then his figure rapidly turned around.
Where was he?
He suddenly discovered that it was completely empty ahead of him.
There was not even a
single person.
This…
A cold chill gripped at his heart.
This was far too uncanny!
His hair stood on end.
“Still looking for me?” At this moment, Ling Han’s voice was heard from behind him again.
The assassin turned around again.
Shua, he sent out a palm strike, but his long sword had stabbed out in a completely opposite direction.
But whether it was the palm strike or the sword, they both missed.
He forced himself to calm down.
Using the Strange Shadow Steps, he immediately fled into the shadows.
After quickly moving a few steps, he stopped.
His mastery of the Strange Shadow Steps had yet to reach the peak stage, so when he was moving, he would cause slight fluctuations in the air.
As long as one was careful enough, they would discover it.
However, once he stopped moving, there would really be no flaws.
He was waiting.
He was waiting for Ling Han to appear first, and then he would seize the opportunity to deliver a fatal blow.
“Hehe, let’s play a game now.
It’s called hide-and-seek.” Ling Han’s voice rang out.
His figure appeared not too far away, but just as the assassin was about to make a move, Ling Han once again disappeared without a trace.
The assassin instantly broke out in a cold sweat, because this time, he could clearly see that Ling Han’s method of fleeing into the shadows was exactly the same as his.
Furthermore, it
was even more covert and untraceable.
Strange Shadow Steps!
But how was this possible?
This was a secret of the Battle God Palace that would not be taught
to outsiders, so why would it be used by an outsider?
Furthermore, it was a target that the
Battle God Palace was determined to kill?
“I’ve caught you!” Right at this moment, Ling Han’s voice rang out behind him.
The assassin instantly felt his scalp go numb.
He had actually been caught by Ling Han while in the state of Strange Shadow Steps.
What
kind of concept was that?
This meant that the other’s grasp of the Strange Shadow Steps was superior to his!
“You, how do you know the Strange Shadow Steps?” As he asked, he stabbed out like
lightning.
“You guess,” Ling Han said with a smile.
His figure appeared, and he immediately grabbed onto his opponent’s sword.
The Starlight Screen enveloped him, allowing him to catch the Spirit Tool with his bare hands.
In fact, when he tempered his physique to a slightly stronger level, even if he didn’t channel the Starlight Screen, he would still be able to take on a Spirit Tool of the same level head-on.
The assassin’s eyes were about to pop out of his head. ‘F*cking caught a Spirit Tool with his bare hands?
Are you a Body Arts cultivator?
But there’s clearly no such data in the
information.’
This was too much of a failure.
How had the intel been gathered?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Are you the only one this time, or is there someone else travelling
with you?”
“Humph, you want me to reveal the secret of the Battle God Palace?
Impossible!” the assassin said resolutely.
Ling Han laughed, and said, “Actually, we’re on the same side.” As he said this, he released
his grip, then continued, “You see, if that wasn’t the case, why would I know the Strange
Shadow Steps?”
Yi, that made sense.
The assassin was slightly dazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4079: Counterattack
paragraphs: Chapter 4079: Counterattack
No, no!
The assassin hurriedly shook his head. He had almost been tricked by Ling Han. This guy was on the must-kill list of the Battle God Palace, so how could he possibly be one of their own?
“Don’t even think of lying to me!” he shouted loudly.

Ling Han sighed. Previously, when he had been speaking, he had even used his powerful spiritual power to influence the other. He had almost succeeded. However, it was a pity that there was not much of a gap in their cultivation levels, after all. It was too difficult to use this kind of method to control the other’s mind.
‘Fine then, I’ll use force to extort a confession.’
Ling Han cracked a smile, “If you don’t confess honestly, you will suffer greatly.”
“Haha, among the disciples of the Battle God Palace, which one of them would be afraid of torture?” The assassin laughed loudly, appearing to be completely unafraid.
“Indeed.” Ling Han nodded, “Because it involves crucial information, it has been sealed by divine sense. If it is forcefully extracted, it would shatter the mind.”
“It’s good that you know.” The assassin humphed.
Ling Han asked, “Do you want to know a secret?”
The assassin ignored him.
“Aren’t you curious about how I learned the Strange Shadow Steps?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

The assassin’s eyelids involuntarily twitched. This was indeed something that he was extremely curious about. If that had not been the case, perhaps he would have been able to successfully assassinate Ling Han instead of being dragged out of the shadows by Ling Han. “Tell me how many more people have entered this place this time, and I’ll exchange this secret with you. How about it?” Ling Han suggested.

“Haha, how could I be the type to betray my companions!” The assassin resolutely refused. He naturally refused, because even if his curiosity was satisfied, he would still fall into Ling Han’s hands, and would not be able to escape.
This deal was really not worth it.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “That is not up to you to decide!”
Weng! The murderous aura activated.
However, Ling Han controlled his power very well. Otherwise, with such an impact, this assassin’s mind would be directly shattered.
“Ah!” The assassin immediately grabbed his head and screamed. How awesome was Ling Han’s divine sense now? He couldn’t resist at all, and could only passively endure it.
It was only an instant, and his whole body was covered in cold sweat, as if he was a drowned rat.
Meanwhile, Ling Han sat at the sidelines. He wasn’t in a hurry, and he was waiting very leisurely.
It was only a few minutes, and the assassin couldn’t bear it anymore. He moaned, and said, “I’ll talk, I’ll talk. Whatever you want to know, I’ll tell you!”
Ling Han withdrew the barrage of murderous aura, then said, “Aside from you, are there any other assassins from the Battle God Palace here?”
“Yes!” the assassin gasped. Sweat rolled down his forehead, and he still hadn’t recovered. “How many are there? What cultivation level are they at?” Ling Han asked again.
“There are four in total. One is a Foundation Building Tier cultivator, two are Core Formation Tier cultivators, and one is a True Self Tier cultivator,” the assassin said.
Ling Han shuddered. There were actually True Self Tier assassins?

If this was outside, he would naturally be unafraid. If he used Earth Qi, he might even be able to kill an assassin of True Self Tier, but it was different here. The ley lines were suppressed, and he couldn’t use them.
“Could it be that I have to use the Heavenly Dao Flames?” Ling Han frowned. By now, there were not many times left for him to use it. Using it on a True Self Tier would be too much of a waste.
Moreover, wasn’t this place only open to those at the Core Formation Tier?

That’s right. The others were all very self-aware, because the Saint had spoken, but these people from the Battle God Palace were shameless, and that was why an assassin from the True Self Tier had snuck in.

Of course, firstly, they had no backing, and secondly, the members of the Battle God Palace were like rats that traversed the streets in the first place. Who would dare to appear in such a grand manner?
“What else do you want to know?” the assassin asked.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Aside from the location of the Battle God Palace, I don’t need to know anything else. Unfortunately, you can’t tell me where the Battle God Palace is.” With a thought, pa, the assassin’s mind was instantly shattered, and he was completely dead. Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be reserved toward those who wanted to kill him. He casually stowed the corpse away before continuing his comprehension.
Nothing was more important than one’s own strength.

However, there were still assassins from the Battle God Palace here. That Foundation Building Tier cultivator obviously couldn’t assassinate him. However, there were still two Core Formation Tier cultivators, so they would definitely be eager to give it a try. As for True Self Tier assassin… it was a little troublesome.
Another day passed, and Ling Han was still stabilizing his cultivation level. However, he suddenly sensed killing intent again.
‘Here it comes.’
This one wasn’t strong, and was merely a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Ling Han remained calm and composed, allowing the other party to approach.
Yi?
A hint of surprise appeared on Ling Han’s face. With his eye technique, he could see clearly that he had seen that person before.
One of the seeds.

Previously, when he had entered into the Blood Tower to receive the inheritance, he had been provoked by a few seeds when he came out, and he had even killed one of them. The person who had come now was a seed from that era.
Enemies were really bound to meet on a narrow road.
After a while, the other party was already close.
Shua, that person brandished his butcher’s knife. A cold light streaked past, slicing towards Ling Han, wanting to forcibly sever him into two.
Ling Han smiled, activated the Strange Shadow Steps, and took a step forward. Not only did
he dodge this saber strike, but he also fled into the darkness and directly disappeared.
That seed was instantly stupefied.
What was going on?
“I’ve seen that expression you have once the day before yesterday,” Ling Han said from
behind him.
Shua, that seed was very strong, and he immediately slashed his saber behind him.
Unfortunately, he had only missed like that person last time.
However, seeds were seeds, after all, so how could ordinary assassins compare?
He immediately used the Nine Styles of the God of War. Boom, battle prowess surged, and𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
blasted towards Ling Han.
This was a Saint Technique, which was extraordinarily powerful.
Unfortunately, merely in terms of Imperial Techniques, Ling Han had mastered more than
one, so how could he be able to show off his celestial technique in front of him?
The God Slaying Technique.
Ling Han raised both hands, and also greeted the incoming attack with a fierce strike.
Peng!

Just how powerful was he now? His raw power was as high as 20 Heavens, and with just a single strike, that seed was sent flying. Blood seeped out from all over his body, and at least a few blood vessels had been broken.
“How could you possibly know the Strange Shadow Steps?” That seed exclaimed in shock. This was something that he couldn’t understand no matter what.
“I also know the Nine Styles of the God of War. Do you want to try it?” Ling Han said with a
smile.

That seed was even more stunned. The world only knew the Three Styles of theGod of War, and to be able to say the Nine Styles of the God of War… he must be a higher-up of the Battle God Palace, or a seed that had crawled through the Blood Tower. However, how could a target of assassination be a higher-up or seed of the Battle God Palace?
“Hehe, only a year and a half has passed, and you don’t remember me anymore?” Ling Han patted his shoulder. With a thought, he transformed into Ding Yi’s appearance.
“You, you, you—” That guy was completely stupefied, his eyes wide.
Who would have thought that the target that the Battle God Palace had sworn to kill would actually sneak into the Battle God Palace, and even become a seed!
No wonder Ding Yi had defected. As it turned out, he was Ling Han, so how could he not have
fled?
