chapters.title: Chapter 4080: Late stage of the Core Formation Tier!
paragraphs: Chapter 4080: Late stage of the Core Formation Tier!
Ling Han smiled and said, “After learning the truth, what are you feeling?”
That seed was speechless. At this moment, he was filled with regret and confusion. How could a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator fool the elites of the Battle God Palace?
You are really f****** suited to become an assassin. This ability of disguise is invincible.
“In the past, the few of you were jumping around. Now… I’ll send you on your way,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Spare me!” That guy hurriedly called out, “No matter what, we can still be considered fellow disciples!”
Ling Han faltered for a moment before breaking into laughter. “You’re so shameless. I think you’ve also chosen the wrong profession. You shouldn’t be an assassin, but rather a salesperson.”
Peng! With a single punch, he killed the seed of the Battle God Palace.
He would uproot the entire Battle God Palace, but his present strength was still insufficient, so he could only kill any of their assassins he saw.
After stowing away the corpse, Ling Han continued to comprehend.
Merely half a day later, the last Core Formation Tier assassin also sneaked over. This naturally was delivering himself up to be killed. After Ling Han casually killed him, he began to
comprehend again.
One day, two days, three days… Time flew by, and what surprised Ling Han was the fact that the True Self Tier assassin still hadn’t appeared.
Had he found some great opportunity? Or had he died?
Ling Han didn’t care either. Under his continuous stabilization, the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier had already been perfected by him.
He could break through now.

In the late stage of the Formation Tier, the cultivator would inscribe the patterns of great dao on the Celestial Core, and the more patterns were inscribed, the higher the grade of the Celestial Core would be, and the battle prowess of the cultivator would naturally be stronger. The problem was, the Core Formation Tier was still unable to directly comprehend the Regulations of heaven and earth, so how could they inscribe the patterns of great dao? Simple, high-level energy.

The use of high-level energy belonged to the Regulations of heaven and earth in the first place. However, cultivators below the True Self Tier only knew how to use them, but did not know the profoundness of it. It was just like how it was very simple for an ordinary person to control a firearm, and there was absolutely no need to understand the construction principles of a firearm.

The Primal Chaos Celestial Core was built with the structure of Destructive Energy as its core. Thus, it was very simple to “draw” the first veined pattern. One only had to stimulate the Celestial Core and allow this structure to appear.
However, this process was not something that could be accomplished overnight. After spending a whole three days, on top of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, a complex veined pattern appeared.
The core of Destructive Energy, the structure that was left after being shredded and cocooned, could be said to be the embodiment of the Regulations of heaven and earth.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core shuddered violently, inhaling and exhaling a great volume of mystical power. It was a great improvement from before.
Ling Han broke into a grin. He had already advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so his power naturally soared.
He casually threw a punch, and instantly, a terrifying power surged.
“As expected, 25 Heavens!”

Ling Han laughed loudly. He had just advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. However, his raw power had already surpassed the likes of Yi Yuanrong, the strongest Core Formation Tier in the West Heavenly Realm.
Of course, some Holy Lands’ Dao Child and Holy Daughters had hidden depths. They clearly had superior battle prowess, yet did not even have a Galaxy Network account.

He did not immediately return, but rather continued to draw the patterns of heaven and earth. In theory, there were countless high-level energies, so wouldn’t it be very easy to cultivate the late stage of the Core Formation Tier to the fullest? That was because the size of the Celestial Core was limited, and one was only capable of drawing so many patterns. However, precisely because the Celestial Core was limited in size, the more one had to be careful when drawing the patterns of heaven and earth, and try as much as possible to draw high-level patterns. Otherwise, it would affect the quality of the Celestial Core, which would in turn affect the height that one could reach in future.

Ordinarily, one could only draw nine patterns at most on the Celestial Core so there was the saying of Nine Inscriptions Golden Core in the case of Silver Core and Bronze Core, they were much smaller.

Thus, Silver Core had Six Inscriptions, while Bronze Core had Three Inscriptions. Theoretically speaking, Three Inscriptions Bronze Core could help one break through to the True Self Tier, but those who formed the bronze Celestial Foundation and still managed to advance into the Core Formation Tier were pitifully few in number. Thus, Three Inscriptions Bronze Cores were extremely rare.

Ordinarily, it would be Six Inscriptions Silver Cores, and prodigies would have to have Nine Inscriptions Golden Core, at least, and in the case of Three Colored Crystal Cores and Nine Colored Crystal Cores, they could even reach Twelve or Eighteen Inscriptions!
Ling Han’s Celestial Core was the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, so it naturally far surpassed the Nine Colored Crystal Core. However, he wasn’t sure exactly how many inscriptions he could
reach.
“No matter what, it is better to have nothing than settle for inferiority.”

Ling Han began to choose the second pattern of heaven and earth. That would definitely be the Heavenly Dao Flames. In future, this would be able to evolve into the highest level of Fire Energy, and was completely qualified to occupy a place in the Celestial Core.

However, when he began to draw the veined patterns, he shockingly discovered that though the pattern representing Destructive Energy only occupied a small area, this guy was extremely domineering, snatching away a large blank area nearby, not allowing him to draw patterns at all.
‘F*ck! Are you just preventing another pattern from using the space even when you yourself have no use for it?’
Ling Han tried a few times, but was still unable to do anything.

He understood now, because the current Destructive Energy was still incomplete, and if it was in its complete state, the patterns formed should have occupied such a large area. Going by that calculation, how many Dao Patterns could he draw on his Celestial Core?
If they were all as awesome as Destructive Energy, then there wouldn’t even be nine of them. At most, there would only be seven.
Er, that was fine. In any case, as long as the Dao Patterns were high-level, it was fine. Quantity
was secondary.
Ling Han comforted himself.

He began to extract the Regulations of heaven and earth from the Heavenly Dao Flames. Because he had already experienced it once, this was naturally a walk in the park for him. Furthermore, compared to the Destructive Energy, the Heavenly Dao Flames were much
simpler to extract.
In a mere two days’ time, he had extracted an incredibly complicated pattern, and branded it onto the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
Two Inscriptions.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Could he also extract the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and transform it into a Dao Pattern?

To be honest, mixing the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and the black light of illusion together, though it was very powerful, it was also very wasteful. If it could be dismantled, it could be turned into two Mystical Powers, which would be more nimble to use. However, this was also risky. This was because once he dismantled the two streaks of divine light and was unable to analyze the essence, these two streaks of divine light would “die” and
completely disappear.
Ling Han only hesitated for a moment before immediately deciding to continue!
Only by transforming it into his own understanding would it truly belong to him.

He began to dismantle the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, extracting the essence from the terrifying lightning. Because he had long since refined it, even if the divine lightning was incredibly terrifying, it was very docile, and would not resist in the slightest.
Ling Han was extremely careful, analyzing bit by bit.
Five days later, he was already close to success.
However, Ling Han’s forehead was also covered with sweat. He was extremely focused, and there couldn’t be the slightest mistake. Otherwise, his two Mystical Powers would be ruined.
‘Soon, soon, soon… I’ve succeeded!’
Ling Han revealed a smile. When he completely dismantled the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the divine lightning actually split into two, turning into two incredibly complex
patterns.

One was the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, and the other was the black light of illusion. They were not one and the same in the first place. It was only because the Ten Cauldrons were fused into one that they were forced to fuse together, and now, they were once again separated.

“Spare me!” That guy hurriedly called out, “No matter what, we can still be considered fellow disciples!”
Ling Han faltered for a moment before breaking into laughter.
“You’re so shameless.
I think you’ve also chosen the wrong profession.
You shouldn’t be an assassin, but rather a salesperson.”
Peng!
With a single punch, he killed the seed of the Battle God Palace.
He would uproot the entire Battle God Palace, but his present strength was still insufficient, so he could only kill any of their assassins he saw.
After stowing away the corpse, Ling Han continued to comprehend.
Merely half a day later, the last Core Formation Tier assassin also sneaked over.
This naturally was delivering himself up to be killed.
After Ling Han casually killed him, he began to
comprehend again.
One day, two days, three days…
Time flew by, and what surprised Ling Han was the fact that the True Self Tier assassin still hadn’t appeared.
Had he found some great opportunity?
Or had he died?
Ling Han didn’t care either.
Under his continuous stabilization, the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier had already been perfected by him.
He could break through now.

In the late stage of the Formation Tier, the cultivator would inscribe the patterns of great dao on the Celestial Core, and the more patterns were inscribed, the higher the grade of the Celestial Core would be, and the battle prowess of the cultivator would naturally be stronger.
The problem was, the Core Formation Tier was still unable to directly comprehend the Regulations of heaven and earth, so how could they inscribe the patterns of great dao?
Simple, high-level energy.
The use of high-level energy belonged to the Regulations of heaven and earth in the first place.
However, cultivators below the True Self Tier only knew how to use them, but did not know the profoundness of it.
It was just like how it was very simple for an ordinary person to control a firearm, and there was absolutely no need to understand the construction principles of a firearm.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core was built with the structure of Destructive Energy as its core.
Thus, it was very simple to “draw” the first veined pattern.
One only had to stimulate the Celestial Core and allow this structure to appear.
However, this process was not something that could be accomplished overnight.
After spending a whole three days, on top of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, a complex veined pattern appeared.
The core of Destructive Energy, the structure that was left after being shredded and cocooned, could be said to be the embodiment of the Regulations of heaven and earth.
The Primal Chaos Celestial Core shuddered violently, inhaling and exhaling a great volume of mystical power.
It was a great improvement from before.
Ling Han broke into a grin.
He had already advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so his power naturally soared.
He casually threw a punch, and instantly, a terrifying power surged.
“As expected, 25 Heavens!”
Ling Han laughed loudly.
He had just advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
However, his raw power had already surpassed the likes of Yi Yuanrong, the strongest Core Formation Tier in the West Heavenly Realm.
Of course, some Holy Lands’ Dao Child and Holy Daughters had hidden depths.
They clearly had superior battle prowess, yet did not even have a Galaxy Network account.
He did not immediately return, but rather continued to draw the patterns of heaven and earth.
In theory, there were countless high-level energies, so wouldn’t it be very easy to cultivate the late stage of the Core Formation Tier to the fullest?
That was because the size of the Celestial Core was limited, and one was only capable of drawing so many patterns.

However, precisely because the Celestial Core was limited in size, the more one had to be careful when drawing the patterns of heaven and earth, and try as much as possible to draw high-level patterns.
Otherwise, it would affect the quality of the Celestial Core, which would in turn affect the height that one could reach in future.

Ordinarily, one could only draw nine patterns at most on the Celestial Core so there was the saying of Nine Inscriptions Golden Core in the case of Silver Core and Bronze Core, they were much smaller.
Thus, Silver Core had Six Inscriptions, while Bronze Core had Three Inscriptions.

Theoretically speaking, Three Inscriptions Bronze Core could help one break through to the True Self Tier, but those who formed the bronze Celestial Foundation and still managed to advance into the Core Formation Tier were pitifully few in number.
Thus, Three Inscriptions Bronze Cores were extremely rare.

Ordinarily, it would be Six Inscriptions Silver Cores, and prodigies would have to have Nine Inscriptions Golden Core, at least, and in the case of Three Colored Crystal Cores and Nine Colored Crystal Cores, they could even reach Twelve or Eighteen Inscriptions!
Ling Han’s Celestial Core was the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, so it naturally far surpassed the Nine Colored Crystal Core.
However, he wasn’t sure exactly how many inscriptions he could
reach.
“No matter what, it is better to have nothing than settle for inferiority.”
Ling Han began to choose the second pattern of heaven and earth.
That would definitely be the Heavenly Dao Flames.
In future, this would be able to evolve into the highest level of Fire Energy, and was completely qualified to occupy a place in the Celestial Core.

However, when he began to draw the veined patterns, he shockingly discovered that though the pattern representing Destructive Energy only occupied a small area, this guy was extremely domineering, snatching away a large blank area nearby, not allowing him to draw patterns at all.
‘F*ck!
Are you just preventing another pattern from using the space even when you yourself have no use for it?’
Ling Han tried a few times, but was still unable to do anything.
He understood now, because the current Destructive Energy was still incomplete, and if it was in its complete state, the patterns formed should have occupied such a large area.
Going by that calculation, how many Dao Patterns could he draw on his Celestial Core?
If they were all as awesome as Destructive Energy, then there wouldn’t even be nine of them.
At most, there would only be seven.
Er, that was fine.
In any case, as long as the Dao Patterns were high-level, it was fine.
Quantity
was secondary.
Ling Han comforted himself.
He began to extract the Regulations of heaven and earth from the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Because he had already experienced it once, this was naturally a walk in the park for him.
Furthermore, compared to the Destructive Energy, the Heavenly Dao Flames were much
simpler to extract.
In a mere two days’ time, he had extracted an incredibly complicated pattern, and branded it onto the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
Two Inscriptions.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head.
Could he also extract the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and transform it into a Dao Pattern?
To be honest, mixing the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and the black light of illusion together, though it was very powerful, it was also very wasteful.
If it could be dismantled, it could be turned into two Mystical Powers, which would be more nimble to use.
However, this was also risky.
This was because once he dismantled the two streaks of divine light and was unable to analyze the essence, these two streaks of divine light would “die” and
completely disappear.
Ling Han only hesitated for a moment before immediately deciding to continue!
Only by transforming it into his own understanding would it truly belong to him.
He began to dismantle the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, extracting the essence from the terrifying lightning.
Because he had long since refined it, even if the divine lightning was incredibly terrifying, it was very docile, and would not resist in the slightest.
Ling Han was extremely careful, analyzing bit by bit.
Five days later, he was already close to success.
However, Ling Han’s forehead was also covered with sweat.
He was extremely focused, and there couldn’t be the slightest mistake.
Otherwise, his two Mystical Powers would be ruined.
‘Soon, soon, soon…
I’ve succeeded!’
Ling Han revealed a smile.
When he completely dismantled the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the divine lightning actually split into two, turning into two incredibly complex
patterns.
One was the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, and the other was the black light of illusion.
They were not one and the same in the first place.
It was only because the Ten Cauldrons were fused into one that they were forced to fuse together, and now, they were once again separated.

chapters.title: Chapter 4081: Get out here and accept your death
paragraphs: Chapter 4081: Get out here and accept your death

What followed was much simpler. Ling Han branded the two patterns on the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. Now, the two Mystical Powers had completely become his celestial techniques. He made a comparison. It was still Destructive Energy that was the most awesome, occupying the largest territory. Then, it was Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and Heavenly Dao Flames. However, the design for the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning covered the territory it occupied fully, while Heavenly Dao Flames was the same as Destructive Energy. Its design wasn’t big, but it occupied a large area.
Obviously, this was territory it was keeping in reserve.

Whether it was Destructive Energy or Heavenly Dao Flames, they were both incomplete, far from reaching the height that they should have. Thus, they occupied a large area, but their designs were extremely small.
It was the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning that was more realistic. It occupied as much space as it could.
In other words, it didn’t have any more room for further advancement.
However, the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was already unbelievably strong in the first place, and could increase Ling Han’s battle prowess by five Heavens.

The black light of illusion was also very realistic, occupying the same space as itself, but among the four patterns, it occupied the smallest space. In other words, its potential was the smallest, and there was already no room for improvement.
Even so, Ling Han did some calculations. Even if they were all this size, his Celestial Core could only be inscribed with 12 patterns.
From this, it could be seen that the black light of illusion was also very, very awesome. It just couldn’t compare to the other three.
Ling Han stood up, raised his hand, and zi, a bolt of lightning struck out, surging with the shards of terrifying seals.
Primal Chaos Divine Lightning!

After launching an attack, Ling Han once again raised his hand. Primal Chaos Divine Lightning struck continuously, and accompanying it was the corresponding pattern on the Primal Chaos Celestial Core dimming.
After striking twelve times of divine lightning in one go, the pattern completely dimmed, and Ling Han was no longer able to strike Primal Chaos Divine Lightning for the thirteenth time.
A smile appeared on his face. Now, the number of times he could use the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was greatly increased, which naturally increased his explosive power by a whole lot as well.
“I can now be considered a Four Inscriptions. Based on the remaining space of the Celestial Core, I have already walked halfway out of the late stage of Core Formation Tier.”
“With the support of the Celestial Core, my power has reached… between 27 and 28 Heavens.” “All right!”

Ling Han’s eyes lit up. At this moment, he would be able to sweep aside the likes of Shi Yongming. Even if he encountered a real Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, he would at least be able to fight them to a tie.
“Now, I want to find the most fundamental, high-level energy. At least, it has to be Heavenly Dao Flames-level.”
“Time to go back!”
Ling Han determined the direction and returned the way he came. Strangely, the True Self Tier assassin still didn’t make a move. Could it be that he had really died here?
This was extremely likely. This place was strange and dangerous, so it wouldn’t be strange if a True Self Tier died here.

A few hours later, Ling Han returned to the coast. He saw that many people had stayed here, trying various methods to cross the sea, but it was all useless. Instead, a few people were killed by the corrosive power.
“Yi, Ling Han, you’re back!” Chi Dao immediately greeted him.

This was a man who liked to hide his emotions. Even though he usually didn’t speak much, that was because he wasn’t familiar with him yet. Once they were familiar with each other, this guy would speak too much.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Brother Chi, I’ll talk to you later.”
He took a slight breath, then shouted loudly, “Shi Yongming, get out here and accept your death!”
After this roar, the whole area was instantly left with dead silence.
What was going on? Someone actually dared to provoke the Buddha Son?
Shi Yongming was resting with his eyes closed, and when he heard this, he couldn’t help but sneer. He stood up, and said calmly, “Ling Han, are you dreaming?”
“Haha, a mere lowly commoner, you can only talk tough.” Liu Yiming sneered.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “The both of you can come at me together. I will fight both of you alone.”
When these words were said, it instantly caused a bout of laughter.

Ling Han was indeed powerful. In the past, he had been the number one elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier, and even the Imperial Son had been defeated by him. However, everyone was in the Core Formation Tier now, so unless you reached the Consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, what right did you have to challenge an Imperial Son?𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
A Buddha Son was an Imperial Son!
“Ling Han, you are too arrogant!”
“You can only act arrogantly in the North Heavenly Realm, because the people there are too weak!”
“Now that you’ve come to our West Heavenly Realm, it’s best to keep a low profile.”
Everyone said one after another, not having the sligthest bit of positive feelings towards Ling
Han.
Prejudice and discrimination due to territory was still quite serious.
Shi Yongming stepped out, and said, “You’ve only mastered an extremely powerful defensive technique. In terms of battle prowess, I can suppress you single-handedly!”
Xiu, Ling Han shot out, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
Shi Yongming greeted that with a palm strike, but just as palm and fist made contact, he was
sent flying.

Thankfully, his raw power was also as high as 28 Heavens. In fact, he was just that bit stronger than Ling Han. However, he was at a disadvantage because he had not used a secret technique, and that was why he was inferior to Ling Han in terms of battle prowess, and was sent flying. With a turn of his body, he had already steadied his footing, and stood in midair.
However, after this attack, a dead silence fell once more.
Who would have thought that the power of Ling Han’s punch would be so domineering?

Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up. She had always had a high opinion of Ling Han. After all, Ling Han was the only cultivator with an eight-star aptitude. As long as his cultivation level could keep up, he would definitely be inconceivably powerful.

“This guy broke through to the late stage of Core Formation Tier,” Chi Dao said. “Hiss, what a monster. Once he advanced into the late stage of Core Formation Tier, his battle prowess can reach such a terrifying extent.”
Shi Yongming’s expression changed drastically. He had just been boasting, saying that he could suppress Ling Han with one hand, but what happened? Ling Han sent him flying with a
single punch.
However, only a dozen over days had passed, so how had Ling Han’s strength increased to
such a terrifying extent?
“Late stage of Core Formation Tier!” He used a Mystical Power from the Buddhist Race, and finally discovered that Ling Han had improved further.
Heavens, he had just newly advanced into the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how
could his battle prowess be as strong as this?
Are you even human? Ling Han smiled faintly, “How does this punch taste like?”
Hearing his mockery, Shi Yongming’s face instantly flushed red and then paled. He flew into a humiliated rage, and roared loudly. A Buddha Halo formed behind his head, instantly
transforming into the Golden Arhat, as he charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was completely unafraid as he faced his opponent head-on.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
After exchanging more than ten blows in a row, Ling Han didn’t back down in the slightest,
nor did he fall into a disadvantage.
This caused Shi Yongming to feel disbelief. Previously, he had exchanged blows with Ling
Han, and knew that though Ling Han was freakish, his raw power was only around 19 or 20
Heavens, but now?
It was more than 27 Heavens, and looked to be close to 28 Heavens. This was practically not inferior to him at all.
He had only advanced one minor level, yet his power could actually increase so drastically?
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Come, have a taste of this punch!”
He threw another punch, but when his fist was thrown, lightning blazed.
Primal Chaos Divine Lightning!
With this strike, peng, Shi Yongming’s whole person was instantly sent flying, completely
unable to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 4082: Complete Battering
paragraphs: Chapter 4082: Complete Battering
Shi Yongming was sent flying. Peng! He landed heavily on the ground.
Hiss, when everyone saw this, they all inhaled sharply.
That was because not only had Shi Yongming been sent flying, there was also a wound on his lower abdomen. It was presently fuming with burnt smoke, and one could vaguely see the flicker of lightning.

It should be known that in the state of Golden Arhat, Shi Yongming’s battle prowess and defense-especially defense-would be greatly improved, but his physical body was actually pierced by a single strike from Ling Han. Just how terrifying was his attack power?
This strike was truly astounding.

Chi Menghan was also astonished. She was an Imperial Daughter, and her battle prowess was even above that of the so-called Buddha Son, Shi Yongming. She was also completely capable of defeating Shi Yongming with a single strike. However, what cultivation level was she at?
Consummate level of Core Formation Tier!
What about Ling Han?
Was this the aptitude of an eight-star genius? How impressive.
And those like Liu Yiming, Liu Kaiji and the two members of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan, all had extremely ugly expressions.
Too strong, how could there be such a freak?
Ling Han’s killing intent was on full display. This Shi Yongming was not just trying to suppress him, but also harboring killing intent towards him.
Then who cares if you are Buddha Son or Imperial Son? Die!
-Even a force like the Battle God Palace was going all out against him, so it was fine even if there was the Buddhist Race added in.

Shi Yongming got to his feet. Blood was flowing from the wound on his lower abdomen, but it was golden in colour. Furthermore, it was still glowing, as if he was a god. He could not believe that he was actually no match for Ling Han.

Previously, he had clearly been able to easily thrash Ling Han. However, the latter had relied on a strange method to weaken his battle prowess by a few Heavens, and also had an awesome defense, so he could only suppress him but could not defeat him.
This change was too fast and too sudden, that he could not believe it.
“How could this be! How could this be!” His hands were tightly clenched into fists, flames practically leaping out of his eyes.

“I’ll send you on your way!” Ling Han charged over, his expression cold and emotionless. “In your dreams!” Shi Yongming gritted his teeth and made up his mind. His forehead suddenly split open, and a majestic light instantly burst forth, making even Ling Han feel slightly apprehensive. He immediately stopped.
“Ah!” Shi Yongming shouted loudly. His right hand stretched into his brow, and actually grabbed out a Demon Subduing Staff.
This Demon Subduing Staff was glowing all over, and there were multiple seals on it. It looked incredibly solemn and austere.
“Yi, why does this Demon Subduing Staff give me an incredibly terrifying pressure?”
“This looks like a True Self Tier… no, a Spiritual Transformation Tier-level precious treasure!”
“I understand now. This isn’t a physical body, but a Spirit Body!”
“How could that be? Without reaching the Spiritual Transformation Tier, how could one possibly form a Spirit Body?
“That must be the power of the Buddhist Race.”
Everyone was engaged in a heated discussion, all of them very excited, because this kind of method was an eye-opener for them.

Even Liu Yiming nodded and said, “The Buddhist Race is most skilled in the aspect of the soul. They were actually able to implant a Spirit Body into the mind of a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier. This technique is truly amazing.”
“Hehe, once the Spirit Body appears, Ling Han definitely won’t be able to endure it.” Liu Kaiji laughed.

“Ling Han!” Shi Yongming shouted loudly, his eyes shooting out golden light, appearing to be extremely furious. That was because he had taken out the Spirit Body in advance, and this originally could only be used by Spiritual Transformation Tier elites. If he took it out now, it would cause massive damage to the Spirit Body.

However, he didn’t want to lose, nor did he want to die. Thus, he had to use his trump card. Once the Spirit Body appeared, what Core Formation Tier wouldn’t be razed to the ground? “You will pay the price for all that you have done!” he forced out through gritted teeth. Who cares about how the Buddhist Race was supposed to avert anger? He was going to commit murder.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he silently unleashed the black light of illusion.

After splitting it up, the Mystical Power was finally able to unleash its true might. Otherwise, the target would be awakened the moment it took effect, completely burying the effectiveness of this Mystical Power.

If Shi Yongming was calm, then he was the Buddhist Race prodigy, so it was still possible for him to defend against Ling Han. However, in this state of losing control of his anger, he was naturally immediately affected, falling into the illusion that he had created.

Everyone was anticipating Shi Yongming’s sudden burst of power. After all, Shi Yongming had even unleashed his Spirit Body, so he was definitely going to start a massacre and completely suppress Ling Han.
However, why was there still no movement?
Multiple gazes focused on Shi Yongming. What was going on with this guy?
Had he had a stroke?
Struck dumb?
Because Ling Han didn’t make a move at all, no one associated Shi Yongming’s dazed state with Ling Han. However, it was also because of this that everyone was at a loss and confused.
This was too strange, wasn’t it?

Ling Han paid no further attention to Shi Yongming. This guy now had a Spirit Body in his hands, and his attack power far surpassed that of the Core Formation Tier. Thus, he just let him stand there and waited for the might of the Spirit Body to disappear.

-Ling Han could see very clearly with his eye technique. After this Demon Subduing Staff was unleashed, its energy was continuously draining away. Thus, as time passed, it would soon become a piece of trash.
“Next, it’s the two of you!” Ling Han set his eyes on Liu Kaiji and Liu Yiming.
Both members of the Liu Clan were both a little apprehensive, because Shi Yongming’s present state was too baffling.

If this had nothing to do with Ling Han, that would be too much of a coincidence, but if it was really Ling Han’s doing, that would be even more terrifying. He did not even need to raise his hand, and one would have already been hit. Then how were they supposed to guard against
him?
“Lowly commoner, you are too arrogant!” Liu Yiming said, putting on a fierce appearance but was actually cowardly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I almost forgot. You still owe me a bet.”
Hearing him mention this again, Liu Yiming’s face instantly flushed red. He glanced at Liu Kaiji, and the latter nodded at him. The two of them immediately joined forces to attack.
Ling Han shook his head. They thought they could resist him just by joining forces?
They were really too naive.
He activated the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, and instantly, the battle prowess of these two
people dropped drastically by three Heavens.
This base power was inferior to Ling Han, so how could it match him?
Ling Han charged out, and as he brandished his fists, Liu Kaiji and Liu Yiming were instantly
beaten into disarray.
The gap in battle prowess was really too wide. They were not on the same level at all, all
right?
No matter what Liu Kaiji and Liu Yiming did, it was completely useless. Very soon, they were suppressed by Ling Han.
“Come, fulfill your bet first, then we’ll settle the other debts!” Ling Han pressed Liu Yiming
and Liu Kaiji onto their knees.
“Why do I have to kneel as well?” Liu Kaiji asked defiantly.
“Er!” Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “It was just a passing thought.
However, since one is already kneeling, the other might as well.”
‘Mighat as well your sister, don’t be so casual!’
Liu Kaiji was both furious and embarrassed. Kneeling down in public was naturally a complete
loss of face. He had completely lost all his face, so how would he be able to face others in
future?

pressed onto the ground.

sentences.text: Chapter 4082: Complete Battering
Shi Yongming was sent flying.
Peng!
He landed heavily on the ground.
Hiss, when everyone saw this, they all inhaled sharply.
That was because not only had Shi Yongming been sent flying, there was also a wound on his lower abdomen.
It was presently fuming with burnt smoke, and one could vaguely see the flicker of lightning.

It should be known that in the state of Golden Arhat, Shi Yongming’s battle prowess and defense-especially defense-would be greatly improved, but his physical body was actually pierced by a single strike from Ling Han.
Just how terrifying was his attack power?
This strike was truly astounding.
Chi Menghan was also astonished.
She was an Imperial Daughter, and her battle prowess was even above that of the so-called Buddha Son, Shi Yongming.
She was also completely capable of defeating Shi Yongming with a single strike.
However, what cultivation level was she at?
Consummate level of Core Formation Tier!
What about Ling Han?
Was this the aptitude of an eight-star genius?
How impressive.
And those like Liu Yiming, Liu Kaiji and the two members of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan, all had extremely ugly expressions.
Too strong, how could there be such a freak?
Ling Han’s killing intent was on full display.
This Shi Yongming was not just trying to suppress him, but also harboring killing intent towards him.
Then who cares if you are Buddha Son or Imperial Son?
Die!
-Even a force like the Battle God Palace was going all out against him, so it was fine even if there was the Buddhist Race added in.
Shi Yongming got to his feet.
Blood was flowing from the wound on his lower abdomen, but it was golden in colour.
Furthermore, it was still glowing, as if he was a god.
He could not believe that he was actually no match for Ling Han.
Previously, he had clearly been able to easily thrash Ling Han.
However, the latter had relied on a strange method to weaken his battle prowess by a few Heavens, and also had an awesome defense, so he could only suppress him but could not defeat him.
This change was too fast and too sudden, that he could not believe it.
“How could this be!
How could this be!” His hands were tightly clenched into fists, flames practically leaping out of his eyes.
“I’ll send you on your way!” Ling Han charged over, his expression cold and emotionless.
“In your dreams!” Shi Yongming gritted his teeth and made up his mind.
His forehead suddenly split open, and a majestic light instantly burst forth, making even Ling Han feel slightly apprehensive.
He immediately stopped.
“Ah!” Shi Yongming shouted loudly.
His right hand stretched into his brow, and actually grabbed out a Demon Subduing Staff.
This Demon Subduing Staff was glowing all over, and there were multiple seals on it.
It looked incredibly solemn and austere.
“Yi, why does this Demon Subduing Staff give me an incredibly terrifying pressure?”
“This looks like a True Self Tier… no, a Spiritual Transformation Tier-level precious treasure!”
“I understand now.
This isn’t a physical body, but a Spirit Body!”
“How could that be?
Without reaching the Spiritual Transformation Tier, how could one possibly form a Spirit Body?
“That must be the power of the Buddhist Race.”
Everyone was engaged in a heated discussion, all of them very excited, because this kind of method was an eye-opener for them.
Even Liu Yiming nodded and said, “The Buddhist Race is most skilled in the aspect of the soul.
They were actually able to implant a Spirit Body into the mind of a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier.
This technique is truly amazing.”
“Hehe, once the Spirit Body appears, Ling Han definitely won’t be able to endure it.” Liu Kaiji laughed.
“Ling Han!” Shi Yongming shouted loudly, his eyes shooting out golden light, appearing to be extremely furious.
That was because he had taken out the Spirit Body in advance, and this originally could only be used by Spiritual Transformation Tier elites.
If he took it out now, it would cause massive damage to the Spirit Body.
However, he didn’t want to lose, nor did he want to die.
Thus, he had to use his trump card.
Once the Spirit Body appeared, what Core Formation Tier wouldn’t be razed to the ground?
“You will pay the price for all that you have done!” he forced out through gritted teeth.
Who cares about how the Buddhist Race was supposed to avert anger?
He was going to commit murder.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he silently unleashed the black light of illusion.
After splitting it up, the Mystical Power was finally able to unleash its true might.
Otherwise, the target would be awakened the moment it took effect, completely burying the effectiveness of this Mystical Power.
If Shi Yongming was calm, then he was the Buddhist Race prodigy, so it was still possible for him to defend against Ling Han.
However, in this state of losing control of his anger, he was naturally immediately affected, falling into the illusion that he had created.
Everyone was anticipating Shi Yongming’s sudden burst of power.
After all, Shi Yongming had even unleashed his Spirit Body, so he was definitely going to start a massacre and completely suppress Ling Han.
However, why was there still no movement?
Multiple gazes focused on Shi Yongming.
What was going on with this guy?
Had he had a stroke?
Struck dumb?
Because Ling Han didn’t make a move at all, no one associated Shi Yongming’s dazed state with Ling Han.
However, it was also because of this that everyone was at a loss and confused.
This was too strange, wasn’t it?
Ling Han paid no further attention to Shi Yongming.
This guy now had a Spirit Body in his hands, and his attack power far surpassed that of the Core Formation Tier.
Thus, he just let him stand there and waited for the might of the Spirit Body to disappear.
-Ling Han could see very clearly with his eye technique.
After this Demon Subduing Staff was unleashed, its energy was continuously draining away.
Thus, as time passed, it would soon become a piece of trash.

chapters.title: Chapter 4083: Killing a Buddha Son
paragraphs: Chapter 4083: Killing a Buddha Son
Liu Kaiji and Liu Yiming both slapped themselves. Though this was also very humiliating, it was still better than continuing to kneel.

At the same time, the dazed Shi Yongming suddenly moved, brandishing the Demon Subduing Staff in his hands and attacking everywhere, not caring at all, causing the people in the surroundings to be greatly shocked and hurriedly move out of the way.
A Core Formation Tier cultivator that wielded a Spirit Body; who dared to block him?
Was this guy crazy?

Shi Yongming seemed to have encountered a life-or-death enemy, and brandished the Demon Subduing Staff in his hands. Every strike was delivered with his full strength, and his expression would be twisted at times, proud at others, nervous at others. It was truly colourful.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel rueful. The black light of illusion was truly astonishing. Though its level was inferior to Destructive Energy or Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, Heavenly Dao Flames, but its practical use was not the slightest bit inferior. Ling Han did not feel regret at having branded it on the Celestial Core, and turning it into his true celestial technique.

Others didn’t know that Shi Yongming had fallen into an illusion, and only thought that he had gone mad. They all retreated. If they were wounded, or even killed by a maniac, then there would really be no place for them to seek justice.
However, after Shi Yongming brandished it for a while, the Demon Subduing Staff slowly dimmed, its might decreasing time and time again.

At this time, Shi Yongming’s expression suddenly changed, and he regained consciousness. He was a disciple of the Buddhist Race, after all, and he cultivated the art of the soul, so it was easier for him to break free from an illusion than any other person. However, it was naturally too late now. The energy of the Demon Subduing Staff had almost been exhausted.
“No!” he cried out in frustration.

This Demon Subduing Staff was planted in his body by an Arhat from the Buddha Race of the West Heavenly Realm. He nurtured it, and when he advanced into the Spirit Transformation Tier, he would possess a deadly weapon.

But now that he had used it in advance, not only did it not have the effect of subduing the enemy, it had instead exhausted all its energy. This meant that all the effort he had previously put in was completely wasted.
Damn it, damn it!
“Ling Han, if I don’t expiate you, I swear that I won’t live!” he said through gritted teeth.

Ling Han merely smiled, “For someone like me, how could hell dare to take me in? Shi Yongming, it would be better for you to go to hell to exorcise the departed souls, and follow in the footsteps of Buddha Doga!”
He charged out. At this moment, Shi Yongming’s Spirit Body was already exhausted, so what did he have to fear?
Boom!
Shi Yongming parried, but he had previously fallen into an illusion, and used all his powerful moves. How could he possibly be a match for Ling Han at this moment?
In just two or three moves, he had completely fallen into a disadvantage, and was suppressed extremely terribly by Ling Han.
This was still the result of Ling Han not using the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. Otherwise, he wouldn’t even be able to withstand a single strike.
Even so, it was only a few dozen moves, and he was already in a perilous situation. His vital points were repeatedly hit, and he was throwing up blood endlessly.

“Ling Han, you dare to kill me?” Shi Yongming didn’t dare to believe this. He was West Heavenly Realm’s Buddha Son, and his status was extremely high. Wouldn’t he be afraid that the Buddha Race would be angered and exterminate your entire clan?
“So what if I kill you?” Ling Han was cold, and his attacks were extraordinarily heavy, showing no mercy at all.
This caused everyone to inhale sharply. They could not believe this at all.
Ling Han was far too arrogant, wasn’t he? He actually dared to kill a member of an Imperial Clan!

At first, Liu Yiming and Liu Kaiji were extremely furious, but now, their hatred towards Ling Han actually decreased slightly. Just look, he even dared to kill the Buddha Son. In comparison, just having the two of them kneel on the ground and slap themselves three times was nothing?
“Please consider carefully!” Chi Menghan suddenly spoke up, sending a message through divine sense to Ling Han.

Ling Han knew that Chi Menghan was deliberately reminding him to prevent him from being too arrogant or being blinded by hatred and making drastic actions. However, this wasn’t his drastic actions, but rather his actions after careful consideration.
Peng!

With a single punch, Shi Yongming was already killed. Under the barrage of Destructive Energy, Shi Yongming didn’t even have the chance to burn his Celestial Core to extend his life. There was dead silence.
A Buddha Son had died. This was equivalent to an Imperial Son. It was equivalent to having poked a hole in the heavens.
Next, the Buddhist Race would definitely fly into a thunderous rage.

Yet Ling Han was unconcerned. The true Buddhist Race was located in the thirty three Heavens. Though there were branches in the North, South, East and West Heavenly Realms, and they all had Buddha Sons, they could only be considered Pseudo Buddha Sons.
Because compared with an Imperial Daughter like Chi Menghan, Shi Yongming’s strength was not just a little bit weaker.
Thus, the Buddha Sons of the four Heavenly Realms were all Pseudo-Buddha Sons. The real Buddha Sons would definitely be in the thirty three Heavens.

Of course, killing Shi Yongming would definitely anger the Buddhist Race, but it should only be the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm. At most, this can only be considered the equivalent of a Holy Land. What did he have to fear?
Everyone looked at Ling Han and felt rueful.

Incredible, this was really incredible. If this freak from the North Heavenly Realm could continue to live, he would definitely become a Saint in the future. Furthermore, he would be an incredibly powerful Saint, the kind that dared to oppose even an Imperial Clan. However, as the saying went, the tallest tree in the forest would be destroyed by the winds. Putting aside the Buddhist Race, the Battle God Palace had already issued a killing order against him. Would this brat be able to live until the day he became a Saint?
Shua, right at this moment, a flash of sword light suddenly appeared out of thin air, slashing towards Ling Han’s back.
This strike was both fast and accurate!
Pu! The sword slashed down, splitting Ling Han into two.

“Hahaha!” The person who had launched the sneak attack revealed his true form. It was an ordinary-looking middle-aged man, but at this moment, he was exuding a burning brilliance. He was the True Self Tier assassin from the Battle God Palace. Previously, he had been searching for the Blood-Patterned Dao Stone, and had only arrived here not too long ago. However, he had coincidentally discovered Ling Han.
He had succeeded with a single strike!
He laughed loudly. He had finally killed the target that the Battle God Palace had to kill. He had done a great service this time, and when he returned, he would definitely be rewarded.
However, in reality, Ling Han just happened to be standing nine meters away, completely
unscathed.
-This assassin had already fallen into an illusion.
He wanted to show off the Strange Shadow Steps in front of Ling Han?
What a joke. He had long since grasped the complete Strange Shadow Steps, and also had an eye technique. If anyone wanted to approach him soundlessly and sneak attack him, that was
practically deceiving himself.
However, Ling Han simply took advantage of this fact and secretly used the black light of illusion, causing the other party to unknowingly fall into the illusion that he had woven.
Seeing this assassin smile foolishly, everyone gritted their teeth.
This was a True Self Tier cultivator, and he had actually concealed his cultivation level and
snuck in secretly. How disgraceful!
“Judging by the way he sneak attacked, he seems to be an assassin from the Battle God
Palace.”
“It should be. Ling Han is on the must-kill list of the Battle God Palace.”
“But what’s wrong with him? He’s smiling so brightly. Could it be that he thinks that he has
successfully killed Ling Han?”
“It’s like he’s gone mad.” “Yi, don’t you think this is very similar to Shi Yongming’s situation just now?”
At this point, everyone stopped in unison. Then, they turned to look at Ling Han, their faces
filled with shock.
This guy… could it be that he could make one enter into an illusion at any time?
Heavens, just how many Mystical Powers had this guy grasped?
“Ah!” The assassin suddenly came back to his senses. After all, he was a True Self Tier
cultivator, so the illusion couldn’t confuse him for too long.
“I’m going to kill you!” He glared furiously at Ling Han, his face burning. He was laughing like an idiot in public; this was too embarrassing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4084: Backer
paragraphs: Chapter 4084: Backer

The True Self Tier assassin roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han again. Then, he stabbed and slashed again and again, strike after strike. Black light blazed, and killing intent spread out, his divine might incredibly powerful.
But as everyone watched, they all felt a sense of amusement and terror rise up in their hearts.
That was because that assassin was randomly attacking again, and was completely slashing at empty air.
Right, he had once again fallen into an illusion.
After a while, the assassin came back to his senses. He faltered for a moment, and his whole face was as red as blood.
“Ling Han, I’m going to tear you into pieces!” He charged over again, and then… very tragically, continued to slash at the air.
“Ling Han!”
Cutting at empty air.
“Ling Han!”
Cutting at empty air.

A considerable number of people couldn’t help but laugh. This scene was indeed quite hilarious, but top-notch prodigies such as Chi Menghan and the others didn’t smile at all. They only felt a deep wariness towards Ling Han’s strength.
That was a True Self Tier assassin, and he was actually being toyed around with by Ling Han. This was practically a freak.

However, what they didn’t know was that Ling Han also felt very regretful. Being trapped in an illusion didn’t mean that he had lost consciousness. When he was attacked, he would still instinctively counterattack. Thus, even if Ling Han attacked, it would only be a waste of energy.

The higher one’s cultivation level, the more difficult it would be to win with a disadvantage in cultivation level. Even a disadvantage of a minor level was extremely difficult, let alone a diadvantage of a major tier.

However, those who could advance into the True Self Tier definitely had very high natural talent in martial arts, so the assassin’s resistance to illusions was also getting stronger and stronger. At the beginning, the illusion was enough to trap him for about half a minute, but now, one or two seconds was already the limit.
“Ling Han, you’re definitely going to die today!” the assassin said balefully. He already knew how to deal with the illusion.

It couldn’t be helped. After all, there was a gap of a major tier between their cultivation levels. It was already quite impressive that Ling Han was able to affect him, and if their cultivation levels were equal, Ling Han could even use an illusion to trap his opponent until he died of old age.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I’m afraid you won’t be able to!”

“You, a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator, and I have already broken through your illusion technique, so how are you going to stop me?” That assassin walked towards Ling Han, step by step. The tip of his sword was lowered, and killing intent surged out, drawing an obvious mark on the ground.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “You’re dreaming!”
“Haha, die!” The assassin pounced over. He became one with his sword, and he was like a fleeting swan.

However, a large hand suddenly swatted over. Peng, that assassin was pressed into the ground. Then, that large hand turned into drifting energy that returned to the heaven and earth, and the assassin had already been smashed into mush of blood.
Hiss!
Which elite had made a move?
Weng, everyone felt a frightening pressure assault them, and saw that those Saints that had disappeared, Venerate Tiers, and Sect Masters had all returned.
The Nine Mountains Venerate also appeared beside Ling Han. He was the one who had struck Battle God Palace’s assassin to death.
What a joke. He had already considered Ling Han as his personal disciple, and had placed his hopes on him becoming an Emperor. How could he allow others to assassinate him?
“Senior, did you gain anything?” Ling Han asked.
The Nine Mountains Venerate nodded, and smiled. “I’ve gained quite a lot.”
Ling Han retrieved a Spatial Tool and handed it over, saying, “This is a small token from this disciple.”

The Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. This disciple of his actually gave him something. Hehe, it had only ever been an elder giving something to a junior. Now that it was him, why was it the other way around?
However, he didn’t mind this. After receiving the Spatial Spirit Tool, he swept his divine sense over it and was astonished.
This was a Dao Stone, and one that had been refined by a Great Emperor at that!

This time, he was excited. At his cultivation level, it was already extremely difficult to take another step forward. Previously, he had observed the Regulations of heaven and earth in the Blood Palace, which gave him a feeling of appreciation. future!”

He was filled with confidence in himself, and believed that he would be able to comprehend the Regulations of heaven and earth without depending on this kind of external object. Furthermore, comprehending the Dao Stones refined by a Great Emperor would definitely affect him. For those who were determined to break through to the Imperial Path, this was actually disadvantageous.

As members of the Imperial Clan, this was indeed an incredibly glorious matter, but if they only used their power to bully others, that would be embarrassing the Imperial Clan.

It had to be admitted that those that could become Saints did indeed have a great bearing. Of course, it was also possible that Saints could not bring themselves to bully a mere Core Formation Tier cultivator.
At the very least, Shattering Stars Saint hadn’t attacked Ling Han yet.
All the juniors related the current situation, and this caused the three Saints to feel curious.
They were very proud. What place in this world could imprison them?
It should be known that they still had an Imperial Weapon on them!
Thus, the three Saints each grabbed their own juniors, and with a flash, they had already
begun to cross the ocean.
They were Saints, how awesome!
“Senior, would you like to try as well?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Mountains Venerate shook his head. He kept staring at the surface of the sea, and after a while, he said, “There are astonishing Regulations in this seawater and on the surface of the sea, and they are intertwined. I can resist them, but it won’t last long, and this will corrode my flesh and blood completely.”
In other words, even if a Venerate Tier crossed the sea bravely, it was very likely that he would
die midway.
This was the power of a Great Emperor. Even though he had been dead for heaven knows how many years, even Venerate Tier elites had to respect him.
Then what could they do? Just go back like this?
“Come, let’s go take a look at that pile of bones,” the Nine Mountains Venerate suddenly said.
Previously, Ling Han had mentioned this to him .
“All right.” Ling Han naturally would not object.
The two of them soon arrived at the pile of skulls. The Nine Mountains Venerate swept an eye
over it, then turned to Ling Han and said, “Are you brave?”
“Quite so, I should think.”
“That’s good.”
The Nine Mountains Venerate moved, and began to dismantle this pile of skulls. Then, he
turned these skulls into a raft.
No way, you want to use this to cross the sea?

The Nine Mountains Venerate seemed to have seen through his confusion, and said, “According to my deductions, the bones should be immune to the corrosion of Regulations, so it wouldn’t hurt to give it a try.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4085: Floating Corpse
paragraphs: Chapter 4085: Floating Corpse
It wasn’t just the Nine Mountains Venerate, but also other Venerable Tier elites who were harvesting skulls to build rafts.
Being able to become a Venerate Tier elite, they indeed had amazing insight.
The Nine Mountains Venerate brought the bone raft to the coast, and said with a smile, “Come on.”
“Senior, take it easy.” Ling Han gritted his teeth. This looked a little unreliable.

“Haha, as long as I’m still breathing, I guarantee that not a single hair on your head would be hurt,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said with a smile. He grabbed Ling Han and threw a palm strike. A terrifying power surged, immediately pushing the bone raft into the depths of the
sea.
The bone raft rode the winds and waves, its speed astonishingly fast.

However, the sea wasn’t calm and without waves, especially when the bone raft was advancing at high speed, creating waves that crashed over. However, these waves were all neutralized by the Nine Mountains Venerate.

After walking for a while, the Nine Mountains Venerate stopped steering the ship. Because he was continuously dispersing the impact of the waves, he was also slightly strained. Though he still had a lot of energy left, who knew what other dangers lay here? It was naturally impossible that he would use up all his power.
After resting for a while, they saw another bone raft row over from behind them. There were a total of three people on this raft. One was a Venerate Tier elite, while the other two were young men.

“Nine Mountains, you are really outrageously bold. You actually dare to enter into the West Heavenly Realm!” that Venerate Tier said. There was no anger or joy on his face, and it was unknown what kind of attitude he had.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled faintly, and said, “What is it? Is the West Heavenly Realm the Underworld or Hell? Can’t I come?”
“When we get out, let’s fight,” the Venerate Tier elite said.
“All right.” The Nine Mountains Venerate was completely unafraid.
“Now, should we join forces?” the Venerate Tier elite suddenly said with a smile.
The Nine Mountains Venerate raised a brow, and said, “Deal.”
The two Venerate Tier elites both needed to rest. They were too strong, and could extract the energy of heaven and earth at any time. There was absolutely no need for them to wait until the sun rose.
“Brother Ling, let’s get to know each other. I am Ning Yanghao, and this is my clansman, Ning Bian.” A young man clasped his hands in Ling Han’s direction, his expression very modest.
Ling Han also clasped his hands in greeting, “Greetings, Brother Ning.”

However, Ning Bian was much more arrogant. He merely raised a brow, then said, “I’ve heard others speak of you in such a grand manner, but you’re only in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. I really don’t know why those rumors are so exaggerated.”

It was clear that he had not seen the scene of Ling Han defeating Shi Yongming, Liu Kaiji and Liu Yiming on the beach. Otherwise, no matter how high his opinion of himself was, he would not dare to say such flippant words.
Ling Han merely smiled. There was nothing to be concerned about this kind of young brat.

Of course, he was also unwilling to destroy the alliance that had just been formed between two Venerate Tier elites. Otherwise, no matter what, he would have to teach this brat who had an exaggerated opinion of his own abilities a lesson.
“Brother Ling, please don’t be angered. This clan brother of mine rarely goes out, so he is a little rash.” Ning Yanghao played mediator.
“Brother Hao!” Ning Bian was still defiant.
“It’s fine. He’s just a child.” Ling Han waved his hand casually.
This infuriated Ning Bian, and also made Ning Yanghao grit his teeth. ‘You still say it’s all right? You didn’t show any mercy with your words either.’
“Yi?” Ling Han suddenly shuddered, and looked into the distance. Using his eye technique, he saw something floating.
Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian also looked over, but they didn’t have eye techniques, so they naturally couldn’t see anything.
Ning Bian humphed, “Stop pretending!”
Ning Yanghao was also slightly surprised. He believed that Ling Han was not that kind of person, but he had indeed not seen anything.
What was going on?
After a while, he also let out a surprised exclamation, and suddenly stood up.
“Brother Hao, what’s wrong?” Ning Bian asked. After being rebuked by Ling Han, and thought that he had been tricked, so at this moment, he was extremely displeased.
“See for yourself,” Ning Yanghao said darkly.
Ning Bian looked in the direction he was pointing, and couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression.
That was… a corpse!

He couldn’t help but feel shocked. There was a terrifying power of Regulations in the seawater, and even Venerate Tier elites would be corroded. Otherwise, why would they have used bones to make rafts? But now, there was a corpse that was moving with the waves, its physical body uncorroded. How could this not be terrifying?
Xiu, the Nine Mountains Venerate and the Heavenly Venerable Tier both stood up, their expressions stern.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
“To be able to keep his physical body from decaying, there must be endless Regulations interwoven within his body,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded, “Regulations intertwine with the physical body, this is-”
“Saint!” the two Venerate Tier elites exclaimed at the same time.

Hearing the word “Saint”, Ling Han and the other juniors all felt their hearts skip a beat. Throughout history, there would always be lapses in Ancestral Kings. For example, in the current era, Saints were the strongest in the world, and even Imperial Clans would treat them as esteemed guests.
But now, the corpse of a Saint had been thrown into the sea, so how could they not be
shocked?
“When an Emperor descends into the world, even Saints are like ants!” Nine Mountains Venerate exclaimed.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate was also in a complicated state of mind, filled with a feeling of loneliness and dejection.
Both of them had set becoming Saints as their lifelong goal. Thus, seeing a Saint’s corpse thrown into the sea naturally caused endless feelings to rise up in their hearts.
So what if he was as strong as a Saint? In front of a Great Emperor, he was nothing but trash.
Right at this moment, a terrifying aura assaulted him. It was like a supreme God Tool,
piercing the skin painfully.
Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian immediately couldn’t bear it, and blood oozed from their skin,
presenting a horrible sight.
“Not good, saintly might!”
The two Venerate Tier elites hurriedly steered the rafts to dodge, retreating into the distance. Only then did that terrifying aura disappear.

Ning Bian glanced at Ling Han, and could not help but feel dissatisfied, because both he and Ning Yanghao were covered with blood, and looked extremely disheveled. However, Ling Han was completely unscathed. Merely with this comparison, it was clear who was superior among
them.
And it should be known that the two of them were both at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, which was a minor level higher than Ling Han.
“Nine Mountains, your Nine Suns Holy Land has really picked up a treasure!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate looked at Ling Han with undisguised envy.
“Haha!” The Nine Mountains Venerate laughed loudly, his expression incredibly smug.
He might not be able to become a Saint in this lifetime, but Ling Han would definitely be able
to. In fact… there was still hope for him to become an Emperor.

Becoming an Emperor… Just the thought of it made him incredibly excited. That was the ultimate elite of the universe, capable of suppressing an era, leaving behind an eternal name that would be praised for eternity.
“Yi, why has the Saint’s corpse floated over again?” The Nine Mountains Venerate suddenly

frowned. They had steered the rafts away, and did not move with the waves. Instead, they headed in a sideways direction. Thus, if that Saint’s corpse was drifting with the waves, they should have been separated.
“Strange!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded, his expression slightly serious.
“Let’s go!”
The Nine Mountains Venerate continued to steer the raft. After all, it was a Saint’s corpse. If it
really turned into a zombie or something, it would definitely be incredibly terrifying, so it
was best to stay as far away from it as possible.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded, and hurriedly steered the bone raft as well, floating alongside the Nine Mountains Venerate.
Ling Han turned around, only to see that the Saint’s corpse was rapidly disappearing into the distance. It wasn’t long before it disappeared from his sight.
The five of them soon forgot about this matter. After travelling for another half a day, they
stopped to rest.
Ling Han was bored, and looked around. All of a sudden, his expression changed, and he blurted out, “Not good, that Saint’s corpse has floated over again!”

After travelling for another half a day, they
stopped to rest.
Ling Han was bored, and looked around.
All of a sudden, his expression changed, and he blurted out, “Not good, that Saint’s corpse has floated over again!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4086: Blood Lotus Pond
paragraphs: Chapter 4086: Blood Lotus Pond
In the distance, a corpse floated over at an unhurried pace.
Wasn’t this the Saint’s corpse that he had previously seen?
He was dressed in robes, completely purple-red in colour, and wore a purple-gold crown on his head. These were obviously all treasures, and there was not the slightest sign of decay.

However, this Saint’s corpse wasn’t floating very fast, and it was far from being able to compare to the speed at which the two Venerate Tier elites were rowing the rafts. Yet, it had actually caught up to them after only a moment. This was naturally terrifying.
Strange!
The Heavenly Martial Venerate opened his eyes, and looked towards the Nine Mountains Venerate. There was a questioning look in his eyes.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
“We have to recover power, or we might encounter even greater danger,” the Nine Mountains Venerate muttered to himself.

The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded in understanding. If they expended too much of their power, then in such a strange sea of blood, they could possibly encounter even more danger. The Saint’s corpse floated closer and closer, and that terrifying aura came again.

Ling Han and the others hurriedly steered the rafts as well. Their power was insufficient, so the speed of the bone raft was naturally not too fast either. Thankfully, the Saint’s corpse was not moving very fast either, and just followed behind them at a leisurely pace.
Though they had not been caught up, the expressions of the three young men were a little ugly.
Being pursued by a corpse, just the thought of it was enough to make one’s scalp go numb. What in the world was going on?
“Yi, there’s an island ahead!” Ling Han’s eyes were sharp, and he looked into the distance. “Row over,” the Nine Mountains Venerate immediately said.
“All right!” Ling Han steered the bone raft and headed towards that island.
The Ning brothers naturally moved as well, steering the bone raft to follow.
Behind them, that Saintl’s corpse was also chasing closely, as if it had eyes of its own, completely ignoring the movement of the ocean currents.
In a short while, the island in front of them appeared. It was not very big, and its greatest length was only 2.5 km.
But for the five of them, having a firm foothold and a place to rest was already enough.

They docked and landed on the island. The two Venerate Tier elites moved one after another, and grabbed the bone rafts from the sea. If they were washed away by the seawater, or destroyed by the Saint’s corpse, it was really possible that they would not be able to return.
This small island was very desolate. It was just a field of rocks, but there was a pool in the centre of the island.
“Yi, there’s a Great Herb!” The Nine Mountains Venerate and the Heavenly Martial Venerate said at the same time.

They arrived at the side of the pool, and saw that there was presently a blood-coloured lotus flower growing in the pool. Additionally, the lotus flower had long since borne seeds, forming a blood-coloured lotus pod, covered with light silver veined patterns.

“Haha!” The Nine Mountains Venerate immediately laughed loudly, “Brat, your luck is not too bad. These lotus seeds contain Regulations, and its grade is definitely not low. This is just in time to add a new veined pattern to your Celestial Core!”
“Wait!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate hurriedly stretched out a hand, “Nine Mountains, have you forgotten that I still exist?”
“What is it? You want to compete with a junior for this kind of treasured medicine?” Nine Mountains Venerate’s expression was filled with disdain.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate humphed, “I don’t need it. But don’t I have any juniors?”

“These two people are already at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. Don’t tell me what they incribed previously on their Celestial Cores corresponds to the Regulations of the Blood Lotus. Eating these lotus seeds can help them complete the Regulations.” The Nine Mountains Venerate mocked.
“Yi, how did you guess?” The Heavenly Martial Venerate pretended to be surprised.
F***, you are really too shameless, aren’t you?

The Nine Mountains Venerate thought for a moment, and said, “If we fight, we’ll need at least a few days to decide the victor. Moreover, this place is extremely strange, and unpredictable dangers might appear at any time.”
“Therefore, why don’t we let these three juniors fight over it?”
When the Heavenly Martial Venerate heard this, he hesitated slightly.

Ling Han was only at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, while Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian were at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. There was a gap of a minor level between them, and this was an irreversible gap for top-notch prodigies. Thus, no matter how one looked at it, Ling Han had no chance of winning.
However, since there was no chance of victory, why had the Nine Mountains Venerate brought it up?
He was no idiot!
“Okay!” Ning Bian interrupted. He stared at Ling Han. Young people were hot-tempered, and he was really too defiant. What right did Ling Han have to make such a great name for
himself?
-Though he had already witnessed how extraordinary Ling Han was previously.

When it came to background, the Ning Clan had descended from a Saint. They were both members of the Holy Land, and the style of a clan was completely different from the style of a sect. Since childhood, he had been ingested with various natural treasures, and had cultivated a top-grade cultivation technique. How could this be compared to a person who had no solid foundation?
Moreover, he also had an advantage in terms of cultivation level.
“All right.” The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded. Indeed, he couldn’t think of any reason to lose, so he agreed, “For the sake of fairness, all Celestial Tools are forbidden from being
used.”
Fair your head!
The Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t expose that. He had too much confidence in Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, stepped out, and said, “Brothers Ning, the two of you can attack together.”
This… how arrogant!
Ning Bian was infuriated. Pointing at Ling Han, he said, “I’ll immediately let you know the consequences of being arrogant!”
He pounced, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han. Shua, golden light blazed, turning into a
sharp sword.
Ling Han replied with a punch. Peng, this golden sword was instantly shattered, and the power of the punch did not decrease, continuing to blast towards Ning Bian.
What!

Ning Bian was astonished. In his eyes, Ling Han was only at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. His power could only reach 20 Heavens at most, yet upon contact, he discovered that Ling Han’s power was actually as high as 28 Heavens!

This was too terrifying. It should be known that his power was only 22 Heavens. Even if he channelled the Saint Technique, his battle prowess would only increase another two Heavens, far from being Ling Han’s match.
Peng!
He was sent flying by Ling Han’s punch. Thankfully, Ling Han withdrew his power when he hit him. Otherwise, with this blow, Ning Bian would be finished.

Of course, the Heavenly Martial Venerate was just standing at the sidelines, so how could he possibly watch helplessly as his junior was killed? He would definitely move to stop him, so Ling Han simply withdrew the power of his own accord.
Ning Bian’s face alternated between red and white. At this moment, no matter how stubborn he was, he had to admit that there was a gap between him and Ling Han, and it was not small
either.

“Nine Mountains, I’m really jealous this time.” The Heavenly Martial Venerate looked at Ling Han. Previously, though he had a high opinion of this young man, he now discovered that this young man’s freakishness far exceeded his imagination.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled as he stroked his beard. At this moment, he only needed
to smile reservedly.
A thought flashed through the Heavenly Martial Venerate’s mind, and he said to Ling Han smilingly, “Young man, have you married?”
Yi, what kind of imagination was this? His imagination was running too fast, wasn’t it?
Ling Han nodded, “I already have a wife.”

The Heavenly Martial Venerate couldn’t help but sigh. Such an outstanding young man, it would be great if he could take him as a son-in-law of the Ning Clan. Unfortunately, Ling Han was already married, and the Ning Clan was a noble Holy Land, so how could they possibly allow their noble daughter to serve the same husband as another woman?
The Nine Mountains Venerate moved and plucked the lotus seed pod. As for the lotus, the Heavenly Martial Venerate had plucked it. Although it hadn’t ripened yet, it would still have
some effect. It was better than wasting it.
They searched around the island again, but did not find anything else.
Just as they were about to leave, they saw the Saint’s corpse float over from the sea again. It was as if it were guarding them.
