chapters.title: Chapter 4087: Blood Wave
paragraphs: Chapter 4087: Blood Wave
“Let’s go,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said solemnly.
The two Venerate Tier elites tossed out their bone rafts, then set out, quickly leaving this small island.
After travelling far away, the Saint’s corpse floated over unhurriedly again. It was really like a lingering ghost.
They all ignored him. At least until now, this Saint’s corpse had only been following them, and had not harmed them.

Even the two Venerate Tier elites needed to rest, but with their strength, who knew how far they could travel in a single day. However, this great sea was terrifyingly huge. They travelled for a whole three days, yet still had not managed to cross this great sea.

However, the weather on the seas suddenly changed. Multiple arcs of blood-red lightning flashed, and their might caused even the expressions of the two Venerate Tier elites to change. That was because this had reached Saint Tier, and even Saint Tier elites would have to go all out. Otherwise, it was possible that they would die.
Thankfully, the blood-coloured lightning was far away in the distance, and did not strike
over.

A rain of blood began to fall from the skies. This did not have any corrosive effects, but had a very strong negative effect on the mentality, and gave rise to endless despondent thoughts. Ling Han was still fine. The quality of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core was too high, allowing him to suppress such negative emotions. However, Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian couldn’t hold on any longer. They were in a daze, and almost threw themselves into the sea to commit suicide. Thankfully, the Heavenly Martial Venerate was there, and the two of them were directly knocked unconscious.

Seeing that Ling Han was still calm and composed, the Heavenly Martial Venerate’s love for talent grew even stronger. Too bad, why had Ling Han already married? Otherwise, with such a good son-in-law, it was a sure bet that a Saint would emerge from the Ning Clan in future.
After walking for another day, not only was there a shower of blood, but a strong wind was also blowing on the sea.
This was no ordinary wind. It could be seen that there were seals of Regulations flickering in the air. If one was scraped by this kind of wind, it was guaranteed that he would be torn into pieces.

The two Venerate Tier elites didn’t dare to be careless. They placed the two bone rafts so that they were side by side. One Venerate Tier elite focused on steering the rafts, while the other raised a shield to resist the terrifying winds of Regulation.

This was like a great battle. The opponent was equivalent to Sect Master-level. Originally, he should not have been able to withstand a single blow, but there was no end to it. This was even more powerful. With several hundred, tens of thousands, or even tens of thousands of Sect Masters battling in turns, even Venerate Tier elites would have to be careful.
At this kind of time, Ling Han wasn’t even qualified to interfere, and could only watch from the sidelines.
However, since he had nothing to do, he took out the lotus seed pod, peeled out a lotus seed, and began to eat.

Others would definitely be filled with shock and fear at this moment. Even if it was a top- grade prodigy, he would like he was facing a great enemy, so how could he still have the mood to refine the Great Herb and extract the Regulations? However, Ling Han was no ordinary person. The more he was in such a situation, the calmer and more composed he was.

The Heavenly Martial Venerate saw this, and felt even more regretful. He secretly decided that in future, he would have Ning Haoyang and Ning Bian become closer to Ling Han. He would not be able to get a live-in son-in-law, but at least they could get a friend.

According to Nine Mountains Venerate, this lotus seed contained the secrets of Regulations, and was the most suitable for Ling Han to consume now. He could extract the heaven and earth’s Regulations from it, and transform it into veined patterns for the Celestial Core. After eating the lotus seeds, the taste could not be considered delicious. Ling Han spoke from the perspective of a professional glutton.
Not long after, a mysterious power rose up in his mind, turning into pieces of seals.
This was Regulations, but Ling Han couldn’t understand them, and could only think of them as complicated seals.

He extracted these shards, and attempted to combine them. Only by forming a complete seal would he be able to analyze a useful seal, and that was the Regulations of heaven and earth, which could be inscribed on the Celestial Core.
Of course, he had to confirm the level of this Regulations first. If it was too weak, he didn’t want it.
The Celestial Core was only so big, so how could it allow a piece of trash-level Regulations to waste its space?
Kuang, a clap of thunder rang out, waking Ling Han from his comprehension.

In the skies, blood-coloured lightning flashed unhindered in the distance, and the wind and rain became heavier in an instant. This gave the two Venerate Tiers immense pressure, and they both became extremely alert, not daring to be the slightest bit careless.
“Nine Mountains!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate suddenly called out, his voice trembling slightly.
What kind of world had a Venerate Tier not seen? His voice was actually trembling?

The Nine Mountains Venerate was originally focused on resisting the wind and rain, and when he heard this, he turned to look sideways. He couldn’t help but reveal an astounded expression, and saw that there was a blood-coloured massive wave rolling over from the distance, and this massive wave was actually as tall as three thousand meters.
He swept an eye over it, and shook his head. This massive wave was extraordinarily huge, and there was no boundary to either side of it. There was no way to circle around it at all.
“We have to take it head-on!” he said.
The speed of this massive wave was too fast. With their present speed, they would be caught up. Thus, they had to face this massive wave head-on.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded. He took out a jade cauldron, and floated it above his head. Then, it rapidly enlarged, just enough to completely shield the bone rafts.
Weng, multiple streaks of light descended. This was manifested from Regulations, and could be considered the strongest guardian in this world.
This was the Spirit Tool that he had cultivated with his life.

Now that it was a matter of life and death, Ling Han naturally had no intention of hiding his strength. He prepared to take out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and hand it over to the Nine Mountains Venerate.
Though this was not a real Imperial Weapon, the Origin Gold itself possessed great might. When used in the hands of a Venerate Tier elite, its might should be stronger than an ordinary
Saint Tool.

However, the Nine Mountains Venerate had already summoned the Saint Tool, the Nine Suns Parasol. After endless power was poured into it this precious tool quickly revived. A saintly might spread out, but it didn’t target the people on the bone rafts.
Not far away, the blood-colored wave was already approaching. It could be seen that the wave was densely covered with seals. In fact, it had even turned into multiple divine chains.
“Get ready!” The Nine Mountains Venerate roared. The Nine Suns Parasol unleashed its full might, blasting towards that massive wave.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
Peng!
The Saint Tool unleashed its might, shooting out a pillar of light.
After this attack, a hole was blasted into the massive wave, which was about 30 meters in
diameter.
“Pass through!”
“All right!”

The Heavenly Martial Venerate steered the bone rafts and rushed through the bloody hole. The waves crashed rapidly, their speed astonishingly fast. Thankfully, it was a Venerate Tier that was steering the raft. Whether it was in terms of power or ability to adapt, he was top- notch in the world, and managed to pass through the bloody hole without any mishaps. The strange thing was that it was calm on this side. There was no wind or rain in the sky at all. If it was not for the fact that they could still see that massive wave rapidly leaving when they turned around, who would believe all that was happening in front of their eyes? However, they had finally left the danger zone. The two Venerate Tier elites and Ling Han all breathed a sigh of relief. The situation just now was truly dangerous. Even the Venerate Tier elites were on edge.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate woke Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian up. There was no more blood rain by now, so there was no need for them to continue lying down.
“Yi, what’s that in front of us?” the Heavenly Martial Venerate asked.
The Nine Mountains Venerate looked over, and he couldn’t see clearly either.
The two Venerate Tier elites couldn’t even see clearly, let alone Ling Han, who couldn’t see
anything even after activating his eye technique.
“Hiss!” All of a sudden, the two Venerate Tier elites inhaled sharply.

Of course, he had to confirm the level of this Regulations first.
If it was too weak, he didn’t want it.
The Celestial Core was only so big, so how could it allow a piece of trash-level Regulations to waste its space?
Kuang, a clap of thunder rang out, waking Ling Han from his comprehension.
In the skies, blood-coloured lightning flashed unhindered in the distance, and the wind and rain became heavier in an instant.
This gave the two Venerate Tiers immense pressure, and they both became extremely alert, not daring to be the slightest bit careless.
“Nine Mountains!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate suddenly called out, his voice trembling slightly.
What kind of world had a Venerate Tier not seen?
His voice was actually trembling?
The Nine Mountains Venerate was originally focused on resisting the wind and rain, and when he heard this, he turned to look sideways.

He couldn’t help but reveal an astounded expression, and saw that there was a blood-coloured massive wave rolling over from the distance, and this massive wave was actually as tall as three thousand meters.
He swept an eye over it, and shook his head.
This massive wave was extraordinarily huge, and there was no boundary to either side of it.
There was no way to circle around it at all.
“We have to take it head-on!” he said.
The speed of this massive wave was too fast.
With their present speed, they would be caught up.
Thus, they had to face this massive wave head-on.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded.
He took out a jade cauldron, and floated it above his head.
Then, it rapidly enlarged, just enough to completely shield the bone rafts.
Weng, multiple streaks of light descended.
This was manifested from Regulations, and could be considered the strongest guardian in this world.
This was the Spirit Tool that he had cultivated with his life.
Now that it was a matter of life and death, Ling Han naturally had no intention of hiding his strength.
He prepared to take out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and hand it over to the Nine Mountains Venerate.
Though this was not a real Imperial Weapon, the Origin Gold itself possessed great might.
When used in the hands of a Venerate Tier elite, its might should be stronger than an ordinary
Saint Tool.
However, the Nine Mountains Venerate had already summoned the Saint Tool, the Nine Suns Parasol.
After endless power was poured into it this precious tool quickly revived.
A saintly might spread out, but it didn’t target the people on the bone rafts.
Not far away, the blood-colored wave was already approaching.
It could be seen that the wave was densely covered with seals.
In fact, it had even turned into multiple divine chains.
“Get ready!” The Nine Mountains Venerate roared.
The Nine Suns Parasol unleashed its full might, blasting towards that massive wave.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
Peng!
The Saint Tool unleashed its might, shooting out a pillar of light.
After this attack, a hole was blasted into the massive wave, which was about 30 meters in
diameter.
“Pass through!”
“All right!”
The Heavenly Martial Venerate steered the bone rafts and rushed through the bloody hole.
The waves crashed rapidly, their speed astonishingly fast.
Thankfully, it was a Venerate Tier that was steering the raft.
Whether it was in terms of power or ability to adapt, he was top- notch in the world, and managed to pass through the bloody hole without any mishaps.
The strange thing was that it was calm on this side.
There was no wind or rain in the sky at all.
If it was not for the fact that they could still see that massive wave rapidly leaving when they turned around, who would believe all that was happening in front of their eyes?
However, they had finally left the danger zone.
The two Venerate Tier elites and Ling Han all breathed a sigh of relief.
The situation just now was truly dangerous.
Even the Venerate Tier elites were on edge.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate woke Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian up.
There was no more blood rain by now, so there was no need for them to continue lying down.
“Yi, what’s that in front of us?” the Heavenly Martial Venerate asked.
The Nine Mountains Venerate looked over, and he couldn’t see clearly either.
The two Venerate Tier elites couldn’t even see clearly, let alone Ling Han, who couldn’t see
anything even after activating his eye technique.
“Hiss!” All of a sudden, the two Venerate Tier elites inhaled sharply.

chapters.title: Chapter 4088: Hole
paragraphs: Chapter 4088: Hole
F***, what the hell was going on?
Ling Han’s heart was filled with curiosity. Something that could cause the expressions of two Venerate Tier elites to change drastically, what great matter had happened?
Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian had not experienced the massive waves previously, so the two of them were at a loss and confused.
“Should we go and take a look?” the Nine Mountains Venerate asked the Heavenly Martial Venerate.
“Alright.” The Heavenly Martial Venerate pondered for a moment before nodding.
The two Venerate Tier elites steered the bone rafts forward.

Ling Han calmed down slightly. Since the two Venerate Tier elites had actively charged over, it meant that the situation wasn’t serious. At the very least, it wasn’t as dangerous as being attacked by massive waves.
“Yi?”

After walking for a while, Ling Han suddenly discovered that the originally calm seawater had begun to flow, and looking around, the strange thing was that all the seawater was surging in one direction.
This was a little inconceivable. Unless a large hole had appeared in the sea, it was possible that all the seawater would be drawn in that direction.
Hehe, a hole had appeared in the ocean; this was really too funny.
Ling Han was just mocking himself, when his expression froze.
If that was not the case, how could the expressions of the two Venerate Tier elites change drastically?
No way, a hole would appear in this sea of blood?
After walking for a while longer, the surging of the seawater became faster and faster. After walking for a while longer, loud splashing sounds could already be heard.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked forward. A look of astonishment instantly spread across his face.
Ahead of them, a massive hole had really appeared in the sea, forming a circular waterfall. Boundless seawater crashed down, creating a colossal noise.
Heavens!
“Look!” The Heavenly Martial Venerate pointed ahead.
The Nine Mountains Venerate immediately looked over, and Ling Han also looked over. With the channeling of his eye technique, his eyesight far surpassed the eyes of ordinary Core Formation Tiers.
They saw that there were actually multiple corpses in the seawater that had rushed into that massive hole!
They were whole corpses, and had not been corroded into bones.
It should be known that only a Saint would be able to maintain the integrity of his physical body in this kind of seawater – whether he was alive or dead.
In other words, these were the corpses of Saints!
This was terrifying. Just how many Saints were there?
“Saints died, these are the deaths of Saints!” the Nine Mountains Venerate muttered. He had really been shocked.

The Heavenly Martial Venerate wasn’t much better off. Only these Venerate Tier elites knew that the Saint Tier definitely wasn’t superior to the Venerate Tier by a whole level of cultivation. This kind of literal strength was actually an earth-shattering change.
In front of a Saint, even Venerate Tiers were like ants.

Theoretically speaking, there should only be a pitifully small number of Saints in the universe. In fact, even a galaxy could barely produce a single Saint. Thus, how many Saints could there be in the universe?
Alright, even if every Imperial Clan had two Saints, taking into account the Saints of the other forces, there would only be over a hundred of them in total. At most, it would not exceed two hundred.
But in this place? Every minute or so, there would be a few Saint corpses that had been washed into the hole.
Just how terrifying was this number?

Meanwhile, Ling Han and the others were completely ignorant. They only knew that Saints were powerful, and there were very few of them. However, they were completely unclear about how powerful they were, and how rare they were.
Thus, though they were also stunned for a moment, they were not as shaken as the two Venerate Tier elites.
Behind them, the Saint’s corpse also floated over. Drawn by the water flow, it directly floated towards the hole ahead of them, sliding down and disappearing without a trace.
Now that there was no Saint’s corpse following behind them, they should have breathed a sigh of relief, but in this strange place, the five of them felt even more anxious.

“Let’s go,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said. There was nothing much to see here. Although the Saint corpses descended one after another, and the scene was filled with impact, it would naturally become boring after watching for a long time.

The Heavenly Martial Venerate nodded. The two great Venerate Tier elites controlled the bone rafts to go against the flow. With their power as Venerate Tier elites, they were naturally capable of resisting this kind of oceanic current. Very soon, the hole in the ocean was far away from them.
The five of them did not speak. Seeing so many Saint corpses all of a sudden, they were still in a state of shock, and it was very difficult for them to immediately come back to their senses.
Ling Han also thought of the Black Heaven Temple. That was also because Saints had died all over the place, but compared with the number of Saints here, it was like an amateur watching
an expert.
Was there no record of such Saints dying in history?
Ling Han thought back to what Chi Menghan had said. There would always be gaps in history from time to time. Even the truth of events tens of millions of years ago might not be
deduced.
True, the Great Emperor only had a lifespan of ten million years, so what was so strange about some things being annihilated in history?

The two bone rafts rode the winds and waves, and another few days passed. That annoying wave rose again, causing the two Venerate Tier elites to once again be on tenterhooks. Thankfully, that massive wave that was three thousand meters tall did not appear.
Most importantly, they had lost their way now. There was no difference between day and night here. The sky would always be blood-red, so it was extremely difficult to determine
their location.

Originally, the Venerate Tier elites should have a very good sense of direction. Even if there was no reference material, it was fine. However, the environment here was unique, and it was extremely easy to affect one’s mind. Even the Venerate Tier elites were no exception. At least, in terms of direction, they were already dumbfounded.
Just like that, they floated on the sea for many days. The five of them were already a little numb, and did not know when such days would end.

Ling Han was still fine. He had already finished eating all the blood lotus seeds, and there were innumerable shards in his mind. He was reconstructing them every day, so there was not much time left for him. That was because if he did not combine them into seals and brand them on the Celestial Core, they would dissipate not too long after.

Thus, he would sit cross-legged on the bone raft every day, and concentrate on cultivating. This caused the Heavenly Martial Venerate to nod repeatedly as he watched. Being able to calmly cultivate under such conditions, how could Ling Han not be freakish?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

Ling Han’s body trembled slightly. By now, he had finally completely comprehended the heaven and earth Regulations contained within the blood lotus, turning it into an incredibly complicated seal. With a slight tremor, it seemed capable of shattering the heavens.
A murderous aura circulated, causing his eyes to instantly become bloodshot. In fact, even his hair was vaguely showing a hint of red.
So terrifying!
Ling Han was very pleased. The level of Regulations should not be inferior to Heavenly Dao
Flames and the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.
It could be branded.
He inscribed this seal on the Celestial Core, and discovered that this was another incomplete blood-coloured seal. It was clearly not very big, but it occupied a very large space.
This was natural, aside from the complete Primal Chaos Divine Lightning that he had coincidentally obtained, with his current cultivation level, how could he possibly grasp the
complete top tier Regulations?
However, the Heavenly Dao Flames, developed to the pinnacle, could even soften Origin Gold.

It could be claimed to be the strongest flame in the world, and it would not be an exaggeration to call it the Imperial Flame. Then, going by the same logic, the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and the blood-coloured seal were all Great Emperor-level.
However, the Destructive Energy was actually a level higher- judging from the size of the
area it had reserved, this was terrifying. Was there anything in this world that was stronger
than Emperor Tier?
Or could it be that there were actually differences in strength among Great Emperors as well?
It was just that there was no comparison, so it was impossible to determine who was
stronger?
“Mainland! We can finally see mainland!” It was at this moment that the two Venerate Tier elites exclaimed in excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 4089: Giant Island
paragraphs: Chapter 4089: Giant Island
A piece of mainland finally appeared ahead of them.
Including the two Venerate Tier elites, the five of them were all very excited. They had either returned to their starting point in a daze, or had already crossed the great sea. No matter
what, it was better than being trapped on the great sea.
“No!” The Nine Mountains Venerate suddenly said, “This isn’t mainland, but a large island.”
What!

Ning Yanghao and Ning Bian were both stunned. No way, the two of them couldn’t see the edge of this island even with their full vision. What kind of island was this? It was ridiculously huge, wasn’t it?
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked into the distance at the coastline. Only then did he catch sight of the edge of the land.
Indeed, this was an island and not a mainland, but it was incredibly huge.
“No matter what, we’ve finally arrived at a new place. Let’s look around. Who knows, there might be a great secret here,” Heavenly Martial Venerate said.
The remaining four nodded. It was unknown which Ancestral King had built this, but since it involved an Ancestral King, there must be a great secret.
The five of them landed on the shore, and stowed away the bone rafts. They still needed to use it when they returned, and then began searching on this colossal island.
This island was the same colour as the sea. It was blood-red in colour, and there was blood- coloured mist wafting in the air, which greatly affected vision.
“Hmm?”
The two Venerate Tier elites showed vigilant expressions at the same time. They stopped in their tracks, as if they were facing a great enemy.
Mist filled the air, and nothing could be seen.

After waiting for a while, the two Venerate Tier elites advanced in unison, but their footsteps were extremely slow. In an instant, Ling Han immediately felt a powerful aura assault him, causing all the hairs on his body to stand on end.
There was a supreme elite ahead of them!
No wonder the two Venerate Tier elites looked on guard. The fog here was dense, and it greatly affected vision and divine sense. Who would dare to mess around?
It should be known that they had seen who knew how many Saint corpses in the last few days, so how could even a Venerate Tier dare to be careless?
Who would want a lifetime of hard cultivation to result in nothing?
A figure gradually appeared ahead of them.
“Primary Constant!”
“Nine Mountains! Heavenly Martial!”

The Nine Mountains Venerate and the Heavenly Martial Venerate called out at the same time, and a voice came from ahead of them. Both sides felt as if a heavy weight had been lifted from their shoulders.
As it turned out, it wasn’t an enemy, but rather another Venerate Tier that had entered this space at the same time they did.
Hu!
Ling Han and the other juniors also relaxed. Both sides walked towards each other. There was only one Venerate Tier elite on the other side, while he had brought three juniors with him.

When they saw Ling Han, the three juniors all looked disgusted-the West Heavenly Realm had always looked down on the North Heavenly Realm, and they couldn’t possibly change their perceptions just because of Ling Han.
On the other hand, the more powerful Ling Han’s performance was, the more he suppressed the West Heavenly Realm so much that they couldn’t even raise their heads. This made them detest him even more.
“Nine Mountains, why aren’t you staying at the Nine Suns Holy Land? Why have you come here?” Primary Constant Venerate asked, a hint of provocation in his voice.
“What can you do about it?” the Nine Mountains Venerate said proudly.
“Nine Mountains, you still dare to be so arrogant after coming all the way to the West Heavenly Realm?” Primary Constant Venerate raised a brow.
The competition and competitiveness among Heavenly Realms was not just limited to the juniors.
“What is it? Do you want to fight?” The Nine Mountains Venerate wasn’t afraid at all.
“When we get out of here, I really want to ask you for some guidance,” Primary Constant Venerate said calmly.
“Then you’ll have to queue up.” The Nine Mountains Venerate laughed loudly as he pointed at Heavenly Martial Venerate.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate laughed loudly, playing mediator, “All right, all right. Now, everyone should work together and explore the island together.”

Primary Constant Venerate nodded. On his way here, he had also seen a great many corpses of Saints, and was naturally filled with wariness of this place. Even Saints would die here, so it was no different for Venerate Tiers like them.
The three Venerable Tier elites teamed up and started to search the large island.
However, the fog here affected even Venerate Tier elites, so they couldn’t see clearly how far ahead they were. Thus, their progress wasn’t fast.
After two days, they didn’t discover anything, but the team expanded considerably, because they encountered several Venerate Tier elites along the way, bringing their juniors to join the
team.

Thankfully, the blood mist only obstructed vision and divine sense, and did not have the ability to confuse others. Thus, everyone did not lose their way. Though the efficiency was not high, they were still steadily searching through the various areas on the island.

The island’s environment had also changed. Previously, it was a flat mountainous area, but gradually, sharp stone pillars protruded. They were incredibly long, as if they were about to pierce through the heavens.
At first, everyone was unconcerned, but as they walked, they discovered that there were actually traces of blood on a pillar, but it had long since dried up.
Yi?
A Venerate Tier elite soared into the sky, and when he landed, there was already a corpse in his
hand.
“Hiss, this is a Venerate Tier elite!” After the Venerate Tier elites examined him, they all
paled in shock.
A mighty Venerate Tier elite was actually stabbed to death on a stone pillar?
They were also Venerate Tiers. If the culprit was still here, would they be spared?
“He’s already been dead for who knows how many years,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said. “The divine essence has all been lost. Otherwise, we should feel pressure when we pass by this
place.”
“En!” Everyone nodded.
“Could it be that it was also the doing of that Ancestral King?” someone asked.
This caused all the Venerate Tier elites to fall silent.

Those who could become a Great Emperor were not only extraordinarily talented, but also broad-minded. This had been developed through being tested by the heaven and earth. Looking at history, which Great Emperor hadn’t suppressed an era, allowing a supreme prosperity to appear in martial arts?

But in this place, there were innumerable Saint corpses, and there were also Venerate Tiers that were slaughtered like animals, hanging on stone pillars. These methods were really too cruel. No matter how they looked at it, it did not seem like the actions of a Great Emperor. The problem was, if it wasn’t a Great Emperor, who would be able to kill so many Saints? “Could it be that it was a Pseudo-Emperor?” a Venerate Tier said with a frown. “That’s not very likely.” His conjecture was immediately denied, “Any Pseudo-Emperor would take that final leap, but once he failed, he would definitely die. Thus, if it is claimed that a Pseudo-Emperor could live for so many years and kill so many Saints, that doesn’t
make sense!”
Indeed, there were really too many Saint corpses here. They did not seem like they belonged
to the same generation at all. No matter what, they had to traverse millions of years, and aside from an Ancestral King, who else could live for so long?
Everyone was scratching their heads in confusion. They couldn’t figure it out no matter what. “We can’t be careless. Let’s continue forward!” the Nine Mountains Venerate said in a solemn
voice.

If this had been set up by an Ancestral King Ancestral King, then even if that Ancestral King had died, the methods that he left behind would be able to easily Venerate Tiers, and it was probable that even Saints would not be spared.
For example, the Heavenly Dao Flames could completely accumulate for millions of years. Once they gushed out, even Saints would be turned into ashes.
They continued onwards. They had not walked too far, when they encountered people again.
This time, it was a Saint.
The Donglin Imperial Clan’s Crystal Saint.
Chi Menghan and Chi Dao were naturally present as well. Chi Menghan was reserved, while Chi Dao came over very warmly to greet Ling Han, causing the other young people to be
dumbfounded.
What was going on here? Was Ling Han planning to leap over the Dragon’s Gate and become the son-in-law of an Imperial Clan?

This island was the same colour as the sea.
It was blood-red in colour, and there was blood- coloured mist wafting in the air, which greatly affected vision.
“Hmm?”
The two Venerate Tier elites showed vigilant expressions at the same time.
They stopped in their tracks, as if they were facing a great enemy.
Mist filled the air, and nothing could be seen.
After waiting for a while, the two Venerate Tier elites advanced in unison, but their footsteps were extremely slow.
In an instant, Ling Han immediately felt a powerful aura assault him, causing all the hairs on his body to stand on end.
There was a supreme elite ahead of them!
No wonder the two Venerate Tier elites looked on guard.
The fog here was dense, and it greatly affected vision and divine sense.
Who would dare to mess around?
It should be known that they had seen who knew how many Saint corpses in the last few days, so how could even a Venerate Tier dare to be careless?
Who would want a lifetime of hard cultivation to result in nothing?
A figure gradually appeared ahead of them.
“Primary Constant!”
“Nine Mountains!
Heavenly Martial!”
The Nine Mountains Venerate and the Heavenly Martial Venerate called out at the same time, and a voice came from ahead of them.
Both sides felt as if a heavy weight had been lifted from their shoulders.
As it turned out, it wasn’t an enemy, but rather another Venerate Tier that had entered this space at the same time they did.
Hu!
Ling Han and the other juniors also relaxed.
Both sides walked towards each other.
There was only one Venerate Tier elite on the other side, while he had brought three juniors with him.

When they saw Ling Han, the three juniors all looked disgusted-the West Heavenly Realm had always looked down on the North Heavenly Realm, and they couldn’t possibly change their perceptions just because of Ling Han.
On the other hand, the more powerful Ling Han’s performance was, the more he suppressed the West Heavenly Realm so much that they couldn’t even raise their heads.
This made them detest him even more.
“Nine Mountains, why aren’t you staying at the Nine Suns Holy Land?
Why have you come here?” Primary Constant Venerate asked, a hint of provocation in his voice.
“What can you do about it?” the Nine Mountains Venerate said proudly.
“Nine Mountains, you still dare to be so arrogant after coming all the way to the West Heavenly Realm?” Primary Constant Venerate raised a brow.
The competition and competitiveness among Heavenly Realms was not just limited to the juniors.
“What is it?
Do you want to fight?” The Nine Mountains Venerate wasn’t afraid at all.
“When we get out of here, I really want to ask you for some guidance,” Primary Constant Venerate said calmly.
“Then you’ll have to queue up.” The Nine Mountains Venerate laughed loudly as he pointed at Heavenly Martial Venerate.
The Heavenly Martial Venerate laughed loudly, playing mediator, “All right, all right.
Now, everyone should work together and explore the island together.”
Primary Constant Venerate nodded.
On his way here, he had also seen a great many corpses of Saints, and was naturally filled with wariness of this place.
Even Saints would die here, so it was no different for Venerate Tiers like them.
The three Venerable Tier elites teamed up and started to search the large island.
However, the fog here affected even Venerate Tier elites, so they couldn’t see clearly how far ahead they were.
Thus, their progress wasn’t fast.
After two days, they didn’t discover anything, but the team expanded considerably, because they encountered several Venerate Tier elites along the way, bringing their juniors to join the
team.
Thankfully, the blood mist only obstructed vision and divine sense, and did not have the ability to confuse others.
Thus, everyone did not lose their way.
Though the efficiency was not high, they were still steadily searching through the various areas on the island.
The island’s environment had also changed.
Previously, it was a flat mountainous area, but gradually, sharp stone pillars protruded.
They were incredibly long, as if they were about to pierce through the heavens.
At first, everyone was unconcerned, but as they walked, they discovered that there were actually traces of blood on a pillar, but it had long since dried up.
Yi?
A Venerate Tier elite soared into the sky, and when he landed, there was already a corpse in his
hand.
“Hiss, this is a Venerate Tier elite!” After the Venerate Tier elites examined him, they all
paled in shock.
A mighty Venerate Tier elite was actually stabbed to death on a stone pillar?
They were also Venerate Tiers.
If the culprit was still here, would they be spared?
“He’s already been dead for who knows how many years,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said.
“The divine essence has all been lost.
Otherwise, we should feel pressure when we pass by this
place.”
“En!” Everyone nodded.
“Could it be that it was also the doing of that Ancestral King?” someone asked.
This caused all the Venerate Tier elites to fall silent.
Those who could become a Great Emperor were not only extraordinarily talented, but also broad-minded.
This had been developed through being tested by the heaven and earth.
Looking at history, which Great Emperor hadn’t suppressed an era, allowing a supreme prosperity to appear in martial arts?
But in this place, there were innumerable Saint corpses, and there were also Venerate Tiers that were slaughtered like animals, hanging on stone pillars.
These methods were really too cruel.
No matter how they looked at it, it did not seem like the actions of a Great Emperor.
The problem was, if it wasn’t a Great Emperor, who would be able to kill so many Saints?
“Could it be that it was a Pseudo-Emperor?” a Venerate Tier said with a frown.
“That’s not very likely.” His conjecture was immediately denied, “Any Pseudo-Emperor would take that final leap, but once he failed, he would definitely die.
Thus, if it is claimed that a Pseudo-Emperor could live for so many years and kill so many Saints, that doesn’t
make sense!”
Indeed, there were really too many Saint corpses here.
They did not seem like they belonged
to the same generation at all.
No matter what, they had to traverse millions of years, and aside from an Ancestral King, who else could live for so long?
Everyone was scratching their heads in confusion.
They couldn’t figure it out no matter what.
“We can’t be careless.
Let’s continue forward!” the Nine Mountains Venerate said in a solemn
voice.

If this had been set up by an Ancestral King Ancestral King, then even if that Ancestral King had died, the methods that he left behind would be able to easily Venerate Tiers, and it was probable that even Saints would not be spared.
For example, the Heavenly Dao Flames could completely accumulate for millions of years.
Once they gushed out, even Saints would be turned into ashes.
They continued onwards.
They had not walked too far, when they encountered people again.
This time, it was a Saint.
The Donglin Imperial Clan’s Crystal Saint.
Chi Menghan and Chi Dao were naturally present as well.
Chi Menghan was reserved, while Chi Dao came over very warmly to greet Ling Han, causing the other young people to be
dumbfounded.
What was going on here?
Was Ling Han planning to leap over the Dragon’s Gate and become the son-in-law of an Imperial Clan?

chapters.title: Chapter 4090: Red-Haired Beauty
paragraphs: Chapter 4090: Red-Haired Beauty
The appearance of a Saint in the team naturally calmed everyone’s hearts.
At present, there were no Emperors in the world, and the Crystal Saint also had the Imperial Weapon. Thus, no matter what kind of danger they encountered, the Crystal Saint could resolve it.

Speaking of which, the Crystal Saint really unlucky. Though his speed was faster, he had completely lost his sense of direction in the sea of blood. In truth, he had just arrived here, but Saints were Saints after all, so he was still faster than the others.
Furthermore, he was the first to arrive among the three Saints, which showed that Saints were actually not very useful here.
The deeper they went into the island, the thicker the fog became. Another day later, they really couldn’t even see their own fingers.
The Crystal Saint summoned his Imperial Weapon. The Mysterious Ice Banner danced above his head, easily tearing a hole into the blood mist. The area within 3000 meters became clear again.
The Imperial Weapon was the Imperial Weapon, after all. It hadn’t awakened yet, yet it was already so mighty. If it fully awakened, would it be able to raze this sea of blood to the ground?
Seeing the might of the Imperial Weapon, everyone’s courage increased greatly.
Even if an Ancestral King came back to life, the Imperial Weapon should be able to last a few moves, right?
In Ling Han’s mind, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower trembled slightly.
It was doing it again. This guy seemed to have been provoked, and was determined to jump out and fight.
“Yi?” The Crystal Saint looked slightly surprised, because he could feel the Imperial Weapon become restless, as if it had been provoked. It was actually showing signs of awakening on its
own.
However, the problem was that there weren’t any other Imperial Weapon here.

Could it be that the Ancestral King that had set up this place had also left behind the Imperial Weapon, and it was presently on this island? That was why the Imperial Weapon had sensed it, and that was why it wanted to actively awaken and battle it?

-Which Ancestral King hadn’t swept through the world and ruled over an era? Thus, the Ancestral King’s ambition was higher than the heavens, and the Imperial Weapon that they had forged was naturally unafraid of any challenge.
“Be careful. It’s extremely likely that there’s an Imperial Weapon standing guard here!” the old Saint said.
Hearing his words, everyone paled in shock.
If the Imperial Weapons engaged in a fierce battle, even Saints would have no option but to turn around and flee. In fact, if they were the slightest bit slower, their only fate would be death.
At this moment, even the Venerate Tiers almost wanted to retreat. It was too dangerous. Only Ling Han knew the truth, and he couldn’t help but wear a strange expression.

If everyone knew that he was the cause of this Saint looking like he was facing a great enemy, or rather, it was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in his mind, would he be beaten to death by these Venerate Tiers that had flown into a rage out of humiliation?
Yes, it was really possible.
Hence, he definitely could not say.

Ling Han was also slightly proud of himself. This was something that could induce fear in the hearts of a group of Venerate Tiers. He, a Core Formation Tier, should be the one and only to achieve this in history.

Everyone was extremely careful. It was extremely possible that there was another Imperial Weapon here. Once it unleashed its might, even Saints would be killed. It was extremely dangerous, and they had to be extremely careful.
The Mysterious Ice Banner fluttered lightly, and the blood mist in front of them was easily dispersed, giving everyone a clear view.

All around them, stone pillars soared into the sky one after another, and what was terrifying was that there was actually a corpse pierced by every stone pillar. However, the bloodstains of the majority of the corpses had only flowed to one third of the length of the stone pillars, and were gone. Hence, at this moment, though the air of their blood spread out, they could not be discovered.
These corpses were all Venerate Tier corpses.

The sea was filled with the corpses of Saints, while this place was filled with the corpses of Venerate Tier elites. They were all hanging on stone pillars like livestock. Was this a sacrificial ceremony for worship?
There was also the pile of skulls from before, and there was no shortage of Venerate Tiers and Saints among them. Otherwise, it could not have possibly formed such a terrifying pressure.
Just what kind of world was this!
“Let’s go, continue walking!”
Led by the Saint, they continued onwards, penetrating deep into this island, and the further ahead they went, the steeper the terrain became. On the fifth day, a mountain peak appeared
ahead of them.
“Let’s go!”
Now that they were here, there was naturally no reason for them to retreat. They all ascended the mountain.

However, though the environment here was terrifying, with Saint corpses and Venerate Tier corpses appearing at the drop of a hat, there was actually no danger at all. On the other side of the great ocean, there were still Yin souls, but here, there weren’t even any ghosts.
The mountain was very tall, but there was a Saint here, so what was the height of the mountain worth?
In less than half a day, they had already arrived at the summit.
“Yi!” “Ah!” “Ya!”

After reaching the summit, quite a number of people immediately exclaimed in shock. That was because there was a blood-coloured great tree at the summit, but it did not have even half a leaf. Its thick trunk was actually semi-transparent like jade.
What caused everyone to exclaim in shock was how innumerable branches hung down, supporting a woman.
This woman was wearing a blood-coloured long dress, and her hair was also blood-red. As the mountain winds blew, it fluttered slightly, like flames.
Her eyes were tightly closed, as if she was sleeping, but even so, her beauty was still world-
shaking.
Even Ling Han had to admit that this woman’s beauty was already not inferior to the empress and Hu Niu.
And near the Blood Tree, there were also blood-coloured giant eggs, as tall as a man. They were no longer semi-transparent, but every single one of them was squirming slightly, as if
life was nurtured within.
This scene was too bizarre.
That red-haired woman was breathtakingly beautiful, but those giant blood-coloured eggs were disgusting. The two images intertwined, incompatible, yet inseparable.
“Is she dead?” someone murmured, starry-eyed.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
“How could such a beautiful woman possibly die!” Immediately, someone rebuked, his face similarly filled with adoration.
To say nothing of these youngsters, even a few Venerate Tiers looked captivated.
This woman was really too dazzlingly beautiful, causing their hearts that were completely focused on cultivation to waver.
Immediately, someone wanted to rush up and “rescue” the red beauty.
“Wait!”
There were always calm people, especially those Venerate Tiers who had cultivated for so many years. Even if their minds were affected, they could still control themselves very well.
“I can sense that this Blood Tree is extracting the energy from the ground, supplying it to that woman!” a Venerate Tier said.

“That’s right, and I have a bold conjecture. Previously, those Venerate Tiers that had been stabbed to death on the stone pillars had all had their energy essence extracted and transformed by this Blood Tree in some way, to be supplied to her,” another Venerate Tier
said.
When everyone heard this, some immediately looked shocked, while others shook their
heads.
“Impossible, how could such an exceptionally beautiful, untainted woman possibly do such a cruel thing!” These people refused to believe it.

“It is indeed impossible that this woman was the culprit,” the Crystal Saint said. “To be able to kill so many Saints, it must be the handiwork of a Great Emperor. However, this place has existed for who knows how many years, and there has never been a Great Emperor that could
live for so long.”
“Furthermore, if this woman was really a Great Emperor, and we were so close, we would have long since been shocked to death by the Imperial Might.”
This was indeed very useful evidence. Furthermore, if this woman was really a Great Emperor, then no one should have any extravagant hopes with regards to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 4091: Split into Pieces
paragraphs: Chapter 4091: Split into Pieces
“But all this is too strange!” someone said.

Indeed, there was a sea of corpses of Saints, pillars stabbing the corpses of Venerate Tiers, and this exquisite red-haired woman was currently in slumber. It was completely impossible to connect all of this.
“If she hasn’t died, we can wake her up. Who knows, we might be able to know the whole story,” a Venerate Tier suggested.
This won the agreement of the majority. Whether they were interested in the red-haired beauty, or were more curious about this world, they all needed to awaken this woman first.
“I’ll go.” A junior immediately jumped out. He was already completely captivated by the red- haired beauty.
The Saint did not speak, and all the Venerate Tiers also tacitly agreed. This young man then walked towards the Blood Tree.
However, the elites were all prepared to move. This place was too strange, and things definitely could not go so smoothly.

At first, the young man was walking very slowly, but his footsteps soon became faster and faster. Then, he became faster and faster, and it became a run. There was also excitement on his face. With such an exquisite beauty, if he could get close to her, he was even willing to live a few hundred years less.
However, just as he was about to reach her, shua, a branch suddenly moved, and whipped towards him.
Extremely fast!
“Humph, how dare you!” A Venerate Tier moved. Pa, a majestic light flashed, interwoven with Regulations, turning into a Divine Sword. With a slash, the branch was severed.
He was the elder of that young man, so he naturally could not just sit by and watch.
The young man was given a fright, but when he saw that the branch had been severed, he showed an expression of pride.
With the support of his senior, what did he have to fear?
Beauty, I’m here!
The infatuation in his eyes deepened, and he couldn’t wait to pull that red-haired beauty into his arms, and love her tenderly.
Involuntarily, he sped up, and then lost consciousness.

And in the eyes of the masses, as this young man ran, he suddenly broke into pieces, as if there was an invisible supreme divine blade that had instantly sliced him into several pieces. Then, The turned into a mist of blood, and disappeared completely.
This!

“Qian’er!” the Venerate Tier cultivator who had attacked earlier couldn’t help but call out. Not only was this his clansman, but this was also his direct descendant. He had placed great hopes on him, yet in the end, he had died in front of him, without even leaving a piece of himself behind.
-If the large black dog was here, he would definitely grumble, “What is it? You want him to leave a piece of himself behind for you to eat?”

He roared loudly, and pounced forwards. The precious tool of the Venerate Tier had already been drawn. It was a long green saber, and was fully activated at the first instant. The terrifying might of the Venerate Tier surged out, causing even heaven and earth to pale.

The Crystal Saint frowned slightly. He had not seen clearly how that young man had died, but he still stretched out a hand, dispersing the pressure that surged over from that Venerate Tier. “Destroy!” That Venerate Tier was furious, and struck out with his saber, intending to destroy that blood tree along with the red-haired beauty.

“No!” This caused a great many young people to exclaim in shock. Even a considerable number of Venerate Tiers were slightly out of control. Should they make a move to stop him? Whether the Blood Tree was struck or not, they were completely unconcerned, but it was a different story for that red-haired beauty. She was really breathtakingly beautiful, and even they were moved.

The Blood Tree immediately launched a counterattack. One after another, its branches waved, lashing out at that Venerate Tier. There were actually Regulations moving as well, and their might was powerful.

This was very inconceivable. Though there were innumerable Celestial medicines in the world, Celestial medicines were only very nutritious. They themselves did not have any battle prowess. At most, they would only release some poisonous Qi, or create illusions to confuse others.
And those that could directly “make a move” would definitely have developed intelligence, and gained spiritual consciousness.

Once they gained spiritual consciousness, even Wood-aligned creatures couldn’t possess a long lifespan. They would also be limited by their cultivation level. However, although it was unclear how many years this place had existed for, it was definitely astonishingly long.
Thus, why was this Blood Tree still alive?
Boom!
The Blood Tree battled fiercely with the Venerate Tier. It was extremely powerful, and was not the slightest bit inferior to the Venerate Tier.

“Humph, a mere Demonic Tree dares to commit violence!” Another Venerate Tier moved, charging towards the Blood Tree. As a dignified Venerate Tier, time was very precious, so how could he possibly have so much free time to just observe the battle for a long time?
The two Venerate Tiers teamed up, and the situation was naturally different. They immediately suppressed the Blood Tree, and victory was only a matter of time.
However, there were also Venerate Tiers who felt that they were too slow and joined the battle as well.
Three against one, this formed a qualitative change, and the Blood Tree could not hold up at
all.
More importantly, it was rooted here, and couldn’t run around randomly. Naturally, it was a huge disadvantage, losing even faster.
But right at this moment, a terrifying scene appeared. The three Venerate Tiers suddenly shattered into pieces, and then turned into a mist of blood, not leaving behind the slightest
trace.
‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’
This time, everyone’s hair stood on end.

Those were three Venerate Tiers, supreme elites that were only inferior to Saints, and they had actually died so soundlessly, without the slightest bit of preparation, without the slightest bit of resistance. How could this not be frightening?
Was it the action of a Saint? Or… was it an Ancestral King?

If there really was an Ancestral King here, then all of them added together would be killed with a single palm strike. Even the awakening of the Imperial Weapon would be useless. Great Emperors were invincible in the world, and those that could stand against a Great Emperor were definitely not the Imperial Weapon, but only another Great Emperor. The Crystal Saint walked out. With a wave of his hands, multiple streaks of Regulations of heaven and earth were instantly extracted, turning into threads of silk. Even though each thread was as thin as a spider’s web, if one was cut by this silk, it was guaranteed that even Venerate Tiers would be instantly split into half.
Instantly, someone understood, and exclaimed in shock, “They were all killed by the threads
of Regulations!”
This would explain why the young man from before, as well as the three Venerate Tiers, had𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
been silently torn into pieces.
However, was there another Saint here?
Everyone turned to look at the red-haired beauty, and then shook their heads in unison.
Putting aside the fact that she was a Saint, even if she was, she was either dead now, or in an extremely sealed state. How could she possibly make a move?
This was a strange place, and it was far too strange. Even Venerate Tiers could die so soundlessly, and they were like crops being harvested. This caused a boundless chill to rise up
in everyone’s hearts.
Obviously, this Blood Tree, or rather this red-haired beauty, was a taboo that could not be
touched.

The Crystal Saint humphed upon hearing this. He was a member of the Imperial Clan, and in this era where there were no Emperors, what did he have to fear? He strode forward, with the Imperial Weapon hovering above his head. It was in a state of awakening at any moment.
He strode forward, and could clearly see that the Regulations of heaven and earth had solidified, forming a complicated three-dimensional network.
The Imperial Weapon was even more terrifying. With a light wave, it directly tore a rip into
the Void, and a terrifying energy surged out.
That was high-level energy!
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. As it turned out, high-level energy did not exist in this
time and space, but rather in the Void.
However, this high-level energy was not all that powerful. At most, it was equivalent to the energy corresponding to the first Spirit Diagram that he had learnt.

However, the Imperial Weapon didn’t need to channel its power at all. It could easily pierce through the Void and draw out high-level energy. This was naturally terrifying. “You guys, look!” Someone suddenly exclaimed, pointing into the distance, even his voice
trembling.

sentences.text: Chapter 4091: Split into Pieces
“But all this is too strange!” someone said.
Indeed, there was a sea of corpses of Saints, pillars stabbing the corpses of Venerate Tiers, and this exquisite red-haired woman was currently in slumber.
It was completely impossible to connect all of this.
“If she hasn’t died, we can wake her up.
Who knows, we might be able to know the whole story,” a Venerate Tier suggested.
This won the agreement of the majority.
Whether they were interested in the red-haired beauty, or were more curious about this world, they all needed to awaken this woman first.
“I’ll go.” A junior immediately jumped out.
He was already completely captivated by the red- haired beauty.
The Saint did not speak, and all the Venerate Tiers also tacitly agreed.
This young man then walked towards the Blood Tree.
However, the elites were all prepared to move.
This place was too strange, and things definitely could not go so smoothly.
At first, the young man was walking very slowly, but his footsteps soon became faster and faster.
Then, he became faster and faster, and it became a run.
There was also excitement on his face.
With such an exquisite beauty, if he could get close to her, he was even willing to live a few hundred years less.
However, just as he was about to reach her, shua, a branch suddenly moved, and whipped towards him.
Extremely fast!
“Humph, how dare you!” A Venerate Tier moved.
Pa, a majestic light flashed, interwoven with Regulations, turning into a Divine Sword.
With a slash, the branch was severed.
He was the elder of that young man, so he naturally could not just sit by and watch.
The young man was given a fright, but when he saw that the branch had been severed, he showed an expression of pride.
With the support of his senior, what did he have to fear?
Beauty, I’m here!
The infatuation in his eyes deepened, and he couldn’t wait to pull that red-haired beauty into his arms, and love her tenderly.
Involuntarily, he sped up, and then lost consciousness.
And in the eyes of the masses, as this young man ran, he suddenly broke into pieces, as if there was an invisible supreme divine blade that had instantly sliced him into several pieces.
Then, The turned into a mist of blood, and disappeared completely.
This!
“Qian’er!” the Venerate Tier cultivator who had attacked earlier couldn’t help but call out.
Not only was this his clansman, but this was also his direct descendant.
He had placed great hopes on him, yet in the end, he had died in front of him, without even leaving a piece of himself behind.
-If the large black dog was here, he would definitely grumble, “What is it?
You want him to leave a piece of himself behind for you to eat?”
He roared loudly, and pounced forwards.
The precious tool of the Venerate Tier had already been drawn.
It was a long green saber, and was fully activated at the first instant.
The terrifying might of the Venerate Tier surged out, causing even heaven and earth to pale.
The Crystal Saint frowned slightly.
He had not seen clearly how that young man had died, but he still stretched out a hand, dispersing the pressure that surged over from that Venerate Tier.
“Destroy!” That Venerate Tier was furious, and struck out with his saber, intending to destroy that blood tree along with the red-haired beauty.
“No!” This caused a great many young people to exclaim in shock.
Even a considerable number of Venerate Tiers were slightly out of control.
Should they make a move to stop him?
Whether the Blood Tree was struck or not, they were completely unconcerned, but it was a different story for that red-haired beauty.
She was really breathtakingly beautiful, and even they were moved.
The Blood Tree immediately launched a counterattack.
One after another, its branches waved, lashing out at that Venerate Tier.
There were actually Regulations moving as well, and their might was powerful.
This was very inconceivable.
Though there were innumerable Celestial medicines in the world, Celestial medicines were only very nutritious.
They themselves did not have any battle prowess.
At most, they would only release some poisonous Qi, or create illusions to confuse others.
And those that could directly “make a move” would definitely have developed intelligence, and gained spiritual consciousness.
Once they gained spiritual consciousness, even Wood-aligned creatures couldn’t possess a long lifespan.
They would also be limited by their cultivation level.
However, although it was unclear how many years this place had existed for, it was definitely astonishingly long.
Thus, why was this Blood Tree still alive?
Boom!
The Blood Tree battled fiercely with the Venerate Tier.
It was extremely powerful, and was not the slightest bit inferior to the Venerate Tier.
“Humph, a mere Demonic Tree dares to commit violence!” Another Venerate Tier moved, charging towards the Blood Tree.
As a dignified Venerate Tier, time was very precious, so how could he possibly have so much free time to just observe the battle for a long time?
The two Venerate Tiers teamed up, and the situation was naturally different.
They immediately suppressed the Blood Tree, and victory was only a matter of time.
However, there were also Venerate Tiers who felt that they were too slow and joined the battle as well.
Three against one, this formed a qualitative change, and the Blood Tree could not hold up at
all.
More importantly, it was rooted here, and couldn’t run around randomly.
Naturally, it was a huge disadvantage, losing even faster.
But right at this moment, a terrifying scene appeared.
The three Venerate Tiers suddenly shattered into pieces, and then turned into a mist of blood, not leaving behind the slightest
trace.
‘F*ck!
F*ck!
F*ck!’
This time, everyone’s hair stood on end.

Those were three Venerate Tiers, supreme elites that were only inferior to Saints, and they had actually died so soundlessly, without the slightest bit of preparation, without the slightest bit of resistance.
How could this not be frightening?
Was it the action of a Saint?
Or… was it an Ancestral King?
If there really was an Ancestral King here, then all of them added together would be killed with a single palm strike.
Even the awakening of the Imperial Weapon would be useless.
Great Emperors were invincible in the world, and those that could stand against a Great Emperor were definitely not the Imperial Weapon, but only another Great Emperor.
The Crystal Saint walked out.
With a wave of his hands, multiple streaks of Regulations of heaven and earth were instantly extracted, turning into threads of silk.
Even though each thread was as thin as a spider’s web, if one was cut by this silk, it was guaranteed that even Venerate Tiers would be instantly split into half.
Instantly, someone understood, and exclaimed in shock, “They were all killed by the threads
of Regulations!”
This would explain why the young man from before, as well as the three Venerate Tiers, had𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
been silently torn into pieces.
However, was there another Saint here?
Everyone turned to look at the red-haired beauty, and then shook their heads in unison.
Putting aside the fact that she was a Saint, even if she was, she was either dead now, or in an extremely sealed state.
How could she possibly make a move?
This was a strange place, and it was far too strange.
Even Venerate Tiers could die so soundlessly, and they were like crops being harvested.
This caused a boundless chill to rise up
in everyone’s hearts.
Obviously, this Blood Tree, or rather this red-haired beauty, was a taboo that could not be
touched.
The Crystal Saint humphed upon hearing this.
He was a member of the Imperial Clan, and in this era where there were no Emperors, what did he have to fear?
He strode forward, with the Imperial Weapon hovering above his head.
It was in a state of awakening at any moment.
He strode forward, and could clearly see that the Regulations of heaven and earth had solidified, forming a complicated three-dimensional network.
The Imperial Weapon was even more terrifying.

the Void, and a terrifying energy surged out.

As it turned out, high-level energy did not exist in this
time and space, but rather in the Void.

This was naturally terrifying.
“You guys, look!” Someone suddenly exclaimed, pointing into the distance, even his voice
trembling.

chapters.title: Chapter 4092: Assault of the Saint Corpses
paragraphs: Chapter 4092: Assault of the Saint Corpses
In the distance, a blood-coloured wall was presently approaching.
No, that was not a wall, but a wave!
The sea suddenly roared, creating a wave that was as tall as three thousand meters, that was presently crashing towards this massive island.
This was hard for everyone to believe. The sudden arrival of the massive wave had nothing to do with what they were doing now.
Just how terrifying were these waves?
It was filled with corrosive power, and even Venerate Tiers would be melted to the point that only their bones would remain. Only Saints would be unafraid.
The Crystal Saint couldn’t help but stop in his tracks. He was unafraid of these waves, but what lay behind these waves made him extremely wary.
Because this was the power of a Great Emperor!
Furthermore, it was suspected that there was another Imperial Weapon here, so he dared not be careless even more.
-This one had been tricked quite seriously.
Of course, he was not afraid either, because he firmly believed that there was no Emperor in this present world!
“Heavens!” A Venerate Tier suddenly exclaimed, and stretched out a finger to point at that massive wave. They saw that it was not something as simple as a wave, and there were
actually multiple figures appearing in the waves.
The Saint corpses!

Peng, the massive wave had already crashed onto this colossal island, shaking the ground madly. Then, that wave began to recede, turning into countless waves, but a terrifying scene was presently happening.
One after another, the corpses of Saints flew over, and then… they opened their eyes!
Dead people opening their eyes?
Everyone was numb with shock. Those who had already died had opened their eyes again. This was already frightening enough, and these dead people were Saints at that. That was even more terrifying.
Weng, weng, weng! Boundless aura surged, enshrouding over.
The Saint corpses didn’t simply open their eyes. Instead, it was as if they had come to life. They radiated with the unique might of Saints.
Heavens, several thousand Saints had appeared at the same time. What kind of concept was that?
The corpses of these Saints were all exuding a piercing killing intent. Though they had opened their eyes, they were all expressionless.
They had long since died!

These Saints came from all kinds of races. There were pure humans, Tiger Tribe, Wolf Tribe, and Snake Tribe. All of them exuded a powerful aura that could suppress heaven and earth. One of them was capable of shattering planets. When there were a few thousand of them, just their aura alone was enough to tear apart the heavens.

The Crystal Saint immediately activated his Imperial Weapon. Although he was a Saint and the most powerful being in the world, he would definitely be obliterated if he were to face several thousand of the most powerful beings.
The Imperial Weapon awakened, and instantly, an indescribable aura circulated, as if an Emperor had descended.
Instantly, everyone knelt down. No one was an exception — aside from Ling Han.
However, those few thousand Saint corpses were completely unafraid, and charged towards him like moths flying into a flame.
Peng, peng, peng!
Even someone as powerful as a Saint was useless. The Imperial Weapon shook slightly, and the Saint corpses that had crashed into it was forcefully shattered into pieces.
Great Emperor, the strongest in the world, and there weren’t any prerequisites.
Everyone raised their heads, only to see the corpses of Saints explode one after another like firecrackers. However, not a single drop of blood splattered. It was as if they were dried corpses.
This was a one-sided “slaughter”. However, the problem was that another massive wave crashed over from the distance, and another few thousand Saint corpses appeared.

The expression of the Crystal Saint changed drastically. Although the Imperial Weapon was invincible, the problem was that he wasn’t a Great Emperor, so he couldn’t activate it endlessly. At most, it would only take a few minutes, and he would be exhausted. By then, what would he do?
Thousands of Saint corpses crashed into him, and even he could only die.
“Retreat! Retreat! Retreat!” he roared loudly. With a wave of his large hand, he had grabbed everyone. Then, the Imperial Weapon cleared the path, turning rapidly, heading back the way it had come.
Xiu, a Saint’s speed was extremely fast, and with the Imperial Weapon leading the way, what else could block it?
The Crystal Saint forcibly carved out a path, but he was also as anxious as a stray dog.

Ling Han looked at the island, and it instantly became a black dot. However, through the eye technique, he could still see the red-haired beauty. He didn’t know if it was an illusion, but he saw that the woman’s eyelids actually twitched!

But when he was about to confirm, whether it was the red-haired beauty or the giant island, they had all disappeared from his field of vision. The only thing that could be seen was the colossal wave that was chasing after them, determined to smash them into pieces. However, a Saint’s speed was far too quick. In just a few hours, they could already see the coastline.
The Crystal Saint didn’t stop. Instead, he continued to advance until he arrived before the entrance. Only then did he descend and loosen his grip. Everyone regained their mobility.
A Saint was really too strong. There were so many Venerate Tiers in his grasp, and not one of them actually managed to break free.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
Of course, at that time, no one really wanted to break free.
“There’s a terrifying background here. If we want to investigate this place, we’ll probably have to work together with the other Imperial Clans and have them bring the Imperial
Weapons over,” the Crystal Saint said.
Everyone nodded.

Though there were no Great Emperors in the world now, and as long as he drew out the Imperial Weapon, it would be enough to sweep aside all opposition, the power of a Saint was inferior to the Ancestral King by who knew how much. There was a limited amount of time that he could keep the Imperial Weapon activated, so how could he possibly withstand the barrage of attacks from tens of thousands of Saint corpses?

Thus, the only way to investigate this place was to gather more members of the Imperial Clans and send out a large number of Saints along with the Imperial Weapons. Then, no matter how many thousands or tens of thousands of Saint corpses you had, they would all be
razed to the ground.

“Let’s go our separate ways.” The Crystal Saint directly tore a rip into space, and left with Chi Menghan and Chi Dao. The area from before was a separate space, and even if they tore it open, they would not be able to leave.
Now that the Saint had left, it was naturally even more impossible for them to enter and take risks. They all tore a rip into space and left.

The Nine Mountains Venerate stayed behind. He had promised to spar with severae Venerate Tiers, and with his status and identity, he naturally wouldn’t go back on his word. Thus, after staying here for close to ten days, the Nine Mountains Venerate finally brought Ling Han back to the Nine Suns Holy Land with him.
Even so, this was still much faster than Ling Han returning by himself.
After receiving the news, the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and the others all came out

to receive him. This parting had taken about a year’s time. Thankfully, they had all come out of the Genesis World, and would often go into seclusion for tens of millions of years. In comparison, a year’s time was only enough for them to take a nap.

The Nine Mountains Venerate started to cultivate in seclusion as soon as he returned. He had gained a lot from the Blood Palace, and he had even obtained the Blood Patterned Dao Stones later. This had been refined by a Great Emperor, so it was extremely beneficial to him. Perhaps, after the Nine Mountains Venerate came out of seclusion, he would become a Saint. Ling Han thought optimistically that his backer would be strong enough. The large black dog had already broken through to the Core Formation Tier. Because he had fused Nine Cauldrons into a single Celestial Cauldron, the first step of the Core Formation Tier was extremely easy for him to complete. However, the empress and Hu Niu were still in Cauldron Forging Tier, and needed to stabilize their cultivation level before they could break
through.

Ling Han divided the Soul Nurturing Stone among them, and told the two women and dog to each take a portion. This could be used immediately after they broke through to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.

He began to pass on what he had learnt. The Nine Styles of the the God of War, the Strange Shadow Steps were all extremely powerful and practical ultimate techniques. However, this peaceful life didn’t last long. On this day, the members of an Imperial Clan
suddenly arrived.
The Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 4093: Unexpected Person
paragraphs: Chapter 4093: Unexpected Person
Ling Han suddenly received a notification. He ran out to take a look, and saw that the atmosphere was extremely tense.
“Ling Han!” A cold voice rang out, bearing deep resentment.
Ling Han looked over. This was a woman, and she was quite beautiful. However, her pretty face was currently twisted with fury.
Di Hailan.
The Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan, the only clan with the surname of ‘Di’.
He, they had finally come looking for him.

Ling Han acted as if he had not seen anything, and merely paid his respects to the Nine Mountains Venerate. Wasn’t this Venerable Tier in seclusion? Yet now, even he had been alerted, which showed that the situation this time was slightly serious.
The Nine Mountains Venerate raised his hand, indicating that there was no need for excessive courtesy.
“My request is very simple. Hand Ling Han over, and I’ll immediately take him away,” an elder said. He was tall and sturdy, and he radiated with an incredibly powerful aura.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled coldly, and said, “When did the Nine Suns Holy Land fall to the point of having someone come to our doors and demanding one of our own?”

The elder was the Venerate Tier elite of the Heavenly Wolf Imperial Clan. His title was Eastern Sea. He raised his white brows and said, “Nine Mountains, do you want to become enemies with the Imperial Clan?”

“You still can’t represent the Imperial Clan!” the Nine Mountains Venerate scoffed. Although the Eastern Sea Venerate and Di Hailan belonged to the Imperial Clan, they weren’t part of the main branch. Rather, they had long since been separated from the main branch.
However, this was the bloodline of a Great Emperor, after all. This bloodline had also produced Saints before, and had left behind a renowned reputation.

Of course, because the Saint had already passed away, this branch of Imperial Clan only had Venerate Tier elites keeping watch. In terms of abilities, they were completely inferior to the Nine Suns Holy Land.

“Very well, you even dare to look down on the Imperial Clan!” the Eastern Sea Venerate said balefully. “Do you really think that just because my branch has left the main branch, it no longer belongs to the Imperial Clan?”
The Nine Mountains Venerate waved his hand dismissively, and said, “Cut the crap and get to the point!”
‘Holy f*ck!’

The Eastern Sea Venerate faltered for a moment. This Nine Mountains Venerate was truly domineering. However, this was also in line with the tradition of the Nine Suns Holy Land. This force was famous for shielding its own people.
“Ling Han killed the son-in-law of our Di Clan. No matter what, he has to give an explanation, right?” he said balefully.

The Nine Mountains Venerable Tier elite, Nine Mountains Venerate, waved his hand, and said, “Ancient sites are searching for treasures, so it’s unavoidable that there would be fights. Isn’t it very normal for there to be casualties and injuries? If someone were to be wounded or killed, his family would have to seek justice, so would everyone still need to cultivate their cultivation techniques? If they seek justice every day, they would have to give an explanation.”

The Eastern Sea Venerate humphed. He seemed to have foreseen that the Nine Mountains Venerate would say this. Thus, he wasn’t angered, and he said, “Fine, I won’t pick on the weak either. Let the two of them fight again!”
Yi, wasn’t this person already dead? How was he supposed to fight? Fight with a ghost?
Not only was Ling Han stunned for a moment, but even the Nine Mountains Venerable Tier elite was slightly surprised. He turned to look at the Eastern Sea Venerable.
The Venerate of the Eastern Sea smiled proudly, “How could the means of our Imperial Clan be something that you can imagine?”
He paused, raised his voice, and called out, “Heaven Step!”
“Fourth great-grandfather!” A young man walked out from behind Di Hailan.
Previously, he had kept his head lowered, so that no one could see his face. Now that he had walked out, he immediately strode forwards with his head held high, exuding an aggressive
aura.
Hong Tianfan, Hong Tianbu.
It was actually Hong Tianfan, Tianbu. He really hadn’t died.
Ling Han found this strange. In the Black Heaven Temple’s Heaven Temple, he had indeed cut Hong Tianjing in half. Why wasn’t this guy dead yet?

That’s right. No wonder he hadn’t seen Di Hailan come to seek revenge. He should have immediately brought Hong Tianbu back to the Imperial Clan Clan with him, and only then did The manage to save him.
Tsk, tsk, tsk. He had survived a great calamity, and this guy was really blessed with good fortune. He had actually advanced into the True Self Tier!
