paragraphs: Chapter 4094: There should be a limit to shamelessness
The True Self Tier against the Core Formation Tier, this should be an absolute one-sided domination.
Thus, even the people of the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have a high opinion of Ling Han at all. They thought that he would definitely die in this battle.
-Aside from the the Nine Mountains Venerate, the empress, and a few others.

They naturally knew that Ling Han was also a Formations Grandmaster, and could draw on the power of the ley lines to support himself. At the very least, he would be able to protect himself. Otherwise, with the Nine Mountains Venerate’s high opinion and love for Ling Han, would he deliberately screw Ling Han over?

Of course, Lu Qi smiled in satisfaction. He had been anticipating this day for a long time. It was a shame that he couldn’t kill Ling Han himself. This made him feel slightly regretful. Meanwhile, Song Lan looked nervous, her slender hands involuntarily clenching into fists. Seeing this beauty ranked ninth in the galaxy so concerned about a man, many people instantly looked jealous.

Prosperous Heaven’s expression was slightly strange. She already knew that Ling Han had killed Shi Yongming, so she was naturally more optimistic about Ling Han’s talent. However, the key was that Ling Han was too good at causing trouble, causing her to begin to hesitate. Would this bring great trouble to the Buddhist Race of the North Heavenly Realm?

Hong Tianbu strode forwards. He didn’t need to soar into the skies. The Nine Suns Holy Land was continuously strengthened by generations of elites. If this place wasn’t able to withstand even True Self Tier-level battle prowess, then others would really be laughing their heads off. “Farewell!” he said calmly, and finally made his move.

Weng, he sent out a palm strike lightly, but endless power of heaven and earth surged out, turning into a giant hand that was like white jade. Multiple veined patterns could be seen glowing. That was the profound will of heaven and earth.
This was the strength of the True Self Tier. He could stimulate the Regulations of heaven and earth, and the power of the attacks he delivered would form a qualitative change.
Crushing all Core Formation Tiers!
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t face this attack head-on. He activated the Imminent Skyline and quickly dodged. He then unleashed a murderous aura attack at Hong Tianbu.
“Humph!” A crack appeared on Hong Tianbu’s forehead, and he similarly exuded a terrifying murderous aura, blocking the murderous aura.

“Don’t forget, my fated opportunity is not inferior to yours!” he declared proudly. The Primordial Beast’s eye could be considered a supreme treasure, far surpassing his present cultivation level, “Speaking of which, I still have to thank you. Because you have defeated it, in order to protect the life of a host like me, this eye has now fallen truly under my control.”
As he said this, a ray of light shot out from Hong Tianbu’s forehead. It was incredibly fast, and there was no way for him to dodge at all. It shot onto Ling Han.

“Haha, die!” He charged over, and after being shot by the Primordial Beast’s eye, his body would instantly turn to stone. He only had to calmly follow up with another attack, and he would be able to easily take Ling Han’s life.
It was too simple. Under the crushing pressure of a major tier, even if you were a supreme prodigy, so what? It was guaranteed that you would die completely.

Peng, as expected, with a palm strike, Ling Han was instantly turned into a shower of blood. Hong Tianbu retracted his hand and stood, laughing loudly. However, at the same time, he also felt some regret. It could be said that he had hated this opponent for many years, but he had killed him all of a sudden, which made him feel like his hatred had not been vented.

However, it was good that he was dead. This was a matter of the past, after all. However, in the eyes of the masses, Hong Tianbu had suddenly become mad. He blasted randomly at the air, and then revealed expressions of disdain.
Er, what are you so proud of?
Could this ideal son-in-law of the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan be a little out of his mind? He actually dared to come out and embarrass himself!
Faced with this scene, the Eastern Sea Venerate also revealed a hint of anger. Why was Hong Tianbu so unreliable at this moment?

In truth, he also had a very high opinion of Hong Tianbu. In fact, he had even thought of going to the main branch to ask for a Saint-level Great Herb to treat Hong Tianbu and remove all of his hidden ailments – of course, he could not possibly ask for the whole Saint-level Great Herb, but if it was just a small portion, there would be no problem.
But now, Hong Tianbu was actually behaving in such an unbearable manner, which caused anger to rise up in his heart. Was there any need to nurture this kind of guy who would go mad?

However, Venerate Tier elites were Venerate Tier elites, after all, so their eyes were naturally sharp. The more he looked, the more he felt that something was off. Then, he suddenly came to a realization. It was not that Hong Tianbu had gone mad, but he had been affected by Ling Han’s illusion technique.

Impressive, being able to affect his opponent with a gap of a major cultivation level. Even he had not been able to tell at the first instant. In fact, he had not even seen Ling Han make a move. What kind of illusion was this?
“Tianbu, don’t be careless!” He opened his mouth and shouted loudly. As he spoke, a sliver of divine sense also shot into Hong Tianbu’s mind.
The Venerate Tier was too powerful. This sliver of divine sense entered into his mind, and immediately destroyed the illusion as easily as crushing dry weeds and smashing rotten wood.
Hong Tianbu faltered for a moment before coming to his senses. He couldn’t help but reveal a humiliated and furious expression.
He had the advantage of a major tier over Ling Han, yet his mind had actually been affected by Ling Han?
This was a great humiliation!
In a battle of True Self Tier against Core Formation Tier, he was actually unable to decide the battle with a single strike, and was instead bewitched?
“Die!” he roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.

Ling Han smiled slightly. The black light of illusion activated, and who cares if you were prepared or not. This was the celestial light that he had obtained from the Black Heaven Temple. Being worthy of the notice of Pseudo-Emperor Doga, how could it be bad?
Hong Tianbu was immediately hit again, and began his performance.

The Eastern Sea Venerate was just about to move again, yet he suddenly saw a gust of wind from a palm strike sweep over. There was an endless power of Regulation, and even he had no choice but to deal with it carefully. Hurriedly, he retreated, and naturally had no more time to deal with it for Hong Tianbu.
The Nine Mountains Venerate withdrew his palm, and said calmly, “There’s a limit to shamelessness!”

The Eastern Sea Venerate’s chest rose and fell in fury, but he had indeed interfered in the battle between two juniors. Originally, if the Nine Mountains Venerate acted as if he didn’t know, then everyone would be fooled, but after he was exposed, his expression naturally
became ugly.
Most importantly, some people had even activated Galaxy Network’s livestream!
As a Venerate Tier elite of the Imperial Clan, he actually interfered in the battle between two juniors. Moreover, he had been exposed in public. How humiliating.

He humphed, and crossed his arms behind his back. By now, he finally knew that the Nine Mountains Venerate had no intention of compromising at all, but rather knew that Ling Han had a way to oppose the True Self Tier.
This was boosting Ling Han’s popularity.

Previously, Ling Han had killed Core Formation Tier when he had been in Cauldron Forging Tier. Now, in the Core Formation Tier, and even only in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier at that, he could match the True Self Tier. This naturally caused Ling Han’s reputation to rise greatly. Probably, a considerable number of Imperial Clans would come over to fight over
this son-in-law, right?
“Fourth great-grandfather!” Di Hailan said worriedly.

“It’s fine!” The Eastern Sea Venerate waved his hand, “That brat only has one illusion technique, no matter how hard he tries. Though this can affect Tianbu, the instincts of Tianbu are still present. When he encounters danger, he would naturally counterattack. With the advantage that Tianbu has of a major tier in cultivation level, he would be able to easily kill𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
that brat.”
Hearing his words, Di Hailan instantly looked relieved.
Eastern Sea Venerate paused for a moment, then continued, “Furthermore, Tianbu is also a
supreme prodigy, and also has the advantage of a major tier in cultivation level. The effects of illusions on him would become smaller and smaller, until they disappear, and by then…
hehe.”
Needless to say, if a True Self Tier cultivator could go all out, what Core Formation Tier cultivator would be able to survive?

chapters.title: Chapter 4095: Shocking the galaxy
paragraphs: Chapter 4095: Shocking the galaxy
This sparring match of the Nine Suns Holy Land was broadcasted live through Galaxy Network and spread throughout the entire universe.

Originally, this was only a battle between juniors, and could not possibly attract the attention of mighty figures. However, one side had a Core Formation Tier, while the other side had e True Self Tier. Furthermore, it was the side of the Core Formation Tier that was on the upper hand now. This was a different story.
More and more people were paying attention to this battle, and in the discussion area below the livestream, it was even livelier.
“It can’t be, right? A True Self Tier cultivator is actually unable to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator? Hehe, allow me to laugh for five minutes first,” a newcomer said.
“Hehe, then just laugh for an hour. There really is such an inconceivable thing.”
“Hey, hey, hey, is there really such an inconceivable thing?”
“Of course.”
“Yi, this guy is Ling Han!”
“That’s right. He’s the guy who’s still alive and kicking even though he’s being hunted by the Battle God Palace.”

“No wonder the Battle God Palace couldn’t kill him. As a Core Formation Tier, he is able to stand against a True Self Tier, and the Battle God Palace would have to send out Spirit Transformation Tier assassins to succeed.”

“However, Ling Han’s battle prowess isn’t on par with the True Self Tier. Rather, it’s because he possesses a precious tool or some secret technique that can create illusions and bewitch the True Self Tier.”
“If it’s an illusion, it can’t last for long. There will always be a way to resolve it.”
“That’s right. At that time, how would Ling Han be able to block him?”
A unanimous conclusion was reached on the Galaxy Network, and that was when Hong Tianbu solved the problem of the illusion, that would be the instant of Ling Han’s defeat.
Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Big Sister, Big Sister, Big Sister!” Chi Mengshan ran over energetically, “Look at Galaxy Network’s livestream. My brother-in-law is currently fighting with a True Self Tier.”

Chi Menghan’s pretty face immediately darkened. At this moment, she was no longer wearing a white veil, revealing an extremely beautiful face. She was definitely not inferior to the red- haired beauty on the island of the sea of blood. She was indeed worthy of being called the third most beautiful woman in the galaxy. In fact, she was completely qualified to be called the number one beauty in the galaxy.
She glared at him, and said, “What nonsense are you spouting!”
“Yi, didn’t you dual cultivate with that guy? What is it? You’ve already been devoured, yet you don’t even get a title?” Chi Mengshan asked, her eyes wideR.
F***, this damn child!
Chi Menghan immediately delivered a harsh knock, instantly causing Chi Mengshan to grab her head and cry out in pain.

“Chi Menghan, just because you were born a few years earlier than me, your cultivation level is higher than mine. You keep bullying me!” the little girl shouted. “Just you wait. When my cultivation level catches up to you, I’ll immediately marry you off!”
Chi Menghan was rendered speechless. Were they really born from the same parents? Why were their personalities so different?
However, Ling Han was battling a True Self Tier cultivator?
She couldn’t help but help but be moved. She summoned a servant, and had him connect to the Galaxy Network, then project the live broadcast.
-If Ling Han was here, he would definitely be puzzled. Why didn’t the Imperial Clan use Galaxy Network? It was obviously so useful.
Seeing Ling Han toy around with Hong Tianbu with his illusions, she couldn’t help but smile, bright and beautiful.
“Sister, are you really moved?” Chi Mengshan asked softly from the sidelines. She was a mischievous little girl.

“Don’t spout nonsense,” Chi Menghan rebuked. She only admired this young man very much, and indeed had the idea of taking Ling Han into the Donglin Imperial Clan. However, it was definitely impossible that she would be the one to “marry” him.
She had great aspirations, and wanted to break through to the Imperial Path. She had not considered romantic matters at all.

Chi Mengshan cocked her head and pondered for a moment. Then, she suddenly reached over and wrapped her arms around Chi Menghan’s back. At the same time, she continued to grope Chi Menghan, saying, “Chi Menghan’s breasts are already so big, so she can finally get married!”
‘Fall!’

Hong Tianbu was a prodigy, after all. Moreover, he had the advantage of a major tier in cultivation level, and he also had the Primordial Beast’s eye inside him. Thus, the time that the illusion could take effect on him was becoming shorter and shorter.
At first, the illusion could last for about half a minute, but very soon, it became twenty seconds, ten seconds, and finally, there were only two or three seconds left.

However, the black light of illusion was also overwhelmingly awesome. Even if Hong Tianbu had already been hit many times, it was still effective. However, the time limit was only two seconds or so, but it didn’t decrease any further.

However, once the number of times increased, the pattern of the black light of illusion on Ling Han’s Celestial Core would become dimmer and dimmer. When it completely dimmed, it could no longer be used.
After all, this was not a celestial technique that he had cultivated himself.
They couldn’t play any longer.
That’s right, Ling Han was just playing around.

“Ling Han!” Hong Tianbu roared in fury. In just a short while, he had already fallen into dozens of illusions, experiencing the ups and downs of life. Sometimes, he would become successful in illusions, but at other times, his parents, children, and grandchildren would all die, and he would become a jinx that would cause the deaths of all those around him. Thus, he alternated between laughing and crying, appearing extremely disheveled. He had powerful strength, yet was unable to use it fully. Who could understand this kind of helplessness?
“Die!” He leaped up high, and Regulations materialized, forming into a God Tool that stabbed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t move or dodge, and he simply crossed his arms behind his back. His
demeanor was as lofty as could be.
“What!”
“He actually didn’t dodge!”
“Hiss, Hong Tianbu wasn’t affected by an illusion this time!”
“Furthermore, this attack has already been launched. Even if Hong Tianbu is under the effects
of an illusion, he should still be able to attack directly. With the battle prowess of a True Self
Tier, he would still be able to easily kill him.”
“Sigh, he’s too conceited.”
“Does he really think that he can rival those at the True Self Tier just by relying on illusion
techniques?”
“Childish!”
On the Galaxy Network, countless people also witnessed this scene in real time. They all shook their heads, thinking that Ling Han was definitely going to die.
However, when Hong Tianbu’s attack landed, boom, an Earth Qi surged out and turned into a
furious dragon.
Peng!

Hong Tianbu’s attack instantly landed on the Earth Dragon. Although he had just broken through to the True Self Tier, his battle prowess surpassed that of ordinary cultivators at the early stage of the True Self Tier. With this attack, the Earth Dragon instantly shattered, no longer able to withstand a single blow from him.
However, after this exchange, the might of his attack had mostly dissipated. Ling Han shot out a punch, and instantly dispersed this burst of power from Hong Tianbu.
‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone was shocked speechless. This time, Ling Han didn’t use any illusion techniques, but rather blocked Hong Tianbu’s attack head-on.
Heavens, how could this be possible!
A Core Formation Tier cultivator actually had the ability to face a True Self Tier cultivator
head-on?
Furthermore, looking at how Ling Han was acting, he was really too relaxed. It was as if he was the True Self Tier, easily dispersing the attack of a Core Formation Tier.
“I know!” someone said. “That’s Earth Qi!”
“What, Earth Qi?”
“That’s right, Earth Qi. Every planet has ley lines, and within the ley lines, there is Earth Qi, which is actually heaven and earth energy. However, only Formations Grandmasters can use
it.”
“Hiss, what you mean is that Ling Han is actually a Formations Grandmaster?”
“Precisely.”
The Galaxy Network was in an uproar, and quite a number of people were grabbing their
heads, exclaiming in disbelief.
Ling Han was a genius of martial arts, freakish to the point of being freakish, but it was this
kind of freak that was actually a Formations Grandmaster!
Would you let others live?
Hong Tianbu was also taken aback. He stared blankly at Ling Han, his eyes filled with shock
and confusion.
Ling Han was actually a Formations Grandmaster!
‘Holy f*ck!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4096: Retreating
paragraphs: Chapter 4096: Retreating

Hong Tianbu had also studied formation techniques before, but this was only limited to the mortal level. After stepping onto the Celestial Path, formation techniques were far too time- consuming, and they also required the support of powerful Spiritual Power. Thus, he placed all of his focus on cultivation.
Even so, he still felt that there was not enough time, but what about Ling Han?
Comparisons would drive one crazy.
He was not willing to accept this, nor could he accept that the gap between the two of them would be so overwhelmingly wide.
“Die! Die! Die!” His fighting spirit was completely ignited. At this moment, he only had one thought, and that was to kill Ling Han.
Once Ling Han died, all the humiliation he had suffered would disappear without a trace, and no matter how outstanding Ling Han was, he would only become a piece of history.
Ling Han was calm and unperturbed. He extracted the Earth Qi and transformed it into the Earth Dragon.
And this time, the two Earth Dragons appeared at the same time.

Even if Hong Tianbu was stronger than the average True Self Tier cultivator, so what? It was impossible for him to destroy two Earth Dragons in one go. Instead, he was countered by the Earth Dragons, which made him feel extremely terrible.
The expressions of the Eastern Sea Venerate and Di Hailan were both extremely terrible. This was a scene that they could never have imagined.
A dignified True Self Tier cultivator couldn’t do anything to a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and even showed signs of being counter-suppressed.
This was a fantasy story.

It wasn’t that Hong Tianbu was too weak-no matter how weak a True Self Tier cultivator was, he was still a True Self Tier cultivator. He could crush a Core Formation Tier cultivator single-handedly, but Ling Han was too freakish. He was actually a Formations Grandmaster, an existence that could match a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator.

Thus, it wouldn’t be strange for Hong Tianbu to be blocked, or even defeated in fact. If it weren’t for the fact that Ling Han was still limited by his own cultivation level and unable to fully unleash his powerful spiritual power, he could have even insta-killed Hong Tianbu with a single strike.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Hong Tianbu continued to attack, yet he was completely unable to break through the Earth Dragons’ blockade. Under Ling Han’s control, five Earth Dragons appeared at the same time, launching attacks at Hong Tianbu.
Five Earth Dragons!

This was equivalent to five True Self Tier cultivators. Even if Hong Tianbu was quite extraordinary, he was still someone who had damaged his foundations, after all. Forcibly breaking through to True Self Tier would definitely lead to an evil consequence that his battle prowess at the same cultivation level was not strong enough.
Thus, when all five Earth Dragons appeared at the same time, he would not be able to hold on any longer.
He was outmatched!
He was overcome with grief. He was a dignified True Self Tier cultivator, yet he was no match for a Core Formation Tier cultivator. He had lost all face.
However, defeat was still better than being defeated and dying.

Hong Tianbu was already thinking of retreating. He knew that after retreating, he would no longer have the chance to defeat Ling Han. However, if he didn’t retreat, he would die. He naturally didn’t want to die even more.
However, Ling Han had no intention of sparing Hong Tianbu’s life.
-You have come to kill me, so you must be prepared to die as well.
He shot out the black light of illusion, and Hong Tianbu immediately fell into an illusion. Then, the five Earth Dragons took advantage of the opening to attack him.

The disadvantage of the Earth Dragon was that it was not agile. Against a real True Self Tier, it would only be effective for defense, but if it wanted to hurt someone… the latter would just have to dodge, which was very easy.
However, the Earth Dragon added with the black light of illusion was a completely different story.
Two seconds, wasn’t that enough time for the Earth Dragons to completely outflank their target?

When Hong Tianbu broke free from the illusion, he had to face the mad barrage of attacks from the five Earth Dragons, forcing him to use his trump card, and use the Primordial Beast’s eye to petrify and shatter the Earth Dragons.

But the problem was that the Earth Dragons were only formed from Earth Qi, and did not have any life. So be it if they exploded. Ling Han could easily create another Earth Dragon, and his attacks would not stop at all.

At the risk of sustaining some injuries, Hong Tianbu forcefully barged out of the Earth Dragons’ encirclement. However, the black light of illusion attacked, and he once again fell into the illusion. When he struggled free, he was once again surrounded by the Earth Dragons. In everyone’s eyes, Ling Han didn’t need to do it himself. He could simply summon the Earth Dragons and deal with Hong Tianbu.
Who could compare to such a prodigy?

“Sister, just marry him. I don’t think this kind of brother-in-law can be found no matter how hard you try.” Among the members of the Donglin Imperial Clan, the mischievous Chi Mengshan began to persuade again. Seeing that Chi Menghan didn’t answer her at all, she placed her hands on her hips, and said, “Let me tell you, Chi Menghan, if I weren’t too young, I wouldn’t have given such a good man to you!”
Chi Menghan placed a hand on her forehead, feeling a headache coming on. Why was this little sister of hers giving her such a headache?
‘Can’t you act like a little girl in her teens? Why are you so mature?!’
The Eastern Sea Venerate frowned. He couldn’t sit by and watch any longer. Otherwise, Hong Tianbu would definitely die.
However, just as he was about to make a move, he saw the Nine Mountains Venerate had
already stepped in front of him.
“Nine Mountains, move aside!” he declared darkly.
“What a joke. This is my territory, and you think you’re worthy of shouting here?” Nine Mountains Venerate said coldly.
“Heng, if Hong Tianbu dies, I definitely won’t let the matter go!” the Eastern Sea Venerate
threatened.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
En, are you trying to scare me?

The Nine Mountains Venerate directly summoned the Nine Suns Parasol. Although the Saint Tool hadn’t awakened, merely a sliver of saintly might circulated, which was enough to give a Venerate Tier a headache.
‘F*** you!’
The Eastern Sea Venerate was completely dumbfounded at this moment. ‘I’ve only said one word, and you’ve already taken out the Saint Tool. Is that appropriate?’
He was protective of his own people, but compared with Nine Mountains Venerate, the two of them weren’t on the same level at all.
“Just obediently stay there. Otherwise, I won’t mind detaining you here forever,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said calmly. However, his tone was extremely firm.
The Eastern Sea Venerate was rendered speechless, and could only tremble in fury. Return to the main branch and ask the Saint to bring the Imperial Weapon to flatten this
place?

What a joke; even Imperial Clan elites couldn’t act recklessly. Even if they mobilized an Imperial Weapon, they would have to be reasonable and justified – oh, you, a True Self Tier elite, bullied a Core Formation Tier. You didn’t win and were killed, yet you still want a Saint to take out an Imperial Weapon to avenge you. If word got out, wouldn’t you be laughed at by
others?
In the whole universe, the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan was not the only Imperial Clan. The Imperial Clan could not do as they liked, simply suppressing all negative public opinion.
“Fourth great-grandfather!” Di Hailan was getting anxious. Hong Tianjin’s situation was getting worse and worse.

“Shut up!” the Eastern Sea Venerate shouted. He then looked at the Nine Mountains Venerate and said, “Fine, I admit defeat. I can guarantee that the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan will never cause trouble for this brat again.”

Yet the Nine Mountains Venerate scoffed, and said, “If you want to target that brat, just make your move. Without experiencing some hardships, how could that brat be able to grow? However, this battle must be fought to the end!”
‘F*ck! I’ve never seen anyone like you before. How can you be so shameless?’
This was a member of the Imperial Clan; did they really think that they were so easily
offended?

However, the Nine Mountains Venerate had already made his stand clear. The Saint Tool was also on the verge of awakening at any moment, and the Eastern Sea Venerate didn’t dare to provoke it at all. Otherwise, he would definitely die here today.
To be killed by a Saint Tool, there was definitely no way he could be saved.
His eyes were spitting fire, while his hands were tightly clenched. “Nine Mountains, are you planning to push the Nine Suns Holy Land into a fire pit?”
“What a joke, this is a ‘fair’ battle. What is it? Does your Di Clan have any objections?” The Nine Mountains Venerate said calmly, not feeling threatened at all.
“Good! Good! Good!” The Eastern Sea Venerate said good three times. He had already decided
that after this, he would go to the main branch. No matter what, he had to ask an Imperial Son
to come out and kill Ling Han.
In a fair battle, so there would be no argument!

Two seconds, wasn’t that enough time for the Earth Dragons to completely outflank their target?

When Hong Tianbu broke free from the illusion, he had to face the mad barrage of attacks from the five Earth Dragons, forcing him to use his trump card, and use the Primordial Beast’s eye to petrify and shatter the Earth Dragons.
But the problem was that the Earth Dragons were only formed from Earth Qi, and did not have any life.
So be it if they exploded.
Ling Han could easily create another Earth Dragon, and his attacks would not stop at all.
At the risk of sustaining some injuries, Hong Tianbu forcefully barged out of the Earth Dragons’ encirclement.
However, the black light of illusion attacked, and he once again fell into the illusion.
When he struggled free, he was once again surrounded by the Earth Dragons.
In everyone’s eyes, Ling Han didn’t need to do it himself.
He could simply summon the Earth Dragons and deal with Hong Tianbu.
Who could compare to such a prodigy?
“Sister, just marry him.
I don’t think this kind of brother-in-law can be found no matter how hard you try.” Among the members of the Donglin Imperial Clan, the mischievous Chi Mengshan began to persuade again.
Seeing that Chi Menghan didn’t answer her at all, she placed her hands on her hips, and said, “Let me tell you, Chi Menghan, if I weren’t too young, I wouldn’t have given such a good man to you!”
Chi Menghan placed a hand on her forehead, feeling a headache coming on.
Why was this little sister of hers giving her such a headache?
‘Can’t you act like a little girl in her teens?
Why are you so mature?!’
The Eastern Sea Venerate frowned.
He couldn’t sit by and watch any longer.
Otherwise, Hong Tianbu would definitely die.
However, just as he was about to make a move, he saw the Nine Mountains Venerate had
already stepped in front of him.
“Nine Mountains, move aside!” he declared darkly.
“What a joke.
This is my territory, and you think you’re worthy of shouting here?” Nine Mountains Venerate said coldly.
“Heng, if Hong Tianbu dies, I definitely won’t let the matter go!” the Eastern Sea Venerate
threatened.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
En, are you trying to scare me?
The Nine Mountains Venerate directly summoned the Nine Suns Parasol.
Although the Saint Tool hadn’t awakened, merely a sliver of saintly might circulated, which was enough to give a Venerate Tier a headache.
‘F*** you!’
The Eastern Sea Venerate was completely dumbfounded at this moment. ‘I’ve only said one word, and you’ve already taken out the Saint Tool.
Is that appropriate?’
He was protective of his own people, but compared with Nine Mountains Venerate, the two of them weren’t on the same level at all.
“Just obediently stay there.
Otherwise, I won’t mind detaining you here forever,” the Nine Mountains Venerate said calmly.
However, his tone was extremely firm.
The Eastern Sea Venerate was rendered speechless, and could only tremble in fury.
Return to the main branch and ask the Saint to bring the Imperial Weapon to flatten this
place?
What a joke; even Imperial Clan elites couldn’t act recklessly.
Even if they mobilized an Imperial Weapon, they would have to be reasonable and justified – oh, you, a True Self Tier elite, bullied a Core Formation Tier.
You didn’t win and were killed, yet you still want a Saint to take out an Imperial Weapon to avenge you.
If word got out, wouldn’t you be laughed at by
others?
In the whole universe, the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan was not the only Imperial Clan.
The Imperial Clan could not do as they liked, simply suppressing all negative public opinion.
“Fourth great-grandfather!” Di Hailan was getting anxious.
Hong Tianjin’s situation was getting worse and worse.
“Shut up!” the Eastern Sea Venerate shouted.
He then looked at the Nine Mountains Venerate and said, “Fine, I admit defeat.
I can guarantee that the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan will never cause trouble for this brat again.”
Yet the Nine Mountains Venerate scoffed, and said, “If you want to target that brat, just make your move.
Without experiencing some hardships, how could that brat be able to grow?
However, this battle must be fought to the end!”
‘F*ck!
I’ve never seen anyone like you before.
How can you be so shameless?’
This was a member of the Imperial Clan; did they really think that they were so easily
offended?
However, the Nine Mountains Venerate had already made his stand clear.
The Saint Tool was also on the verge of awakening at any moment, and the Eastern Sea Venerate didn’t dare to provoke it at all.
Otherwise, he would definitely die here today.
To be killed by a Saint Tool, there was definitely no way he could be saved.
His eyes were spitting fire, while his hands were tightly clenched.
“Nine Mountains, are you planning to push the Nine Suns Holy Land into a fire pit?”
“What a joke, this is a ‘fair’ battle.
What is it?
Does your Di Clan have any objections?” The Nine Mountains Venerate said calmly, not feeling threatened at all.
“Good!
Good!
Good!” The Eastern Sea Venerate said good three times.
He had already decided
that after this, he would go to the main branch.
No matter what, he had to ask an Imperial Son
to come out and kill Ling Han.
In a fair battle, so there would be no argument!

chapters.title: Chapter 4097: Killed
paragraphs: Chapter 4097: Killed
Hong Tianbu was filled with utter despair.

His retreat was fruitless, so he placed his hopes on the Eastern Sea Venerate. Thus, he naturally heard the conversation between the Eastern Sea Venerate and the Nine Mountains Venerate. The two Venerates had absolutely no intention of concealing their conversation.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
The Eastern Sea Venerate could not make a move, and he was also trapped, so he could only fight all out. The result of fighting all out… was naturally death.
He didn’t want to die, and he more so didn’t want to die in Ling Han’s hands. This was the greatest opponent he had faced in his entire life. He would truly die with remaining grievances.
But so what? Under the frenzied barrage of attacks from the five Earth Dragons, he could only parry. Furthermore, he was still unable to parry, and could do nothing at all.
The injuries on his body were also getting more and more serious, continuously spurting out blood. In some places, even his bones were revealed, and his appearance was too horrible to look at.
He was already going all out, extracting the Regulations of heaven and earth, turning them into his strongest attack.

With such might, if it landed on Ling Han, then even with the strength of Ling Han’s physique, and with the Primal Chaos Celestial Core being able to disperse the power that he was hit with, even if he did not die, he would still be severely injured.
But the problem now was that he did not have the chance to hit Ling Han at all.
This, he really could only wait for death.

“Tianbu! Tianbu!” Di Hailan shouted from the sidelines, but she also knew that she would be of no help at all if she just called out like this. Thus, she looked at Ling Han, and said, “If you dare to kill Tianbu, I will capture all your family and friends, and kill them one by one in front of you, and then kill you!”
A powerful killing intent instantly rose up in Ling Han’s heart. This was his reverse scale, and touching it would result in death.
You want to kill my family and friends?
Then I’ll kill you first!

Ling Han summoned another five Earth Dragons. In the previous battle, he had already revealed his ability to summon ten Earth Dragons at the same time. Thus, he was not afraid of others finding out now. In any case, his true trump card was as many as sixteen.
Hong Tianbu couldn’t even withstand five Earth Dragons, let alone ten.
He was completely outmatched, and was blasted into smithereens.
This time, he had really died, and there was no longer the slightest possibility of revival.

“Tianbu—” Di Hailan released a shrill cry. She really liked Hong Tianbu. Otherwise, with her identity as a member of the Imperial Clan, how could she have married a person with no background like Hong Tianbu?
“Good! Good! Good!” The Eastern Sea Venerate’s aged face was livid, “Nine Mountains, you will definitely regret what happened today!”
“Farewell!” The Nine Mountains Venerate said calmly.
With a wave of his hand, the Eastern Sea Venerate grabbed Di Hailan and tore a rip into the Void.
The Nine Mountains Venerate smiled at Ling Han. He was extremely satisfied with this disciple.

Just ask the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the world. Which one of them could counterattack and kill a True Self Tier cultivator in the Core Formation Tier? Especially when Ling Han was only in the late stage of Core Formation Tier.
“Don’t be arrogant and don’t be proud. Focus on cultivating, and strive to advance into the True Self Tier as soon as possible,” he said.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

“Go on.” The Nine Mountains Venerate waved his hand, and took the lead to leave. He had been in seclusion at first, and had been awakened by the aura of a Venerate Tier. Now that the opponent was defeated, he naturally had to return to continue his seclusion.
If he could become a Saint, he would become Ling Han’s sturdiest support, and assist this strongest disciple in breaking through to the Imperial Path.
The crowd dispersed, but they were still discussing spiritedly. Meanwhile, it was as if Lu Qi had been beaten, and he looked extremely despondent.
Was it really that difficult to kill a Core Formation Tier late stage cultivator?

Ling Han returned in a flash, and continued to teach the secret techniques of the Battle God Palace to the two women and the large black dog. However, only a few days later, the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm also sent someone over, and made the same request, demanding that the Nine Suns Holy Land hand over Ling Han.
This time, the Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t even show himself. Several Sect Master elites aggressively rebuked the people from the Buddhist Race.

It couldn’t be helped. The Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm could only be considered a Holy Land, at most. With how Nine Suns Holy Land had always been assertive, how could they possibly admit defeat?

When the news spread out, it naturally caused another round of heated discussions on the Galaxy Network. They both admired Ling Han’s ability to cause trouble, and at the same time, praised the Nine Yang Holy Land for protecting their disciple.
Ling Han didn’t care too much. After the his lessons ended, he couldn’t sit still any longer.
The late stage of the Core Formation Tier wasn’t cultivated in seclusion.
He had to obtain more high-level Spirit Diagrams, extract the Regulations of heaven and earth from them, and brand them onto the Celestial Core, completing this stage of cultivation.

Of course, theoretically speaking, one could break through with just Three Inscriptions. By now, Ling Han had already reached Five Inscriptions. In fact, he was already qualified to advance to the fourth stage of the Core Formation Tier, the Liquefied Gold Core, to lay the foundations for the True Self Tier.
However, if he broke through now, it would be too much of a waste.
Ling Han was someone who was going to attempt breaking through to the Imperial Path, so he naturally had to cultivate every cultivation level to perfection.
There were indeed Spirit Diagrams sold on the Galaxy Network, but their level was too low. There was absolutely no way that Ling Han would waste the space on his Celestial Core.
Thus, if he wanted to obtain a high-level Spirit Diagram, he could only go out.

The Nine Mountains Venerate was willing to open up the Spirit Diagrams of the Holy Land to Ling Han, but not one of them was Great Emperor Tier-level. Though Ling Han had learnt it, he was not in a rush to break through now, so he just left it for now. However, if he didn’t have a target, he couldn’t just run around randomly, right?
Though Ling Han was very awesome, he was only a Core Formation Tier, after all, and the opponents that he had provoked… there were already two Imperial Clans alone.
He checked on the Galaxy Network every day to see if any ancient site had appeared. There was definitely, but the level was too low. They didn’t even have Sect Master-level, so they
definitely wouldn’t attract him.
However, another few days passed, and finally, a big piece of news spread out.
The True Dragon Abyss was about to open!
The entire world was in an uproar. Even the Imperial Clans couldn’t remain calm.
Why? Were there some supreme precious treasures hidden here?
It could be said that there was, but it could also be said that there wasn’t.

That was because what they were fighting over in the True Dragon Abyss was not treasures in the traditional sense, cultivation techniques, celestial techniques, but rather… fortune! Fortune was something that could not be grasped, but it did indeed exist.
For example, if you faced a choice at a crossroads, that could lead you to hell, or it could lead
you to heaven.
Those with great fortune would subconsciously make the most beneficial choice.
Moreover, this fortune was not only applicable to individuals. In fact, it could even benefit the
sects and clans.

For sects or forces that were flourishing with fortune, there would be prodigies joining them, and freakish prodigies emerging. They were destined to rise up, and no matter what, they could not be stopped.

Additionally, one would only need to cultivate earnestly to become a Venerate, but becoming a Saint would definitely need fortune, and becoming an Emperor would also need to gather the great fortune of heaven and earth.
In the True Dragon Abyss, there was the True Dragon of Fortune. Those who obtained it could increase the fortune of themselves and the force behind them, and would be favoured by heaven and earth.
When Ling Han found out, he hurriedly investigated the exact situation of the True Dragon
Abyss.

Every time the True Dragon Abyss opened, there would be six True Dragons of Fortune, which belonged to the six cultivation levels from Foundation Building Tier to Minor Advanced Tier. Meanwhile, cultivators could only enter into the area corresponding to their cultivation level, and whether one could obtain the True Dragons of Fortune would depend on one’s abilities
and natural talent.
Was there… a Spirit Diagram inside?
Ling Han thought. However, whether there was a Spirit Diagram or not, this trip was
obviously necessary.
The Nine Mountains Venerate supported him so much. He naturally had to do something for
the Nine Suns Holy Land. Furthermore, the True Dragon of Fortune was also greatly beneficial for Ling Han. Merely for this reason, he had to go.

chapters.title: Chapter 4098: True Dragon Abyss
paragraphs: Chapter 4098: True Dragon Abyss
Deciding to go was one matter, but how to go was another matter.
Though Ling Han never admitted it, in truth, there were indeed a great many forces that wanted to get rid of him.

There were some that truly had enmity with him, such as the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan and the Buddhist Sect of the West Heavenly Realm. There were also those that actually did not have any enmity with him. They were only wary of his talent, and wanted to kill him.

There had been no Emperor in the world for tens of millions of years. Theoretically speaking, the door to becoming an Emperor had already been opened. Any prodigy would be qualified to attempt it, and a freakish guy like Ling Han… would drive a great many people to despair.
Killing Ling Han was equivalent to eliminating a powerful competitor for their own juniors. He was sure that there would be a great many elites willing to make a move.
Thus, Ling Han had to take it easy.

“There are a total of six True Dragons of Fortune in the True Dragon Abyss, so it’s also divided into six regions, corresponding to the six cultivation levels from Foundation Building Tier to Minor Advanced Tier.
“In other words, Sect Master elites will also participate. Thankfully, I won’t clash with them head-on. Otherwise, no matter how lucky I am, if I want to compete with them, the
possibility of me being killed would definitely be higher.”

“The large black dog and I are in the Core Formation Tier. Of course, we’re entering the territory of the Core Formation Tier. Luan Xing and Hu Niu are still in the Cauldron Forging Tier, so if we go to the True Dragon Abyss, we’ll definitely be separated.”

“En, they are both Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, and have also mastered a considerable number of Imperial Techniques and Saint Techniques. Even against an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, they may not be at a disadvantage.”

“Moreover, it’s said that the True Dragon Abyss also contains Great Herbs, as well as inheritances left behind by predecessors. Even if one can’t obtain the True Dragon of Fortune, there are still many benefits.”
Ling Han discussed with the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog, and decided to set out immediately.

This kind of great fortune was definitely not something that could be obtained through hard cultivation. Something like fortune was bestowed by the heavens. If one missed it, it was possible that he would never be able to obtain it again.
Ling Han communicated with the ley lines, and with a twist of Earth Qi, they had already arrived at the Transfer Formation on the Nine Suns Planet.

Right now, the Nine Mountains Venerate was cultivating in seclusion, so he didn’t have time to bring Ling Han and the others through the galaxy. Thus, Ling Han and the others could only rely on themselves to travel.
Thankfully, the opening of the True Dragon Abyss would need a very long time, so there was no need to worry that it would not make it in time.

The three people and one dog were still travelling at night, and only when their bodies could no longer bear it did they stop to rest and recover. In this manner, they endlessly travelled through the galaxy, and after spending more than three months, they finally arrived at the True Dragon Abyss.
The True Dragon Abyss was on the Heavenly Dragon Planet. This was a damaged great planet, and was located at the borders of the four great Heavenly Realms. It possessed a very special
status.

According to legends, the first and only True Dragon in the world was born here, and was overseer in the heart of the entire galaxy. Thus, the Heavenly Dragon Planet did not belong to any one of the Heavenly Realms.

However, at some point in history, a great battle had erupted here, blasting the Heavenly Dragon Planet into bits, turning it into a damaged planet. At the same time, it also allowed the True Dragon Abyss to appear in the world for the first time.

The True Dragon was an existence that was comparable to the Great Emperor, and dragons were the symbol of great fortune in the first place. Thus, the True Dragon was born here, and died here, as if it had formed a whirlpool of fortune of heaven and earth. Every once in a while, a True Dragon of Fortune would be nurtured.
Of course, this period of time was also astonishingly long, numbering in the tens of millions of years.
And every time the True Dragon Abyss opened, it spoke of a fact.
-The heaven and earth had already prepared themselves to welcome the birth of the next Emperor. This was the greatest significance.
However, looking through history, of all the Ancestral Kings that had been born after the appearance of the True Dragon Abyss, only 50% had ever been to the True Dragon Abyss.
In other words, even if one didn’t obtain the great fortune of the True Dragon Abyss, it actually wouldn’t have any effect on becoming an Emperor.

Because the Heavenly Dragon Planet had already been shattered, it was far worse off than Celestial Sea Planet. There was no longer a sliver of life here, because without the protection of the atmosphere, mortals would not be able to survive at all.
Thus, those who could come here had to be at least in the Foundation Building Tier.

Ling Han, the empress, Hu Niu and the dog didn’t directly arrive at the Heavenly Dragon Planet. Instead, they first arrived at a nearby great planet, then boarded a warship, crossed the galaxy, and arrived at the Heavenly Dragon Planet. For this, they also paid a huge sum of Dao
Stones.
Looking from the galaxy, there was a massive fissure on the Heavenly Dragon Planet, that lay across the entire damaged planet, like an eye that was presently opening.
That was the True Dragon Abyss. When this “eye” was completely open, one could enter.

The warship landed, and Ling Han came out. He saw that this originally barren broken planet was extremely lively. There were people everywhere, and they were all waiting for the True Dragon Abyss to open.

Ling Han and the others kept an extremely low profile-mainly because of Ling Han and the large black dog. It could be said that there were definitely several times more people who wanted to kill them than those who liked them.
In this place, the aura of Venerate Tier would appear and disappear intermittently. In fact, occasionally, there would even be saintly might spreading out.

If the power of a Great Emperor suddenly exploded here, and completely destroyed the Heavenly Dragon Planet, then it could instantly cause the overall level of cultivation of the entire galaxy to decline by tens of thousands of years, or even more.
Now, there were too many prodigies and elites gathered here.

“Low-key! Low-key!” Ling Han and the large black dog encouraged each other. Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t provoke anyone, and the large black dog also suppressed the urge to steal their underpants. The man and dog both hid in a simple tent.
However, how could such provocative beings like them keep a low profile for too long?
“I’d better go out and take a look.”
“That’s right. In any case, we have already changed our appearances, and even our soul fluctuations have changed. We would definitely not be recognized.”
“En, let’s go!”𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

The man and dog walked out boldly just like that. Because there were too many prodigies gathered here, there was no shortage of people with money and treasures. Thus, some people simply set up a stall here.

At the beginning, there had even been an incident of robbery, but this had caused a Saint to speak up, saying that rules had to be observed in all matters. Thus, the whole marketplace became very well-behaved. Even the Imperial Clans dared not act recklessly.
Saints were just that freakish. Their words were as effective as law.

Ling Han strolled around with the large black dog. The large black dog had been holding back for a few days, and instantly turned into a chatterbox, chattering non-stop. There was still quite a lot of good stuff here. In fact, there were a considerable number of high-grade items that had been obtained from ancient ruins. However, no one knew how to use them now, but once they figured it out, the buyers exclaimed that they had made a killing.

Deciding to go was one matter, but how to go was another matter.
Though Ling Han never admitted it, in truth, there were indeed a great many forces that wanted to get rid of him.
There were some that truly had enmity with him, such as the Heaven Wolf Imperial Clan and the Buddhist Sect of the West Heavenly Realm.
There were also those that actually did not have any enmity with him.
They were only wary of his talent, and wanted to kill him.
There had been no Emperor in the world for tens of millions of years.
Theoretically speaking, the door to becoming an Emperor had already been opened.
Any prodigy would be qualified to attempt it, and a freakish guy like Ling Han… would drive a great many people to despair.
Killing Ling Han was equivalent to eliminating a powerful competitor for their own juniors.
He was sure that there would be a great many elites willing to make a move.
Thus, Ling Han had to take it easy.

“There are a total of six True Dragons of Fortune in the True Dragon Abyss, so it’s also divided into six regions, corresponding to the six cultivation levels from Foundation Building Tier to Minor Advanced Tier.
“In other words, Sect Master elites will also participate.
Thankfully, I won’t clash with them head-on.
Otherwise, no matter how lucky I am, if I want to compete with them, the
possibility of me being killed would definitely be higher.”
“The large black dog and I are in the Core Formation Tier.
Of course, we’re entering the territory of the Core Formation Tier.
Luan Xing and Hu Niu are still in the Cauldron Forging Tier, so if we go to the True Dragon Abyss, we’ll definitely be separated.”
“En, they are both Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, and have also mastered a considerable number of Imperial Techniques and Saint Techniques.
Even against an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, they may not be at a disadvantage.”
“Moreover, it’s said that the True Dragon Abyss also contains Great Herbs, as well as inheritances left behind by predecessors.
Even if one can’t obtain the True Dragon of Fortune, there are still many benefits.”
Ling Han discussed with the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog, and decided to set out immediately.
This kind of great fortune was definitely not something that could be obtained through hard cultivation.
Something like fortune was bestowed by the heavens.
If one missed it, it was possible that he would never be able to obtain it again.
Ling Han communicated with the ley lines, and with a twist of Earth Qi, they had already arrived at the Transfer Formation on the Nine Suns Planet.
Right now, the Nine Mountains Venerate was cultivating in seclusion, so he didn’t have time to bring Ling Han and the others through the galaxy.
Thus, Ling Han and the others could only rely on themselves to travel.
Thankfully, the opening of the True Dragon Abyss would need a very long time, so there was no need to worry that it would not make it in time.
The three people and one dog were still travelling at night, and only when their bodies could no longer bear it did they stop to rest and recover.
In this manner, they endlessly travelled through the galaxy, and after spending more than three months, they finally arrived at the True Dragon Abyss.
The True Dragon Abyss was on the Heavenly Dragon Planet.
This was a damaged great planet, and was located at the borders of the four great Heavenly Realms.
It possessed a very special
status.
According to legends, the first and only True Dragon in the world was born here, and was overseer in the heart of the entire galaxy.
Thus, the Heavenly Dragon Planet did not belong to any one of the Heavenly Realms.
However, at some point in history, a great battle had erupted here, blasting the Heavenly Dragon Planet into bits, turning it into a damaged planet.
At the same time, it also allowed the True Dragon Abyss to appear in the world for the first time.
The True Dragon was an existence that was comparable to the Great Emperor, and dragons were the symbol of great fortune in the first place.
Thus, the True Dragon was born here, and died here, as if it had formed a whirlpool of fortune of heaven and earth.
Every once in a while, a True Dragon of Fortune would be nurtured.
Of course, this period of time was also astonishingly long, numbering in the tens of millions of years.
And every time the True Dragon Abyss opened, it spoke of a fact.
-The heaven and earth had already prepared themselves to welcome the birth of the next Emperor.
This was the greatest significance.
However, looking through history, of all the Ancestral Kings that had been born after the appearance of the True Dragon Abyss, only 50% had ever been to the True Dragon Abyss.
In other words, even if one didn’t obtain the great fortune of the True Dragon Abyss, it actually wouldn’t have any effect on becoming an Emperor.
Because the Heavenly Dragon Planet had already been shattered, it was far worse off than Celestial Sea Planet.
There was no longer a sliver of life here, because without the protection of the atmosphere, mortals would not be able to survive at all.
Thus, those who could come here had to be at least in the Foundation Building Tier.
Ling Han, the empress, Hu Niu and the dog didn’t directly arrive at the Heavenly Dragon Planet.
Instead, they first arrived at a nearby great planet, then boarded a warship, crossed the galaxy, and arrived at the Heavenly Dragon Planet.
For this, they also paid a huge sum of Dao
Stones.

That was the True Dragon Abyss.

In this place, the aura of Venerate Tier would appear and disappear intermittently.
In fact, occasionally, there would even be saintly might spreading out.

If the power of a Great Emperor suddenly exploded here, and completely destroyed the Heavenly Dragon Planet, then it could instantly cause the overall level of cultivation of the entire galaxy to decline by tens of thousands of years, or even more.
Now, there were too many prodigies and elites gathered here.
“Low-key!
Low-key!” Ling Han and the large black dog encouraged each other.
Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t provoke anyone, and the large black dog also suppressed the urge to steal their underpants.
The man and dog both hid in a simple tent.

chapters.title: Chapter 4099: Bidding
paragraphs: Chapter 4099: Bidding
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and said, “Hehe, the layer of rust outside is indeed an old thing.”

How smart was the large black dog? He was the ancestor of trickery in the first place, so he immediately understood after hearing Ling Han’s words. He immediately tossed the dagger onto the ground before grabbing the stall keeper and saying, “Good one, you actually dared to trick Grandpa Dog!”
Yi, are you really a dog?

That person spread out his hands and smiled awkwardly. In the first place, doing business here was based on one’s insight. If one had good insight, they could avoid being deceived, or even pick up real treasures. However, it was your own fault for having poor insight, and having bought fake goods, who could you blame?
“Old Black, don’t drop down to his level.” Ling Han waved his hand dismissively.

“Humph, consider yourself lucky!” The large black dog withdrew his hand. He and Ling Han had to keep a low profile now. Otherwise, with his petty nature, how could he possibly let go of someone who wanted to trick him so easily?

Ling Han searched through the stall. Needless to say, the counterfeiting ability of this stall keeper was quite strong. Each item was exuding an ancient aura, but if one looked closely with an eye technique, they were actually all new items deliberately made old. However, their craftsmanship was extremely good, and ordinary people really wouldn’t be able to tell.
He swept an eye over them before withdrawing his gaze. Everything here had been faked, so there was nothing interesting about it.
“Old Black, let’s go.”
“All right!” The large black dog nodded, then glared harshly at the stall keeper as a warning.
They walked, but they had not walked too far when Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks.
“Little Han, what are you doing?” the large black dog asked in confusion.
“Let’s go back.” Ling Han’s expression became serious.
“Yi?” The large black dog faltered for a moment, then looked excited, “Then there really is treasure?”
“I don’t know whether it’s a treasure or not, but I did miss it,” Ling Han said with a nod.
“Let’s go, let’s go.”

The man and dog returned. However, in such a short while, there were already other people watching the stall. They were two men, and they were both very young. They were handsome and energetic, exuding a captivating aura.

One of them was at the Core Formation Tier, while the other was at the True Self Tier. Moreover, he wasn’t just newly advanced into the True Self Tier. He was at the consummate level of the True Self Tier. When Ling Han observed him, he also turned around to glance at him, and his gaze was so piercing that Ling Han felt a little pain.

The other Core Formation Tier cultivator also turned around, and when he saw Ling Han, he was disdainful, because now that Ling Han had disguised himself, he naturally wouldn’t recognize that this was the most popular Galaxy Network celebrity.
The large black dog didn’t care about this. To him, treasure was the most important.
“Make way.” It squeezed through, then said to Ling Han, “Little Han, come and pick.”
Seeing that the two “people” had come again, the stall keeper’s expression involuntarily darkened. ‘You guys are here to cause trouble, right?’

Seeing the large black dog forcefully squeeze in, the other two frowned slightly. That man in the Core Formation Tier had a bad temper, and immediately said, “What’s the rush? Can’t you come back after we leave?”

“What is it? Is this place reserved by you people? Do I have to wait until you’re satisfied before I can come here?” The large black dog immediately retorted. When it came to a matter of principle that involved precious treasures, he naturally would not give in.
What if the treasure was picked up by someone else?
“He!” The Core Formation Tier cultivator was enraged, and he immediately stood up.
“Little Han, there’s room.” The large black dog, and Ling Han took advantage of the opening to fill his position, forcibly pushing the Core Formation Tier cultivator out of the way.
The Core Formation Tier cultivator was instantly enraged. “Who are you two? You even dare to trifle with me, Liu Fang?”

He thought that after announcing his name, Ling Han and the large black dog would definitely feel “respect”, because he was ranked 76th in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network, and it could be claimed that he was inconceivably strong.
However, he immediately discovered in fury that neither Ling Han nor the large black dog paid any attention to him. Instead, they were searching around in the stall.
He was being completely ignored!
“How dare you!” Liu Fang’s eyes were spitting fire.

Young people were hot-tempered in the first place, and he was also a top-notch prodigy that was ranked high on the Galaxy Network. Usually, he was used to being flattered and ingratiated, and now that he was being ignored like this, he immediately felt an urge to make a move.
“Junior Brother!” The True Self Tier cultivator stretched out a hand to block, holding Liu Fang back.
“Senior Brother Tu, don’t stop me. I want to teach them a good lesson!” Liu Fang said angrily.
“Don’t forget the rules here!” the True Self Tier said solemnly. His name was Tu Yang.
Liu Fang shuddered upon hearing this. No matter how proud he was, he couldn’t ignore the words of a Saint.
A single word from a Saint was a law.
He waved his hand angrily, and made up his mind. As long as he left this “market”, he would definitely catch these two people and teach them a good lesson.
Tu Yang, meanwhile, was calm, and communicated through divine sense, “In a while, no matter what he buys, we will raise the bid to compete with them.”
Liu Fang’s eyes instantly lit up. This was indeed a good way to cause trouble for others.
Haha, they had all come from the Holy Land, so which one of them wasn’t rich and imposing?
Have a bidding war with them, humph!
“Little Han, which one is it?” the large black dog also asked through divine sense.

Ling Han had already found his target. That was a Buddha that was about a foot tall. He communicated with the large black dog through divine sense, then said, “Don’t be anxious. I don’t think those two have any good intentions.”

“That’s right. They’re not picky either. They keep staring at Grandpa Dog’s behind, they definitely don’t have any good intentions.” The large black dog nodded, then bared his teeth, “Grandpa Dog knows very well that these two brats have a lot of bad ideas. They must have seen what we wanted to buy, so they will compete over it with us, to disgust us.”
This kind of little trick was left over from Grandpa Dog’s bag of tricks, all right?
“Come, Grandpa Dog will play with them.”
The stall keeper’s forehead was covered with cold sweat. He had really seen weirdos today. Four people were surrounding his stall, yet all of them were silent. Are you guys playing a mime?
“Er, how much is this?” The large black dog suddenly picked up a mirror.
‘Ancestor, you’ve finally made a sound.’

The stall keeper breathed a sigh of relief, but his expression was still strange. ‘Didn’t you f****** just say that it was a fake, and still asked me for a price? Are you deliberately messing with me?’ However, there was still Tu Yang and Liu Fang on the sidelines, so he could not call out too cheap a price.
“A thousand Dao Stones,” he said.
“Alright, I’ll take it.” The large black dog nodded, and did not bargain.
“Wait!” Liu Fang hurriedly stopped him, “I offer 1500. Give me the item.”
The large black dog turned around, and said, “Grandson, Grandpa Dog has already reached an agreement with the stall keeper. Why are you interrupting?”
Grandson?
Liu Fang gritted his teeth, and the flames of fury in his eyes burned even brighter. However, he had not lost his reason. Fighting was not allowed here.
“The highest bidder wins. Don’t you understand this logic?” he said, pretending to be indifferent. Then, he asked the stall keeper, “Don’t you agree?”
Of course. Who would not want to take money given to him freely?
The stall keeper hurriedly nodded, “That’s right. The highest bidder wins.”
He looked at the large black dog with slight anticipation. ‘Come, don’t be reserved. Please increase the bid.’
“Little Han, what do you think about this one?” The large black dog ignored him completely, and pointed at another item.
F***, why didn’t you play by the rules?

chapters.title: Chapter 4100: Trick
paragraphs: Chapter 4100: Trick
The large black dog’s principle was that if he couldn’t take advantage, then no one could. Thus, it definitely wouldn’t raise the price for the stall keeper!
In any case, Liu Fang was already at a disadvantage by offering this price, and it had already enjoyed itself to its heart’s content, so how could the stall keeper enjoy himself further?

Seeing that the large black dog’s battle prowess was so weak, Liu Fang instantly felt as if he had punched cotton. He did not feel any force at all. Instead, he felt very uncomfortable, as if he was about to suffer internal injuries.
“Boss, how much is this?” The large black dog pointed at a bronze mirror again. It had an ancient appearance, and looked to be very old.
“This, 10,000 Dao Stones.” The stall keeper hurriedly tried to save himself.
Initially, he had only planned to ask for 3,000 for this copper mirror, but he could tell that there seemed to be signs of a fight between the two of them. Thus, he could completely ask a high price.
“Oh.” The large black dog placed the bronze mirror back down.
‘F*ck!’
The stall keeper was confused. ‘What do you mean? Ah, is there anyone like you?’
Even Liu Fang was a little confused. What was going on? He had never seen anyone play cards like this.
The large black dog bared his teeth in a grin. ‘You’re still too naive to make use of Grandpa Dog to earn money!’
It picked up another sword, and asked, “What about this?”
The stall keeper somewhat understood, and answered honestly, “A thousand and five hundred Dao Stones.”
“I’ll take it.” The large black dog nodded.
“2000!” Liu Fang said coldly.

The large black dog directly stuffed the sword into his hands, then turned to the stall keeper and said, “Boss, do I count as a trustworthy support of the universe? Remember, I want half of the extra money earned today.”
Is it really good for you to say that?

The stall keeper was extremely embarrassed, and Liu Fang and Tu Yang’s expressions also became very ugly. At first, they had wanted to disgust the other party, but why was it that they were the ones being disgusted now?
Who was this guy? This was practically, practically a f*cking trap.

The large black dog ordered a few more items. At first, Liu Fang even perked up and increased the bid a few times, but afterwards, he finally realized that it was actually the large black dog that was toying with him.
‘F*ck! I’m not bidding anymore! Let’s see what you can do!’
“Oh, then I don’t want it.” The large black dog directly placed the item in his hand back onto the ground.
‘Holy sh*t! Is that even possible?’

The stall keeper was stunned, and so were Liu Fang and Tu Yang. How could there be someone as shameless as you? You had already asked for the price, and said that you were going to buy it. Why did you go back on your word?

“What is it? Grandpa Dog hasn’t paid yet, and you still want to rob me?” The large black dog looked at the stall keeper viciously, “When doing business, you have to behave and do your job, don’t you think so?”

The stall keeper was already unable to speak. However, thanks to the large black dog, he had also earned a small profit. In truth, he was still a little grateful to the large black dog, but there was a deep feeling of awkwardness mixed in.
At this moment, the large black dog finally picked up the Buddha statue and asked Liu Fang, “Boss, how much is this?”
Yi, just ask the price, why are you staring at me?
Do I look so much like a fool?

A muscle twitched in Liu Fang’s cheek. He wanted to hit someone again. Furthermore, previously, if he had only been slightly displeased with Ling Han and wanted to teach him a lesson, then now he really had the intention to kill the large black dog.
F***, he was too despicable.
“Five hundred Dao Stones,” the stall keeper said.
“I’ll buy it,” the large black dog said. Then, he didn’t pay, and just looked at Liu Fang expectantly.
You, you, you… have gone too far!
Liu Fang turned his head away. If he took another look at the large black dog, he would definitely lose control.

Liu Fang and Tu Yang were both startled, but they were also smart people. Otherwise, how could they have cultivated to such a high cultivation level at such a young age? In fact, they had even squeezed into the top hundred of the Galaxy Network?

His target was this Buddha statue. Previously, he was simply trying to divert their attention, and then take advantage of the opening to make a move.
‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’

The large black dog snickered. Pa! With a powerful toss, the Buddha statue instantly crashed into the ground, revealing multiple cracks.

The large black dog was overjoyed. This was definitely what Ling Han had said about seeing
wrongly.

How pretentious!
Whether it was Tu Yang, Liu Fang, or that stall keeper, they could all see very clearly that the large black dog’s act was really too fake. He was not the slightest bit surprised, and was
grinning from ear to ear.
“You dare to trick me!” Liu Fang said darkly. By now, he naturally knew that the large black dog had long since known that there was something inside this Buddha statue, yet still tricked
him into buying a pile of things that he did not need.
Damn it, absolutely damn it.

Moreover, though the Buddha statue was a fake, and had shattered with a few throws, it was a bit unreasonable to say that one fake was used to conceal another fake, wasn’t it? Thus, it was extremely possible that this clay figurine was really some kind of treasure!

With such a discovery, even the stall keeper was shocked. He had indeed found this Buddha statue in a small shop. With his expertise in counterfeiting, he immediately discovered that the Buddha statue was indeed quite old, but it was definitely no treasure.
He deliberately forged some patterns on it so that it would look pricier, so that he could sell it for a high price. Who would have thought that he was the one who had misjudged? As it turned
out, there was a clay figurine inside the Buddha statue!
“I, I’m not selling anymore,” he said, beginning to act shamelessly.
“Sure.” The large black dog kicked the shards of the Buddha statue to him, “Give me back the
500 Dao Stones.”
Er!
The stall keeper was rendered speechless. He was already shameless enough, but he had never thought that he would encounter someone even more shameless.
Ling Han smiled, and said to Tu Yang and Liu Fang, “The two of you, farewell!”
Liu Fang did not speak, but his fists were already tightly clenched. He swore that he would
definitely kill Ling Han and the large black dog, especially that shameless swindler. He would shatter him into ten thousand pieces!
Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t continue to wander around. They were very curious about this clay figure. What was its use?

They left the marketplace, but they had not walked too far, when they saw that Liu Fang had already appeared in front of them, blocking their path, and Tu Yang had cut off their path of retreat. He crossed his arms over his chest, looking disdainful.

Indeed, not only was he in the True Self Tier, but he was also in the consummate level of the True Self Tier. There was absolutely no need for him to take Ling Han and the large black dog seriously. He was far too powerful.

He did not feel any force at all.

“Oh.” The large black dog placed the bronze mirror back down.

The stall keeper was confused. ‘What do you mean?
Ah, is there anyone like you?’

What was going on?
He had never seen anyone play cards like this.
The large black dog bared his teeth in a grin. ‘You’re still too naive to make use of Grandpa Dog to earn money!’
It picked up another sword, and asked, “What about this?”

Who was this guy?

Why did you go back on your word?

Do I look so much like a fool?

He wanted to hit someone again.

F***, he was too despicable.
